rab tu bsam pa'o/ /de ltar dngos po thams cad kyis/ /rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor mthong nas su/ /sa bon 'od zer lcags kyu yis/ /gshin rje gshed bskul 'khor lo dgug /de dang lhan cig 'ongs pa'i bgegs/ /bskrad nas bsrung ①byas khro bo thim/ /bde bas rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /mdun du dmigs la mchod par bya/ /dung gi chu yis bsang gtor dang / /kun das kha bkang chus nye reg /mchod yon snod kyis mchod yon dang / /mtha' sogs dbye bas zhabs bsil lo/ /de bzhin khro bo gzhan bskul bas/ /'od zer gyis ni gzhug pa dang / /bcing dang rjes su dgyes bskyed nga kye/ /chos kyi dbyengs su byin gyis brlab/ /mos pas mig la sogs pa rnams/ /rdo rje gsum ni gnas gsum bkod/ /snga ma bzhin du dbang bskur bas/ /rigs kyi dbang bskur gzhag lgopa'o/ /sangs rgyas bzhi po mi bskyod pa/ /lha mo rang rang bdag pos brgyan/ /rnam snang mi bskyod snang mtha' yas mi bskyod sgo srung mtshan ma'o 5/ /sa bon 'od kyis lha mo bkug /zhal zhugs zhu gyur rdo rjer bye phyung / /pad nang lo oṃ paṃ tai dang / /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥskyekhaṃ ram̐ gyur/ /de yi 'od kyis bcu po dgug /rang rang sa bon la zhugs pas—/ /nus dang ldan par rab byas nas/ /shes rab ba spu'i bu gar spro/ /'od rtse gzugs rdo rje sogs ni/ /rang rang mtshan mas rnam mdzes pa'i/ /dri med rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sku/ /sgyu ma lta bur spro bar bya/ /de bzhin phyi yi gdugs la thusogs/ /'od rtse las spro nam mkha'i 7(khams/ /bkang ste bdag dang 'khor lo la/ /mchod par byas te tremachod pa dang / /mchod pa po dang mchod gnas gsum/ /rmi lam lta bur shes bya'i phyir/ /tha dad 22—589

las ni grol byas lhanas/ /sngags kyis byin gyis brlab par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa yis ko33 haṃ/ de nas brag ca'i sgra lta bur/ /sgra yul thams cad rab bsams nas/ /rdo rje dril bu bde dbyangs kyis/ /rang nyid lha yis 1bstod par bsgom/ /mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /gsang ba'i dbyings jel phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dga' chen po/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/ /rang bzhin kyis ni 'od gsal mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med—/ /dngos nyid dag pas gos pa med/ /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtogs khye7nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dag pa rdo rje gdon mi za/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /rang bzhin dag pa nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rlung dang me yi dkyil 'khor nas/ /pad+ma bhan+dhar bdud rtsi lnga/ /zla ba nyi mar yi ge lnga/ /bsams nas 'od zer spro bya'o/ /rtag sogs bkug nas sa bon dgug(ce /bzhu zhing bskol bas rlangs nas hūṃ7/ /de byung rdo rje zhu byas nas/ /phreng ba'i rgyun du dbab par bya sgo / /oṃ gyis bsil bar byas nas su/ /lha rnams phyag tu spros rngubyas la/ /lce hūṃ ⑫las byung rdo rje bkod/ /snying zla'i 'khor lo tshim par bya/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal ba mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /ye shes sems dpa'i thugs 'od kyis/ /thub pa'i dbang pos kun rtog spangs/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas nyid byas nas/ /sa bon la ni thim par bya/ /thugs 22—590

ka'i mtshan ma nang gnas pa/ /nyi ma'i dbus kyi yi ge hūṃrmye/ /'od zer rnam pa lnga ldan pa'i/ /tsa na'i 'bru tsam thig ler bsam/ /de yi 'od kyis gnas la sogs/ /rdo rje mchog gsum gsal byas nas/ /bzhag ste thig le lta bu ru/ /rang gi sems nyid zhugs par bya/ /de ma thag tu ting 'dzin gsum/ /grub pa rab tu bsam byas nas/ /de yi gsum pa las spro zhing / /thig le yan chad gsal bar bya/ /gzhan kyepa ba spu las spro zhing / /dkyil 'khor rten la sogs pa nas/ /khams kun bkang nas mtha' la bsdu/ /de rim thuyang ni spro bsdu bya//yang ni sa bon 'od kyis ni/ /bde gshegs dgug ④gzhug zhu gyur nas/ /rdo rje'i thulam nas phyung nas su/ /ze'u 'bru bum pa'i nang du dbab/ /de las rdo rje mthing ga che/ /nas tshad lte bar rin po che/ /yungs kar tshad tsam dbus su yang / /rten bcas ting 'dzin gsum po bsgom/ /rdo rje rtse lnga lcags kyu yis / /phyung ste sna rtser gnas par bya/ /rdo rje nang nas thur sel rlung / /phyung ste gnas bya rnam pa gzhan/ /'di yi nying 'dzin gsum pa las/ /spro bsdu gong ma bzhin du bya/ /de la bzung bas stobs ldan na/ /brtan pa'i mtshan ma skye bar 'gyur/ /de skyes sprul pa 'phro ba ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs phyag mtshan rnams/ /yang nas yang du spro bsdu bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje dang / /ye shes sems dpa'i sa bon las—/ /gsang sngags bzlas brjod spro byed pa/ /rim pa'am ni cig car bya/ /oṃ sogs re re brjod skad cig /sku rdo rje la sogs 'khor lo/ /spros pas nam mkha'i khams bkang nas/ /yan lag bcu gnyis gsum ldan mos/ /oṃ sogs re re brjod skad cig /ma bskul gnyis dang gong ma ltar/ /dang pos 22—39/

phyung ste nam mkha' la/ /bkod nas gnyis pa gong ma ltar/ /mchod pa'i lha mo spro byas nas/ /'khyud pa'i bde bas thub dbang rnams/ /bde chen dbang du gyur byas la/ /gsum pas nang du thim par bya/ /rdo rje dang ni gsal ba dang / /lam byung chos kyi 'khor lo las/ /steng du g.yas g.yon gnyi ga las/ /drag dang dal bar shes par bya/ /'byung ba hūṃ ste 'jug pa oṃ/ /gnas pa āḥste de nyid bzung / /ye shes sa bon ngo bo ste/ /gzhi rnams gcig tu brtsi bar bya / /nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga las/ /bzhi bsdus brgya phrag dgu nyid do/ /de ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi rim 1/ /nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'o/ /phra myur rnams kyis ngal ba bsal/ /spyan sogs glu yis bskul byas nas/ /sngon bzhin 'khor lo mchod bya ste/ /sems kyi gzengs ni bstod bya ste/ /nyam chung spyi bor mtho gang tshad/ /zla steng oṃ gyi snebarlan pa yi/ /bdud rtsi cho ga bzhin phab pas/ /rdo rje gsum sogs tshim par bya/ /baṃ rngo las byung ba'i bum pa bzang zla gam phyed kyis ④kha bcad pa/ /thigs pa yid bzhin rin po ches/ /brgyan pa rkan gyi dbus su bsgom/ /'od zer lnga ni rab 'bar ba'i/ /oṃ ni lce yi rtse la bsam / /de gzer rim pas dbab byas pas/ /nus dang ldan pas bkres skom 5gzhom/ /bkres skom khul sogs nyon mongs la/ /rnal 'byor de ni kun brtsams nasamu/ /rdo rje thugs kyi bka' bzhin du/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur/ /cung zad ngal sos snayul gzhan 'gro/ /gong mi'i cho gas brtan bya'i phyir/ /rdo rje gsum sngags ma zhen par/ /gsang sngags bzlas brjod yang bya'o/ /ldang bar 'dod na sngags pa yis tsusna/ /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang byas la/ /oṃ s+dzahūṃ 7nyid brjod byas la/ /de nyid gsum la 22—592

'khor lo bsdu/ /las kyi rgyal ba mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa yiḥ/ /rig pa'i lta ba ma thob pa'i sems can thugs rjes gzung pya ba'i phyir/ /smon lam 'di ni sngon du bya/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i mi bskyod mgon/ /rnal 'byor gyis thob dge ba gang / /bde chen ye shes rang byung nas/ /sems can kun mkhyen sar 'god shog /gang zhig 'di mthong 'dod pa'am/ /gang zhig zhu bar 'dod pa des/ /thugs kyi dbang phyug grangs med pa/ /mgon po de ni mthong bar shog /nam mkha' mtha' klas phyogs bcu ru/ /sems can kun gyi don spyod la/ /ji ltar thugs kyi dbang phyug bzhinazhu/ /bdag gis kyang ni spyod par shog /ji srid thog ma med pa nas/ /'khor ba yi ni mthar thug par/ /de srid sems can phan pa nyid—/ /sangs rgyas spyod pa bdag spyod shog /ji srid sangs rgyas sna tshogs rnams—/ /'jig rten bshes gnyen mya ngan 'das/ /de yi bstan pa'i don du ni/ /bskal pa'i bskal par byed par shog /rdo rje 'chang sogs gzugs kyis ni/ /bdag gis phyogs bcur sprul gyur cig /sngags kyi tshul gyis sems can rnams/ /de tshe bdag gis 'dul gyur cig /ting 'dzin las ni langs nas ni/ /lha yi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ /spyod yul sems tsam shes byas la/ /rang gi lha yi gzugs su dmigs/ /yang na spyod yul de dag nyid/ /rang rang dag pas gnas pa'o/ /so so rang rig chos nyid pas/ /rnam snang mdzad la sogs par snang / /yang na rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /rang yid dga' bar byed pa'i phyir/ /dbugs rtog spangs nas rab bsgoms nas④/ /gsang ba chen po mchod pa'o/ /rang gi kha zas za dus su/ /snying khar 'khor lo rab 22—593

bsgoms la/ /bdud rtsi sha yi sbyor ba yis/ /gong ma lta bur sbyang byas te/ /de nyid gsum ni bzlas byas te/ /lce dang dbu rgyan mchog bsgom ①la/ /lha rnams ma lus tshim pa yi/ /bsam pas nang gi sbyin sreg bya/ /phyi rol sbyin sreg dpag pa tsam/ /ye shes me ni 'bar byed pas/ /phung sogs blun pa'i bud shing bsregarngu /bla na med par bshad pa'o/ /ji skad gsungs pa'i sdom par ldan/ /ji ltar myong bar mnyam par spyod/ /blo dang ldan pas dam med lakye / /dus rig byas la gsang bar bya/ /snying rjer gnas pas las gnyis byed/ /'gro ba'i don dang sangs rgyas mnyes/ /lus ngag tha mal khyad par can/ /phyag rgya sngags kyi bdag nyid do/ /chos can gcig la rtog ④pa ni//sna tshogs rnam par snang ba yin/ /sdug bsngal bde ba gol 'byung ba/ /las kyi khyad par mang gyur yin/ /de k+shir dge dang mi dge'i las/ /lus la sogs pa'i rtog las byung / /kun rtog thams cad las grol ba/ /nag po'i las snyesu ga la 'gyur/ /dam tshig nyams pa bskang don du/ /don yod rdo rje sbyor bsgom stekhya/ /thugs ka'i zla bar khaṃ bskyed pa'i/ /sna tshogs rdo rje bsam (1par bya/ /gzugs sogs nam mkha' bzhin dag nas/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal sems bskyed de/ /bskul ba sngon ༷du 'gro ba yisaspu/ /dbang bskur byas pas dag par bya/ /bla ma brnyas pa'i skyon byung na/ /yon dang rko ldan pa'i ston mo dbul/ /sdig bshags la sogs sngon 'gro ba'i/ /sdom pa bzung bas bskang bar bya/ /phyi yi khrus kyi cho ga la/ /rang gi rnal 'byor dmigs byas nas / /dbang bskur gong ma bzhin bsgoms nas/ /mtha' ru bdag po gzhag /— pa'o/ /de ltar nyin phyed dus dang ni/ /phyi 'byed 7du yang bsgom 22—594

par bya/ /nam phyed dus su sa bon nas/ /bzlas pa'i dus su /rmyebaskyed par bya//gshegs su gsol 'dod sngags pa yis/ /mchod pa bstod pa bdud rtsi myang / /byas nas mtha' ru mu bzhag pa'i/ /yi ge gsum gyis gshegs su gsol/ /de bzhin yi ge gsum brjod pas/ /ye shes sems dpa'i 'khor lo la/ /phyi rol 'khor lo bcug byas te/ /shes rab snying rje ldan pas nyal/ /ldang ba'i dus na lha mo yi/ /dbyangs kyis bskul bsam langs nas su/ /sngon bzhin dus bzhir ting 'dzin gsum/ /rtse gasbug pa yis thams cad bsgom/ /brel ba bcad ༄ bhepa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /dus dang por ni ting 'dzin gsum/ /ma lus par ni bsgom byas la/ /yan lag rnams ni sngon bzhin bsam/ /de las gzhan pa'i dus dag tu/ /glo bur rang gi lha bzhengs la/ /thugs las 'khor lo spro byas la/ /dbang bskur ba ni sngon bzhin blang / /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang byas la/ /thig le'am yang na phra mo'am/ /sngags kyi bzlas brjod yang byas nas/ /'khor lo bsdu ba sngon bzhin brtsam/ /de ltar zhugs pa rnam pa gnyis / /rang gi lam gyi mi mthun phyogs/ /bzlog pas brtan pa'i rtags rnyed pas/ /las dang po yi rnal 'byor ro/ /de yis sgu la dmigs pa yis/ /man ngag thob pas ye shes che/ /'be+ebs thob rang dang gzhan mthong na/ /cung zad ye shes dbang gyur pa'o/ /dus bzhir 4mig dang lus sogs rnams/ /byin rlabs dbang bskur rab byas nas/ /mchod pa sogs kyis mnyes byas la/ /bzlas brjod sbyor ba brtsam pa'o/ /sngon bzhin du ni bsdu byas nas/ /sdom pa bskyang sogs snga ma bzhin/ /rgyun du goms rlabs 5bcu dang gcig /mthu chen stobs rtogs des dmigs so7/ /de yi gsung la dmigs pa yis/ /22—595

rlung gi rang bzhin rtogs mdzad nas/ /bdag dang gzhan gyis dkyil 'khor mthong / /ye shes dbang du gyur pa'o/ /de la nyin mtshan rgyun du'am/ /yi ge gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin/ /kun du spyod las chos thams cad/ /dbyer med gong bzhin snyen hūṃbyed do/ /'di yi —snaphyag rgya chen po yi/ /bsgrub pa'i mtshan ma gsum mthong nas/ /brtul zhugs la sogs rim 'di yis/ /sems dmigs rdo rje 'chang ba thob/ /'di las gzhan pa bcu bzhi yi/ /bsnyen pa'i cho ga 'di bzhin te/ /rang rang lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /'og nas 'byung ba'i don brtson bya/ /de yan chad ni sngon zudu bsnyen pa bya ba'i cho ga rgyas par bshad zin to// //da ni slob ma rnams la dbang bskur ba'i cho ga bshad par bya'o/ /de la gang gis dbang bskur zhe na/ dang por zhugs dang dang po pa/ /thams cad kun gyi slob dpon no/ /cung zad ye shes dbang gyur pa/ /nus dang ldan pa'i slob dpon no/ /ye shes dbang du gyur pa ni/ /sbyor ba rnyed pa'i slob dpon no/ /de rnams ci rigs mnyes byas nas/ /de yis dkyil 'khor brtsam pa'o/ /gang dag gi don du zhe na/ dad ldan gtong phod brtson 'grus ldan / /snod rung srog la mi lta ba/ /tshe 'dir dngos grub thob 'dod pas/ /gnyis sam gsum gyi bar du zhus/ /sku gzugs bris dang lder so dang / /glegs bam rdo rje la sogs dang / /mchod rten la sogs gnas pa'i phyir/ /gnyis sam gsum gyi bar du zhus/ /gang dag sdig pa'i las dbang gis/ /mngon du'am rmi lam dag tu ni/ /lha 'khrug pa yis chomatshan ma mthong / /22—596

gnyis sam gsum gyi bar du zhus/ /mos dang 1brtan la dad pa can/ /gzhan la phan dga' mthong nas ni/ /ma zhus kyang ni de bos la/ /phan 'dod phyir ni dkyil 'khor brtsamaṭu// /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bum pa'i dbang gis rab sbyor bas/ /sa brgyad pa ru yang dag gnas/ /gang dag gsang ba'i dbang gis ni/ /dgu pa dang ni bcu par byed/ /shes rab ye shes dbang gis ni/ /rdo rje lta bur rab gnas pa'ikye / /'bras bu 'byung bar nus mthu ldan—/ /dang po bzhi par shes par bya/ /rab gnas ma byas gzugs brnyan la / /thal bar brlag kyang 'bras bu med/ /sngags dang bral ba'i sbyin sreg bzhin—/ /lus nyon mongs pa kho nar zad/ /de bas ji srid gnas pa'i bar//mchod pa'i rten du rung bya dang / /'khor los sgyur ba bzhin te dag /byin gyis brlab phyir brtsam pa'o/ /sngon ④bsags sdig pa dpag med rnams/ /skad cig gis ni zad byed pa/ /dkyil 'khor zhugs dang dbang bskur ba/ /de yis rab tu byed pa nas/ /ye shes kyis kyang 'debs pa yi/ /cho ga zab mos sdig pa zad/ /mtshan ma'i 'bras bu mi 'byung zhing / /gong gi yon tan ldan par mdzad/ /thabs ji ltar zhe na/ bdag nyid chen po de la gong du smos pas zhu ba gsol ba dang / khyod kyis spro bya rnams tshogs sam dri bar bya'o/ /des kyang kha cig ni tshogs/ kha cig ni ma tshogs zhes gsol nas/ 'dzab bzlas pa bya'o/ /'phral du dben par 'dug nas ni/ /lha yi 'khor lo bsgom byas la/ /tshogs 'phel bgegs ni zhi ba'i phyir/ /sngags kyi bzlas brjod byas pa yin/ /de nyid gsum par yi ge gzhug /yang na dbyung ba bar du gzhug /sgrub pa de'am phreng sngags sam/ /rig pa dang bcas bzla bar bya//22—597

du ma rab tu bzla ba'am/ /'khor bdag 'bum ste rang lha'i 'bum/ /gzhan dag khri phrag bzla byas tekye/ /bsam mam dngos su bka' thob bri/ /gsum pa bsrungs nas 'dzab bya ba/ /cho ga bzhin te rang gis sam/ /sbyor ba dag gis 2dag byas nas/ /ri mo'i dkyil 'khor bri ba brtsam —/ /lha khang grang ④ngam skyed tshal gyi/ /byang shar mtshams ni ji lta bar/ /shar dang byang du dma' ba yi/ /mkhas pas sa ni btsal bar bya/ /der ni bcags pyenas sa brkos byute/ /lhag 'gyur yang na 3rdzing 'dra ba/ /chus bkang mi g.yo g.yas su 'khyel/ /ma rung 'u'akhyel pa'i phur bus gzhom/ /der ni sa bdag phyogs skyong ba/ /phyogs su bskyed nas sngon bzhin du/ /gtor ma byin brlabs tsho dbul byas nas/ /sa gsol byas nas gshegs su gsol/ /ting 'dzin rim pa gsum pos ni/ /dkyil 'khor la byesogs sta gon nas 11/ /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba dang / /gtor ma yon dang phyi mchod 'bul/ /sbyin sreg gis ni tshim byas nas/ /gsol ba btab ste nam mkha' la/ /khung bu brko ba'i ched du yang / /byin gyis brlab phyir dgod par bya/ /las kyi rdo rje slob ma yis/ /lto 'phye brtags nas 'jor gyis klog /mgrin pa lte ba pus mo tsam/ /dngos grub rim pas brko bar bya/ /tho bas bong ba dag dkrugs nas/ /zhib mor btags 7nas btsags nas su/ /shis pa'i phyir dang dge ba'i phyir/ /rin chen 'bru sman nang du gzhug /de steng sa gtsang gzhan las kyang / /stegs bu khru gang dpangs kibartsigs nas/ /dam tshig lnga yis rab byugs te/ /steng rgyan sogs pas mdzes par bya/ /rang gi lha yi rnal 'byor ram/ /yang na bgegs dgra'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /dbang bskur blangs nas ngabagegs kyi 22—598

tshogs—/ /bskrad pas nang nyid dag par bsam hūṃ/ /oṃ bhu khaṃ gi sngags kyis ni/ /mkha' la ri rab bskyed par bya/ / hūṃ lo hūṃ gruzhes rdo rje'i bdag /sa gzhir byas nas brtan par bya/ /oṃ mi di nī badzi bha rngub ban+dha hūṃ④/ sngon bzhin srung ⑤ba'i 'khor lo nas/ /rjes chags mtha' yi tsasbyor dang po/ /dkyil 'khor phyung ste mnyes mdzad pa/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal ba mchog bdag nyid/ /'khor lo gong dang 'og las byed/ /las kyi rgyal mchog sbyor bdag nyid/ /de yi dbang phyug mgon po ni/ /ting 'dzin gsum gyi mchog gyur yin/ /dpa' bo rdo rje dril 'dzin pas/ /thams cad dang ni bdag mnyam mo/ /rang bzhin kyis ni bdag dag go/ /rdo rje'i bdag nyid nga rgyal bskyed/ /'khor lo'i ⑦dbus su gnas pa la/ /rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa yi/ /rtag sogs las kyi rdo rje yis—/ /mchod nas 5dkyil 'khor gsol ba gdab/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi chos/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan nyid med pa thams cad spangs/ /kun du bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhi ba'i chos mchog yang dag byung / /ye shes spyod yul rnam spyod pa/ /kun du bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag pas dri ma med/ /kun du bzang po thugs kyi mchog/dkyil 'khor snying po bshad du gsol/ /mi bskyod rdo rje khros byas nas/ /ma dang ṭa las rang gi mig /nyi zlar bskyed nas mig 'bras hūṃ/ /rdo rje las spyos sprul par bya/ /rkang mthil haṃ las rdo rje bskyed/ /g.yas pa rdo rje g.yon 22—599

pa dril/ /'gying bag mche gcigs hūṃ lkubarjod cing / /phyogs kun 'bar bar blta bar bya/ /g.yas brkyang g.yon brkyang zlum po dang / /sa ga bzhi ste mi bskyod pa'i/ /rnal 'byor gyis ni phyogs bzhi ru/ /dang por rab tu brtsam pa'o—/ /khro bo re res drug drug tu/ /phyogs bcu rnams su brtsams byas pas /'khor los bgegs kyi tshogs rnams ni/ /bskrad par gdon mi za bar 'gyur/ /rus sbal stobs rtedang rdo rje gar dang rdo rje hūṃ sgra/ /lcags kyu thabs dang ting 'dzin thabs dang mtha' yas thabs/ /gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis gnas nas—/ /shar gyi phyogs su rnal 'byor pas bya'o/ /rdo rje gdengs pa dang ni rdo rje 'jigs su rung ba dang / /ral gri thabs dang phub kyi tshul dag dang / /rdo rje skyil krung rnam par rgyal ba'i thabs/ /shes rab mthar byed kyis ④3ni lho phyogs brtsamalte/ /rdo rje 'joms tshul dang ni rdo rje ro langs dang / /rdo rje thabs dang mdung gi thabs dag dang / /pad+mo'i 'dug stangs gsus po che yi thabs / /rta mgrin gyis ni nub kyi phyogs su brtsam/ /rkang pa ya gcig stangs dang rdo rje tho ba dang / /'khor lo'i thabs dang sems dpa'i kyeskyil krung dang / /sprin sgra dang ni gzhu yi thabs dang ni/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pas byang phyogs nas brtsam mo/ /seng ge thabs dang rdo rje gdu bu dang / /ba dan thabs dang thag mdung bskor ba'i thabs/ /bzang po'i 'dug stangs phur bu brdung ba yi/ /shar lho'i mtshams su 'dod pa'i rgyal pos brtsam seng ge glal dang bud med sgyu 'phrul thabs/ /zhags pa'i thabs dang mchod spyin pa yi thabs—/ /tsog bu'i 'dug stangs dang ni ra ba'i thabs/ /lho nub mtshams nas dbyug pa sngon pos brtsam/ /rdo rje sgrog dang stobs po che gdengs dang / /22—600

pad+mo'i stabs dang mtshon rtse gcig pa'i thabs/ /rtse ba'i thabs dang mtshams bcing lha/pa yi thabs/ /nub byang mtshams dang stobs bo ches brtsam mo /bung ba 'phur stabs zhal bzhir byin brlabs dang / /gtun shing thabs dang mda' 'phangs pa yi thabs/ /dpa' bo 'dug stangs bkra shis rgyal mtshan stangs//byang shar mtshams nas mi g.yo mgon pos brtsamanya/ /rdo rje gsor ba dang ni rdo rje mche ba dang / /be+e con thabs dang thag pa'i 'khor lo'i thabs/ /phyir 'gyed pa dang phyogs bcing ba yi thabs/ /steng gi phyogs nas 'khor los stisgyur bas brtsam/ /rdo rje sgeg pa dang ni rdo rje gad mo dang / /mi 'jigs pa yi thabs dang phyag 'tshal ba yi thabs/ /phur bus gnas lngar gdab dang mtshon cha lnga yi thabs/ /'og gi phyogs nas gnod mdzes kyis brtsam mo/ /de rnams kyis ni bgegs kyi tshogs/ /ru tra'i chobi bo sha na dang / /tshangs pa'i srin po phyegaza' phur bu/ /gtso bo drug cu rtsa bzhi smrod/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bdag la gson/ /bdag ni dpal ldan ⑪rdo rje 'dzin/ /bka' yi 'khor lo rab spyor bas/ /gal te gang gis bdag bka' 'goms/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzugs 'di yis/ /'dod gsum bskyed lus bshig byed de/ /'jigs byepar 'gyur gyi gzhan du min/ /bgegs bsal bya phyir phur bu yang / /stod ni khro bo smad zur gsum/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil par bsams nas su/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su gdab par bya/ /oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭan phaṭa/ tī la ya khri la ya/ sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ snyebadz+ra tī la ya/ badz+ra dha ro ādzñā 9pa ya ti/ kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra shī la ya hūṃ sbyi phaṭa/ de las 'od zer 'khrugs shing 'bar/ /phyogs bcu bdud 22—601

bcom be+er 'dus nas/ /mtshams dang ra ba gur bcing bas/ /dkyil 'khor sa ni srung ba'o/ /sa gnon phyag rgyas sa la mnan/ /sa yi lha mo bton gyur nas/ /me tog sogs pas mchod nas ni/ /sbran phyir gsol ba gdab par bya/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyisasti/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi⑩/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang por gsol/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi stobs bcom pa/ /de ltar bdag gis bdud bcom nas/ /dkyil 'khor kun du bri bar bya/ /de skad gsol nas zhal gyis bzhes/ /de nyid du ni thim par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid kyis ni bsang ga gtor sogs/ /byas nas de ru nyal bar bya/ /mtshan mo gnyis pa'i cha dang por/ /dri zhim sogs kyis rab bskus rgya la/ /me tog sil ma la sogs bkram/ /tsan+dan mchog sogs maṇ+ḍal bya/ /de ru ting nge 'dzin gsum mam/ /yang na lhag par mos pa yis/ /rten dang bcas pa dam tshig gi//dkyil 'khor rab tu dgod par bya/ /de nas bdag nyid spro bskyed la/ /ye shes 'khor lo bkug nas ni/ /byin brlabs mchod dang bstod pa dang / /bdud rtsi myang bas mnyes par bya/ /bum pa nag nog med pa la/ /mchu 'phyang zhabs ni brtan pa dang / /rdo rje'i chus byugs 3nyi shu gcig /yang na drug tu sta gon bya/ /mgul pa dar gyi cod pan mtshan/ /a mra la sogs kha rgyan can/ /spos bsreg hūṃdri zhim chu yis bkang / /rang rang sngags kyi 3 bzlas pa'o/ /'bru lnga sman lnga rin chen lnga/ /'khor lo dri chu yon snod bsdu/ /mtshan ma lnga yis brgyan pa yi8/ /rnam rgyal bum pa bdag pos bzla3 / /rdo rje pad+mas btsir nas su/ /me tog dkar po de ru gtor/ /bdag gis slob ma 22—602

thams cad la/ /dbang bskur mdzod cig gsol ba gdab/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil bzlas bum pa la/ /ku sha'i be+em lhapor bcas pa yis/ /bdag gis lduslob ma thams cad la/ /bgegs bzlog gsol zhes snyan gsan dbab1/ /de rnams byin gyis brlabs rngubyas la/ /thun gsum gtor ma phul nas kyang / /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang byas la/ /so so'i sngags kyis mnyes par bya/ /'khor lo sngon bzhin mchod byas la/ /lag par pog por ⑤thogs nas su/ /pus mo btsugs nas thal sbyar bas/ /dkyil 'khor sogs la snyan gsan dbab//bcom ldan mi bskyod rdo rje yi/ /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdag gis snying rje'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /mgon po bri bar 'dod pa ste/ /slob ma rnams la phan phyir dang / /khyed la mchod pa'i don du ni/ /de bas bcom ldan gus bdag la/ /byin rlabs gnang bar mdzad par rigs/ /dgongs shing bdag la sangs rgyas dang / /'gro ba'i 'khor lo don byed rnams/ /'bras gnas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /gang zhig gzhan yang sngags kyi lha//lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /'byung po byang chub ston pa rnams/ /sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba'i/ /gang zhig rdo rje'i ming can rnams/ /che ge bdag ni rdo rje che/ /dkyil 'khor byang chub sems 'byung ba/ /ji ltar nyer spyod nus pa yis/ /'gro dag don du bri bar bya/ /slob ma dang bcas bdag la ni/ /thugs rjes nye bar bzung nas ni/ /tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /snyan gsan lan gsum du gsol nas/ /mchod pa la sogs rab sbyar nas/ /mtshams la sogs pa bcings nas ni/ /phyi rol byung nas slob ma gzung khu/ /shes rab 22—603

chen po dga' chen po/ /nga rgyal med cing drin lan shes/ /rigs ldan yon tan dad pa che/ /gzugs mdog gzhon pas brgyan pa'o/ /gsang sngags kyi ni grub pa mchog /'dod pa rab tu ldan 'gyur na/ /dman pa'i rigs dang byad ngan dang / /yon tan med kyang gzung bar bya/ /slob dang yid ches dad ldan dang / /theg chen dga' ba'i bdag nyid dang / /dkyil 'khor mthong dang sngags 'grub 'dod/ /tshogs 'phel phyir ni 'khor lor gzung rmye// /snod ldan 'khor ni bzhi po dang / /'di dang pha rol bsod nams 'dod/ /snod dang snod min rab bsgrags la/ /bdag nyid rang gi nang du 'gro/ /ting 'dzin rdo rje chu skyes kyis/ /sbyang /thuba'i slob mas khang pa'i sgor/ /thal mo sbyar ba byas nas ni/ /tshig 'dis gsol ba lan gsum —gdab/ /ston chen khyod la bdag dga' bo/ /brtan 5po byang chub chen po'i lam/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'dod de/ /de nyid dam tshig bdag la stsol/ /bdag la byang chub sems kyang stsolaphye/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /skyabs su 'gro ba bdag la stsol/ /thar chen khang pa brtsegs pa ru/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug par mdzod/ /de ltar brjod pas bla ma yi/ /slob ma gcig ni gtsor byas nas/ /de sogs rnams la tshig 'di yis/ /gzhug phyir brod pa bskyed par bya/ /bu tshur shog cig theg chen gyi/ /cho ga sngags kyi spyod pa'i tshul/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /tshul chen khyed kyis bsten par gyis/ /sangs rgyas dus gsum las byung ba/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /gzhal med ye shes thob pa ni/ /rdo rje sngags kyi don bsgom 6yin/ /ci phyir dpag med sngags rnal 'byor/ /shākya seng ge sogs rab kyis/ /drag po chen po 22—604

bdud kyi tshogs/ /dpung chen de dag gzhom byas nas/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs nas su/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de phyir blo ldan bu khyod kyis/ /thams cad mkhyen pa thob par gyis/ /de ltar bgyi zhes der 'dug nas/ /bla mas tshig gis byang chub sems/ /ma bskyed pa ni bskyed par bya / /bskyed pa yin na 'phel bar bya/ /sdig pa bshags pa rjes yi rang /bsngo dang gsol ba skyabs 'gro dang / /byang chub sems bskyed lam bstan h+pha7dang / /smon lam gdab pa sngon 'gro bya/ /'khyil bzlas bsrungs nas gnas gsum du/ /'khor lo rdo rje pad+ma las/ /oṃ hūṃ ra āḥni bkab byas la/ /rdo rje khu tshur dri chus byug /spyi bor me tog mdun du spos/ /mar me dri ni snying ga ru / /las kun byed pa'i sngags bzlas nas/ /mchod pa'i don du sbyin par bya / /a shwat+tha dang u dum bāragye/ /me tog rtse mo desor bcu gnyis/ /drang po dri zhim gyis byugs pa/ /dngos grub ltas 6phyir sbyin par bya/ /ha cang ring min thung ba min/ /ku sha sngon po 'bus ma zos/ /rmi lam mi 'khrug 7bkra shis phyir/ /nyag ma gnyis ni sbyin par bya/ /sum bsgril mdud pa gsum byas laresna / /'khyil pa'i sngags bzlas pho yi 9g.yon/ /mo yi dpung pa g.yas pa ru//bsrung ba bya phyir bcing bar bya/ /'khyel bzlas chu gtsang skyor chu yisarka/ /kha bshal lan gsum 'thung bcug ste/ /byin chags gtsang bar bya ba dang / /ngag gi nyes pa sbyang phyir sbyin/ /oṃ tweḥ nyu1bi shudhe sarba dharma bo so da sa bo kalpa a na ya hūṃskye/ phyir mi ldog dbang dkyil 'khor la/ /byen nas mgon po bdag la gsungs/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi de nyid dang / /slob dpon gyi ni phrin las dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /gsang ba mchog gi sdom pa 22—605

rnams—/ /rtag tu dbang gi slob dpon bgyid/ /sems can kun don byed phyir stsol/ /de nas bla mas thun mong sdom/ /byin nas slob ma de yis kyang / /rig dbang thob phyir lan gsum du/ /bka' sprul de ni blang bya'o/ /kun mkhyen gang du 'jig rten du/ /bde bar 'byung ngam 1 mi 'byung ba/ /u dum bā ri —ra'i me tog bzhin/ /gal te brgya lam brgya 1'ga' 'byung / /bde cho bas thob dka' 'byung ba ni/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'di ni/ /ci phyir dpag med sems can don/ /bla na med pa byed nus pa/ /sa yang bskal pa du ma yi/ /snod 5du byas pa'i sdig pa gang / /de kun zad par 'gyur ba yin//dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong bas so/ /gang gzhung mtha' yas grags pa yi/ /sngags kyi spyod pa la gnas nas/ /bla med go 'phang phyin pa ni/ /sngags bzlas pa las skye ba'o/ /gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gos gtan du mi g.yo ba/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /ngan 'gro de dag gis gcod do/ /de ring dpag med rnyed pa ni/ /bdag chen khyed rnams kyis thob ste / /sras bcas rgyal ba kun gyis kyang / /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ /thams cad yongs su bzung gnas pa'i/ /skye bar gyur pa bdag chen gyi6 / /de phyir khyed kyis bdag chen la/ /bde ba skye bar 'ong 'gyur cig /dpal ldan mchog gi theg pa 'di/ /chen por 'byung ba theg chen po/ /gang gis khyed chag 'gro 'gyur ba/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams 'ong 'gyur la/ /zhal bzang khyed ni de ring 'ongs/ /sang ni 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor che7/ /mthong dka' nga yi thugs rje yis/ /spyod kyis mthong bar 'gyur ba'o/ /kye bu dag nyon cig do nub ni/ /seng ge nyal stabs bzhin du nyol/ /khyod kyis rmi 22—606

lam dge mi dge /mthong ba tho rangs bdag la thrus/ /de ltar bgyi zhes rab gsol nas/ /de dag nyal bcug 'khyil pa yi/ /sngags bzlas dri chu byugs nas su/ /srung ba byas te gnas par bya/ /lhag par mos pas dkyil 'khor dmigs / /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang byas te/ /bsdu zhing ye shes 'khor lo ni/ /kha sbyar dbus su mkha' la bzhag /tho rangs langs nas shar bltas te / /so shing 'chos nas steng du bsgyur/ /ba lang ko tsam maṇ+ḍal la/ /zhi ba la sogs grub par lta1/ /sbyin dang srung ba la sogs la/ /'khyil pa'i sngags ni mchog nyid las/ /mthong ba'i rmi lam mi dge bas/ /rang ngam des bzlas gzhom par bya/ /mtshan mo gsum pa'i cha dang por/ /skud pa brtag 5 pa la sogs 'dra/ /de yi sa bon las byung ba/ /nyi shu rtsa lngar mos pa'o /mi bskyod rdo rje mig gnyis kyang / /dza la nyi zlar bskyed des mtshan/ /rdzi ma'i rba rlabs /—lcags kyu yis4/ /mkha' yi 'khor lo las dgug bya/ /oṃ āḥrnam par snang mdzad che/ /rang gi 'khor lo la mchod phyir/ /khyed kyis lhaskud pa bdag la stsol/ /dip+ta driṣ+ṭa badz+ra saṃ 6gu sha dza hūṃ3/ de ltar mi bskyod par byas pas/ /rang rang skud pa rang la thim/ /so so gnas pa'i skud pa kun/ /chos nyid sngags kyis bsgril bar bya/ /sarba dharma spa ra ṇa a nu pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharma at+yan+ta a nu pra biṣ+ṭa dharma/ dkyil 'khor nyis 'gyur ring thung dang / /sgo yi nyi shu chas sbom phra/ /tsan+dan mchog sogs dri zhim gyis/ /byugs nas gser dngul snod du bsrung / /yi ge gsum gyi bar bsams la/ /khrus byas rang lha'i nga rgyal gyis/ /de nas skud pa bsdogs byas nas/ /'khor lo thig ni gdab par bya/ /bdag nyid mi bskyod shar bltas 8nas/ /slob ma snang 22—607

mdzad bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /lte bar khu tshur g.yon bzung nas/ /nam mkha'i thig ni ma lus gdab/ /nam mkha' la gnas de bzhin gshegs/ /sems can don byed dus bab snyepas/ /gnas 'dir byon pa'i don ched 2du/ /thig gi sgra yis bskul bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sru tra mā ti kra ma hūṃ / gnod sbyin gshin rje brgya byin gluje/ /phyogs su kha bltas phyogs bzhir gdab/ /me mtshams bden bral mtshams gnas nas/ /grwa yi thig ni rab tu gdab/ /de nas tshangs thig sogs tregacig tu/ /sum char byas la mtha' gnyis dor/ /dang po cha bzhir rab byas la/ /de yi dang po cha gnyis so/ /de yi gnyis pa gnyis pa bya 6/ /re re yang ni gnyis gnyis so/ /gsum pa'i dang pos cha chung gnyis/ /de nas yang ni cha chung gcig /de nas cha chung gnyis dor nas/ /cha chen gcig ni dor byas nas/ /cha chung gcig ni bcad pa'o/ /yang ni gnyis dor gcig bcad do/ /gnyis dor gcig bcad de steng du/ /cha chung gnyis ni dor bar bya/ /de nas cha chen gsum ni bcad/ /de steng cha chung gsum dor nas/ /yang ni cha chung gsum dor bya/ /lhag ma cha chung gcig lus pa'o/ /de nas thig skud gnyis 'gyur byas/ /tsan+dan phur bus dbus su gzugs / /yang ni rang 7gi ra ba dang / /phyi rol ra ba kun bskor bya/ /cha chen lnga ni rab bskor na/ /nang gi rdo rje ra ba ste/ /lha yi gnas la cha chung lnga—/ /byas pa'i phyed gnyis ka bar 'gyur/ /phyi yi 'khor lo cha brgyad la/ /cha gcig sgo yi dbus bya'o/ /de tshad lha yi snam bu ste/ /de phyed 'khor sa chung ngu'o / /de yi tshad kyi kha khyer sa/ /dra ba dra ba phyed pa dang / /phreng bshal 'phyang ba'i snam bu dang / /de bzhin 'gram pa gshog pa'o/ /logs kyi phyi 22—608

rol ya phugs te/ /de ltar ka ba la yang ngo / /de phyed rin chen pha gu dang //tshon sna lnga yi sa mnyam mo/ /de bzhin 'khor lo ka sogs dang / /rdo rje ra ba'ang de bzhin no/ /ya phugs steng du cha chen gsum/ /ta 1ra khu/ yi sa ru 'gyur / /cha chung drug la pad+ma dang / /rdo rje ra ba bskor bar bya/ /cha chen gcig ni 'od dkyil 'khor/ /bskor nas gcig ni nye 'khor las/ /ltas ngan kyis ni 'grub mi 'gyur/ /thig skud chad na slob dpon 'chi/ /lhag chad byung na 'bras sogs 'byung / /phyogs 'khrul 2slob ma sbyo bar 'gyur/ /gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhisardo/ /brgyan 4cing dar sham me tog dang / /'phan dang rgyal mtshan ba dan gyis/ /brgyan pa'i 'khor lo mthong bar bya/ /grwa yi cha ni thams cad dang / /sgo yi zur kun cha la yang / /zla ba rin chen rdo rje dgod/ /gam pa'i ri sogs rab brgyan pa/ /chos kyi 'khor lo ri dwags gnyis / /'phan sogs kyis brgyan twa ra ṇa/ /ji ltar mdzes shing bklubs 5par bya/ /sems can rnams kyi bsam dbang gi6/ /'di ni thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bas/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi rgyud 'di ru/ /khru ni bcu gnyis nyid du gsungs / /de la khru bcu gnyis ni byang chub kyi sems la dga' ba'i rdo rje sgeg mo dang / gzugs dang yon tan gyi rdo rje phreng ba ma dang / chos 'chad pa'i rang bzhin rdo rje glu ma dang / sems can thams cad kyi don byed pa'i rdo rje gar ma dang / grags pa thams cad 'dus pa'i rdo rje bdug pa ma dang /byang chub kyi yan lag gi rdo rje dra tog ma dang / 'go ba gzhan dga' bar byed pa'i rdo rje mar me ma 7dang / tshul khrims la sogs pa'i rdo rje dri chab ma dang /sbyin pa'i rang bzhin rdo rje kyo ba ma dang / snyan par smra ba'i rang bzhin rdo rje 22—609

gsol ka ma dang / don mthun pa'i rang bzhin rdo rje pho nya ma dang / don spyod pa'i rang bzhin rdo rje 'bebs pa ma ste/ de rnams rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no / /1de bzhin du sku'i dkyil 'khor la khru bcu drug tu gsungs pa ni/ byang chub kyi sems brtan par byed pa'i rang bzhin rdo rje sems dpa' dang / thams cad 'gugs nus pa'i rang bzhin rdo rje rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par byed pa'i yon tan rdo rje chags pa dang /gzi brjid bstod cing dga' ba'i yon tan rdo rje legs pa dang / chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur ba'i rdo rje rin chen dang / gzi brjid gzhan las 'phags pa'i yon tan rdo rje gzi brjid dang / re ba yongs su rdzogs pa'i yon tan rdo rje dpal rab dang / 'dzum pas lung ston pa'i yon tan rdo rje bzhad pa dang /chos la dmigs shing so sor rtog pa'i yon tan rdo rje chos rab dang / sgrib pa yongs su gcod pa'i yon tan rdo rje rnon po dang / sku gsung thugs zad mi shes par kun la khyab pa'i yon tan rdo rje rgyu dang / gzhung gi chos rab tu sgogs pa'i yon tan rdo rje smra ba dang / sems can smin pa dang grol bar byed pa'i yon tan rdo rje las rab dang / mi 'jigs pa sbyin zhing srung ba'i rang bzhin rdo rje srung ba dang / gdul dka' 'dul bar byed pa'i yon tan rdo rje gnod sbyin dang / rdo rje gsum bsdus shing dbyer med pa'i yon tan rdo rje sbud pa ste/de rnams rnam par dag pa'o / /4gsung gi dkyil 'khor la khru nyi shu gsungs pa ni / de rnams dang rdo rje'i rigs rnams sdud cing dam tshig gi phyag rgya byen gyis rlob pa'i yon tan sems ma rdo rje ma dang / rin po che'i rigs sdud cing dbang bskur ba'i byin gyis rlob pa'i rang bzhin yon tan rin chen rdo rje ma dang /22—610

pad+ma'i rigs sdud cing chos kyi phyag rgya byin gyes rlob pa'i yon tan chos kyi rdo rje ma dang / las kyi rigs sdud cing las kyi phyag rgya byin gyis rlob pa'i yon tan las kyi rdo rje ma ste/ de rnams rnam par dag pa'o/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ de rnams sa lkubacu rnam par dag pa ste/ sa bcu ni ye shes lnga'i rten du gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du gsang ba'i thig le nor bu'i rgyud phyi ma las/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /lam rnams dag ste rim pa bzhin/ /bcu gnyis bcu drug nyi shu ru/ /ye shes la ni ye shes gnas/ /thos dang bsam pa ngo bo ni//kyo ba la sogs rang bzhin no/ /shes rab brtson 'grus ting nge 'dzin/ /thar chags sbug pa la sogs so/ /drod la sogs pa dang por spyor/ /sgeg mo la sogs ngo bo'o/ /lhag ma nyi shu gnyis gnyis kyang / /sa re ru ni rnam dag pas/ /ye shes rten 3snadu yang dag mtshams / /stegs bu 'di yang 'khor lo yi/ /rten du yang dag gyur pas na/ /rnam par dag pa mngon du bya'o/ /zhes so/ /mdor na zab gsal gnyis med las/ /grub pa'i khyad par 'byung bas na/ /rigs dang tshad sogs nges med pas/ /khru gang nas brtsams stong phrag brgya/ /rin chen lnga yi phye ma'am/ /yang na 'byung khungs nas 'byung dang / /sā lu btags pa'i phye ma la/ /snga ma'i rim bzhin 'khor los dbab/ /bden pa'i byen gyi rlabs chobarjod de/ /gser sogs snod du bdug pa bsreg5 /gsal bar bsams nas gsang sngags 'dis/ /mngon par bzlas pa rab tu bya/ /badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ6/ rdo rje shugs kyis zhugs nas su/ /chos dbyings kyis ni 'di nyid dag /sems can dbyings ni rab sgol mdzad/ /rgyal ba'i mchog ni mi bskyod mgon/ /bde bar gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /skyon kun 22—611

las ni grol bar mos/ /bla mas g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis/ /dbang ldan mtshams nas phyi rol nas/ /ri mo lnga ni bri ba'o/ /dkar po ser po dmar po dang / /ljang khu nag po nang du'o/ /g.yas su bskor cing chad med pas/ /rdul tshon ri mo bri ba'o/ /sbom por bris na nad 'byung ste/ /phra bas nor zad 'khrog 'thab 'byung / /chad na slob ma bla ma 'chi/ /de bas phyogs kun mnyam par 'gyur/ /g.yas skor tshul du mi 'debs na/ /tshon la phur bus gdab par bya/ /rdo rje rtse mo gnyis dkar mo/ /gzhan ni ser por shes par bya / /pad+ma rā ga 'dra ba gzhan/ /ma ra ga ta lta bu ste/ /dbus ma nag por shes byas nas/ /tshom gyi rim pa de ltar ro/ /shar gyi phyogs su dkar po che/ /lho ser nub dmar byang ljang khu/ /dbus ma'i cha phyogs ra bas bskor/ /in+d+ra m+bi la'i kha dog go/ /de dus rlung dang sprul sogs sprul/ /bgegs dgra'i phyag rgya dran byas nas/ /sdang ba'i dgra yi sngags rgyal 'di/ /brjod pas de dag sel bar bya/ /na maḥs man+ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra 1rde/ na mo badz+ra rngo dhā ya/ma hā rdasbyoṭa ka ṭa bye ra ba ya a si mu sa la pa ra shu pā sha hastu ya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li kha kha khā hi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/pa tsa pa tsa/ gardza gardza/ bi sgo ṭa ya bi sgo ṭa ya/ sarba bigha nan bi nā ya ka/ma hā ga ṇa 4pa ti/ dz+re brnyi 5an+ta ka ra ya t+t+waṃ phaṭa/6 de ltar rdul tshon btab gyur nas/ /pad+ma'i gdan la nyi ma dang / /zla ba rab tu bkod byas nas/ /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya dgod pa'o/ /dbus su rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /in+d+ra nī la'i kha dog 'dra/ /shar du lce brgyad 'khor lo ni/ /zla ba lta bu'i 'od zer dang / /lho ru rin chen zur dgu pa/ /margad lta bu'i 'od zer ldan/ /nub tu pad+ma 22—612

'dab brgyad pa/ /dmar po 'od zer dang ldan pa/ /byang du ral gri rin chen yu/ /sngon po 'od zer dang ldan pa'o/ /me mtshams sbyan ni sngon po'o/ /bden bral mtshams su rdo rje bri/ /rlung mtshams pad+ma sdong bur bcas/ /dbang ldan ut+pal ljang ser can/ /phyi rol me mtshams la sogs dang / /shar sgo g.yas g.yon gru gnyis la/ /me long pi wang dung dang snod/ /gos dang chos kyi 'byung gnas bri/ /tho ba 'bar ba shar sgor bri/ /rdo rje dbyug pa lho sgor bri/ /pad+ma nub kyi sgo ru bri/ /rdo rje kha bye byang du bri/ /shes rab thabs su rab ldan pas/ /rtag tu mnyam par gzhag 1ste bya/ /rang rang gi ni ngo bo rnams / /'phro ba'i sngags kyis gdab par bya/ /de nas lha rnams gnas bya'i phyir/ /sme sha can gyi bdag nyid che/ /bu mo lo grangs bcu gnyis pa/ /mā ma tī ru byin gyis brlabs / /gnyis sbyor rjes su chags bskyed nas/ /sangs rgyas rang gi nang du gzhug /cho ga gsum gyis bsgrub byas nas/ /bzhi pas gnyis su med par bya/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i sgra yis ni/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor rnam par dgug /bskrad nas srung 4bya sngon bzhin du/ /mchod yon la sogs dbul bar bya/ /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang byas nas/ /shes rab mthar byed kyis gzhug dang / /bcings te dga' byas nyer sgrub 5dang / /sgrub pa dbang bskur gyis mtshan pa'o/ /sngon bzhin mchod pa yang byas te/ /de bzhin bstod dang bdud rtsi myang / /gsal bar bsgoms nas bzlas brjod dang / /reg pa'i mchod pas mnyes bya'o/ /de bzhin phyi yi dri la sogs/ /sngags dang phyag rgya dang ldan pas/ /rang gi sa bon las sprul te/ /'khor lo yang dag mchod pa'o/ /'di ni yang dag bdug pa ste/ /rang bzhin dang ni 22—613

sbyar ba'i dri/ /bdag gis dbul k+ṇib 'di bzhes la/ /bdag la bka' drin stsal du gsol/ /badz+ra dhū bye pū phudza spa ra ṇa/ sna tshogs me tog yid 'ong ba/ /rab tu yid 'ong 'bar ba yi/ /byang chub yan lag me tog 'di/ /bdag la brtser byedagongs bzhes su gsol/ /badz+ra puṣ+pe pū dza spa ra ṇa/ ting 'dzin mar me dge ba 'di/ /sreg byed ngan 'go 'jigs las skyob/ /lha yi spyan ni thob byed pa/ /bdag la brtser ngadagongs bzhes su gsol/ /badz+ra a /5lo ke pū dza spa ra ṇa/ ga pur la sogs byug pa ni/ /dri zhim la sogs me tog rgyan/ /t+t+waṃ 6dbyangs snyan par rol 'byung 'di/ /bdag la brtser spedagongs bzhes su gsol / /badz+ra gadhe pū dza sga ra ṇa/ sna tshogs bza' ba yid 'ong ba/ /bza' dang bcas dang bldag dang gzhibadwa/ /yid 'ong gdung ba sel ba 'di/ /bdag la brtser shedagongs bzhes su gsol/ /badz+ra nai bi bye pū dza spa ra ṇa/ sna tshogs btung ba yid 'ong ba/ /'bru yi chang dang bcos pa'i chang / /myos byed bdud rtsi dpa' bo 'di/ /bdag la brtser dgongs bzhes su gsol/ /badz+ra su ra pū dza spa ra ṇa/ rin chen ri'am rgya mtsho rin chen rnams/ /bzhad dang sgeg dga' rol dang bde ba dang / /dpag bsam shing dang na bza' shing rnams kun/ /'khor lo bla mar bcas la dbul bar bya/ /bo bye rat+na a waṃ ka ra / sa ha 7la se ra ti kri ha sau 1khyu a nut+ta ra/ a nut+ta ra bo bye lo ka ra bas+t+ra pū 1 dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ rta zhes dbul lo/ /bsrungs 4nas phyi rol byung nas kyang / /phyogs skyong rang rang rnal 'byor gnas/ /sdig med sha khrag chu zan gyi/ /gtor ma phul nas nang du 'gro/ /'di ni gzhan du bshad pas der shes par bya'o/ /gos dang rgyan gyis rab brgyan te/ /rdo rje 22—614

hūṃ lkumadzad bdag bsgyur la/ /dkyil 'khor bskor ba yang byas te/ /phyag 'tshal me tog sngon po dor/ /bdag pos bcing khyabasams mgo ru babyungs/ /de yi gong 'og cho ga rnams/ /rnam par dag par 'gyur bas na/ /dag pa'i dag pa rnam dag pa'o/ /de nas lha rnams tshim bya'i phyir/ /thab snyel sogs pa dang ldan pa'i/ /sbyin sreg gnas su song nas kyang / /sbyor ba ldan pas mnyes par bya/ /'di'i cho ga yang gzhan du bshad pas der shes par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa yang byas te/ /shis pa'i phyir na bkra shis glu/ /'khor lo bskor nas bdag nyid kyis/ /pheg ④rdob pa yi gar kyis kyang / /hūṃ hūṃ 'khor ba 'don byed sku 'dzin pa/ /gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa'i sbyor ba'i mchog /mi bskyod rdo rje khyod 'ba' zhig /te na hūṃ te na hūṃ te na te te hūṃ/ khyod kyi zhabs kyi pad+ma la/ /lha dang mi yis 'dud pa'i mchog /sprul pa'i me tog sna tshogs dang 'u/ /mi bskyod rdo rje khyod 'ba' zhig /te na t+t+waṃ te na hūṃ te na te te hūṃ / dngos po rnam grol rnam par bsnyen/ /gsang ba'i gsang ba 'dzin pa khyod / /bdud rtsi mtha' med gsol ba khyod/ /khyod kyi dgongs pa pad rgyas yin—/ /te na hūṃ te na hūṃ te na te te hūm̐/ rtsom spangs sems can don mdzad pa / /rgyu med gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /te na hūṃ te na t+t+waṃ te na te te t+t+waṃ/dung dang ku mu ta 6(yi gzugs/ /rgya mtsho dngas ma zla gzugs 'dra/ /te na hūṃ te na hūṃ te na te te hūṃ/ rol pa gnyis med rnal 'byor mdzad/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya 'dzin/ /te na hūṃ te na hūṃ te na te te hūṃ/ sgyu 'phrul las kyi 'gro ba bzung / /rkyen gyis 7ma byas gzugs can yin/ /te na hūṃ te na t+t+waṃ te na te te hūṃ / de nas 'og nas 'byung ba'i rim/ /bdag nyid zhugs byas lha yis 22—6/5

kyang / /chu nas bka' stsal bar gyi dbang / /bskur bsams 'khor lo de la ni / /slob ma rnams ni gzhug pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje 'chang ba las byung ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor rten dang bcas pa yi/ /de bzhin nyid ni lan gsum brjod/ /nam mkha' las byung mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i sems /rdo rje sems dpa' che rang bzhin/ /mi bskyod rdo rje deng grub shog /mchog chen dngos grub thams cad dang / /dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i lha/ /thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gzugs/ /dam pa'i yi ge grub par shog /skyon med rtag pa la sogs pa/ /'dod chags kun la rjes su chags/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /de nyid bcom ldan bdag la grub/ /gtan du dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod ma nas gol de bzhin gshegs/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 3bdag grub bo/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po'i phyag rgya yis/ /rdo rje snying gtso bdag la ni/ /rdo rje sngags chen grub par shog /sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa/ /sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /sems can kun gyi de bzhin pha/ /dam tshis/ mchog gi 2'dod pa'i mchog /bden pa gang gis ye shes kyi/ /shes rab thabs dag dkyil 'khor ni/ /mgon po khrod kyi bden pa des/ /bdag gis 'dod pa yongs su skongs / /gzugs brnyan dang ni mnyam pa'i chos/ /dag cing dang ba rnyog med pa/ /gzung med brjod du med pa yang / /rgyu dang rkyen la kun du byung / /de nyid de nyid bskyed pa ni/ /de dag bden pas dkyil 'khor la/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob pa ni/ /sdig med pas ni blta bar bgyi/ /thun mong sdom pa dang ldan pa/ /bsnyen sgrub gsum gyis bsgrubs 22—616

nas su/ /yol bas bar du bcad pa la/ /'khyel bzlas chu yis gtor bar bya//dmar po sham gyis gdong g.yogs nas/ /dga' ba khyod gang yin zhes dri/ /dga' ba skal ldan bdag yin zhes/ /'jug pa po yis smra bar bya/ /de nas me tog snyim bkang nas/ /'khor los bzhes zhes gtor nas ni/ /gtong sems bskyed nas bla ma la/ /yon ni rab tu dbul bar bya/ /yul mkhar khyem dang glang po rta/ /bran dang bran mo chung ma drug /bu mo shin tu yid 'ong dang / /gang gis rang gi lus 'di yang / /deng nas brtsams te dbul bar byatshosna / /ci yi phyir ni ༄ —7dbul bya na/ /slob dpon du ni nyer gnas phyir/ /snying ri —rje chen pos nyer gnas phyir/ /sems can thams cad skyob don du/ /bdag gi lus 'di dbul bar bgyi/ /hūṃ gis 4snying kar rdo rje bsgom/ /oṃ sarba 3yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā zhwad ya mi/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ sed+dhi 7badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ brjod pas byang chub sems bskyed la/ /lus kyi 'khor lo bskul bar bya/ /de ring khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 8byin gyis rlob 9par 'gyur ro/ /khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog gi gsang chen 'di/ dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya'o/ /dad par mi byed pa yang mi rung ngo / /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'am/ /a khaṃ bī ra hūṃ brjod nas/ /drangs nas 'jug pa'i sgor gnas te/ /snga ma'i sdom pa brtan par bya/ /de ring khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs la rab tu chud do/ /de bas ngas khyod la rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya'o/ /ye shes de 11khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob na/dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de'i thabs 'di khyod kyis dkyil 22—617

'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du ma smra shig /khyod dam tshig las 'da' bar mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ /snying gar rdo rje bzhag nas ni/ /de ring rdo rje sems dpa' nyid/ /khyod kyi snying la yang dag gnas/ /gal te tshul 'di 'das na ni/ /snying 'gas sdug bsngal de ltar 'byung / /badz+ra satwa hūṃ/pad+ma'i ban+dhar bdud rtsi lnga/ /yi ge gsum gyis 'bar byas la/ /rdo rje yis 1ni de yi khar/ /mi ldog phyir ni blud par bya/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam las 'da' na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub pa'i/ /bdud rtsi rdo rje chu 'thung shig /badzo bhe 7da ka ṭha/ de nas de yis mi 'gyur byas//sems g.yo dogs phyir bstan pa yi/ /dam bcas 'di ni bla ma yis/ /lan gsum du ni bsgrags par bya/ /de ring phyin chad khyod kyis 1phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi4/ ngas ci smras pa'i bya ba thams cad khyod kyis bya dgos so/ /khyod kyis bdag la brnyas par mi rung ste/ brnyas na ya nga ba ma spangs pas shi ba'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bas 7ma 'gro shig /de nas slob ma de yis kyang / /brtan nas rang nyid dag bya'i phyir/ /gsol ba gdab pa 'di yi mchog /smros shig ces ni bla mas smras/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la rdo rje sems dpa' bdag cag la dbab du gsol lo/ /de yi snying ga ru ni hūṃ/ /lam̐ byung dbang chen dbus su bsam/ /mgrin par a ni baṃ 6byung ba'i / /chu yi dkyil 'khor dbus su bsam/ /spyi bor haṃ meni dkar po che/ /yo byung rlung dbus bsams nas ni/ /skul byed dhi ni rkang mthil gnyis/ /rlung gis bskyod pas 'bar byas dbab/ /oṃ ā be+e sha ya ste bha ya ra ra ra ra tsa re la ya tsa 9la ya/ hūṃ a ha dhi/ rdo rje dril bu sgra dang bcas/ /'jigs rung 22—618

gar gyis smin ring lkubaskyod/ /mig bgrad so gcigs bzhad byed pas/ /slob ma dbab pa rab tu bya/ /lce la thig le'i yi ge āḥ/ /bsams nas bzlas shing dge mi dge/ /bru bhe hi badz+ra zhes brjod nas/ /dbab pa brtan par bya ba'o/ /pra ti badz+ra ho brjod la/ /me tog dkyil 'khor dor du gzhug /de yis bcings par rab bsams la/ /blangs nas mgo ru bcing bar rngubya/ /'di ni stobs chen sems dpa' bas/ /'di yi ma 'dres so sor zung thu/ /phyag mtshan nye'am pyemi nye ba/ /re'u cha'i gnas las shes par bya'o/ /yang na rang gi skal ba yis/ /gdong phye me tog de la gtor/ /mig gnyis oṃ 'bar bsams nas ni/ /gdong phye las kyi kha dog bstan/ /de ring rdo rje sems dpa' nyid—/ /nan tan byas te khyod mig phye/ /bla na med pa'i rdo rjes mig /thams cad la ni mig phye 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo nas brtsams nas/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil par bstan pa'am/ /yang na bdud rtsi 'khyel pa las/ /gtso bo'i bar du bstan bya'o/ /slob mas thal mo sbyar byas la/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor nyid du bdag zhugs so/ /spyor ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor de ring bdag gis mthong / /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag dbang bskur/ /de skad lan gsum brjod par bya/ /bum pa rnams chu gcig tu byas 'u/ /mi bskyod rdo rje rab bskyed la/ /zhugs nas slob ma'i mgo bo ru/ /'khor los sgyur 7bzhin dbang bskur bya/ /rin chen la sogs dbu rgyan la/ /rin chen 'byung ldan gyur byas te/ /dbus su rang gi lha bzhag pas/ /cod pan dang ldan dbang bakhrur bya/ /rdo rje rtse mo dgu lnga pa/ /'od dpag med bsgoms yongs gyur te/ /22—619

byin nas snying gar de bzung ba/ /rdo rje'i dbang ni bskur bar bya/ /dril bu don yod grub pa ru/ /bsgoms nas yongs gyur byen nas ni/ /rdo rje dril bu la 'khyud tshul/ /bdag por dbang ni bskur bar bya/ /spyi gtsug ltag pa la thu3bcug ste/ /spyi bor phyag reg ming gi dbang / /che ge rdo rje zhes bos nas/ /khyad par gzhan yang mthong bar bya/ /gang gang snang ba kun bdag ste/ /de yi gtso bo mi bskyod mgon/ /chos rnams rang bzhin kyis dag pas/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi yi ge tshul/ /kun kyi gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ /ming gong dpal gyi sgra gzhug bya/ /go ba nyid du bsgrags napa'i phyir/ /dang po kye sbyor bye mtha' yi bar / /hūṃ bskyed rdo rje lag byin nas/ /'chang bas rdo rje lan gsum gsor/ /brtul zhugs 'di ni dang po ru/ /rnal 'byor pa yis blang bar bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ /rtag par khyod kyis kyang bzung ste/ /lag na ltardo rje brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sidhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa two dha ra ya mi/ hi hi hi nyi hūṃ/ de yi de nyid bshad par bya/ /sngon mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun gyi bdag /rdo rje snying po'i gtso bo'i gtso/ /a las byung ba'i dril bu ni/ /lag g.yon byin nas phyogs brgyad dgrol / /brtul zhugs 'di yang dang po ru/ /de yi grogs su sbyin pa'o/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs chen 'khrol bar 'dod/ /rtag par khyod kyis kyang bzung ste/ /rgyal ba byang chub mchog tu 'dod/ /de nyid bshad par bya ba ni/ /'di ni khyed kyis dkrol bya ste/ /srid pa rang bzhin gyis dag phyir/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'byung bar byed/ /rang bzhin 22—620

dag pas sems can kun/ /dam pa'i srid pa byed pa po/ /slob ma rdo rje dbyings phyug dang / /ldan par bsams nas bcom ldan 'das/ /mngon byed 'das pa mchog 'di yis/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig sbyin pa'o/ /phyag rgya chen po'i byin brlabs 1te/ /snying po bsnyen pa la sogs grags/ /dam tshig 'dod gzugs sogs rnams kyis/ /sngags ni dbugs su rtogs nas bzla/ /rang gi rang bzhin de rnams kyis/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum khyab pa yi/ /ma lus gtso bo mchod byas nas/ /bdag dang gzhan yang mnyes par bya/ /dka' thub dam bcas de dag gis/ /bstan par byas kyang 'grub pa me+ed/ /mi snang mngon shes mkha' 'gro med/ /sgu gsung thugs las grub skyes so/ /de bas sangs rgyas sems can rnams/ /sngags kyi spyod pa mchog bzung ste/ /'dod pa kun la longs spyod pas/ /chos kyi yi ge mchog thob 'gyur/ /bde snyug gnyis med bdag nyid kyis/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga bsten te/ /chags chen ye shes don sbyor na/ /de kho na nyid kun kyang 'grub/ /sku gsung thugs grub yang dag ste/ /gang gzhan dman pa yang skye 'dod/ /de yang sku gsung thugs bsgoms nas/ /sngags bzlas pa yis 'grub pa'o/ /thun mong ma yin sdom par ldan/ /spyor ba ma nyams yon phul nas/ /rdo rje slob dpon dbang nod phyir/ /de yis lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ /byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar bkyis pa bzhin/ /bdag kyang rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha' rdo rje bdag la stsol/ /'jug pa'i sgo ru khru do bar—/ /pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad la/ /sa bon gyis mtshan dbang stegs bri//seng ge mtshan par 'dug tu gzhug /de nyid ting 'dzin gsum ldan par/ /22—621

byas nas bla ma'i lus dkyil 'khor/ /sangs rgyas sogs spro rnam dgug cing / /nam mkha'i khams kun dga' bar bya/ /de yis rnga dril sil snyan dang / /rgyal mtshan 'phan sogs pheg rdob cing / /bum pa gtso sogs gzung byas nas/ /sngon bzhin chu sogs dbang bskur bsam/ /dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ /khams gsum kun gyis dzophyag byas pa/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin pa yin/ /de skad lan gsum brjod nas su/ /dge ba'i phyir dang shis pa'i phyir/ /bum pa spyi bor rab bzung ste/ /bkra shis dbyangs 'di brjod par bya/ /dpal ldan gser kyi ri bo ltar 'bar ba/ /'jig rten gsum mgon dri ma gsum dang bral/ /bcom ldan pad rgyas lta bu'i spyan mnga' ba/ /bkra shis des ni deng khyod zhi byed shog /de yis bstan pa'i dri med mchog rab ni/ /'jig rten gsum grags lha dang mis mchod pa/ /cho ga skye dgu rnams ni zhi bar byed/ /bkra shis gnyis pa deng 'dir khyed la shog /dam pa'i chos ldan thos gang bkra shis shing / /dge 'dun lha dang lha mi'i 1mchod 'os pa/ /ngo mtshar dpal rab mchog rab tshogs rnams kyi/ /bkra shis gsum pa deng 'dir khyed la shog /de nas de dag thams cad kun/ /ye shes ngo bor zhugs bsams pas/ /dbu rgyan ye shes sems dpa' bskyed/ /bskor byas slob dpon gnas par bya/ /sngon bzhin mchod dang bstod pa dang / /bdud rtsi myang ba yang byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor de bzhin nyid bstan bya/ /sangs rgyas ma rgyas mnyam pa'i phyir/ /gru bzhi ru ni rab tu bstan/ /dran pa nyer bzhag shar kyi sgo/ /yang dag spong ba lho yi sgo/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa nub kyi sgo / /dbang po stobs ni byang gi sgo/ /bsam gtan bzhi ni twa ra ṇa/ /22—622

ting 'dzin rnams ni kha khyer brgyad/ /gzungs rnams der gnas lha mo'o/ /bsam pa bskang ṭ+wāphyir lha tshogs rgyan2/ /gsung rab yan lag 'phags sogs so / /byang chub yan lag dra ba sogs/ /rnam par thar brgyad ka ba brgyad/ /sngags tshul rdo rje phreng ba zlum/ / phyi logs rnam dag yon tan lnga/ /dri med stobs sogs mchod pa lnga/ /bum pa chus gang thugs rje dang / /tshogs rdzogs ser po ye shes gter/ /'gro ba rnams dang dbyer med kyang / /de yi nyes pas mi gos phyir/ /sna tshogs pad+ma bcu dgu ni/ /sdong bu dang ni bcas pa'o/ /mi dge 'dam rdzab skam mdzad phyir/ /dge ba'i myu gu gso mdzad pa/ /nyi ma'i gdan ni bdun rnams so/ /nyon mongs tsha ba bsil byed dang / /ma rig mun nag sel ba'i phyir/ /zla ba bcu gnyis dang ldan pa'o/ /tshor ba gsob la sogs pa dang / /'ju ba la sogs dus bcu gnyis/ /zad dus sgron bdun rnam dag pas/ /grangs ni nges par bstan pa'o/ /nyon mongs thams cad las grol phyir/ /gzhal yas khang du btags pa yin/ /snying po la ni 'dus pa'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor zhes su bshad pa yin/ /rnam par shes pa zhe sdang thugs/ /chos dbyings rnam dag mi bskyod pa/ /gzugs phung gti mug che 4dang sku/ /me long rnam dag rnam snang mdzad/ /tshor ba'i phung po myo/nyam pa nyid/ /nga rgyal rnam dag rin chen 'byung / /'du shes phung po 'dod chags gsum/ /so sor rtog pa snang mtha' yas/ /'du byed phung po nan tan dang / /phrag dog rnam dag don yod grub/ /sa dang stong nyid thabs dang ni/ /snying rje zhi byed spyan ma'o/ /byams dang mtshan med smon lam dang / /chu khams srung byed mā ma tī/ /dga' dang smon med stobs dang ni/ /me 22—623

khams rgyas byed na bza' dkar/ /btang snyoms ye shes rang bzhin gsal/ /rlung khams sgrol byed sgol ma'o/ /sbyin pa rnam dag gzugs rdo rje/ /tshul khrims rnam dag sgra rdo rje/ /bzod pa rnam dag dri rdo rje/ /brtson 'grus rnam dag ro rdo rje/ /bsam gtan rnam dag reg rdo rje/ /shes rab rnam dag chos rdo rje/ /phyi yi longs spyod kyis mchod phyir/ /dbyung sngags ting 'dzin gsungs pa'o/ /mi la sogs pa rnam dag phyir/ /de nyid du ni bkod par gsungs / /dbyung sngags ting 'dzin ma gsungs pas/ /sa snying la sogs phyir mi dgod/ /'jigs sogs shes bya 1 phung po'i bdud/ /dad dag gshin rje gshed 'gugs pa/ /nyon mongs de bdud mthar 'dzin lha/ /brtson dag 'jug byed shes mthar byed/ /skye sgrib 'chi bdag log par lta/ /dran dag 'ching byed rta mgrin no/ /las dang lha bdud mchog 'dzin lha/ /nying 'dzin mgu mdzad bdud rtsi 'khyel/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa dang / /ngo bo nyid de rnam bzhi ni/ /thugs sogs rdo rje ye shes sems/ /phyag rgya bzhi zhes bshad pa yin/ /rnam par rtog pa dang bral phyir/ /gting dpag dka' bas zab mo ste/ /phyag rgya chen por rab snang ba/ /rang gzhan smin byed gsal ba po / /zab mo dang ni yang dag gsal/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid de/ /mtha' gnyis skyon ni rab bkag pas/ /dus thams cad du dbyer med do/ /de bzhin slob ma dbang bskur dang / /dngos grub sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /sgrub pa'i thabs ni rab bstan pas/ /gang zag gnyis su shes par byed3 / /gzugs brnyan glegs bam la sogs pa/ /yod na khyod kyis rab gnas mdzod/ /de ni ji srid bar du ni/ /sems can don du 'gyur ba'o/ /de ltar lung 22—624

bstan dbugs dbyung dang / /bka' stsal pa yis dbang bskur nas/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa kun bstan te/ /bka' lung g.yar gyi blang ba'o/ /bum pa'i dbang gi cho ga'o/ /lo 'am yang na zla ba ru/ /rig dang slob dpon dbang thob pas/ /lus dang zang zing thabs dang bcas/ /spyod pa mchog gis bla ma bkur/ /rin chen sna bdun la sogs pa/ /rjes su mthun pa dbul bya ste/ /bla ma dgyes par byed pa'i ched/ /bu mo gzhon nu gzugs bzang ba/ /rgyan ldan dam sdom dbang bcas pa/ /lus rgyas mdzes pa dbul byas nas1/ /bla ma'i g.yon du bu mo bzhag /rgyal po mu stegs chos rkun gyis//gnod med dbe+en pa'i sa phyogs su/ /mchog gi dris byugs pad sogs gdan/ /bla re rgyal mtshan sogs kyis bklubs2/ /rol mo sil snyan sna tshogs sgras/ /gong gi 'khor ram yang na sku/ /tshogs kyi mchod pa chen po yis/ /dbyer med 'khor lo mchod byas nas/ /me tog snyim bkang gsol ba gdab/ /kun mkhyen ye shes phung po sogs/ /pus btsugs thal sbyar mgrin dma' bas/ /gsang ba mchog gi sdom pa che/ /yang dag blangs nas bsrung bar bya/ /ji ltar dbang bskur sogs tshul gyis/ /sangs rgyas la sogs thob pa bzhin/ /byang chub spyod pa gzhan gyis 4ni/ /'dul ba'i dge ba de bzhin med/ /de bas dam tshig bus srungs shig /rtag tu sdom pa yang skyongs shig /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bza' ste/ /de las gzhan yang dam tshig srungs/ /dkon mchog bla ma brnyas byed gzhom/ /gzhan gyi bud med spyad pa dang / /ma byin par yang blangs byas nas/ /brdzun 5gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya/ /rnal 'byor rgyud las gsungs pa bzhin/ /de ni cho ga bzhin du srungs/ /de ltar bya'o zhes gsol 22—625

nas / /yang na 1me tog phreng ba gtor/ /thal mo sbyar nas gsang ba yi /dbang nod phyir ni gsol ba gdab/ /rdo rje sems khyod la sogs pa/ /tshigs bcad lnga yis lan gsum du/ /zhugs nas slob ma dam pa ni/ /mdzes pa'i chas ldan gyis bya'o/ /de nas bla ma yon tan mtsho/ /mchog gi mchog gis de gsan nas/ /zhal ni mdangs dang ldan byas nas/ /snying rje de la bskyed par bya / /gzugs sogs phun sum tshogs ldan pa'i/ /lha mo de ni byin brlabs nas / /thub pa'i dbang po zhugs byas nas / /rdo rje nang du gnas par bya/ /mje bo srin lag gis bkab nas/ /slob ma dpal ldan snang mdzad khar/ /spro ba'i sngags kyis phab nas su/ /gnyi gas 'di ni brjod par bya/ /a ho a ho su kha ho/ /gzhan yang blo yi bye brag gis / /dbang bskur byas nas mgrin pa ru / /de nyid myong bar byas nas su/ /de nas 'di yis bsngags pa'o/ /de 'di rdo rje thams cad kyi/ /dbang bskur mchog tu bsngags pa ste/ /thams cad sngags ni 'grub —'gyur te/ /las mchog khyad par can yang 'grub/ /zla ba za ba rab byung ba/ /lung bstan dbugs dbyung bka' stsal pa/ /'og nas 'byung bzhin sbyin par bya/ /rdo rje bzlas pas phyi nang tshogs/ /sgyu ma smig 5rgyu la sogs pa'i/ /'dod don phyag mtshan mdog dang dbyibs/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i rnam smin sgu/ /bsgom pa la gnas de bsgom gzhug /gsang ba'i dbang gi cho ga'o/ /de bzhin gong ma'i rim pa yis/ /mtshan dang ldan pa'i rig pa che/ /btsal te bla ma dag la yon/ /rjes mthun dang bcas dbul bar bya/ /sngon bzhin gsol btab sdom pa blangs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /nyan thos rang rgyal de bzhin te/ /sgu gsung thugs su 22—626

sbyor ba na/ /phyag 'tshal na ni ma rung 1'gyur/ /kun du rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /lus ngag yid kyi dkyil 'khor la/ /bsam gtan rdo rje gsum sbyor bas/ /sngags zlos pas ni bsam gtan bya/ /mdor na sems can thams cad ni/ /bsam gtan rdo rje bskul bar bya/ /de 'di rdo rje thams cad kyi/ /dam chos rab tu bstan pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor dag kyang yang mi bri/ /glegs bam bklag 2par mi bya zhing / /mchod rten dag gi las mi bya/ /rdo rje gsum mchog phyag mi bya/ /gal te byang chub mchog 'dod na/ /lag pa'i phyag rgya mi bcing ngo / /de ltar bya zhes gsol bar bya/ /yang ni me tog gtor byas nas / /mchod sbyin rdo rje la sogs pa'i/ /tshigs bcad lan gsum gsol btab nas/ /shes rab ye shes yang dag blang / /de nas lha mo bdag nyid dang / /dam tshig sdom pa'i mchog smras nas/ /bde chen za ma tog gi ni/ /lha mo'i bsngags pa rab tu brjod/ /de dag mdun du gnas pa'i lag /g.yas g.yon 'og dang steng bzhag nas/ /byin gyis brlabs 4pa'i lha mo 'di/ /sngags 'di yis ni sbyin par bya/ /yid 'ong gzugs 5ma 'di nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi spyod du gnang / /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rim pa yis /dam pa'i bde ba khyod kyis myong / /de nas rab mnyam bzhag pa yis/ /dal ba'i bya ba rnam gsum gyis/ /rdo rje skyil krung nang du sems/ /rin chen dkyil du rtogs pa bya/ /rang gi lha yi 'khor lor ldan/ /dbyengs kyi dbang phyug dang 'brel pa/ /yol bas bcad de bde myong la/ /sngon bzhin dbang bsgur byas nas thim/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma kopho haṃ/gti mug rang bzhin gti mug spyor/ /gti mug dga' dang yang dag ldan/ /22—627

gti mug rgyun gyis hūṃdabang bskur na/ /gti mug rdo rje'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /zhe sdang rang bzhin zhe sdang spyor/ /zhe sdang dga' ma dang ldan par/ /zhe sdang rgyun gyis dbang bskur na/ /zhe sdang rdo rje'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /'dod chags rang bzhin 'dod chags sbyor/ /'dod chags dga' dang yang dag ldan/ /'dod chags rgyun kyis dbang bskur na/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /shes rab ye shes bdag sbyar na/ /rdo rje dga' ma dang ldan par/ /ye shes rgyun gyis dbang bskur na/ /shes rab ye shes bdag nyid 'gyur / /shes rab ye shes so/ /de nas bla mas g.yon pa yi/ /phyag ni slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag /de bzhin gshegs kun dpang byas la/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs sbyin pa'o/ /thabs gzhan kyis ni sangs mi rgya/ /de bas rig ma 'di ni mchog /chos kun gnyis su med pa la/ /gnyis kyis rnam par mtshon pa yin/ /de bas rtag tu 'khor ba ru/ /khyed kyis 'bral bar ma byed cig /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi2/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /blun chen gang zhig 'da' byed na/ /mchog gi dngos grub de la med/ /de ltar de bzhin gzhir yang grags/ /sngon bzhin gnyis ni rgyas btab pas/ /gsal zhing rab dga' mkha' 'dra ba'i/ /man ngag tu ni de nyid brtag /bla ma de bzhin gshegs gyur na/ /snying gar khu tshur chos gos g.yon/ /g.yas pas mchog sbyin phyag rgya bya/ /bdag nyid bzhengs nas lung ston bya/ /oṃ khyod la bdag gis lung 'di ston—// /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro thar byas nas/ /yang dag srid pa grub pa'i phyir/ /sa bla sa steng sa 'og tu/ /kye rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba/ /rang byung chorang nyid 22—628

grub gyur cig /sngags pa gang la lung 'di bstan/ /de ni 'gro ba kun gyi gtso//bla na med pa'i byang chub la/ /bde gshegs kun gyis lung bstan yin/ /lung bstan pa'o/ /ji ltar dbang bskur thob pa yis/ /slob mas yon tan brjod par mos/ /dam tshig gsum gyis dbugs phyung nas/ /'di yis bsngags pa brjod pa'o/ /dam tshig gsang chen dkyil 'khor la/ /rab tu zhugs nas mthong bas na/ /khyod ni sdig pa kun las grol/ /de ring shin tu kho nar gnas—/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad shi ba yong med de/ /mi thub mi shigs gzhan gyis kyang / /rol zhing 'jigs par ga la 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal srid las mya ngan 'das/ /srid pa gtan du dag pa'i phyir/ /yang dag 'byung ba ston pa'i mchog /srid pa gtan 7du dngos grub po/ /dngos grub dam tshig sdom pa 'di/ /rig ma rtag tu bsrung 3snabar bya/ /dam pa'i shes rab bstan pa ni/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par gsungs/ /byang chub sems ni spang mi bya/ /gang zhig rdo rje phyag rgya zhes/ /de ni bskyed pa tsam gyis kyang / /sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med/ /dam pa'i chos ni smad mi bya/ /ma rig pa dang gti mug gis/ /de ni bor bar mi bya'o/ /rang bdag yongs su spangs pa dang / /dka' thub sdug bsngal gzir mi bya/ /ji ltar bde ba 'di bzung nas— / /rdzogs sangs rgyas pa 'di las 'byung / /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya rnams / /nam yang spang bar byar mi rung / /bla ma sangs rgyas dang mnyam phyir / /rdo rje slob dpon smad mi bya/ /de ni sangs rgyas kun mnyam phyir/ /slob dpon la ni smod byed na/ /sangs rgyas thams cad smad pa yin/ /des ni rtag tu sdug bsngal thob/ /rims dang 'or dang dug dang nad/ /mkha' 22—629

'gos gtses dang bzung ba dang / /bgegs dang tshogs bdag drag po yis/ /bsad nas dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de bas nan tan thams cad kyis/ /mchog gi dge ba mngon 'gyur ba'i/ /rdo rje slob dpon bla chen la/ /nam yang brnyas par byar mi rung / /gus pas bla ma yon du ni/ /rjes su 'thad pas dbul bar bya/ /des ṭ+wāni rims nad khyal sogs pa/ /phyi nas 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu rang gi dam tshig bsgrub/ /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa mchod/ /rtag tu bla ma la yang dbul/ /sangs rgyas kun dang de mnyam phyir//de byin sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rtag tu byin pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de byin bsod nams tshogs yin pas/ /tshogs la byang chub mchog tu 'gyur/ /ci phyir shin tu 'dir gnas pas/ /khyed kyi tshe 'di 'bras bur bcas/ /dam tshig lha dang mnyam pa ru/ /gnas par the tshom med pa'o/ /rdo rje dang bcas sangs rgyas kyis/ /de ring khyed rnams dbang bskur bas/ /rgyal po chen po khams gsum na/ /rgyal po gtso bo brtan par 'gyur/ /de ring bdud rnams rnam bcom nas/ /gzhal yas khang mchog du — chud phyin/ /sangs rgyas nyid phyir de kho nar/ /khyab bdag gis ni the tshom med/ /rab tu dang ba'i yid kyis ni/ /rdo rje de dag kun mdzod cig /zad med rang gi dam tshig bde/ /bde bar sems bskyed la bsnyen cing / /myur bar 'gro ba'i bde chu ru/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'dra ba yi/ /mnyam pa de ru gyur nas su/ /khyod rnams de la 'gro bar shog /dbugs dbyung ba'o/ /de nas slob mas phyag 'tshal te/ /bla ma'i zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis/ /sogs pa'i tshig gis thams cad kun/ /gnang ba'i dbang ni blang bar bya/ /ji lta ji ltar 'dul 'gyur ba/ /sems 22—630

can rang bzhin du 'gro bgyis/ /de lta de ltar sems can don/ /'dod chags/ la sogs dag par bya/ /nyin re yi ni mtshams gsum la/ /ting 'dzin gsum gyi sbyor ldan ni/ /bsgrubs nas sgrub pa thun mong dang / /cig shos dngos grub bsgrub par bya/ /mi snang stong ni chung ngu la/ /mngon shes nyi stong bar ma la/ /rig 'dzin dag ni stong gsum la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa 'gro kun gtso / /zhi ba rgyas pa sogs las gang / /de las gzhan nam gang 'dod la1//dkyil 'khor kun du chags spyor na/ /bsgrub pa myur du 'grub par 'ong /rdo rje bdag po thams cad kyis/ /'dod chags de nyid don bsams te/ /sems can thams cad phan byed pa'i/ /byang chub 'dod chags las skyes 37 mdzad—/ /de bas byang chub 'dod bsngags sgopas/ /sgu gsung thugs ni bsgom chobyas te/ /cho ga bzhin du las byed na/ /de kun rtogs par 'gyur ba yin—/ /de dag byang chub thob 'dod kun/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis thams cad dbul/ /gang zhig phongs pas yid mi bde/ /dad pa'i mchog ldan de yin no/ /bka' stsal pa'i dbang ngo / /dad pa mchog tu gus ldan pas/ /bla ma'i zhabs ni spyi bo blang / /ji ltar shārje btsun bka' sprul ltar/ /de ltar bya zhes spyan sngar gsol/ /bkra shis smon lam dang ldan par/ /yang dag gnas par gyur cig brjod/ /snod rung byas pa'i slob ma la/ /bla ma shin tu dgyes pa ༄ na/ /de dag kun las gsang ba dang / /rab gsang shin tu gsang ba yi/ /bsgrags min mna' yis btab byas nas/ /som nyi med par bshad par bya/ /'byor ldan slob ma kun tshogs nas/ /sbyin sreg gnas su gnas byas nas/ /bla ma slob ma sbyor bar ldan/ /mar la sogs pa rgya chen rnams/ /22—631

slob mas g.yon pa'i mthe bong ni/ /bla ma'i g.yas pa'i mthe bong dang / /gung mo yis ni gzung lam̐byas nas/ /sdig pa rnams ni zhi bar bya/ /de bzhin de ru sa bdag dang / /phyogs skyong rgyal po la sogs pa/ /zhi bar bya phyir bdun nam ni/ /yang na gsum mam gcig tu bya'o/ /bdag nyid bshad dang nyan pa dang / /bsam dang bsgom tsadang dngos grub bsgrub/ /tha na 'jig rten las grub dang / /khyod kyis grogs ni mdzod cig ces/ /gsol ba btab nas gshegs su gsol/ /sngon bzhin mchod pa thams cad dang / /glu gar sel snyan la sogs dang / /bza' dang btung ba'i mchog rnams kyis/ /bdag gzhan 'khor lo mnyes par bya/ /de nas pog snod lag thogs te/ /dril bu gsil nas pus mo btsugs/ /ye shes 'khor lo thams cad kun/ /sngags 'dis gshegs su gsol ba'o/ /oṃ sems can kun don mdzad nas su/ /dngos grub stsal te rigs pa bzhin/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs su gsol/ /yang ni 'byon par mdzod cig muḥ/ /de bzhin oṃ dang s+dzadang hūṃ/ /brjod pas ting 'dzin 'khor lo rnams/ /rdo rje gsum la bsdu byas nas/ /de yang nam mkha' lta bur mos/ /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā shā / ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta oṃ āḥ5hūṃ swā hā zhes brjod pas/ gzugs brnyan stong pa nyid dmigs la/ /snod gtsang ma ru bsdus nas su/ /'dod pa la ni nyung shas sbyin/ /lhag ma chu yi skye bo khusogs/ /phan phyir gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / /'phan sogs sel snyan rab ldan pa/ /dge 'dun tshogs kyis bteg nas su/ /chu bo chen por blug dz+wapar bya / /rdo rje rtse mos ri mo dbye/ /bum pa bla re la sogs pa/ /spyad rung bla mas blang bya ste/ /lhag ma gong bzhin dor bar bya/ /dkyil 22—632

'khor 'di ru gzugs brnyan dang / /glegs bam la sogs rab gnas kyi/ /cho ga bya ba gzhan du bshad/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi kyeder shes bya/ /'di ni dang po rnal 'byor pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga dang por gsungs/ /gzhan du khyad par ma gtogs pa/ /cho ga rgyas par 'dir shes bya/ /cung zad ye shes dbang thob pas/ /'bebs pa'i cho gas bri bar gsungs/ /khams gsum skye bos smon 'dzugs 3 phyir/ /rnam pa gzhan du mi bya'o/ /ri rtse nyams ni dga' ba dang / /nags tshal rab tu dben pa'am/ /mchod rten kun dga' ra ba sogs—/ /dgon pa'i gnas su spyad bya'o/ /bu mo lo grangs bcu gnyis ma/ /de bzhin bcu gnyis lon pa'i khye'u/ /cho rigs btsun zhing drang por skyes/ /rma sogs spangs dang bzhin mdzes shing / /so yi thags bzang rab gtsang ba/ /skra gnag mig dkyus ring ba dang / /rang bzhin dul ba rig pa che/ /bzung nas dbab par rab tu brtag /de la gong du smos pa dang / /snod rung sogs kyis zhus nas su/ /de rnams don du tshogs skyed 4phyir/ /rnam par dag pa'i bzlas pa bya/ /de bzhin sa btsal la sogs nas/ /sbran pa'i cho ga'i bar byas nas/ /lha dang bum pa sems can rnams/ /sta gon du ni gnas par bya/ /thig sgud rdul tshon byin brlabs na5/ /gong gsungs snod ni khrus byas te/ /gos dang rgyan gyis rab bklubs 6te/ /ri ska 7la sogs kyis bdug ༄ bhebya/ /de yi gnas gsum snga ma bzhin/ /dbang chen chu dang rlung dkyil 'khor/ /yi ge gsum kyi 1byin brlabs la/ /rkang mthil gnyis su sgul byed pa/ /rlung gis sbar bas sdig pa bsreg /ye shes yang dag dbab pa'i phyir/ /rigs gsum bdag nyid rdo rje dril/ /'jigs rung gar dang 22—633

bcas pa yis/ /de yi snying ga phye byas nas/ /chu dang mar bzhin ro gcig gyur—/ /gzi byen la sogs ldan gyur na/ /babs pa'i rtags kyis shes par bya—/ /spyan dang rnam par snang mdzad zhugs/ /khru gang tsam mam khru do'am/ /khru lnga tsam mam brgyad tsam du/ /'jigs shing skrag tshul 'bar rngubar 'gyur/ /snang ba mtha' yas gos dkar zhugs/ /phreng ba'i sngags dang dbyung ba'i sngags//de bzhin snying po rig 37pa sogs/ /ma bslabs par yang brjod par 'gyur/ /mi bskyod mā ma shī babs pas/ /'das dang ma 'ongs dus dag gi/ /ji ltar byung 'byung dngos po rnams/ /skad cig gis ni yang dag ston/ /de nas sngags kyis bstan par bya/ /de gnyis bla ma slob ma'i tshul/ /thig 'debs dang ni tshon 'gyed dang / /phyag rgya'am sku sogs 'god par byed/ /de nas mdun du 'dug byas nas/ /ji ltar bgyi zhes bka' nod byed/ /mchod pa sna tshogs rab byas la/ /ye shes lha ni gshegs su gsol/ /snod gnyis zas dang skom rnams dang / /yon gyis mnyes par byas nas su/ /grangs lhag rung bar bya ba ste/ /rang gi gnas su gtang bya'o/ /de nas 'khor lo gnas bsam dang / /mchod dang zhugs dang dbang bskur ba/ /bsdu ba dang po rnal 'byor bzhin / /cho ga rgyas par bya ba'o/ /'di'am gong du slob ma'am/ /gzhan don rab tu bya ba'i phyir/ /bri ba'i gsung gi 7cho ga ni/ /gzhan du bshad pas der shes bya/ /'di ni cung zad dbang gyur pa'i/ /bri ba'i cho ga gsungs pa'o//sgrub pa la yang ri mo ni/ /tshul 'di dang ni mtshungs zhes bya/ /ye shes dbang sgyur chornal 'byor pas/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog las rgyal mchog /rdzogs pa'i bsam gtan kyis bsgrub bya/ /bla ma'i 22—634

man ngag rab thob cing / /sbyor shes de dag lhur len pa/ /rtags 7bheshes dang po pha rol phyin/ /yul la zhen pa dang bral ba'i/ /bdag nyid chen po nyag gcig des/ /de 'dra'i sa bcu mgon po che/ /rang gi nus pa dang phrad pa/ /mnyes bya de yis yang dag blang / /me tog la sogs mchod pa'i tshogs/ /phyi rol nang du bcas sngon song / /thal sbyar pus mo btsugs nas ni/ /bla chen de la gsol ba btababye/ /'jig rten sgon mchog rnal 'byor kun la 'phags/ /khyod ni skyon rnams dag pa'i pha rol phyin/ /srid pa'i mtsho las sems can kun sgol ba/ /ded dpon chen po khyed la skyabs su mchi/ /bdag cag thabs bral 'khor bar 'khyams gyur te/ /ma rig mun pas bsgribs pas dmus long gyur/ /sdug bsngal kyis gzir yang dag don ma rnyed/ /bdag nyid chen po khrod kyis bskyab tu bye gsol/ /de skad gsol nas de yi tshe/ /bla ma bdag nyid chen po des / /snying rje chen po rab bskyed nas/ /tshig 'dis gnang ba sbyin pa'o/ /bu tshur shog cig bsam gtan gyi/ /'khor lo chen po nga yis bstan/ /khyod kyis kyang ni mnyam zhog la/ /nga yi bkod pa lta bar gyis/ /de skad gsol nas bsam gtan gyi/ /dkyil 'khor rim pa 'di yis bsgom/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i spyor ba ni/ /skad cig ye shes kyis rdzogs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas 'khor lo sbyar ba yis/ /bsam gtan 'khor lo rab rdzogs bya/ /ye shes 'khor lo bsam gtan kyis/ /'khor lo can kun mngon sum zhugs/ /gong gsungs mchod pa'i cho ga ni/ /bsam gtan ldan pas mnyes par bya/ /de nyid brjod pas 'khor lo bskul/ /zhugs sogs gong bzhin rab byas te/ /ye shes dbab pa sngon 'gro ba'i/ /mthong ba'i yul bzhin rnam par gnas/ /ye shes 22—635

kyi ni 'khor lo la/ /gnyis med 'khor lo gzhug par bya/ /de nas byin gyis brlabs brjod la/ /sa bcu'i mgon po'i dkyil 'khor la/ /dngos grub rtags ni shes bya'i phyir/ /me tog 'dod par bya ba ste/ /sku'am dbus su nub gyur na/ /phyag rgya chen po bsgrub par bya/ /zhal gyi dkyil 'khor la babs na/ /sngags kyi dngos grub thob par bshad/ /lte ba'i dbus su rab babs na/ /thun mong dngos grub brgyad 'grub bo/ /sku smad cha ni gar 'bab snakyang / /zhi sogs dngos grub 'byung ba'o/ /ring zhing thal bas dngos grub kyang / /da dung rgyang ring 'gyur ba'o/ /phyag rgya chen po ji lta bzhin/ /bsgrub 2pas ji bzhin dus thob bo/ /ye shes babs pa'i mthu nyid kyis/ /dman mchog gsum dang rang gi las/ /ji skad bshad bzhin gyis rab thob/ /de las gzhan pa ji snyed pa/ /bla ma'i ye shes stobs kyis ni/ /sbyar ba yis ni rnyed pa'o/ /de nas mkha' dbyings thams cad kun/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rig pa'i lha mo khro bo tshogs/ /chu sogs rkyen bzung gang bar bsamasasgo/ /de dag kun gyis bum pa dang / /gsang dang shes rab ye shes dang / /brtul zhugs lung bstan dbugs dbyung dang / /bka' sruX pa rnams rim bzhin dbang / /de yis de yi byang chub ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byang chub che/ /sems can thams cad phan 'dod pas/ /ngo mtshar chen po rab tu grub/ /bsam gtan dkyil 'khor bsam gtan gyis/ /mchod dang dbang bskur de bzhin du/ /byas nas gzhan la 'ga' yi don/ /bsgrub phyir lung 'di bsgo ba'o/ /nga yis byed ni dkyil 'khor du/ /bcug zin dbang bskur yang zin gyis/ /khyod kyis slob dpon sgrub po las/ /'dod bzhin du 22—636

ni gyis shig ces/ /gnang nas bsnyen la sogs pa la/ /'jug par gang yin 'gyur ba ste/ /de yis kyang ni khyod shes bya/ /bsam gtan 'khor los sbyang phyir ro/ /gnyis pa de ru 'jug mi nus/ /mthong ba'i yul la mngon zhen zhing / /blo gros ngan zhing sbyor ba spangs/ /dad ldan snod rung de mthong nas/ /don rnams yal bar mi 'dor phyir/ /snying rje chen po rab bskyed nas/ /dag sogs cho ga sngon 'go ba'i/ /phyi yi bya ba bsten bya ste/ /ye shes cung zad dbang gyur ltar/ /ri mo'i dkyil 'khor bris nas ni/ /dbang bskur yang dag brtsam bya ste/ /gnyis med man ngag gis sbyang bya/ /de bzhin sku sogs 'khor lo la/ /cho ga sngon bzhin rgyas bya ste/ /kun khyab chos kyi dbyings ye shes / /thams cad de ru rnam dag pas/ /bde gshegs gnas su mi bskyod dgod—/ /gzhan gyi gnas su gzhan bkod de/ /gnyis shes rdo rje mtshon la sogs / /khyad par gzhan yang rtogs par bya/ /rdo rje slob dpon slob ma sogs—/ /gong dang 'og gi cho ga rnams/ /sems kyi 'ba' zhig gtso bor gsungs / /dman pa las ni mchog mi 'gyur/ /sems nyid glang po yan lta bu / /gzugs la sogs la 'phyan 1byed pas/ /ngan 'gro g.yang sar ltung bar 'gyur/ /de nyid rab tu rtogs byas la/ /dran pa'i thag pa dam po yis /dmigs pa'i ka ba la btags te/ /'dod bzhin ba yi yul spyod pas/ /ji lta bzhin du 'dus par bya/ /ji skad du/ sems can kun gyi sems gang ni/ /brtan 3pa'i phyir na sems dpar brjod/ /mnyam par gzhag — na ting 'dzin te / /de bstan pa las rdo rjer 'gyur/ /sems dpa'i byin rlabs sbyor ba las / /slar yang rdo rje sems dpar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /bsod nams 22—637

tshogs kyi yan lag phyir/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis lus ngag gi/ /bya ba bstan te drang srong ltar/ /dang po rab tu 'drid pa'o1bhe/ /khang skas yan lag dang po bzhin/ /steng phyin ma yin dgos med min/ /de yi rten rngugyis de bzung ste//de nyid 'ba' zhig rtogs par bya/ /de bas sems la khyad par 'byung / /longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul pa'i sku/ /de yi zhing khams yongs dag pa/ /sems nyid 'ba' zhig las 'byung ste/ /mtshams kyi rnam shes ji lta dang / /klu khros pa yi sems bzhin du/ /mi mthun ltar yang snang ba ste/ /de bas sems nyid rtogs par bya/ /rnal 'byor pa rnam pa gsum gyis slob ma rnams dbang bskur ba'i cho ga rgyas par bshad zin to// //da ni dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs kyi cho ga bshad par bya'o/ /de la sgrub pa po'i 4gang zag ni/ brtul zhugs sdom pa sngags ldan pa/ /mi brtan lha yi nga rgyal bral/ /cung zad ye shes dbang gyur pa/ /thun mong sgrub pa shes par bya / /rgyu dang mi rgyur bcas pa rnams/ /sgyu cho'adrar sems can dbyer med rtogs / /thun mong cig shos dngos grub kyi/ /sgrub par 5ye shes dbang gyur pa'o / /de yi yid dang mthun pa'i gnas/ /shin tu dbe+en pa'i ri dgon dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs ri bo dang / /klung 7dang 'bab chu rnams dang ni/ /dur gyi khrod la sogs par yang / /bsam gtan bsdus pa 'di bsgom mo/ /dgon pa chen po'i sa phyogs ni/ /me tog 'bras bu sogs kyis brgyan/ /ri bo dpen pa dag tu ni/ /dngos grub thams cad bsdus pas 'grub/ /lam gyi bzhi mdo shing gcig drung / /mtshan ma gcig dang zhi gnas su/ /rdo rje 22—638

dgug pa'i khyad par gyis/ /sgrub pa pos ni rtag tu bsgrub/ /dgon pa chen po'i sa phyogs sam/ /rab tu rnam par dbe+en pa'am/ /ri bo nags 'dab chu ngogs su/ /ting 'dzin byas nas ting 'dzin 'thob/ /rdo rje 'gug 1gnas mig sman dang / /ka pā la ru bsgom par bya/ /yid du 'ong dang shis pa'i gnas—/ /sgrub pa po yis rab nges bya/ /rjes su mthun pa'i shis pa'i zas/ /nyi ma dang ni zla ba dang / /chu dang shel dang sman dang dri/ /phyag rgya chen po rig 'dzin gyis/ /lam la mkhas pa rnams kyis sngags/ /glang chen sha yis mngon shes bsgrub3/ /rta yi sha yis mi snang bsgrub/ /'gugs pa ba lang sha yis bsgrub/ /khyi sha yis ni thams cad bsgrub/ /nus pa yis ni dgug par bya//med na bsam pas rnam par brtag /ngo bo nyid dang mthun dag dang / /rang bzhin gyis ni de 'grub pa'o/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa' grags chen mnyes/ /'dod khams 'jig rten dbang phyug gi/ /las kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /gtso bo gzi chen stobs dang ldan/ /mdangs bzang mthong na yid du 'ong / /mthong bas bskul ba ma byas kyang / /'jig rten 'di dag dbang du 'gyur/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba dam pa byang chub ste/ /yang dag sngags kyi gsang ba 'di/ /rmongs pa'i man ngag sems 'da'o/ /mi snang stobs dang brtson 'grus dang / /dam tshig chen po bsgrub pa dang / /rdo rje 'gugs pa mchog dag kyang / /dam tshig 'di yis rnam par grub / /grub pa yi ni mtshan ma ni/ /shin tu 'be+ebs pa thob pa yis/ /gdon mi za bar 'grub 'gyur te/ /bsod nams tshogs kyi yan lag rdzogs/ /spyi yi mtshan mar shes par bya/ /bzlas dang bsgom dang 22—639
