rang lha yi/ /khyad par gang yin rtogs par mdzad/ /rmi lam bye brag rab byed pas/ /so so'i mtshan ma shes par bya/ /bsam gtan ngag gi bzlas pa yis / /dus sam byin rlabs rab sdud du/ /'dod pas rnyed pa'i mtshan ma ni / /rmi lam du ni shes par bya / /3rmi lam na sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs tha dad par mthong ba dang / rmi lam na bdag nyid ye shes mchog thob nas sangs rgyas thams cad dang mthu mnyam par mthong ba dang /rmi lam na mtshan dang dpe byad du ldan pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rgyud dag pa la snang bar bdag nyid mthong ba dang / rmi lam na brgya byin dang tshangs pa dang drag pa 2sogs pas bdag nyid la me tog la sogs pas mchod par mthong ba dang / rmi lam na sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis 1phyi nang gi 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas bdag la mchod par mthong ba dang / rmi lam na bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang ba'am/ rtag pa la sogs pa'i gzugs su mthong ba dang / rmi lam na rdo rje gsum mam spyan ma la sogs pa'am/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bdag la btud cing phyag 'tshal bar mthong ba dang /rmi lam na mngon dga' la sogs pa'i zhing du mi bskyod pa la sogs pa mthong ba dang / de dag kyang thugs rab tu dgyes nas chos kyi mdzod chen po gtad par mthong ba dang / rmi lam na bdag nyid shākya thub pa la sogs pa'i gzugs lha dang klu dang gnod spyin la sogs pas bskor zhing chos bshad par mthong ba dang /rmi lam na bdag nyid la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis nam mkha' la gdugs dkar po bteg cing / seng ge'i khri la bzhag nas chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur bar mthong ba dang / rmi lam na gdol pa'i bu mo'am/22—640

khyi'am—/ rta rgod ma la sogs pa'am/ snyoms par 'jug pa de dag phyag rgya chen po grub pa'i mtshan ma'o/ /gzhan yang rmi lam na kha dog sna tshogs pa'i kun dga' ra ba dang skyed mos tshal yid du 'ong ba mthong ba dang / rmi lam na lha'i bu mo gdu bu dang / dpung rgyan dang / snyan cha dang / mgur chu dang /nu 'bur dang / zur phud la sogs pas brgyan pa dang / mi'i khye'u dang bu mo yid du 'ong ba bcu drug pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa mthong ba ni thun mong gi 'grub 1pa'i mtshan ma'o/ /rigs 'dzin la sogs yongs smin las/ /'dzam bu gser 'dra'i sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /de bas de dag thams cad kun/ /cig shos mtshan mar shes par bya/ /sngon du bya ba'i las kyi rgyal po mchog ni/sngags pa rnam par dag pa yis/ /de dag rab tu rtogs byas nas/ /sngon gyi phyir na gnyis kyis kyang / /ci rigs gsang sngags bzlas brjod bya/ /dbe+en par gtsang gtor byas nas su/ /bgegs bskrad sa la gsol ba btab2/ /cig shos la yang gsol byas nas/ /bka' stsal sa ni brko bar bya/ /sngon gyi rim pa shes byas la/ /sa stengs rgyan dang ldan pa dang / /dag bya'i phyir na gong bzhin du/ /dbang bskur blang bas 4yid sbyang bya/ /rdo rjes khyad par byas pa yis5/ /sa 'dzin lta bur byin brlabs 6la/ /bdag nyid ting 'dzin gsum gnas pas/ /de dbus nga rgyal gsum ldan bya/ /sngon bzhin rtag sogs gsol btab nas/ /byen brlabs stangs thabs brtsam pa'o/ /phur bus btab nas sa srung ste/ /nub gcig sta gon gnas par bya/ /lha rnams gnas par byas nas su/ /brod bskyed mchod pa sna tshogs brtsam/ /dgongs par bya phyir gong ma bzhin/ /'khor lo gsol ba gdab par bya/ /lha mo bzhi 22—6

dang mi bskyod pa/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i bum pa ni/ /rdzas dang ldan par sta gon bya/ /yod na bcu dgu nges pa'o/ /skud pa tshon rtsi 'dus byas la /sngon bzhin 'be+ebs pa'i cho ga bya/ /de yis thig dang tshon btab nas/ /zhal sogs ldan pa'i phyag rgya dgod/ /gzhan la ma thos sems can rnams/ /gzung bar bya phyir sngon bzhin bshad/ /gnas rnams stong pa mi mdzes pas/ /dang chung srid pas de ma bsngagasarmye/ /mi rnams kyis ni phye ma yis/ /zhal la sogs pa rdzogs mi 'gyur/ /yan lag ma rdzogs byin mi rlob/ /de bas lha yi mdzes pa bsngags1/ /rang gi phyag rgya'am sems kyis su/ /lha rnams rab tu gnas byas nas/ /byen rlabs sngon chodu mchod pa sogs/ /brtsams te 'byung gtor khyad par du/ /rnam rgyal spyor bas skyon bsal nas/ /tshim par bya phyir lha rnams la/ /ji srid rdzas kyi thab rnams su/ /sbyin sreg gis ni mnyes bya'o/ /slob ma gzhug 5pa'i rim pa bzhin/ /bdag nyid 'khor lor zhugs par bya/ /sdig bshags me tog 'dor ba'i bar/ /byas nas lha rnams kyis gnang ba'i/ /sngon bzhin bum pa gsang ba dang / /shes rab ye shes brtul zhugs dang / /lung bstan dbugs dbyung bka' stsal thob/ /de yis bsgrub pa brtsam pa'o 6sgrub pa'i thabs gang zhe na/ dang po de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /rig 'dzin sgrub thabs bshad par bya'o/ /ji bzhin byas pa'i sngags pa yis/ /thun mong cig shos bgegs bsal nas/ /spyi gzugs gyur nas rtag pa las/ /byung ba'i gzhal yas khang pa bsgom/ /lnga dang bzhi las mchog dang po/ /rab bskyed skye rim 7bzhi spangs nas/ /dri za rab tu zhugs byas pas/ /de ni cho ga bzhin du zhu/ /rang gi tshangs pa'i spyod pa bzhi/ /mā ma shī la sogs gyur 22—642

nas—/ /bskul te thim gyur sa bon gyur/ /phyag mtshan des mtshan bshes gnyen zhugs 1/ /de las rtag pa sngon bzhin bskyed/ /de yi thugs kar zla ba la/ /oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan/ /bsams nas sngags kyis byin gyis brlab—/ /oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa a kolhasnyehaṃ/ gnyis sogs ma gtogs de phyag rgyasacho/ /gnas nas sngags 'di bsgom par bya/ /oṃ āḥ.oṃ dzi na dzika rtsu/brjod pas oṃ las 'od zer tshogs/ /dkar ba'i rgyun gyis nang gsal te/ /ba sru'i 5bu ga nas spros pa'i/ /'od rtse rtag pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /nam mkha'i khams kun bkang byas nas/ /sangs rgyas rtag pa spyan drangs nas/ /rang gi ba spu'i ⑥bu gar gzud kye/ /brtan pa'i ngo bos phyag byas nas/ /yang nas yang du dus bzhir bsgom/ /de nas zhag bdun la sogs nas/ /nye ba'i mtshan ma mthong nas ni/ /'byung po rnams la gtor byin nas/ /yang ni sbyin pa der zhen bya/ /'di lta bu yi sbyor ldan pas/ /rdo rje'i sku ni rgya mtsho dag /zla ba phyed na nges pa ru/ /the tshom med par 'grub par 'gyur/ /ye shes lnga ldan bsten nas ni/ /rnam par snang mdzad dang 'dra ba'i/ /sangs rgyas sgu ni 'bar ba'i 'od/ /rdo rje bskal pa gsum du gnas/ /thams cad sngon bzhin rab byas te/ /'od dpag med bsgoms mgrin pa ru/ /āḥ8 las pad+ma āḥ9yis mtshan/ /bsams nas bzlas brjod yang bya'o/ /oṃ āḥ.ā ro rbaka hūṃ/ /de yis sngon bzhin 'od dpag med/ /spros te bkug nas rang la btsud/ /brtan byas sngon bzhin rab bsgrubs nas/ /zla ba phyed na 'grub par nges/ /ye shes lnga dang ldan pa yis/ /rdo rje chos ni bsten byas nas/ /de dang 'dra ba'i 'od thob ste/ /rdo rje bskal pa gsum du gnas/ /sngon 22—643

bzhin mi bskyod rab bskyed de/ /thugs kar hūṃ las rdo rje la/ /hūṃ gis mtshan pa rab bsams la/ /sngags kyi bzlas brjod bya ba'o/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra dh+rika hūṃ/ sangs rgyas mi bskyod tshogs nyurnams kyang / /btsud nas chags par byas nas su/ /sngon bzhin nye mtshan mthong bsgrubs nas/ /zla phyed 'grub par the tshom med/ /ye shes lnga ldan bsten na ni/ /ston pa rdo rje thugs 'dra ba/ /ye shes yon tan rgya mtshor 'gyur/ /rdo rje bskal pa gsum du gnas/ /thams cad sngon bzhin rab gnas te/ /mi bskyod cho ga bzhin bskyed nas/ /thugs kar rdo rje bum pa ru/ /oṃ bsams bzlas brjod bya ba'o/ /oṃ dharma dhā tu sgyudzñā na rastu hūṃ/ mi bskyod tshogs bkug sngon bzhin du/ /zhugs nas chags byas nye bar mthong / /gtor ma btang nas rab bsgrubs nas/ /zla phyed mi bskyod 'dra ba thob/ /mi bskyod pa yi sku dag dang / /gsung dang thugs mchog 'dra ba 'dzin/ /'jig rten khams rnams thams cad du/ /mi bskyod rdo rje mchod par 'gyur/ /rin chen 'byung ldan sngon bzhin bskyed/ /thugs kar mtshan ma la gnas pa'i/ /oṃ bzlas pa yis 'grub pa'o/ /de dang 'dra bar bsgrub par bya/ /oṃ s+dza.oṃ sa man+ta dzñā na rastu dh+ri/ de yis rin chen 'byung ldan tshogs//spros pa bkug nas rab tu btsud/ /brtan byas gong bzhin rab bsgrubs nas/ /zla ba phyed na rab tu 'grub/ /lus dang ngag sems rdo rje yi/ /rin chen 'byung ba'i 'od dang 'dra/ /de ni byang chub bdag med dang / /ye shes gsang ba'i gnas su 'gyur/ /'od dpag med pa bsgom byas la/ /de yi thugs kar pad+ma la/ /gnas pa'i oṃ ni bzlas byas pas/ /dpag med 'dra ba bsgrub par bya/ /oṃ s+dza oṃ pra t+ya 4be+ek+ṣa ṇa dzñā na rastu hūṃ/ 'od dpag med pa'i 22—644

tshogs spros pas/ /bkug nas brtan byas chags byas nas/ /gong ma bzhin du rab bsgrubs nas/ /zla ba phyed na 'grub par nges/ /sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje yi/ /dpag med pa yi 'od dang 'dra/ /'di ni sems can thams cad kyi/ /jeg chen lam gyi mchog tu 'gyur/ /sngon bzhin don yod grub bsgoms la/ /thugs kar ral gri'i snabheyu ba la/ /zla ba'i dbus su oṃ bsams la / /sngags kyi bzlas brjod brtsam pa'o/ /oṃ āḥ.oṃ kri ta a nuṣ+ṭha na 2dzñā na rastu hūṃ/ de yis don yod grub pa'i tshogs/ /spros te bkug byas zhugs byas la—/ /gnas brtan ngo bor chags byas na/ /zla ba phyed na de dag 'grub/ /sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje yi/ /rdo rje thogs med 'dra ba 'ong / /de ni dpal ldan ye shes mtsho/ /sems can don kun 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin snang mdzad bsgom —byas te/ /sngags kyi bzlas brjod bya ba'o/ /oṃ āḥ.oṃ ā dar+sha dzñā na badz+ra rastu hūṃ/ sngon bzhin zhugs sogs rab byas nas/ /zla phyed de dang 'dra bar 'grub/ /thams cad snga ma bzhin byas te/ /snang mdzad mgo mgrin thugs ka ru/ /'khor lo pad+ma rdo rje la/ /zla ba'i dbus nas oṃ gsum gnas/ /oṃ āḥ.oṃ oṃ oṃ tri ga ka ra ya rastu chohūm̐/ de yis rdo rje gsum gyi tshogs/ /bkug nas gnas gsum du brtan par/ /byas nas nye ba'i mtshan ma mthong / /gong bzhin byas na zla phyed 'grub/ /sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje yi/ /sangs rgyas snang mdzad 'dra ba'i mdog /de ni byang chub ye shes dang / /sku gsum 1ye shes 'grub par 'gyur/ /de yi rim pas mi bskyod sogs/ /rang rang ngo bos rab bsgrubs na / /dpal ldan zla ba phyed grub nas/ /rdo rje bskal pa gsum du gnas/ /de bzhin de ltar de gnyis sam/ /gcig la'ang gsum du 22—645

goms byas nas/ /rgyal ba'i sras po mos pa yis/ /nyung ngam lhag par gnas par 'gyur/ /sngon bzhin thams cad rab byas la/ /rnam par snang mdzad cho ga bzhin/ /bskyed nas chos dbyengs byin brlabs ①nas/ /lag pa g.yas pa 'khor lo bskyed/ /'khor lo gser sogs dngos byas la/ /oṃ bskyed lte bar rtag pa yi/ /'khor lo chen po rab bsgoms te/ /sngags kyi bzlas brjod brtsam pa'o/ /oṃ āḥdzi na dzika tsakra aza sidhi hūṃ swā hā/ 'od zer gyis bkug rtag dkyil 'khor/ /bsdus te bcug nas brtan byas pas/ /drod dang dud 'thul 'bar ba dang / /nam mkha' la ni 'phar bar 'gyur/ /de yi steng du su bsams nas/ /lag tu babs nas spyan mas bzla/ /'byung po rnams la gtor sbyin la/ /chags byas zla ba phyed nas 'grub/ /ri rab sum cu rtsa drug gi / /rab tu phra ba'i rdul snyed kyi/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang 'dra ba kun/ /de yi rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur/ /sngon bzhin mi bskyod rab bsgoms la/ /rdo rje dngos byas hūṃ bskyed de/ /rdo rje rigs kyi 'khor lo bsgom/ /sngags kyi bzlas brjod bya ba'o/ /oṃ s+dzabadz+ra j-ika badz+ra arba sirnyi hūṃ swā hā/ rdo rje cerigs kyi spro dang bsdu/ /brtan par byas la chags byas nas/ /sngon bzhin rab tu bsgrub gyur 5/na/ /zla ba phyed na 'grub par nges/ /ri rab sum cu rtsa drug gi/ /rdul phran ji snyed yod pa yi/ /de snyed kyi ni bud med rnams/ /yon tan can gyi bdag gir 'gyur/ /drag po dag gis phyag byas pasatre/ /khams gsum rdo rje chen por 'gyur/ /sngon bzhin rgyas par rin chen 'byung / /bsgoms nas swa bskyed rin chen dngos/ /rin chen rigs kyi lha bsgoms la/ /sngags kyi bzlas brjod bya ba'o/ /oṃ āḥrat+na byeka rat+na dz+wa.arba sidhi swā hā/ rin chen 22—646

rigs kyi lha rnams kun/ /spro zhing bsdu bas brtan 1snabyas nas/ /nye ba'i mtshan mthong sngon bzhin bsgoms/ /zla ba phyed 'grub the tshom med/ /ye shes lnga ldan bsten na ni/ /bskal pa gsum gye yun gnas shing / /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /gsang ba gsum la bsnyen bkur byed/ /de bzhin dpag med tshe bsgoms la/ /gser sogs pad+ma a las skyes/ /lte bar gsung rigs lha bsgoms la/ /bzlas brjod rab tu bya ba'o/ /oṃ āḥ.ā ro t+paka ka ma la arba sirnyi swā hā/ de spros gsung gi rigs bkug nas/ /bcug nas brtan bya yang yang bsgom/ /mtshan ma thob nas gtor ma btang / /zla ba phyed na de 'grub 'gyur/ /ri rab sum cu rtsa drug gi/ /rab tu phra ba'i rdul snyed la/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la/ /dag pa'i bdag nyid 'jog par byed/ /don yod grub pa sngon bzhin bsgom/ /ral gri dngos byas ha las bskyed/ /las kyi lha rnams yu bar bsgom/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa brtsam pa'o / /oṃ āḥpradzñā dh+rika khaṅga arba sid+dhi swā hā/ las kyi rigs kyi lha rnams spro/ /bsdu zhing bcug nas chags byas na/ /de mtshan mthong nas sngon bzhin bsgrub / /zla phyed kyis ni nges par 'grub/ /khams gsum kun gyis rab mchod cing / /tshangs la sogs pas phyag kyang byas5/ /stong gsum na ni mchog tu dpa'/ /mi mchog gsang ba 'dzin par 'gyur/ /gang rnams 'dod dang bsam pa dag /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje thugs las rab byung ba/ /de lta bu yi dngos grub ster / /6'khor lo la sogs grub pa'i mchog /sangs rgyas sku dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /gang gā'i gebye snyed thams cad du/ /grub pa kun du rnam par spyod/ /dam tshig dam pa thams cad kyi/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i gtso 22—647

bor 'gyur/ /rdo rje sku ni rab bsgoms pas/ /de ni dam tshig mchog tu 'gyur//thams cad snga ma bzhin byas te/ /'jam dpal bskyed pa'i cho ga rdzogs/ /thugs kar ral gri'i lhayu ba la/ /haṃ gi 'od ldan bzlas brjod bya/ oṃ āḥ1haṃ mañdzu shrī hūṃ phaṭa/ de yi 'od kyis ④nang gsal nas/ /ba spu las byung 'od zer lngasashe—/ /thams cad 'jam dpal skur thubyas te/ /bkug cing bu gar thim par bya/ /yang nas yang du brtan byas pas/ /ba spu dbang po gzhu mthong nas//'byung po gtor byin chags byas na hūṃ// /zla ba phyed kyis nges par 'grub/ /'jam dpal dam tshig longs spyod la pya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /sa bcu dag la gnas pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' de 'gyur ro/ /yang ni 'jam dpal de bzhin bsgom3/ /ral gri yu bar bcug 'phan gnas/ /bzlas brjod byas la gong bzhin dpag /de dang 'dra bar bsgrub par bya/ /oṃ s+dzazlo mañdzu hūṃ swā hā/ de ni zla ba phyed na yang / /'od zer 'bar bar gyur pa yin/ /rdul phran rdo rje lus ngag gi/ /rdo rje sku dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /snga ma bzhin du kun shes bya/ /gshin rje gshed la sogs pa bcu/ /longs spyod dang po rdzogs pa la/ /mtshan ma yis ni de 'dra 'grub/ /tho ba dbyug pa pad+ma dang / /rdo rje lcags kyu dbyug gsal zhing / /ral gri 'khor lo rdo rje rnams/ /dngos byas 'khor lo gcig bsgom brjod/ /oṃ āḥya mān+ta kṛta muṅga ra sid+dhi hūṃ/oṃ āḥpradzñārnya kṛta badz+ra dha na da sid+dhi hūṃ/ oṃ āḥpad+mān+ta kṛta pad+ma sed+dhi hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbispyon+ta kṛta badz+ra sirnyi t+t+waṃ/ oṃ āḥṭāk+ki rā dza saṃ ku sha sidhi hūṃ/9 oṃ āḥnī la daṇ+ḍi daṇ+ḍa — sid+dhi hūṃ/ oṃ āḥm hā ba la tri shā 11la sid+dhi hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.a skyatsa la khaṅga 13sid+dhi hūṃ/ oṃ āḥtsakra warti tsakra sirnyi hūṃ/ oṃ āḥsum̐ bha badzo sirnyi hūṃ/ de 22—648

yis khro bo'i tshogs bkug ste/ /bcug nas brtan par byas nas su/ /sngon shebazhin gtor sogs kyis bsgrub pyan/ /de 'dra zla ba phyed na 'grub/ /yang na rtag pa 'od dpag med/ /mi bskyod pa yi — mtshan ma rnams/ /bsgrubs te rang gi lha bcug pas/ /zla byed de dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /mi snang ba bsgrub pa'i cho ga bshad par bya'o/ /sngon du spyi yi cho ga sogs/ /rgyas par rab tu bshad 'gyur yang / /bde blag tu ni rtogs bya'i phyir/ /yang ni thugs rjes bsdus te bstan/ /mtshan ma thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /'dzab bzlas cho ga la sogs nas/ /lhas dbang bskur ba'i bar zhugs la/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug par bya/ /bgegs bzlog cho ga nas brtsams te/ /brgyad kyis nam mkha' kru snying po bskyed/ /chos dbyings byin rlabs 5lus kun la/ /gnas bzhi ma gtogs 4 khaṃ gis mtshan/ /oṃ yisakhaṃ ga na kha gasgo hūṃ/ de yi 'od kyis 7sangs rgyas rnams/ /nam mkha'i snying po'i skur byas la/ /bkug ste khaṃ kun la bstems 5la/ /nam mkha' zubazhin du stong par bsam/ /bdag gi yan lag mi mthong sogs/ /'byung po gtor ma yang byin te/ /chags byas yang du bsgrub 'gyur na/ /zla ba phyed na mi snang 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /yang dang yang du mchod pa dang / /bskal pa gcig tu gnas pa dang / /sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs 'gyur/ / gzhi yi sbyi'abras bu gzhan yin phyir/ /de bshad gsang ba'i thig le las/ /rim pa 'di bzhin tshig 'grub pa/ /'jig rten dbang po bsgrub 1pa bshad/ /thams cad sngon bzhin rab byas la/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang bsgom par bya/ /de lce s+thāḥ rki las pad+ma ni/ /'dab brgyad mdun du rdo rje ni/ /oṃ āḥdīḥkalo ke shwa ra bha dha 22—649

na arba sidhi hūṃ swā hā/ bzlas pa thos pas sangs rgyas rnams/ /'jig rten dbang ni bskur byas te/ /bkug ste lce la bcug nas ni/ /gnas brtan ngo bor chags par bya/ /lce de rdo rje mthong gyur nas/ /gtor ma byin te yang yang bsgom/ /zla ba phyed na nges pa ru/ /tshig gi dngos grub thams cad 'grub//bden pa ru ni smra ba dang / /shags dang rgol ba sun 'byin dang / /kun thos rnams ni yid 'ong bar/ /'gyur ba 'di la the tshom med/ /de las yang ni sgrub pa'i mchog /mtshon cha rnams ni 'jig 'gyur ba/ /phyi mas dhigasungs pa 'byung ba'i phyir/ /de yi sgrub ⑪pa'i cho ga bshad/ /sngon gsungs rgyas par bshad pa yi/ /cho ga rnams ni rdzogs byas la/ /klu shing me tog mtshan pa yi①/ /snang mdzad 'dra ba'i byams pa bskyed/ /thugs kar mtshan ma la gnas pa'i/ /me ni cho ga bzhin bsgoms la/ /bzlas brjod byas pas byams pa yi/ /tshogs kyis khams gsum dgad pa'o/ /oṃ s+dzame ma hā me dha ra sa ra ṇa hūṃ swā hā/ de yis sems can thams cad la/ /byams pas dmigs byas snying rje sogs/ /khro dang bral bar rab bsams la/ /sems can de dag rab tu bsdu/ /brtan par rab tu chags byas la/ /ral gri so sogs ma gtogs te/ /'byung po gtor sbyin yang bsgoms na/ /zla phyed mtshon chas mi tshugs so/ /'phen dang mi 'phen la sogs pa/ /mthong ba tsam gyis 'jig par 'gyur/ /btab 'gyur 'thor ram me tog 'gyur/ /gang mthong byams sems dang ldan pa'o/ /sngon bzhin bya ba thams cad bya/ /'jam dpal cho ga bzhin bsgoms la④/ /thugs kar ral gri'i 5yu bar mo/ /bsams nas bzlas brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ s+dza.oṃ mdzi shrī arba sid+dhi hūṃ swā hā/ 'od zer stug pos nang gsal te/ /ba spu'i tre 22—650

bu ga las byung bas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'jam dpal skur/ /byas te bkug nas ba spu yi/ /bu gar bcug nas stong pa nyid/ /bsams pas sngon bzhin rtogs 'gyur na/ /bar chad zhi bar byas nas su/ /bsgrubs na zla ba phyed na 'grub/ /dpag tshad brgya yi khyon tsam du/ /rdo rje 'jam pa'i 'od dag gis/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa yi/ /grub pa'i mtshan ma snang bar 'gyur—/ /tshangs pa drag po la sogs lhas/ /nam yang mthong bar mi nus so//yang ni sngon bzhin thams cad bya/ /phyag rgya chen po gang yang rung / /cho ga bzhin du dang pos bsgrub/ /de yis bsgrub pa'i ri lu gsungs/ /bdud rtsi lnga hulnga'am rta 1shar sbyar/ /khyi sha'am sha chen dag dang sbyar/ /ba lang sha'am shang srin bu/ /ga bur tsan+dan dang sbyar ba'am/ / gi waṃ 1/a ka rur sbyar ba'am/ /ga bur gur kum sbyar ba yi/ /ril bu skred byed lnga spyor tsam/ /nyi ma zla ba sred byed kyi/ /nyi ma man cha bzhi dang ni/ /sreg byed gcig ste zla ba gnyis/ /bkri ba tsa na'i 'bru tsam du/ /oṃ'am āḥ'am hūṃ las bskyed/ /khar bcug nas ni de dbus su/ /rang gi 'khor lo rab bsgoms la/ /de yis de yi sangs rgyas tshogs/ /bkug ste bcug nas bzlas brjod bya/ /oṃ āḥku la arba sirnyi hūṃ/ /brtan pa'i ngo bor chags byas nas/ /'bar sogs mtshan ma mthong bar 'gyur/ /'byung po gtor ma yang byin nas/ /bsgoms na zla phyed mi snang 'gyur/ /rdo rje sku dang rab 'dra zhing / /nyi ma shar ba'i 'od 'dra ste/ /'dzam bu na da'i gser 'od kyi/ /byang chub ye shes thob par 'gyur/ /'di ni dpal dang ldan pa yi/ /sangs rgyas 'od dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /dpag tshad bye ba gang gā yi/ /steng du rdo rje 'gro bar 'gyur/ /'dod khams gnas 22—651

pa'i bu mo ni/ /lha yi longs spyod brtul zhugs ma4/ /yang na gzugs khams gnas pa la/ /stobs chen gyis ni 'dod pa spyod/ /thams cad sngon bzhin rab byas te/ /rang gi lha ni dang po dmigs/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su man 'ji'i steng / /thod pa yis ni brgyan par bya/ /bdud rtsi lnga ni go rims bzhin—/ /gong gi cho gas dag byas nas bu/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ yig gsum po ni/ /brgya dang brgyad du bzlas par bya/ /de yis ke dro ba la sogs pa/ /mthong nas bar chad zhi bya ste/ /yang ni sbyor bas brtan byas na/ /zla phyed sangs rgyas kyis mi mthong / /de bzhin bshad pa 'ba' zhig gam/ /khyi sha rta sha 'bras chan shāsha /gong gi 5cho gas rab zos nas༅/ /sangs rgyas nyi mas mi mthong ngo / /mi snang gyur pa kun las mchog /stong khams dag ni snang bar byed/ /sangs rgyas kun la 'phrog pa dang / /lha yi bu mo mchog la spyod / /1mig sman sgrub 8pa bshad par bya'o/ /mtshan ma thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /thams cad sngon bzhin rab byas la/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba ni/ /longs spyod dang pos rdzogs par bya/ /nya yi dus su brtsams nas lkuni/ /dro sogs rgyu las rab byung ba/ /brgyad kyi dus su shes byas la/ /bcu bzhi'i dus su bsgrub par bya/ /gong gi gnas su song nas kyang / /thod pa gnyis ⑫kyi steng 'dug nas/ /mdun du thod pa'i man 'ji la/ /skyes pa'i thod pa bzang po bzhag /de yi nang du tshil chen la/ /khrag dang bdud rtsi lnga yis dgang / /pad+ma'i khong srog dur ras dkris/ /de la me mar 'bar bar bya/ /spyad mkhan thod pas steng bkab nas/ /de yi dud pa skye blangs nas su/ /'ug pa'i mgo ni bsreg mubyas nas / /pad+ma'i rak+ta bsre bar bya/ /srod kyi dus su btags nas su/ /bya 22—652

rgod rje ngar nang bkang la/ /pad+ma'i zil pas brlan par bya/ /'od med thur mas mig la bskutū/ /de yi tho rangs dus nas ni/ /gnod sbyin gter rnams mthong ba dang / /'gro kun dbang du 'gyur ba dang / /gzi can kun gyis mi mthong 'gyur/ /rig 'dzin grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa / /bskal par gso bar gnas pa'i rgyu/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi cho ga mchog /ji bzhin du ni bshad par bya//thabs dang shes rab dbye ba yis/ /dkon mchog dpal dang 'od dpag med/ /dbu rgyan la ni bsam byas la/ /gnyis su med pa'i ros zhu 'gyur/ /tshim pa'i cho ga bzhin drangs nas/ /rtsa rgyus thams cad khyab par byas/ /rlung dang bad kan mkhris pa ni/ /khros par gyur kyang mi thub bo/ /skal dbang rnam pa gsum po yis/ /mos pa'i sems can gzung —7ba'i phyir/ /mthun pa'i cho ga la gnas nas/ /rang rang dam tshig gis gnas bya/ /thugs rjes non pa'i sngags pa yis/ /nyan thos gzugs kyis gnyis med spang / /dge ba bcu la btsud nas ni/ /rang gi ngo bor 'gyur ba'o/ /de bzhin rang sangs rgyas gzugs kyis/ /lus kyi rdzu 'phrul dpag med mdzad/ /btsud nas de don 'di la bkod/ /slar yang rang gi ngo bor 'gyur/ /de bzhin skad cig oṃ las bskyed/ /tshangs pa chen po zhal bzhi pa/ /mtshan dang rgyan rnams kyis brgyan pa/ /tshangs skud se ral cod pan la/ /rdo rje sems dpas mtshan pa yi//dang po dbyug pa rtse gsum gyis/ /mtshan pas zhi ba'i ku tsa babyur/ /gnyis na bgrang phreng gudhe snye'adzin/ /dang steng pad+ma zla bar gnas/ /gti mug lam gyis dman pa rnams/ /'jigs pa bskyed cing mos ma thag /rang gi lha yi skur 'gyur ro/ /a las bskyed pa'i drag po ni/ /thal mdog zhal gcig spyan 22—653

gsum pa/ /zla phyed dang ldan cod pan la/ /rdo rje sems dpas mtshan pa'o/ /kha 1ṭ+wāṃ mgul pa dril mtshan pa'i/ /phyag g.yas kyi ⑤ni phrag pa brten/ /bdud rtsi lngas gang thod pa ni/ /g.yon pas bsnams zhushing 'khyud pa'o/ /u ma sku mdog ser po ste/ /me tog sna tshogs sku la dkris/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rab brgyan pa/ /rdo rje rtse mo nang bltas bsnams/ /gnyis kyis de yi ku tsa 'dzin / /stag lpags sham thabs glang steng na/ /pad+ma zla ba la gnas nas/ /zla ba'i 'od kyis rgyan du mtshan/ /de yi gzugs kyis 'dod chags can/ /bud med dngos po gsum spyad na/ /btsud nas mos ma thag tu ni/ /rang gi ngo bor 'gyur ba'o/ /hūṃ las bskyed pa'i khyab 'jug gzugs/ /nag po rin chen dbu rgyan can/ /rdo rje sems dpa' ral pa mtshan/ /phyag bzhi 'khor lo rtse gsum dang / /'bud dung rin chen ldan pa'o/ /lha mo gser sku'i bdag nyid 'dra/ /thod du me tog sna tshogs dkris/ /mtshan ma bdag 'dra rgyan rnams brgyan/ /dang po gnyis kyis legs par 'khyud/ /khyung steng pad+ma nyi ma la / /nyi ma'i 'od kyis rgyab brten mdzad/ /de yis gzugs khams gsum na gnas/ /sdang ba rnams ni bsad nas su/ /yal bar mi 'gyur brtson byas nas / /slar yang rang gi bdag nyid 'gyur/ /de ltar de bzhin sha bza' zhing / /gzhan gyi bud med spyod pa yis/ /gnod sbyin pho mo bsgrubs na ni/ /don byas yang ni grol bar 'gyur/ /'o ma dang ni phra ma dang / /'dod yon lnga dang dri rnams kyis/ /klu yi bu mo bsten byas na/ /yang ni grol nas ngo bor ④ gnas / /khro zhing nga rgyal gnod sems ldan/ /spos 5dang me tog spyad pa yis/ /lha min bu mo mnyes byas la/ /grol nas rang gi skur 'gyur ro/ /thos rung 22—654

bdug pa 'bru mar gyis/ /srin po rnams ni dga' bar bya/ /de bzhin 'byung po rnams kyang ngo / /des kyang gtsang ba'i don chen byed/ /bdud rtsi lnga'am khrag dag gam/ /chang la sogs pa 'thung ba tshoyis/ / go rī pyal sogs mnyes byas la/ /sdang ba ma lus gsad par bya/ /de bzhin brgya byin la sogs pa'i/ /ngo bo dam tshig la gnas nas/ /de 'dra'i sems can gdul bya'i phyir/ /gzugs kyis de tsam gnas pa'o/ /ngo bo nyid kyis kun 'byung ba/ /khams rnams dag na rnam par spyod/ /sems can kun la phan 'dod pas/ /dam tshig ma lus spyad par bya/ /gang dang gang gis bsam pa yis/ /'dul bar 'gyur ba'i gzugs can de/ /thugs rjes non pa de dang der/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid rnams kyis bstan/ /da ni mngon par shes pa lnga/ /bsgrub pa'i cho ga bshad par bya'o/ /mtshan ma thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /sngon bzhin bzlas pa'i cho ga nas/ /ri mo'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs byas nas/ /lha yis dbang bskur bar 1zhugs te/ /bgegs dgra spyor ba nas brtsams te/ /chos kyi dbyings su byin gyis brlabs④/ /gnyis kyi ⑤bsgrub pa rnam par bshad//gcig la 'bras bu gnyis su shes/ /mig gnyis dang ni rna ba gnyis/ /dpral ba snying ga lte ba ru/ /sngon bzhin k+ṣiṃ sogs mtha' gnyis las/ /'khor lo la sogs de yis ⑥mtshan/ /de las bzhi po gcig gnyis skyed⑩/ /de rnams thugs kyi 'od zer gyis/ /sangs rgyas rnams bkug zhugs byas pas/ /rdo rje sngar gyur bcud 'phan dumatshan/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra rjaka pañtsa nyi byed arba sirnyi hūṃ swā hā/de brjod 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /sangs rgyas sa snying sogs byas pas /bkug tre7ste gnas bcug brtan byas nas/ /bar du chod pa'ang mthong la sogs/ /22—655

dngos grub bar chod nyer zhi'i phyir/ /'byung po sogs la gtor byin nas/ /gong gi sbyor bas chags byas na/ /zla ba phyed na 'grub par 'gyur/ /de bzhin rtag pa rin chen 'byung / /'od dpag med dang don yod grub/ /'khor lo rin chen pad+ma dang / /ral gri gyur pa bcud 'phen mtshan/ /oṃ t+padzi na dzika pañtsa a bhi byed 3bhe.arba sidhi hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ rat+na dh+rika pañtsa a bhi byed atho sidhi hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ ā ro loka /zupañtsa a bhi bh+yod arja sirnyi hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ pradzñā dṛka pañtsa a bhi byed arja sirnyi hūṃ swā hā/ brjod cing spros pas gong ma ltar/ /sa snying la sogs bcug byas te/ /mtshan mthong bar chad zhi byas nas/ /zla ba phyed na nges par 'grub/ /gang gā'i bye snyed sangs rgyas rnams/ /nyid kyi rdo rje gdan bzhugs pa/ /shing tog lag tu bzhag pa bzhin/ /rdo rje mig gis mthong bar 'gyur/ /gang gā'i bye snyed zhing dag na/ /rna ba'i drung na 'khod pa bzhin/ /sgra grags pa yi rkyoji snyed pa/ /mngon shes rna bas thos pa'o/ /gang gā'i bye snyed zhing dag gi/ /sems can kun gyi sems rnams ni/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs kyis mtshan/ /gar mkhan la sogs rig par 'gyur/ /bskal pa gang gā'i bye snyed du/ /'khor ba dag na gnas pa yi/ /sngon gyi gnas kyi gtan tshigs brtag4 /zhag gsum 'das pa bzhin du dran/ /gang gā'i bye snyed zhing dag tu/ /sangs rgyas sprin gyis brgyan pa'i sku/ /bskal pa gang gā'i bye snyed du/ /rdo rje rdzu 'phrul mchog gis 'gengs/ /sangs rgyas mngon shes rgyu yi phyir/ /phul du 'byung bar bshad pa ste/ /grangs dang tshad du rab ldan pa'i/ /mngon par shes pa rtogs par bya/ /gang gā'i bye snyed grangs med pa'i/ /'khor gyis yongs su bskor nas su/ /rdo rje sku dang gsung 22—656

thugs kyis/ /'jig rten khams kun bgrod par 'gyur / /1da ni dgug pa'i cho ga'i las 'ga' zhig bshad par bya'o/ /mtshan ma thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas—/ /gang phyagasungs gnas su ji lta bzhin/ /ri mo'i dkyil 'khor bri byas nas—/ /lha yi 1 dbang bskur byas nas zhugs —/ /bka' yi 'khor lo sogs sbyor bas/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sngon 'gro ba'i/ /'dod pa'i lha ru dmigs byas la/ /mig la sogs pa byin gyis brlabs5/ /lcags kyu gnas ni bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje gsum gyis byin kyis brlabs6/ /yi ge gsum par rang rang sngags/ /rig pa dang bcas bzlas par bya/ /rdo rje gsum las 'phros pa yi—/ /lcags kyus mtshan pa'i lha rnams spro/ /skyes pa bud med la sogs pa/ /sems can ma yin pa yang rung / /rlung gi dkyil 'khor thog gnas pa/ /lcags kyus snying gar sbyar bar bya/ /rim bzhin 'ongs te lam byung gis/ /phab ste pyamadun du zla gnas la/ /'og 'byung cho gas mā ma shī/ /spyan ma zhi dang bsrung bar bya/ /de ltar byas pas ji tsam du/ /'dod pa'i las ni byed nus pas/ /cho ga'i mchog ni 'di nyid ni/ /dgug pa kun la spyi ru sbyar/ /de bzhin bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yang / /rdo rje gsum gyis mtshan pa bsgom/ /sngon bzhin rlung dkyil la gnas pa'i/ /mi yi bu mo mchog rnams dgug /oṃ s+dzabisnan+ta kṛta bu mo che ge mo ā kar+ṣa ya dza hūṃ dza/ brgya rtsa lnga bcur bsgod par bya/ /sngon bzhin 'dod pa'i rgyal po yang / /rdo rje gsum gyis byin brlabs 8la/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /nam mkha'i bu mo dgug par bya/ /oṃ āḥ— bheṭak+ki rā dza nam mkha'i bu mo ā kar+ṣa ya dza hūṃ dza/ sbyor ba de ltar gnod mdzes kyang / /rdo rje gsum gyis mtshan bsgoms la/ /lha ma yin gyi bu mo 22—657

mchog /rlung dkyil tri shu phyilcags kyus dgug /oṃ s+dza sum+bha rā 37dza lha ma yin gyi bu mo ā kar+ṣa ya dza hūṃ dza/ sngon bzhin 'jam dpal rdo rje bskyed/ /rdo rje gsum gyis byen brlabs la/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /gnod sbyin bu mo'i cod pan la/ /mnan phyir khro bo gshin rje gshed/ /bskal pa'i bsregs pa ltar bsams la/ /lcags kyu zhags pas snying gar sbyar/ /mngag bzhug don du dgug par bya/ /rang rang sngags kyi khyad par dang / /phyag rgya'i khyad par thams cad kyis/ /dgug par rang rang thabs su gsungs/ /gzhan du byas na mi 'grub 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /yang dang yang du bskul bar bya/ /de nyid lha rnams thams cad dang / /rgyal po rab tu brtan pa'o/ /rdo rje rgya mtsho rkang pas gnon pa'i cho ga bshad par bya'o/ /mtshan ma thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /ri mo'i cho ga sngon bstan bzhin/ /chu yi drung sogs bris nas kyang / /lha yi krudabang bskur bar gyis zhugs/ /bka' yi 'khor lo la sogs pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bskyed nas kyang / /dri za 'jug pa la sogs pas/ /byang chub sems su zhu bar 'gyur/ /de las phyogs bzhi dbus lnga'i chu/ / hūṃ s+t+waṃ dz+rī 5khaṃ hūṃ du gyur/ /de la mtshan ma de yis mtshan/ /spro basbu las ni rigs lngar gyur/ /mig la sogs pa byin gyis brlabs / /rdo rje gsum ni gnas gsum bkod/ /de rnams kyi ༄ bheni ye shes kyis / /bsgul sogs sngon 'gro dbang bskur bya/ /de yi dbu la bdag nyid ni / /rdo rje 'chang ba rig mar bcas/ /mi bskyod dbu gnas zhabs bzhi yithu/ /sangs rgyas bzhi yi spyi bor bsgom/ /oṃ āḥsarba budhe ma ku āt+pa haṃ hūṃ/ nga rgyal de yis brtan par gnas/ /chu la sogs pa reg rung ste/ /'byung po mnyes 22—658

par byas nas su/ /chags byas zla ba phyed na 'grub/ /de nas rtag pa la sogs pa'i/ /rnal 'byor ldan pas chu yi rdul/ /spyan la sogs pa bsgom tsho byas nas/ /dus de nyid du 'grub par 'gyur/ /'jam dpal rdo rje la sogs pasabye /—/ /chu rnams rang gi gnas su bsgom/ /gong bzhin brtan par rab byas nas/ /zla ba phyed na 'grub par 'gyur/ /grub nas rgya mtsho bzhi la sogs//thams cad kun du 'chag 'gyur te/ /thang la bya ba ji bzhin du/ /rnal 'byor pa ni spyod par byed/ /thams cad sngon bzhin rab byas te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sngon 'gro ba'i/ /baṃ dang rdo rje ser po las/ /dpa' bo rdo rje bsgrub thupar bya/ /cung zad ser la g.yas g.yon zhal/ /gnag 3dang dkar po bsgom par bya/ /dang pos 'khyud cing lhag ma na/ /rdo rje ral gri nor bu pad—/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs sgogs pa/ /mig dang lus rdzogs byin brlabs nas/ /bskul ba la sogs sngon 'gro ba'i/ /mi bskyod pa yis dbu brgyan bsam/ /oṃ ubi bi ra badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ bzlas pa sngon bzhin rab byas pas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad de ru byas/ /bkug ste bcug nas brtan byas pas/ /zla ba phyed na bka' nyan te/ /dgug dang dbang du bya ba sogs/ /sman dang sngags kyi dngos grub rnams/ /sgrub thupa po ni sbu 'dod pa'o/ /de dag thams cad sbyin par byed/ /yang ni sngon bzhin thams cad bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' las byung ba'i/ /rtsu dang pad+ma dkar po las/ /lcu gyis mtshan pa bsam par bya/ /de yi 'od 'phros sangs rgyas kyis/ /phyogs bcu la gnas sangs rgyas sogs/ /sgul byed pa yi gzugs byas nas/ /bkug ste de ru gzhug par bya/ /de la sangs rgyas rdo rje ma/ /dkar mo g.yas g.yon gnag 7722—659

dang dmar/ /dang pos skyathabs la 'khyud pa dang / /pad snod ral gri nor bu 'bar / /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa yi/ /mig dang lus sogs byin brlabs la/ /bskul ba sngon du 'gro ba yi/ /mi bskyod pa yis dbu brgyan bya/ /de yi ye shes sems ma yi/ /thugs kar zla ba lcu bkod de/ /spro bsdu gzhug pa snga ma bzhin/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa bya ba'o/ /oṃ a tsa le tsu le tsun+da le swā hā hūṃ swā hā/ de yis zla ba phyed na ni/ /zhi ba la sogs gang yang rung / /sgrub po'i 3 yid la 'dod pa yi/ /dngos grub rnams ni ster bar 'gyur/ /khyad par du ni bum bzang dang / /yid bzhin nor dang dpag bsam shing / /rnal 'byor pa ni gang 'dod pa/ /sgrub pa po la sbyin par byed/ /snga ma bzhin du thams cad bya/ /rdo rje sems las byung ba yi/ /rdza dang ral gri 'bras bu ni/ /dze+e gis mtshan pa bsam par bya/ /de yi 'od kyis skyasangs rgyas rnams/ /gnod gnas kyi ni skur sgobyas nas/ /bkug nas de la thim par bya/ /de la gnod sbyin dbang bo che/ /gsus che rkang pa thung ba ste/ /gser 'dra g.yas g.yon gnag ltadang dkar/ /dang pos 'phags ma nor rgyun 'khyud/ /lhag mas pi dza pū 6ra dang / /sre mo rin chen skyug byed dang / /rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa'o / /zhabs g.yas rdo rje mtshan pa yi/ /bum pa bzang la rab bzhag ste/ /g.yon pa btsan dkyil du gnas pa/ /zla steng de yi 'od kyis mtshan/ /nor rgyun de 'dra dang po na/ /mchog sbyin 'bras kyi snye ldan pa/ /sku 'jam dbu la me tog gi/ /sna tshogs thod bcings zhi ba'o/ /gzhan gyi spyan zlum yid dga' ba'o—/ /spyi bo snying ga lte ba dang / /gsang ba dang ni rkang mthil du/ /zla ba nyi mar go rims bzhin/ /rtag pa mi 'khrugs 3rin chen che/ /'od dpag 22—660

med dang don grub bsgom/ /sku sogs byin gyis brlab tshobyas nas/ /bskul ba sngon du 'gro ba yi/ /mi bskyod pa yis dbu brgyan nyabya/ /de yi ye shes sems dpa' yi/ /thugs kar zla bar dze+e bkod de/ /sngon bzhin nor gyi char 'be+ebs pa/ /rtsom pa bcug ste bzlas brjod bya/ /oṃ āḥdzam+bha la dza lejo ya 7hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de yis zla ba phyed na ni/ /nyin re gser srang stong stong gi/ /sgrub pa po la rab sbyin par/ /'gyur ba 'di la the tshom med / /thu/yang ni rang 'dod spyor ba yis/ /yan lag brgyad ni rdzogs byas te/ /rdo rje pad+ma sbyar brtsams nas/ /bde gshegs rang gi zhal du gzhug /zhu nas rdor 6/phyung pad nang du/ /byang chub sems la dze+e bcu dgu7/ /de las gtso bo gnod gnas kyis—/ /'byel pa'i 'khor lo brtan par bya/ /de yi mig la sogs pa dang / /sku gsung thugs ni byen gyis brlabs/ /yang na rang gi sa bon gyisnye/ /'od kyis bde gshegs dgug par bya/ /zhal zhugs zhu gyur rdo rjer phyung / /de yi lce la rdza bkod nas/ /'od kyis drangs nas sngags 'di yis/ /zhal du dbab par byas nas dbul/ /oṃ s+dzadze+e da na de hi de hi hūṃ/ de yis tshim nas dbu rgyan la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mchog bsgom zhing / /zla ba phyed du dus bzhi ru//de 'dra'i chu rgyun byin nas 'grub/ /ji tsam 'dod pa'i nor ldan zhing / /'bru yi char ni 'be+ebs par mdzad/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu 'dra bar 'gyur/ /thams cad snga ma bzhin byas la/ /rang 'dod lha yi rnal 'byor ram/ /'jam dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor gyis/ /gnod sbyin mo ni bsgrub par bya/ /ci gsungs gzhal yas khang bsgoms la/ /de yi sbyor bas dbus su gnas/ /mdun du gser mdog zla ba la/ /zla gam thig 22—661

le rtse ldan pa/ /k+ṣiṃ bsgoms de las 'od zer spro/ /kha dog sna tshogs 'phros pa yis—/ /spyan sogs lha mo bkod pa la/ /phog pas gnod sbyin mo ru 'gyur/ /bkug ste de la thim gyur nas/ /de gzugs gnas gyur gnod sbyin mo/ /rgyud gzhan las ni gsungs pa bzhin/ / sgrub po'i bhe/)mdun du rnam par bsam⑤/ /gser mdog mdzes pa'i cha lugs can/ /bud med gzhon nu'i skra tshul ldan/ /dar gyi na bzas stod smad dkris/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /g.yas pas gdugs ni dkar po thogs/ /g.yon pas dpag bsam shing la brten—/ /cung zad 'dzum zhing zhal mdzes shing / /kha dog lnga pa'i me tog las—/ /me tog phreng ba sogs kyis mdzes/ /byas pa'i phyed krung thor tshugs can—/ /rin po che yi ri phug nagu/ /gnas par rab tu bsam pa'o/ /de yi gzugs la sogs pa lnga/ /shrī budhe chohaṃ bha lnga yis/ /lha mor bskyed nas gnas gsum du/ /yi ge gsum gyis byin kyis brlabs cho/ /bskul ba sngon du 'gro ba yi/ /dbang bskur byas pas dbu rgyan la/ /gshin rje gshed po rnam bsgoms te/ /de yang 6ngar 'dzin mnan par bya/ /de nas rang gi sa bon gyi//'od kyis ye shes sems dpa' bkug /thugs kar bcug ste snyan tshig gis/ /bzhams te bsgo bas bsgrub par bya/ /de nas de yi ye shes sems/ /rang gi sems dpar rab bcug pas/ /rang bzhin gcig tu gyur byas nas/ /sngags kyi bzlas pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas sha dang khrag dang ni/ /til phye sgur gdong la sogs pa'i/ /gtor mas mnyes par byas nas su/ /zhi ba'i spyor bas bsgrub par bya/ /yang ni de yis ma grub na/ /drag shul gyis ni bsgrub par bya/ /ye shes sems dpa' der bcug la/ /rdo rje sbyor ba 22—662

brtsam par bya/ /gnod sbyin mo la 'khyud byas nas/ /rdo rje rtse lnga 'od zer 'bar—/ /pad+mar stsal kyenas sngags bzlas pas/ /nang du 'od zer spro bar bya—/ /oṃ āḥldu ya mārnya kṛta yak+ṣiṃ yak+ṣiṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūṃ phaṭa/ 'od zer me ltar 'bar ba yis/ /ye shes sems dpa' gdung byas pas/ /tsha ste skrag nas sgrub po la/ /zla phyed 'phral du dngos grub ster/ /sgrub po'i mdun du thal sbyar nas/ /rje gcig bdag la bka' stsol zhes/ /'dzum pa'i bzhin bltas bka' len te/ /sgrub pos de la bka' stsal pa/ /ma dang sring mo chung ma dang / /g.yog mo'i kyibya ba gyis zhes bya/ /de nas de yis rje gcig ④gi/ /bka' ni spyi bos nod ces len/ /gal te ma yi bya ba byed/ /tho rangs srod la 'ongs byas nas/ /gser srang bcu dang mu tig gi/ /ha ra bdun ni bzhag nas 'gro/ /sreng mo yi ni bya ba byed/ /nyi ma'i gung la drung 'ongs te/ /gser srang bdun dang ha ra bdun/ /phul te ming po sang 'ong zer/ /gal te chung ma'i bya byed na/ /yid kyi 5'dod pa'i dus su ni/ /'phral du drung du 'ong bar byed/ /cang mi smra bar 'dod pa spyad/ /gser srang lnga dang ha ra gcig /bzhag ste rang gi gnas su 'gro/ /gal te gtam smras gyur na ni/ /phyin chad ci yang mi ster ro/ /g.yog mo'i 6bya ba byed pa yis/ /zas dang gos dang gser la sogs/ /bzhon pa la sogs ci 'dod pa/ /bka' tsam gyis ni spyor bar byed/ /gzhan ni na chung yid du 'ong / /bkug nas byin te rang gnas skyel/ /de sogs gnod sbyin mo rnams kyi/ /yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab thob/ /sngags kyi khyad par rnams kyi sgrub 7pa khyad par bshad zin to // // 22—663

da ni zhi ba'i las kyi rim pa bshad par bya'o/ /spyan gyi tshul gyi rnal 'byor gyis/ /bsam gtan 'di ni brtag par bya/ /yang na mos pa'i rnam pa yis—/ /rnal 'byor rab tu brtsam pa'o/ /gong ngam yang na grong khyer ram/ /ljongs rnams gang ba'i nad la sogs/ /zhi bar bya phyir bsam gtan mchog /'di ni rtag tu sbyar bar bya/ /thams cad snga ma bzhin byas la/ /zhi ba'i sems kyis shar bltas te/ /rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa mchog /ta la bdun tsam nam mkha' la/ /phyogs de 'greng bur rnam par bsam/ /de yi bum pa gzhal yas khang / /gdan dang bcas pa rnam bsams te/ /de nang rmyertag pa'i 'khor lo ni / /dkar po sngon bzhin nyi shu bsgom kye/ /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang byas la/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa las byung ba'i/ /'od zer rnam par spro bar bya/ /oṃ t+pabye dzi na dzika che ge mo'i nad dz+wa la dza hūṃ swā hākye/ de brjod lha dang rdo rje yi/ /lus las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /zad dus me 'drar 'gro kun kyi/ /nad rnams rab tu bsreg 'gyur ro/ /shel ltar rab tu gnas pa la/ /mi ldog bya phyir rgyas bya'i phyir/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod pa yis/ /spyan la sogs pa spro bar bya/ /oṃ ru ru sgu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sidhe lo tsa ni sarba arja sā dha ni nad shārnyi ku ru swā hā/ mkha' dbyings yongs su bkang byas nas/ /bdud rtsi lngas gang bum pa yis/ /de rnams spyi bor bkra shis sgra/ /ldan par blangs nas dbang bskur stsol/ /oṃ kā jiya badz+ra nad shārnyi ku ru swā hā/ oṃ wāg thubadz+ra nad shās ku ru swā hā/ oṃ tsit+ta badz+ra nad shāk+ṣiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de rnams brjod pas rdo rje gsum/ /ba spu'i 4bu ga las spros pas/ /sngon bzhin dbang bskur rab byin na/ /nges pa'i nad kyang zhag bdun 'jig /rdo rje bsam gtan 22—664

'di yis ni/ /gang ①dka' ba'ang rab tu 'gengs/ /de ni sbyin pa rab grub cing / /yid bzhin nor bu dpal 'drar 'gyur/ /bskal pa gsum gyi yun gnas shing / /sangs rgyas thams cad byin gyis rlob/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba'i sku ste skyon med pa'o/ /yang na 'ga' zhig don gyi phyir/ /thams cad snga ma bzhin byas la/ /chu zla'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /rtag pa'i 'khor lo nyi shus bskyed/ /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang byas la / /de yi ye shes sems dpa' yi/ /thugs kar zla ba'i steng du ni/ /zhi bar 'dod pa gzhag rngupar bya/ /de nas gong du gsungs pa yi/ /spyan ma'i sngags ni rig mar bcas/ /bzlas brjod byas pas ba sru yi/ /bu ga las ni spyan tshogs spro/ /de rnams 'od zer lnga 'bar ba'i/ /'od zer tshul gyis nad pa la/ /zhi bar bya phyir rgyas bya'i phyir/ /de la gzi brjid dbab par bya'o/ /yang na mi ldog bya ba'i phyir/ /gong gi dbyung ba'am sa bon nam/ /yi ge gsum par rig par bcas/ /bzlas pas rtag pa'i tshogs spro bya/ /de rnams sbyan dang bcas pa yis/ /bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bzung / /dbyangs dang bcas pas dbang bskur bya/ /nad ni zhag bdun gyis zhi byed/ /rdo rje bsam gtan 'di yis ni/ /dgang dka' ba'ang rab tu 'gengs/ /de ni de ma thag tu yang / /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dra bar 'gyur/ /thams cad snga ma bzhin byas la/ /spyan ma'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo mchog /cho ga nyi shus rnyirdzogs byas la/ /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba bya/ /de yi ye shes sems ma yis—/ /shi ba'i ro ni gzhag ④ byas na/ /sngags 'di rnam par brjod par bya/ /oṃ ru ru spru ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sirnyi zhelo tsa ni sarba arba sā dha ni shi ba sos par gyur cig 22—665

swā hā/ de yis de nas lam̐ 'phros pa'i/ /lcags kyu'i gzugs su phyung byas te/ /de yis shi ba'i rnam par shes/ /bar ma do na gnas pa'am/ /yang na skye gnas chud kyang rung / /dri med mar me'i tshul gnas pa'i/ /bkug ste ro yi snying ga ru/ /bcug nas dbyung sngags de la dgod/ /de yi zer gyis ro bsregs te/ /rang min tha mas spyan ma yi/ /gzugs su bskyed nas phung po dang / /khams dang skye mched kyis dag bya/ /de lus gang ba'i phreng sngags kyis//phyi nang bar mtshams med par gtams1sna/ /sngags las sngon bzhin spyan ma spro/ /bsdus nas 'od zer spro bar bya/ /bskal pa'i bar du gnas bya'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas rtag pa'i tshogs spros pa'i/ /dbang bskur byas pa las skyes pa'i/ /shi ba zhag ni bdun nas 'tsho/ /'tsho na'ang lnga brgya'am stong gi bar/ /'di nyid du ni gnas par 'gyur/ /spyan gyi ye shes kyis btab phyir/ /rim gyis sangs rgyas thob pa'o/ /thams cad snga ma bzhin byas te/ /rnam par snang mdzad rnal 'byor pas/ /lta ba rdo rje dug la sogs/ /mi bzad dug ni dbrog par bya/ /bdag nyid g.yas pa'i bar ma ru/ /'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ /lte bar oṃ dkar po yis mtshan/ /'od zer dkar po spros nas brtsam/ /nad pa mdun du gzhag gabyas la/ /sgrub pos spyi bo la bzhag ste//dug rnams dbrog pa'i ched du ni/ /sngags 'di brjod la 'od zer spro/ /oṃ āḥdzi na dzika che ge mo'i dug zhi bar mdzod cig hūṃ swā hā/ brjod pas 'od zer dkar po ni/ /spyi bor zhugs pas nag po dbyung / /'od zer de yis nam mkha'i 5khams/ /phyogs bcu kun du gtor bar bya/ /de yi bye shul du 'od zer ni/ /dkar zhing bsel ba phab byas pas/ /zhag bdun na ni nam mkha' 22—666

kun—/ /gang ba'i dug kyang med par byed/ /yang ni sngon bzhin thams cad bya—/ /mi bskyod 'khor lo dang ldan pas/ /ha la ha la la sogs pa/ /sbyor ba 'di yis gso bar bya/ /bsgrub bya mdun du rab bzhag la/ /de yi thugs kar hūṃ byung ba'i/ /rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ /'od zer dkar po 'bar ba bsam—/ /de yang zla 'od ltar bsil zhing / /bsil bas lus kun khyab pa'i dug /snying ga sgog ma dpral ba dang / /mgo bo'i gnas su yang dag bsdu/ /de ltar lan gsum par bsams la/ /thams cad snying ga'i dbus su bsdu/ /de nas 'di ni brjod pa yis/ /nag po skyug pa'i tshul du bsam/ /oṃ s+dzabadz+ra dṛka che ge mo'i dug sos par gyur cig swā hā/ de ltar byas pas zhag bdun na/ /nam mkha'i khams kun gang ba yi/ /dug rnams kyang ni zad byed na/ /bsgrub bya'i lus ni smos ci dgos/ /sngon bzhin thams cad rab byas la/ /'od dpag med kyi rnal 'byor gyis/ /'bras dang phol mig 'brum phran sogs/ /nye ba'i dug rnams dbyung bar bya/ /g.yas kyi bar mas as bskyed 3pa'i/ /pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad pa'i/ /lte bar 'od zer lnga 'bar ba'i a bsams nas ni byab par bya/ /bsgrub bya mdun du rab bzhag la/ /a yi 'od zer gyis bsdus nas/ /nag po'i mdog ni rnam pa ru/ /bsgrub bya'i lus las byung bar bsam/ /de yis kun du rab spros pas/ /dug spangs kha dog dkar po bsam/ /de ltar dus bzhir gsang sngags 'di/ /bzlas pas zhag bdun dug rnams 'byang / /oṃ ā ro t+paka che ge mo'i nye ba'i dug zhi bar gyur sbug hūṃ swā hā/ de yis las skyes snying 'bar ba'i/ /dug rnams thams cad zad byed na/ /bsgrub bya'i lus gcig la gnas pa'i/ /nye ba'i dug 22—667

rnams smos ci dgos/ /thams cad snga ma bzhin byas la/ /khro bo'i ①rgyal po rta mgrin ni/ /kha dog dkar po rab bsgoms te/ /dug rnams thams cad bsal bar bya/ /bsgrub bya mdun du gzhag bubyas la/ /de yi snying gar zla ba la/ /hūṃ dkar 'od zer dkar po 'bar/ /'od zer de yis lus kun gyi/ /dug rnams rab tu sbar byas la/ /g.yas pa'i bar mar hūṃ dkar po/ /de bskyed pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad/ /dkar po'i lte bar hūṃ bsam mo/ /rang ming yi ge dang po yis/ /bsgrub bya rnam par bsams nas ni/ /gsang sngags 'di yis de yi ni/ /dug rnams kun du bsal bar bya/ /na maḥs man+ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta 1badzā rde/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ tu ru la bi ru la/ sarba bi sha ga ta ya/ dza li ta/bi sgu ling ga tata/ ha sa ke sa ri sa ta to pa/ badz+ra khu ra ni ra ga ta/ tsa li ta ba su tata la nish+tsa sa ma ru tod k+ṣi bi thud da ra ni da ra/ bi sha na ta ha sa/a pā ra mi tā/ pa la pa ra kra ma/ ār+ya be+e ga ste bhu ta ga na/ bhū ⑤ ta byu ta/ha ya spyi hūṃ ba kha da ⑦kha da/ pa ra man+t+ra na tshirnya tshirnya/ sidhi me de ma me da da bi sha /ā be+e sha ya rak+ṣa dza/ bi sha tsa nan/ sarba gra thuhesh+tsa bya/ pra ti ta to ta bha ba badz+ra rdaṣ+ṭa ki tsa mā pya/ ra ya si/ i rda 6duṣ+ṭa/ gra ha na duṣ+ṭa sar+pā na/du na du na/ ma tha ma tha/ ma ta ma ta/ ban+dha brnya/ burnya ra ma saṅga nu dzñā na ta ka ra dz+wa/ ku ru sri ban ha ya spyi ⑩ba ya phaṭa/ badz+ra ya phaṭa/ badz+ra ga ta ya phaṭa/ badz+ra ne+e tra ya phaṭa/ badz+ra rdaṣ+ṭa ⑫ya phaṭa/ badz+ra khu ra ya phaṭa/badz+ra khu ra nir ga ta ya phaṭa/ pa ra man+ta bi nā ⑩sha na ya phaṭa/ tre+e lo kya 1 ta ba yi ka ra ya phaṭa/ sarba karmarja pra ti ha ta ya phaṭa/ badz+ra ku la ta pa na phaṭa/hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ swā hā/ hūṃ las 'od zer dkar po yirkye/ /22—668

bdud rtsi babs pas bsgrub bya yi/ /lus las nag po'i dug blangs te/ /sa la sogs par spro bar bya/ /shul du bdud rtsi dkar po yi①/ /'od zer bab ②par byas nas su/ /de bzhin thun bzhir byabs gyur na/ /zhag bdun na ni nam mkha'i dbyings/ /dug gis yongs su gang ba yi/ /rdo rje mi bzad pa yi dug /sbyar ba tsam gyis sel bar byed/ /sngon bzhin thams cad rab byas la//yang ni dug rnams zad bya'i phyir/ /sbyor ba rnams la brgyad ldan par/ /gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba bsgom/ /gser 'dra g.yas gnag g.yon dkar te—/ /dang pos rang 'od rig ma —'khyud/ /g.yas pas 'og 'byung 'khor lo 'dzin—/ /lhag mas ①ral gri rin chen pad/ /'di la rnam snang lta bur sbyar/ /bye las 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad ni/ /dkar po bye gyis gyematshan pa bsam/ /bsgrub bya ming gi dang por ⑤bskyed/ /sgrub po'i mdun du rab bzhag la/ /sbyor ba gsum gyis spang bya'i phyir/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod pas su/ /bye las 'od zer dkar po spro/ /na maḥs man+ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta bye badzā rde/ oṃ s+dzasarba la bu ti/ lo ka dadhi/ yan+t+ra man+t+ra tan+t+ra/ tsūr+ṇa pra yo gi ti/ ma ma kṛ ti ye na ke na tsi ta kṛ ti/ tā ni sarban+tu/ tshin+ta tshin+ta/ bin+ta bin+dha/ ha na ha na/da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ shaṃ pa ya kai pa ya/ badhī skyes ya/ sha ta sa 5ha sru/bi tsūr+ṇa ya/ oṃ uspyo ṣa badz+ra tsakra warti/ r+ghaṃ phroṃ zlo/ hūṃ hūṃ rtsu/ phaṭa swā hā/de nas 'od zer tshogs spros pas/ /spyi bo nas ni phul byas te/ /rkang pa'i mthil du phyung byas la/ /sa yi gting du mnan phya par bya/ /yang ni 'od zer de yis kyang / /mdun du bsnun pas dug rnams kun/ /rgyab tu phyung bas sa la sogs/ /'byung ba rnams su spro bar bya/ /de bzhin 'od zer gyis basbus 22—669

nas / /phyung ste gtor nas de shul du/ /bdud rtsi dkar po rab 'bab pas//dug ni rnam par spang bar bya/ /dkar po dang ni ser po dang / /nag po bsam gtan 'di yis ni/ /rdo rje gsum gyi sprul pa yis/ /dug rnams kyang ni zhag bdun 'byin/ /yang ni sngon bzhin thams cad bya/ /rnam par snang mdzad 'khor lo che/ /kha dog dkar po bsam byas te/ /'don pa'i sngags kyis nad rnams bsal/ /nad pa mdun du gzhag ①byas te/ /bdag nyid khros nas gsang sngags 'di/ /brjod pas 'od zer tshogs spros pas/ /bsgrub bya'i lus la gzhug par bya/ /oṃ yasadzi na dzika che ge mo'i nad a pa na ya hūṃ / de yis nad rnams bskul bar bya/ /rlung mkhris bad kan las byung ba'i//spre'u'i gzugs brnyan lta bu'am/ /de bzhin khyi ni rkang pa gsum/ /yi dwags gcer bu'i gzugs dag tu/ /bsgrub bya'i lus las rngu phyung nas su/ /phyogs bcu dag tu rab rgyug cing / /'bros par gyur par 1rnam par bsam oṃ t+padzi na dzika che ge mo'i nad mā ④ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ brjod pas thugs las 'phros pa yi 3—/ /khro bo'i 'khor los mtshan pa ceyi/ /spre'u la sogs pa'i nad rnams kun / /mtshan mas phye mar rlag 2par byed/ /bkug ste 'ongs pa rang gnas kyi / /mtshan mas phye mar brlag 'gyur te/ /bsgrub bya nad dang rnam bral bas / /shel 'dra'i kha dog lta bur bsam/ /de nas bdag nyid 'khor lo che//kha dog dkar po rnam bsams la/ /sngon /zubazhin spyan ma'i sngags brjod pas/ /'od zer 'bab pas lus dgang bya/ /oṃ āḥdzi na dzika nad pa che ge mo la a t+ta ṣiñtsa hūṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod zu/sngon bzhin rtag pa'i tshogs/ /spyan dang bcas pas ⑩bum pa 'dzin/ /dbang bskur byas te brgya rtsa brgyad/ /zhag bdun 22—670

bar du dus bzhir ①bya/ /de ltar byas na phyi nang gi/ /myong bar nges pa'i nad kun yang / /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin du/ /the tshom med par 'byang bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin mi bskyod rin chen dpal/ /'od dpag med dang don yod grub/ /yi ge'i tshig ni gang mos pa/ /dad pa bskyed de nad rnams bsal/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra byeka che ge mo'i nad a pa na ya hūṃ/ oṃ āḥrat+na byeka che ge mo'i nad a pa na ya hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.ā ro t+paka che ge mo'i nad a pa na ya hūṃ/oṃ t+papradzñā dh+rika che ge mo'i nad a pa na ya hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dh+rika che ge mo'i nad mā rngo ra ya phaṭa hūṃ/ oṃ āḥrat+na dh+rika che ge mo'i nad mā ra ya phaṭa hūṃ/shu oṃ s+dza.ā ro t+paka che ge mo'i nad mā ra ya phaṭa hūṃrgya / oṃ s+dzapradzñā dh+rika nad pa che ge mo'i nad mā ra ya phaṭa hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dṛka nad pa che ge mo la a d+ngha ṣiñtsa hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ s+dzarat+na j-ika nad pa che ge mo la a dha ṣiñtsa hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ u.ā ro dzaka nad pa che ge mo la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ s+dzapradzñā byeka nad pa che ge mo la a d+ngha ṣiñtsa hūṃ swā hā/de yis nad rnams phyung byas te/ /rang rang mtshan mas sngon bzhin bsad/ /stobs dang dbang bskur sogs pa yi/ /snga ma bzhin du rab tu bya/ /spyor bas zlos pas zhag bdun du/ /myong bar nges pa'i nad rnams kun/ /rdo rje bsam gtan cho ga des/ /phyi dang nang du bcas pa sel/ /da ni rgyas pa'i las kyi lam gyi rim pa rgyas par bshad par bya'o/ /sngon bzhin bzlas pa'i cho ga nas / /dbang bskur yan chad rdzogs byas te/ /rdo rje pad+mo chocan gyi ni/ /sbyor bas rgyas pa'i las brtsam mo/ /stobs la sogs pa'i chos rnams dang / /lhag ma'i tsher 'gyur 'dod pa dang / /mdzod po che ni rgyas byas kyephyir/ /rgyas pa'i sems kyis bya ba'o/ /bka' yi 'khor lo sbyor ba yis/ /sngon bzhin khang 22—671

pa brtsegs pa'i lhadabus/ /rdo rje sems dpa' las byung ba⑤/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor ser po'i dbus/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsams nas ni/ /gser zhun lta bu'i 'od dpag med/ /'khor lor bcas pa bsam gebyas la /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba bya/ /de yi ye shes sems dpa' yi/ /thugs kar zla ba'i steng du ni/ /'dod pa rnam gsum bzhag nas ni/ /thams cad gsang sngags 'di ni zlos/ /oṃ ka ṭi bi ka ṭi ni ka ṭi ka ṭaṃ ka ṭi ka ro ba re che ge mo puṣ+ṭi ku jeru hūṃ/ na bza' dkar mo la sogs tshogs/ /mngon par 'dod pa'i don char 'be+ebs/ /nam mkha'i khams kun rab bkang nas/ /rjes su 'od zer bsdu bar bya/ /de ni 'od zer rnam pa lnga/ /'dod pa'i spyi bo mgrin pa dang / /thugs ka'i gnas ni gsum po ru/ /'dod pa gsum gyi tshul du bzhag /de rnams mi bzad bya ba'i phyir/ /thams cad kyi ni gsang sngags 'di/ /brjod nas 'od dpag med pa'i tshogs/ /bum pa gang ba gzung skyebar bya/ /oṃ s+dzadzi ā ro t+paka che ge mo puṣ+ṭi ku ru hūṃ/ bkra shis glu dbyangs tshigs bcad kyi/ /dbang bskur ba ni stsol bar bsam/ /de ltar dus bzhir zhag bdun du/ /spyor bas thams cad rgyas par 'gyur/ /rdo rje bsam gtan 'di yis ni/ /dgang dka' ba yang rab tu 'gengs/ /de ni sbyin pa rab bsgrub cing / /yid bzhin 'unor bu dpal 'drar 'gyur/ /yang na 'di ltar gos dkar ba'i/ /'khor lo ldan pa'i sbyor ba bsgom/ /ye shes sems ma'i thugs ka ru/ /'dod pa dag ni gzhug par bya/ /oṃ ka ṭi bi ka ṭi ni ka ṭi ka ṭaṃka ṭi ka ro ba re che ge mo puṣ+ṭi ku ru hūṃ/ brjod pas de mtha' dbus yig la/ /nam mkha'i khams ni dkar mos gang / /de nyid gzi 22—672

brjid tshul gyis su/ /rjes su 'od zer sngon bzhin dbab/ /gong gi sngags kyis 'od dpag med/ /spyos nas dbang bskur stsal bar bsam/ /de ltar dus bzhir zhag bdun du/ /byas pas bsgrub bya rgyas par 'gyur/ /bsam gtan sngags kyi spyor ba 'dis/ /rtag par chos kyis rgyas par mdzad/ /rtag tu mdzod po che dang ldan/ /nad rnams med cing tshe rgyas 'gyur/ /da ni dbang gi las kyi rim pa bshad par bya'o/ /thams cad sngon bzhin rab byas la / /ri mo'i dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /don yod grub pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /dbang du bya ba brtsam pa'o/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sde chen dang / /sems can khams rnams ma lus pa/ /dbang du byed dam byed 'dod phyir/ /chags pa'i yid kyis bya ba'o/ /bka' yi 'khor lo rab bskor bas/ /khang pa brtsegs pa'i dbus su ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' las byung ba'i/ //nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zla gam la/ /ji bzhin spyo bas ban+d+ra ka /don yod grub pa'i 'khor lo che/ /bsgoms nas mchod pa bstod pa dang / /bdud rtsi myang bas mnyes par bya/ /de yi ye shes sems dpa' yi/ /thugs kar zla ba'i steng du ni/ /gong gi gnyis po bzhag nas ni/ /thams cad kyi ni gsang sngags brjod/ /oṃ āḥkhaṃ pradzñā j-ika che ge mo ba shaṃ ram̐ rā ga ya ho1/ de brjod thams cad ba sru yi/ /sgo las sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis / /mkha' dbyings yongs su dgang bar bsam/ /de rnams 'od zer rnam lnga yi / /tshul gyis thams cad 'dus byas la/ /thugs kar 'dod pa de lus la/ /rjes su stobs ni dbab par bya/ /gong gi sngags brjod sngon bzhin du/ /dbang bskur de la stsol bar bsam/ /de ltar sbyor bas dus bzhi ru/ /bzlas 22—673

pas zhag bdun 'grub par 'gyur/ /de ni de ma thag tu yang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi 1thugs su byon/ /'jam dpal dang ni gzi brjid mnyam/ /las thabs byed par de 'gyur ro/ /dga' bas myong ba'i dbang po dang / /dgyes nas ci 'dod rab tu stsol/ /bskul ba chen po ma byas kyang / /'gro ba 'di kun dbang du 'gyur/ /yang ni de ltar sgrol ma yi/ /'khor lo ldan pa rab bsgoms la/ /de yi ye shes sems dpa' yi/ /thugs kar zla ba'i steng du ni/ /dbang du bya ba bzhag nas ni/ /dbus su yi ge t+t+waṃ tso7dmar po/ /mtha' ma phreng sngags dmar po ni/ /gyen du 'greng bas bskor bar bsam/ /dmar ba'i mtshan ma rnams dang ni/ /t+t+waṃ ༄ las 'od zer dmar po'i tshogs/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod nas su/ /bsgrub bya bskul phyir dbyung bar bya/ /oṃ tā re tut+tha re tu re che ge mo pa shaṃ ku ru ho/ skyes pa'i snying dang mgrin par bskul / /bud med gsang ba nas bsgul bya/ /phreng ba'i sngags las 'od zer dmar/ /rang gi skye gnas nas phyung bya/ /gong gi sgo ru rab zhugs pas/ /bsgrub bya'i sems ni bkag 'dra ba/ /zla ba'i dbyibs 'dra bkug nas ni/ /rim pa gnyis su chud par bya/ /gal te lha mo mda' can ma/ /'og nas 'byung bzhin byin brlabs la/ /bskul ba la sogs de bzhin bya/ /des kyang dbang du byed pa'o/ /gzhan yang snga ma bzhin du 'dod/ /de ni thugs kar rab bzhag la/ /dpa' bo btang 4sogs cho ga yis/ /gzhan la stobs ni dbab par bya/ /de ltar spyor bas dus bzhi ru/ /zhag bdun bar du rab byas na/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sde can 5dang / /sems can khams rnams ma lus pa / /de ma thag tu bran bzhin du/ /thams cad yod med 6dbang du byed/ /22—674

thams cad snga ma bzhin bsgoms la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' las byung ba'i/ /'jam dpal rdo rje 'khor lo yis/ /dbang du bya ba brtsams 1pa'o/ /sngags byed dang ni dal byed dang / /'dod byed dang ni rmongs byed dang / /dbang gi rang bzhin mda' lnga ni/ /cho ga 'di yis byin brlab bya/ /smyug ma a yis byin brlabs te/ /mde'u ni hūṃ gis byin brlabs la/ /g.yon gyis lo snyebaskyed gzhu bzung ༷nas/ /dbu rgyan rtse mor sbyar byas la/ /drangs te rna drung du bkang nas/ /sngags kyis rab tu gdab pa'o/ /oṃ āḥ.oṃ mañdzu shrī che ge mo pa shaṃ ku ru ho/ de yis spros pas bsgrub bya yi/ /mgo dang snying ga lte ba dang / /gsang ba dang ni rkang mthil du/ /khro bo'i tshig gis rab tu gdab/ /sngags kyi 'od zer dmar po yi/ /rdo rje gnyis las phyung nas kyang / /zla ba spyad ldan lta bu'i sems/ /'od zer gyis ni dgug par bya/ /bdag ni skye gnas nas bcug ste/ /ye shes sems dpa' de bzhin no/ /dngangs shing brgyal bar rab bsgoms te/ /sdong po bcad bzhin zhabs 'og 'gyel/ /spyor ba de yis dus bzhi ru/ /zla ba phyed du rab bsgoms 4na/ /byis pa'i blo ni grags chen pos / /gsang ba'i bskul ba bsgom chobyas pas/ /rdo rje kun gyis rab gsang ba'i / /rdo rje don ni chud par gsungs/ /de nas mngon spyod lam gyi rim pa bshad par bya'o/ /sngon bzhin bzlas pa la sogs pa'i/ /dbang bskur yan chad rdzogs byas te/ /rdo rje khro bo rnal 'byor gyis/ /las 'di rab tu brtsam pa'o / /dkon mchog gnod byed ma chags pa/ /gdug pa'i sems can rnal 'byor gcod/ /bla ma smod brtson ma rungs pa/ /gtum pa'i yid kyis bsgrub pa'o / /de rnams bskrad trepa 'jigs 'jigs lta/ /sta gri gtun shing lag na 22—673

'dzin / /gnod par byed pa rab brtson la1/ /bsams nas bsam gtan rab tu bya/ /mkha' dbyengs sems can sangs rgyas kyis/ /yongs su gang bar rab tu bsam/ /gdug pa'i sta gri 2gtun shing gis/ /gsad par rab tu bsam pa'o/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /mkha' dbyengs yongs su gang bar bsam/ /sta gri gtun shing gis gsad par/ /bsams nas dgra rnams myur du 'chi/ /de yis dran rnyed mtshon cha bor/ /skyabs med skrag cing 'jigs pas dkrugs/ /sdug bsngal dang ldan gzigs byas la/ /snying rje chen po'i khro ba bskyed/ /rang lha goms pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /rnal 'byor byas nas gsum pa ru/ /ye shes sems dpa'i 'od zer kyis/ /sangs rgyas tshogs spro bka' lung blang / /khams bzhugs mgon po rnams kyis ni/ /bdag rtsom las 'di gzigs mdzad phyir/ /gro ba tsan+dan dkar po sogs/ /las brtsam bris pa snyan du gsol/ /phan mdzad khyed cag rnams la ni/ /'di yi thabs 'di ma brtsams na/ /'di ni mnar med skyi g.ya' ba'i/ /bud shing du ni 'gyur bar nges/ /snying rjer ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /khyod kyi bka' lung bdag cag byed/ /de bas las ni bgyid pa la/ /rdo rje can rnams bdag bka' stsol/ /bdag cag khyad par ma mthong bar/ /dad pa kho na dang ldan pas/ /snying rje 'di la phan pa'i phyir/ /khyed kyi 4bka' stsol byed pa'o/ /gong bzhin khro bo'i tshogs spros pas/ /de dag snyan du rig pa dang / /sngon bzhin du dang gal bcu yis// /snyan gsan dbab par bsam pa'o las mdzad 'di la khyod kyis ni/ /grogs bo mdzad pa rigs pa yin/ /de ltar min na khyed cag 'dir/ /dam tshig 'gal bar gyur pa'o/ /de nas de dag 22—676

thams cad kyang / /zhal gyis bzhes par bsam byas nas/ /'khor lo dang bcas nag por bsgyur/ /khros nas bka' yi 'khor lo spro/ /bgegs kyi tshogs kun nyan par byos/ /sku gsung thugs la gnas pa yi/ /dpal ldan bdag ni che ge mo/ /bka' yi 'khor lo byed pa'o/ /gal te nga yi bka' 'gom na27/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzugs 'di yis/ /'dod gsum bskyed lus 'jig byed de/ /'gas par 'gyur te gzhan du min/ /de nas sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /mkha' khyab sangs rgyas zhal bcug ste/ /zhu gyur rdo rje pad+ma ru//cho ga bzhin gyis bskyed byas la/ /mi bskyod lta bu 2dang pos 'khyud/ /rdo rje lcags kyu ral gri zhags/ /'dzin pa'i khro bo sum+bha'i gzugs/ /de yi srung ma dgug don bskyed4/ /snying rje ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /dbyangs yig 'og la hūṃ yig steng / /rdo rje rgya gram kha sbyor phyir/ /sngags 'dis srung 5ma dgug pa'o / /oṃ āḥhe sum+bha ni che ge mo'i srung ma khug 6tsig dzaḥt+t+waṃ/ de yis dgug la g.yon du bzhag /gnod mdzes de la bcug byas te/ /de yi lus gnas 'khor lo la/ /de yi nyes pa bsgo ba'i phyir/ /dpal ldan gnod mdzes mdun du gnas/ /rig pa'i tshogs kyis gsol gdab bya/ /las kun rnam pa gang gis ni/ /da lta mthu ni yod 'gyur ba/ /ma 'ongs bde ba 'dod pas na/ /khyod kyis 'di nyid spang bar bya/ /sangs rgyas gsod byed ma chags pa/ /bla ma smod par byed pa'o/ /'di yi srung 7dang byin rlabs kyis/ /da lta ru ni spang bar gsol/ /de ltar min na khyed cag kun/ /rang gi bstan pa 'di la ni / /brdzun gyis sgrub po bslus 'gyur bas/ /khyed rnams dam tshig 'gal ba'o / /de dag thams cad mgrin gcig tu/ /bdag gis spangs kyi 'dod 22—677

bzhin kyis/ /dgyes te bsad dbyung rang lha yi/ /'khor lo ru ni gzhug par bya / /bsrung ba la sogs rnams dang yang / /de yi lha rnams mnan bya'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas rnams kun bgegs dgra'i gzugs/ /sngon bzhin phur bus bskyed byas nas/ /g.yas pas tho ba gzung byas nas/ /g.yon pas mgul pa brten lhabyas te/ /stong pa dran par bya ba'i phyir/ /sngags 'dis rab tu btab pa'o/ /oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṭīn na7phaṭa/ tī la ya shī la ya sarba duṭīn 3ye shes srung ma phaṭa/ t+t+waṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra kri la ya/ badz+ra dha ro ādzñā rngopa ya ti/ sarba duṭīn 5ye shes sems dpa'i kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra tī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ de yis rang gi ye shes sems/ /gnyis su med par 'gyur bar bsam/ /skra bshig gcer bu 'bru mar byugs/ /'jigs bcas dran nyams srog med pa/ /me la gnas shing gzi brjid bral/ /skyabs byed srung trebhems rnam spangs pas7/ /khang stong lta bur bsams nas ni/ /las kyi dngos gzhi la 'jug bya/ /sngon bzhin thams cad rab byas la/ /dang po mgon po las byung ba/ /sa bon las skyes kha bzhi pa'i/ /rtse lnga mgon pos byin gyis brlabs/ /'od zer bde gshegs thams cad la/ /bsgrub bya'i skyon brjod de dag kun/ /mi bskyod ngo bor khror 8gyur nas/ /zhugs bzhin de / la thim par 'gyur/ /de gnyis zhu bar gyur pa las / /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang mi bskyod pa/ /drag po sbrul gyi ske rags can / /mgon po rten sogs kyis mtshan pa/ /dang po spyor bas rnam bsgoms te/ /de kho na bzhin rtag pa sogs/ /sbyor ba gnyis pas bsgom byas te / /mchod pa sogs kyis mnyes par bya/ /de nas badz+ra dh+rika —1sogs ni/ /yid kyis brjod pas rab bskul la/ /sangs rgyas zhi ba'i tshul spros pas/ /22—678

skrag pa spang phyir dang po dgra/ /'od kyi gong bu'i 1tshul du ni/ /sha glan phyir na gnas gsum du/ /btsud de rang sngags brjod pa yis/ /ji ltar 2 gzugs bzhin spro bar bya/ /oṃ āḥ badz+ra be+eka che ge mo 5mā ra ya phaṭa hūṃ/sems lus khros pa'i khro bo che/ /mi sdug 'jigs su rung ba'i gzugs/ /gsod pa'i don rnams sems pa'i phyir/ /sta gri 6tho ba sogs 'dzin spro/ /gzhan yang gri dang ka pā la 'dzin/ /skra 'greng srin po'i tshogs rnams dang / /ring du sgra 'byin pa yi tshogs/ /khwa dang bya rog sna tshogs spro/ /bya rgod lcags kyi mchu can dang / /lcags kyi mche ba can gyi 1khyes/ /nam mkha'i khams kun gang bar bsgom bye/ /bskal pa'i me bzhin 'bar ba yis/ /gru gsum la gnas sngon bzhin du/ /gnas pa'i bsgrub bya de dag gis/ /khros nas rtog cing 'thab pa'i tshul/ /drag po'i tshig gis bskul bar bya/ /sha rnams gcod cing rgyus rkang drangs/ /rus 'chos khrag 'thungs rab bsgoms te/ /dus bzhir rterab tu brtan byas te/ /nyi ma bdun du bsgrub par bya/ /de ltar bsgoms na dgra rnams 'chi/ /snying rje'i dbang gis 'og bzhin brtsam/ /gal te rmongs pas 'grub mi 'gyur/ /rdo rje 'dzin yang zla phyed 'chi/ /sngon bzhin thams cad rab byas la/ /gshin rje gshed kyi 'khor lo che/ /rang gi rdo rje rab brtan la/ /gsum pas las 'di brtsam pa'o/ /oṃ āḥya mān+ta kṛta hūṃ phaṭa/ de yis 1— ba spu bu ga las/ /zhi ba'i tshul spros sangs rgyas kyis/ /sems can bsdu bar 8byas nas su/ /rang gi sku gsung 'khor lo gzhug /o tweḥsmiḥwī kri 1 tā na na che ge mo na sha ya s+t+waṃ bha 7ya mā ra ya t+t+waṃ phaṭa/ brjod pas de dag spro bar bya/ /gshin rje gshed gzugs 'ba' zhig tu/ /spros pas 22—679

gdug sems dgra bo rnams/ /sngon bzhin gcod par rmyebyed par bsam/ /thun mtshams bzhi ru zhag bdun du/ /brtan pas rab tu chags byas nas/ /ma mo'i bdag gshed yang 'chi na/ /gdug sems ldan pa smos ci dgos/ /rtse gcig ma gyur pa yis kyang / /bsrung ba'i dam tshig bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /nyin mtshan bzlas pa la sogs brtson/ /bdud rtsi 'khyel pas gdug pa gzhom/ /thams cad snga ma bzhin byas la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' las byung ba'i/ /gdug pa'i dgra bo 'ba' zhig gam/ /'khor lor 3bcas pa bsam byas nas/ /mchod pa sosas kyis mnyes par bya/ /oṃ āḥ bibyān+ta kṛta —che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa / brjod pas ba sru'i sabu ga las/ /gong ma lta bu'i srin po dang / /gtum zhing mi bzad khro bo spros/ /me steng gnas pa'i bsgrub bya ni/ /bcings shing brdegs 6pa la sogs pas7/ /de ni skrag par byas par bsam de bzhin 'ug pa khwa ta dang / /ring du sgra 'byin pa spros pas/ /mig dang rna ba la sogs par/ /rtse zhing deng bar rab bsams te/ /skrag cing 'jigs par bsams gyur nas/ /dgra bo de yi mod la 'chi/ /de bzhin sbrul nag mgo brgya pa/ /re re lce gnyis mche phreng can/ /rgyud dang gnas dug bdag nyid spro//dpral bar dug bsams gdug pa 'chi/ /yang na bdag gi lag pa ru/ /tho ba rab tu drag po bsam/ /bsgrub bya gong mas mdun bkug la/ /'og ma'i sngags kyis snying gar brdeg /de bzhin lag na gnas pa yi༄8/ /rdo rje sta gri 9 gtun shing sogs/ /bsgrub bya bshig cing gtub tsobasams na/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'ang 'chi bar 'gyur/ /sngags kyi cha lugs dran byas nas/ /phyag 'tshal la sogs spyor ba yis/ /spros pa rnams kyis bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /22—680

sngags 'di brjod par bya ba'o/ /na maḥs man+ta kā ya 1wāka tsit+ta badzā rde2/oṃ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ gadz+dza gadz+dza/ bi sgo ṭa ya bi sgo ṭa ya/ che ge mo'i srog dz+re bi tā na 4ka ra ya phaṭa/ sngags rgyud spyin sreg las rnams la/ /'di yi las la de mchog yin / /phyogs bcu sems can thams cad la/ /'tshe zhing gnod pa 'byung ba yi/ /dgra rnams 'jig 5par byed pa la/ /bskul ba dam pa 'di mchog yin / /snga ma bzhin du thams cad la6/ /sku gsung thugs kyi snying po mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' las byung ba'i/ /dang po las byung hri bskyed do/ /de la tri shul hri yis mtshan/ /de yis sangs rgyas thams cad kun/ /mkha' 'gro'i gzugs byas thi la zhugs/ /de gnyis rdo rje mkha' 'gror bskyed/ /drag po mi sdug khros pa ni/ /ut+pal sngon po lta bu la/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar phyag drug pa/ /dang po rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'khyud/ /g.yas pa tri shul rdo rje bsnams/ /g.yon pa thod pa rin chen 'dzin/ /nyi ma'i gdan la brkyang bsgum du/ /khro bo'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa bskyed/ /dkon mchog gzhom 7pa la sogs pa'i/ /bsgrub bya nam mkha'i dbus su ni/ /khaṃ bskyed dmar gyis rgyal ba ltar/ /brgyangs pa'i ye shes drang blobyas nas/ /mi bskyod pa ru bskyed byas te/ /lus de khang stong lta bur bsams/ /bdag gi lce la dhīḥ bsams te/ /de ni 'od zer mthing ga dang / /dkar ser dmar po ljang khu'i 1 tshogs/ /lus dang yan lag bzhi ru bsam/ /rang gi mtshan ma tri shul dang / /rdo rje rin chen phur bu yis/ /gong ma rab tu phug byas te/ /bsam gtan sngags kyi spyor ba yis / /'od zer lnga yis thod pa ru/ /khrag drang pa ni bsam par bya/ /hūṃ 22—681

hri khaṃ badz+ra dh+rika ni a nu ka sa ma ya ragha ā kar+ṣa ya tsu sha ya t+t+waṃ/ brtan par zhag bdun thun bzhi ru/ /byas pas sangs rgyas chos sku yang / /skams par 'gyur na gdug pa kun/ /smos ci dgos te de lta yin/ /thams cad snga ma bzhin byas te1/ /brgyud 2kyis dbyug sngon 'og bzhin bskyed/ /mchod pa bzlas pa mnyes byas la/ /sngags rgyud ldan pa'i las brtsam mo/ /sha chen dur khrod sol ba dang / /bal mi kham 4sa khre tsi saphug /bsgrub bya'i rkang rjes rnams dang ni//bong 6bu'i gcin gyis gzugs brnyan bya/ /de yi snying gar dur ras la sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram la/ /gnas pa'i me yi dkyil 'khor te/ /bsgrub bya'i ming dang phreng sngags spel/ /zhi ba'i sa bon bton 3nas su/ /hūṃ phaṭa ldan par mi dgug par/ /dug khrag rams rugyis bri byas la/ /de yi snying gar gzhug par bya/ /bsgrub bya bkug ste bcug byas na ḍa/ /rabs chad thod pa kha sbyar gzhag1 /shin tu khros pa'i g.yon pa yis/ /mnan te brgya dang brgyad du ni/ /nyi ma'i gung dang nam byed du/ /bzlas te rdo dang rus pa dang / /nim pa'i lo ma rnams kyis ni/ /gzugs brnyan de ni mnan par bya/ /na maḥs man+ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badzā rde/ oṃ e bye hi bha ga bān nī la — 1badz+ra daṇ+ḍa/ ku ru ku ru/ la hu la hu/ hā hā/ ku la ku la/ ku la pā ya ku la pā ya/ kra ma kra ma/ bha ga bānas/ ba yu be ge na/ bu dan shi kran/ da ha da ha/ha ra ha ra/ ba ha ba ha/ ha na ha na/ pa tsa pa tsa/ ma ta ma ta/ ma ta pā ya ma ta pā ya/ sarba karma ni tshin+dha tshin+dha/ bin+dha bin+dha/ bak+ṣa ya bak+ṣa ya/me te tsosnyesaṃ sarba ru dhi ra/ ma ma sa me da madz+dza ru ti pri ya/ sa.e bye hi bha ga bān sarba bispyo/ mū d+kul karma ni/ sarba mū sal gra ha na/ ha na ha na/ bañdza bañdza/22—682

marda marda/ i rda me gakhya nyusu da ya/ t+t+waṃ m+bi la ya nī la ya badz+ra/ dha na dha na/du ru du ru/ bispyo bi nā ya ka nā sha ya/ hu bye hu bye/ dībe+e dha dha ya/sarba man+t+ra na sha tru nān / z-i da ya ni/ bri da ya/ tshin+dha tshin+dha/ bir+ya nānatshu/tiṣ+ṭha a nu smra 57ra ya sa ma ya badz+ra da ra pa tsa nān6/ da ra ma ni ni krin+ta dh+ri/ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ du ru du ru/ ku ru ku ru/ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūṃ dh+ri/kri dan+ta ya/ de ba ṛ ⑦ṣi bir+ya ka pa ya/ badz+ra dan te na che ge mo mā 8ra ya hūṃ phaṭa—/ g.yel med pa yis zhag bdun du/ /mtshan ma mnan nas bzlas byas pas / /de yi nyi ma kho na la/ /gdug pa rnams ni gsod par byed/ /de ru gal te ma grub na/ /nam phyed dus su dur khrod du/ /gang gi gzugs brnyan khyer nas ni/ /mi ro bsregs pa'i thal ba la/ /mngon spyod hom khung gzhung bzhin byas/ /nim pa'i me ni sbar byas nas/ /zhal dang spyan rnams 'gyur ba yi / /dbyig sngon kha gdangs dbus bsams la/ /gzugs brnyan mtshon cha rnon po yis/ /g.yon pa'i rkang nas bcad gtubs nas/ /gong gi sngags bzlas sbyin sreg bya/ /de yi mtshan mo 'chi bar nges/ /yang ni khro bo gang rung gi / /bzlas pas sngags pa dag byas la/ /rab tu dben pa'i gnas dag tu//'bum phrag tu ni rang sngags bzlas/ /ma mo'i gnas sam dur khrod dam/ /khang stong dang ni bzhi mdo dang / /ling ga gcig pa shing gcig drung / /mngon spyod las ni brtsam pa'o/ /dbyug sngon can bsrung rdzas la ni/ /gzugs brnyan ming dang bcas byas nas/ /gan rkyal du ni gzhag byas te/ /dgug pa sngon 'gro kha sbyar dbye/ /de nas khro bo gang rung gi/ /rnal 'byor khros byas khrag chu yis/ /gsher ba'i 7gos ni gyon pa'am/ /bshang gcis 22—683

gsher ba'i gos gyon bya/ /gzugs brnyan rkang pas mnan nas ni/ /mngon sum bzhin du bsams byas nas/ /rang sngags brgya rtsa brgyad du bzla/ /de bzhin chu dron 'ba' zhig gam/ /bshang gcis gsher bar byas pa'i gos/ /ngan pa rul 1pa dri mnam 2pa/ /bgos te sngon bzhin bzlas pa bya/ /de bzhin thal ba'i spyo ma yis/ /gsher ba'i gos gyon lus ngan 'khrugs/ /sngon bzhin brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas na/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'ang 'jig ༄ par 'gyur/ /yang na gcer bur rab phyung ste/ /skra bshig thur du 'phyang byas te/ /mche gcigs mig ni bsgyur byas la4/ /rkang pas gzugs brnyan mnan nas ni/ /sngon bzhin brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ /lus ngag yid gsum khro thu7byas nas/ /thun bzhir zhag bdun sogs sbyar bas/ /nam mkha'i dbyengs kyang 'jig par nus/ /yang na gong ma'i gnas de ru/ /rnal 'byor der gnas phur bus gdab / /ro bsregs sol dang thal ba dang / /chu ngogs pa dang phub 3ma dang / /rkang rjes dang ni bshang gcis badze+es/ /bsgrub bya'i gzugs brnyan snying ga ru/ /ske tshe dug dang lan tshwa dang / /nyungs mar snag tshas dur ras la/ /khro bo rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i/ /lte bar sngags dang ming spel ba'i/ /rang rang sngags ldan mi dgug par/ /bris nas snying gar gzhug pa'o/ /kha sbyor dbye ba sngon 'gro ba'i/ /dgug pas gzugs la phab nas su/ /mi yi rus pa las byas pa'i//sor brgyad pa yi phur bu la/ /rang sngags brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas/ /gzugs brnyan snying gar btab nas ni/ /dgra yi khyem mam sgo'am ni/ /grong la sogs par sba bar bya/ /sangs rgyas sgu gsum mchog sbyin pa/ /shes dang mi shes rnam spangs pa/ /zla ba phyed ni tshun chad kyis(/ /skams sam yang na 'jigs 22—68 /

par 'gyur/ /rdo rje gsum gyi rnal 'byor gyis/ /mngon spyod las la bgegs dgras sbyar/ /dkyil 'khor gsum dang rigs lnga'i las/ /ting 'dzin dag pas byed phyir ro/ /de yi rnal 'byor sngon bzhin bya/ /gzugs brnyan gong ma bzhin byas la/ /dgug pa sngon du 'gro ba yis/ /rtag pa'i spyor bas las 'di bya/ /mi yi rus pa'i phur bu la/ /sor brgyad rtse mor 'khor lo bsam/ /me tog sngon pos mchod cing ni/ /'khyil pa'i sngags ni rig bcas bzla/ /de yis spyi bor btab gyur ༄kyin/ /rtag pa yang ni klad gzer can/ /'gyur na bdag sems ldan pa yi/ /dgra bo dag ni smos ci dgos/ /de bzhin seng sdeng rtse mo las/ /byas pa'i phur bus pad+ma can/ /byin gyis brlabs bzlas sngon bzhin mchod/ /snying gar btab nas ling ga de/ /thod pa kha sbyar nang bcug ste/ /dur khrod me la gdung byas na sna/ /tsha ba'i nad kyis 'debs byed pas—/ /dpag med rnal 'byor gyis bya'o/ /de bzhin mi bskyod rnal 'byor pas / /gsod byed lcags byas phur bu la/ /rdo rje rtse mor byen brlabs la/ /mchod cing sngags bzlas snying gar gdab/ /me 'bar nang du de bcas bsguracho/ /de yi mod la gang sbyar ba'i/ /sku gsum 'jig par byed pa ste/ /bdag sems ldan pa smos ci dgos/ /bdud rtsi 'khyel pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /sngon bzhin gzugs brnyan rab byas la/ /de mnan khro bo bka' nod bsgo/ /de nas btang nas bkug ste gzhug /sngon ma'am yams nad 'tshe ba'am/ /yul du sna tshogs 'byung byed pa/ /gzugs brnyan de la phab nas ni/ /snying ga nas ni rkang pa'i bar/ /de bzhin du ni spyi bo'i bar/ /rdo rje gsum gyi sngags brjod byung / /gdug dang sdig pa bsal byas nas/ /che ge lus ngag yid 22—685

gsum la/ /rdo rje phur bus thob ces pa'i/ /sngags ni gong ma bakhya/na du brjod//thun bzhir g.yel med zhag bdun du/ /phur bu'i rnam 'phrul 'di bya'o/ /bsam gtan rdo rje'i sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas dag kyang nges par 'be+ebs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /phur bu btab na'ang myur du 'chi/ /de bzhin bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yi/ /rnal 'byor sngon bzhin rab byas te/ /kha sbyor dbye ba sngon 'gro ba'i/ /spyor ba bdun kyis bsgrub par bya/ /dur khrod thal ba la sogs la/ /sngon bzhin gzugs dang ming bcas pa/ /dgug pa sngon 'go dur khrod du/ /skra bshig gcer bur phyung byas te/ /mtshan ma mnan nas sngon ma yi/ /sngags ni brgya dang rtsa brgyad bzla/ /zhag ni bdun du thun bzhi ru / /spyor ba de yis khams gsum 'jig rmye /ro bsregs thal ba 'ba' zhig la / /gzugs brnyan la sogs sngon bzhin byas/ /gong ltar stong rtsa brgyad bzlas na/ /spyor ba yis de 3mod la 'chi/ /chu 'gram gnyis kyi sa bsogs —la / /bsgrub bya'i gzugs brnyan rab byas te/ /ske tshe lan tshwa 'bru mar dang / /dug dang da dur snag tshar sbyar/ /dur khrod ras la de yi ming / /sngags spel bris nas ming bcug ste/ /gan rkyal mgo ni byang du bstan/ /srang ko tsa dang 'byi tse 4ka /gzhan ma btsos pas de'i lus la/ /til 'bru tsam du btsags byas la/ /bskul ba'i tshig dang sngags bcas pa/ /dgang zhing thun bzhir zhag bdun byas/ /spyor ba de yis sangs rgyas kyang / /'jig par 'gyur na gnod sbyin kun/ /smos ci dgos te de lta 5yin/ /rus phye dug dang khrag rnams la/ /gzugs brnyan ming dang bcas byas la/ /sol khur sbangs pa'i gos gon la/ /khros nas rkang pas mnan te bzlas/ /che ge mo rak+ṣa seng kra ha 22—686

ya / bskul ba'i tshigs bcad thun bzhi ru/ /zhag bdun bzlas pas dgra bo de—/ /srin pos khyer bar gdon mi za/ /ske tshe mar dang bshang gcir sbyar/ /gzugs brnyan yog par blugs byas la/ /bdud rtsi 'khyel pa'i rkang pa mchog /me rmyeyi 'khor lor byen gyis brlab/ /pra sha dza la che ge mo mā sder ya hūṃ phaṭa/gong gi sngags spel thun bzhi ru/ /zhag bdun g.yel med sems kyis bsgrub/ /tsha ba'i nad kyis 'debs par byed/ /gang yang rung ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ /thams cad snga ma bzhin byas la/ /phran tshegs rdo rje gsang ba yi / / gsang ba'i 4las 'di bsgrub pa'o/ /rdo rgyus sam dur khrod sol ba la/ /de nyid —gsum gyi bar bcug pa'i/ d+ngha /khaṃ 4ni brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas na/ /dur khrod sa la sbrul gzugs bri/ /nag po mi sdug 'jigs byed pa/ /'od 'bar sems 'khrugs mche phreng gtams/ /lce gnyis myug pa 6mig bgrad pa/ /mjug ma rdeb 7pa'i tshul can no/ /de yi kha ru mi bzad dug /sreg byed lta bu dmar nag tu/ /gnas pa'i yi ge khaṃ bsams te/ /de yis sbrul de gnas las bskyod / /de yi lce yi rtse mo la/ / twe ljang khu 9yi lcags kyu yis/ /rgyu ba dang ni gnas pa'i dug /ha la ha la la sogs kun/ /bkug ste bsdus nas khyer 'ongs nas/ /lce yi rtse la gzhug par bya/ /de yis 7khams gsum dug blangs nas/ /de nyid dug gis gang bar bsam/ /oṃ kṛṣ+ṭa sarba che ge mo'i dpral griṇ+ḍa na khaṃ tri phaṭa/ brjod pas de sod ཿ dpral bar bzung / /mche bas phug ste lces reg pas/ /rdo rje 'chang ba chen po yang / /dug gis 'chi nges dogs pa med/ /de kho na bzhin sdig pa dang / /sre mong lta ba ne+e.e na pa/ /chu sbrul rlung sprul la sogs pa/ /sa yi zas can sbal pa las1 / /bsgrub bya 22—687

'dzin du gzhug pa'i phyir/ /bri ba'i rdzas dang gzugs dang bskul/ /gdug pa kun nas rbad tshobatang bas/ /de yis mi 'chi dogs pa med/ /gshin rje gshed kyi spyor ldan pas/ /thams cad snga ma bzhin byas la/ /dkon mchog gnod byed gzhom pa'i phyir/ /sbyor ba bzhi yis bsgrub par bya/ /oṃ s+thāḥt+thaḥthuwi kṛ tā na na che ge mo pa ta ya t+t+waṃ phaṭa/ de yis dur khrod sol ba la/ /stong rtsa brgyad ni btab nas kyang / /ro bsregs shul gyi sa la yang / /bsgrub bya'i gzugs bris bkug ste gzhug /bkas pa'i bsam pas sol ba de/ /gong gi sngags bzlas spu gri ltar/ /bsams te mgul pa'am spyi bo nas/ /de ltar thun bzhir zhag bdun sbyar/ /spyi bo 'gas sam mgo 'chad jepar/ /'gyur bar 'di la som nyi med/ /de bzhin de 'dra'i rnal 'byor pas/ /de nyid lag pa g.yas par 'gyur/ /mdun du bsgrub bya'i lus bsams la/ /sngags 'di nyid kyis bsnun zhing brgyalazhe/ /oṃ s+thāḥjiḥkyewi kṛ tā na na che ge mo mu ṅka ra a ta ya dh+ri phaṭa/ de yis thun bzhir zhag bdun du/ /bsnun zhing brdungs pas bsgrub bya de7/ /g.yang du lhung nas 'chi bar nges/ /yang na 8snade yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /g.yas par t+t+waṃ las byung ba yi/ /rdo rje rtse lngas bsgrub bya yi/ /lus la bsnun zhing 'di 9brjod do/ /oṃ dīḥdz+rīḥrkabyu kṛ tā 1na na che ge mo badz+ra a ko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ de yis thun bzhir zhag bdun du/ /kha phye bsnun pas bsgrub bya de/ /srin po la sogs 'jigs par byed/ /de ltar de yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /sngon bzhin sngags btab rdo rgyus sam/ /sol bas dur khrod sa gzhi la/ /bsgrub bya pho mo'i gzugs bris la/ /hūṃ bskyed sta gri /lag par bsam / /khros te mgul par sngags bzlas nas/ /mid pa bcad par bsam 22—688

pa ni/ /spyor ba thun bzhir zhag bdun du/ /oṃ tweḥṣ+ṭṛḥ①blu kṛ tā na na che ge mo wāka ti pa ta hūṃ phaṭa/ brjod cing g.yel ba med pa yis/ /bzlas pas bsgrub ⑪bya mgul 'gags nas/ /kha zas mi thar nad kyis 'dzin/ /de bzhin bgegs dgra'i sbyor ba yis/ /ro bsregs thal ba rus la sogs/ /khro bo nyi shu'am de phyed kyis/ /me thab dkyil 'khor gru gsum bya/ /mar chen dud pas kha dog bsgyur/ /kha phye rdo rje rtse gsum pas/ /dbus su kha khyer gsum byas te//tsher ma'i me ni khros nas sbar/ /bshad pa'i cho gas me lha bskyed/ /gong gsungs rdzas byas gzugs brnyan gtub/ /de yi zhal du lan gsum du/ /gang ba'i sbyin sreg dbul bar bya/ /de yi ye shes sems dpa' ru/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa zhal gdangs pa/ /hūṃ ljags mche ba rnon po can/ /khro dang ldan pa sngon bzhin bsam④/ /srog song steng ngam sra ba'am/ /yang na ci yang med pa ru/ /rkang pas rkang pa mnan nas su/ /sos ni so yang 'cha' bar byed/ /ba lang sha dang khyi yi sha/ /zangs phud can sogs sha rnams ni/ /bsgrub bya'i yan lag tu bsams rjol/ /gong ma'i sngags kyis sbyin sreg bya/ /sha chen 'ba' zhig kho na la/ /dgra yi gzugs brnyan byas nas ni/ /de yi zhal du sbyin sreg byas/ /rdo rje las byung 'jig par bshad/ /sngon bzhin dgra yi gzugs brnyan la/ /bshang gci 'bru mar bcas byugs nas/ /sngon gsungs sngags dang bskul bar byape/ /tsher ma'i me la khros te bsreg /thun bzhir zhag bdun brgya rtsa brgyad/ /bzlas pas sangs rgyas kyis sbyar ba'i/ /las kyang 'jig na dgra bo yi/ /sbyar ba'i las ni smos ci dgos/ /bsad pas de dag thams cad kun/ /thugs rjes bzung ⑥phyir rnal 'byor ches/ /gnyis 22—689
