bral 'das pa'i de ma thag /'jug pa'i las 'di brtsam ①pa'o/ /de dag rnams kyis dngos po rnams/ /ma skyes par ni gzhig rjonas kyang / /'bras bu myong bar nges pa'i tshul①/ /ye shes rang rig chen po mchog /sa bon 'od zer gyis bkug nas/ /zhal du zhugs nas zhu gyur ④te/ /rdo rje lam byung pad+mar gnas/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i gzugs gyur la/ /spyan sogs lha mos bskul ba la/ /hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan/ /spro ⑪bsdus mi bskyod rdo rjer bskyed ༅ / /chos kyi dbyings su byin gyis brlab/ /rang las dgu gnyis drug phyung nas/ /gnyis dang gsum du rdzogs byas la/ /dang po rtog pa yongs dag phyir—/ /sngags kyis phur bu dbyung bar bya/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra tī li ki khā ⑦ya hūṃ/phyung nas de yi gnas su yang / /rang gi ye shes 'khor lo can/ /gnas bcas bsams nas 'od zer gyis/ /sngon bzhin rang sgra ④sangs rgyas su/ /bskyed dang des bskyed lha mo'i tshogs/ /bdud rtsi lngas gang bum pa yis/ /dbang bskur de dang bla mar bcas/ /zhugs pas rdo rje sems dpar bskyed/ /oṃ badz+ra dh+rika bye/bhesngags kyis phyung ste/ /mdun du rlung gi dkyil 'khor steng / /'khor lo bcas pa mos byas la/ /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba bya/ /a ho yi gi sngags ⑫brjod pas/ /rlung gis bteg nas mngon dga' ru/ /gshegs su gsol ba'i sngags 'phangs pas/ /de dag ⑪sras su skye bar nges rang rang lha yi sbyor ba'am/ /de yi gnas pa gang rung du/ /blo gros ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /spyor ba de kho na yis bya/ /gnyis po rang zhugs de ma thag /de yi ye shes rang lha'am/ /zhe sdang dag pa'i sbyor kho nas/ /gong ma bzhin du rab tu brtsam/ /bdag med sems med bems po ni/ /lan gsum gyis ⑩ni 22—690

gzhig byas pas/ /gong gi sbyor bas 'bras bu che/ /mjug tu brtsam mi dgos par 'byung / /de ltar thabs dang sngags ldan pas/ /'khor ba'i 'og ma'i rgyu ldan pa/ /bsad pas rang dang gzhan dag pas/ /ma 'khrul pa ru gsungs pa'o—/ /sred pa zhe sdang gis bslang ba'i1/ /sems kyis gsod pa'i gti mug can/ /thabs med ye shes dang bral bas/ /thur du bltas te dmyal bar 'go/ /da ni gnas nas spro ba'i cho ga bshad par bya'o/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /thams cad snga ma bzhin byas la/ /gnyis kyi khyerab tu bsgrub byas pa/ /gsum pa las 'di brtsam pa'o/ /thod pa srubs ni gang ba dag /pho dang mo yi bskrad pa la/ /de yi rigs pas btsal byas la/ /gnod byed yul gzhan dbyung bar bya/ /a ri lo ma'i khu ba dang / /rkang pa g.yon pa'i srin lag khrag /snag tshar byas te bya rgod kyi/ /sgo rtsa'i smyu gus bri bar bya/ /mgar ④ba'i dur khrod ras ma la/ /gzhu 'dra rlung gi dkyil 'khor steng / /ral gri yis ④ni mtshan pa bri/ /de steng bsgrub bya'i gzugs gzhag cho la/ /gong gi ras la de yi ming / /sngags kyi bar bcug che ge mo ༅/ /uts+tsha ta ⑦ya phaṭa bris la/ /de yi snying gar gzhug par bya/ /bkug ste bcug nas de dkris ⑧la/ /thod pa ru ni bcug byas te/ /khro bo'i tshig gi spurang rang sngags//rig ⑩dang bcas par brgya rtsa brgyad/ /thun bzhir zhag bdun bzlas byas nas/ /khyem mam grong ngam sgo dag tu/ /sbas te bzhag na dus de ru/ /sangs rgyas dpung yang sgod par 'gyur/ /de bzhin tā la'i lo ma la/ /gro ga'am shog shog ras la sogs/ /snod med cho gas gong ma ltar/ /stong rtsa brgyad ni rig bcas bzlas/ /dgra yi khyim mam sgo dag tu/ /sbas te bzhag na myur ba ru/ /22—691

dkon mchog 'joms pa'i dgra bo che/ /skams sam 'chi'am skyod par nges /las de bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yi/ /sbyor ba yis kyang rab tu bsgrub/ /thams cad snga ma bzhin byas la/ /cho ga 'di ni rab tu brtsam/ /rgyal mtshan ras ni chag gang la/ /gru bzhi lham par kha ti dang / /a ri sha yi lo ma dang / /ro bsregs spyo byed sol ba dang / /mu zi'i dug dang rkang g.yon gyi/ /ming med khrag la snag tshar byas/ /khwa yi gshog pa'i sgyu gu yis①/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu 'dra la/ /phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad rtse bstan pa'i/ /ral gri brgyad pa'i 'khor lo la/ /de dbus bsgrub bya'i gzugs bris la/ /de yi snying gar phreng sngags ni/ /gong gi rig pa dang bcas pa/ /dgug med bris nas snying gar glan/ /bkug ste bcug nas rkang g.yon gyis/ /mnan te brgya dang rtsa brgyad bzlas/ /na maḥs man+ta k+ka ya wāka tsit+ta badzā hūṃ⑤/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya/ma hā rda1 1ṭa/ ka ṭa bye ra ba ya/ a si mu sa la pa ra shu/ bā sha hastu duya/oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li kha kha khā hi khā ⑩hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+ta ban+ta/ ha na ha na/pa tsa pa tsa/ gardza gardza/ bi zwa ṭa ya bi sgo ṭa ya/ sarba bispyo⑥/ bi nā ya ka rgo⑦—/ che ge mo uts+tsha ta byeya phaṭa/ de yang phyag 'tshal mjug tu yang / /bskul ba 'di ni bya ba dang / /phyag 'tshal bskul dang bod pa dang / /las brgyad de dag tu shes bya/ /de ltar bsngags nas ras ma de/ /ma mo la sogs gnas su sba/ /sangs rgyas dpung yang sgod byed na/ /bgegs kyi gnod pa smos ci dgos / /spud ni bsgrub bya srin po la sogs pas 'dzin du gzhug pa'i cho ga bshad par bya'o/ /thams cad snga ma bzhin byas la/ /gzhan gyis ⑩mi thub rnal 'byor gyis/ /gsum pa'i dus su rdzas ldan par/ /cho ga 'di yis las 22—692

'di byed/ /rgyal mtshan dang ni mtshon bsnun dang / /shi ba'i thod pa gnyis btsal la/ /dur khrod kyi ni sol ba la/ /khro bo'i sngags ni rig ①bcas bzlas//de yi thod par srin po'i gzugs/ /'jigs rung gyen badze+es mche gcigs pa/ /sha zlon za zhing khrag 'dzag pa/ /g.yas g.yon ro langs gri dang ni/ /sdogs 'dzub byad pa duhūṃ bskyed bri/ /de yi snying gar rus phye dang / /dug dang mthe'u chung khrag gis ni/ /che ge mo ni zung shig bri/ /yang ni thod pa gnyis pa la—/ /bsgrub bya'i rkang rjes sa dang ni/ /ro bsregs sa dang thal ba dang / /sol ba gcin gyis sbrus byas la/ /de yi gzugs brnyan byas nas su/ /dug dang rus phye mdzub mo'i ①khrag /ming dang sngags bcas ta ler bris/ /de yis rjosnying gar gzhug par bya/ /gnyi ga bkug ste bcug byas nas/ /de ni 'og bzhag gong ma steng / /srin po de yis bsgrub bya rnams/ /bzung bar bsams nas khros byas te/ /nag po gnyis la rkye dur khrod du/ /nam phyed song nas bsgreng byas te/ /sngags bzlas srin po'i ⑥'dzin par 'gyur/ /na maḥs man+ta rgodze+e/ kā ya wāka zu byuX badzā hūṃ/ oṃ hūṃ dzi na ri ta che ge mo rak+ṣa ghi ha rgo ⑨hūṃ phaṭa/ de bzhin sbrul dang seṅge dang / /'byung po sdig la sogs pa rnams/ /cho ga gong bzhin gnyis par bri/ /gong gi sngags de rigs ⑩bcas bzla/ /g.yeng med gnyis kyi mtshan dus su/ /khros nas bsgreng zhing bzlas byas pas /gal te mi bskyod yin na yang / /de dag rnams kyis 'dzin par 'gyur/ /de dag thar bar byed 'dod pas/ /'dzin byed de dag thams cad kun/ /bsgrub bya'i lus la bsdus byas la/ /rkang pa gnyis kyis mnye bar bya/ /lag gnyis 'bar ba'i rdo rjer bskyed/ /de yis dbyug ⑪pas brdung bar ⑫bya/ /22—693

rdo rje 'bar bas brdung ba dang / /sngon gyi sngags bzlas lcug mas gdab/ /che ge mo rak+ṣa sa 'di phyi mo tsa yi①/ /srin mo ma rungs gtum mo 1dang / /'jigs pa chen pos 'khrugs pa la/ /sbyor ba de yis rab sbyar na/ /cho ga bzhin du grol bar byed / /1da ni dgug pa'i cho ga rgyas par bshad par bya'o/ /ri mo'i dkyil 'khor bris nas su/ /lha yis dbang bskur yan chad ni/ /thams cad gong ma bzhin byas la/ /bsam gtan 'khor los dgug par bsgrub//rnam par snang mdzad sbyor ba yis/ /'khor lo chen po rnam par bsams④/ /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang byas la/ /lcags kyu gnas ni bsgom par bya/ /oṃ āḥdzi na dzika che ge mo sems can nam sems can ma yin pa ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ/rjobarjod pas de las rab 'phros pas/ /lcags kyu zhags pas mtshan pa yi/ /lha yi sku ni mang po dag /bsgrub bya 'gugs phyir spro bar bya/ /dgug bya ming gi yi ges bskyed/ /yi byung rlung dkyil la bzhag ste/ /lcags kyus snying btab zhags pas bcings/ /rlung gis bteg nas 'ong bar bsam/ /rdo rje pad+ma 'khor lo sogs/ /mtshan ma'i lha rnams spros byas nas/ /de yis btab pas de bzhin du/ /dgug par the tshom med pa'o/ /lo gis phab ste mdun bzhag nas / /sngon bzhin lha mo gnyis kyis ni/ /'tshe ba bzlog nas bka' nod bsam / /de ltar sbyor bas zhag bdun du/ /thun bzhir rab tu sbyar byas nas / /dgug las mi 'da' kun gyis kyang / /sgrub po las thabs byed par 'gyur—/ /de bzhin mi bskyod rdo rje dang / /rnam par snang mdzad 'od dpag med—/ /'khor lo chen po'i sbyor ba yis/ /lcags kyus 3 gnas bsam ④rang sngags brjod/ /oṃ s+dzabadz+ra rjaka che ge mo ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ⑧ / oṃ s+dza.a ro loka che 22—694

ge mo ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ①/ gzhan kun sngon bzhin dpag byas la/ /thun bzhir zhag bdun sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje gsum gyi nus pa yang / /'gugs 'gyur bsgrub bya smos ci dgos/ /sems kyi spyod pa gzhan bral bas/ /rdzogs chen rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /de yi bsam gtan 'ba' zhig gis/ /dgug pa dag ni thabs su gsungs/ /dga' dang dga' ba rab dga' yi/ /skyed pa gong ④du mngon byas la/ /bsgrub bya ye shes ngo bo ru/ /byas te gnyis par chud byas te/ /ma 'phros rtse gcig pa yis gzung kye/ /ye shes gsum gyis sku gsum mchog /de yi rgyud la 'gugs 'gyur na/ /sngags rgyud la sogs bsgrub bya ni/ /smos ci dgos te de mchog yin/ /de bas rnam pa thams cad du—/ /las rnams kun 'di bstan pa yin④/ /lus sogs med pa'ang dgug sogs 'gyur/ /gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor pas/ /thams cad snga ma bzhin byas la/ /rang gi sngags kyi ⑤rig pa mchog /grangs med bzlas pa rab tu bya/ /de nas lus rtsal thob pa yis/ /'bum phrag gcig ni bzlas pa bya—/ /ri mo'i dkyil 'khor bris byas la/ /lha yis dbang bskur bar kyis zhugs—/ /bud med gzhon nu'i thod pa ni/ /ma chag /byucing ni ma gas pa/ /pad+ma ltar mdzes yid du 'ong / /dum bu gcig pa blangs byas nas/ /gi wang la ni sngags bzlas nas/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor steng du ni/ /pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad bris te/ /lte bar dgug par bya ba ni/ /gur gum go ro tsa nas bri/ /gro ga shog shog la sogs la/ /phreng sngags 'di ni mi dgug par/ /swā hā bton te dza bcug nas/ /bskul ba dang bcas bris nas ni/ /de yi snying gar glan par bya/ /thod pa de yang kha sbubs 3nas/ /gshin rje gshed kyi 22—695

zhabs g.yas brkyang / /g.yon pa bskum pas mnan byas la/ /khro dang bcas pas gsang sngags 'di/ /rdo rje gsum dang bcas bsams pas①/ lan gsum drag tu brjod par bya/ /na maḥs man+ta/ kā ②ya wāka tsit+ta badzā t+t+waṃ/oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba duṭīn satwa da ma ka /a se mu sa la pa ra shu pā sha ha stu ya/ tsa tusgro dza tsa turmu kha/ sngo ḍa sha tsa rā ya/ ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha/sarba duṭīn pā shā a ha ri ṇi/ ma hā bighān ④bi nā ya ka /bi kṛ tā na na sarba bhū ④ ta bha yo ka ra ya/ ā gat+ta ha sa da di ⑤ni/ byā gh+ra tsarma ṇi ba sa na/ ku ru ku ru/ sarba karma tshin+ta tshin+ta/ sarba matram̐ bhin+da bhin+darjo/ pa ra mu tram̐/ bu mo che ge ā kar+ṣa ya ā kar+ṣa ya/ sarba bhū t+t+waṃ④/ nir ma tha ya nir ma tha ya sarba duṭīnane+e—/ pra be sha ya pra be+e sha ya/ maṇ+ḍal ma bi bi be ba swā hā/ dzī bi tān+ta ka pri ya/ ku ru ku ru/ ma ma kaphroṃ/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa ma bi lasba ma bi lasba/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra t+t+waṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ sbo ṭa ya sgo ṭa ya/sarba nā sha ya ni sum̐ ka ra ka ra/ he te bha ga bān⑨/ kakhyu ra ya si ma ma aza sā dha yadz+dza/ de las 'phros pa'i gshin rje gshed/ /lcags kyu thogs pa mang po yis—/ /sngon bzhin rlung dkyil la gnas pa'i/ /bsgrub bya bud med dgug par byed/ /skrag pas 'tshe ba bzlog pa'i phyir/ /spyan ma'i sngags kyis sngon bzhin du/ /ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir/ /mā ma tī ni sbyor bas srung / /de bzhin skyes pa'i thod pa la/ /g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum pas mnan te/ /cho ga sngon bzhin rab byas te/ /skyes pa rnams kyang dgug par byed/ /bsam gtan sngags rgyud spyor ba yi⑫/ /zhag bdun thun bzhir rab brtsams nas/ /gshin rje gshed kyi yon tan yang / /'gugs ⑪'gyur gzhan lta smos sbu dgos/ /22—696

thams cad snga ma bzhin byas la/ /'dod pa'i rgyal po khro bo che/ /'og nas 'byung ba'i cho gas bsgom/ /bu mo rnams ni dgug pa'i mchog /gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud gsungs pa'i/ /cho gas bsgrub bya bkug bcug nas/ /g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum gyis mnan na/ /sngags 'dis rig ①bcas bzlas brjod bya—/ /na maḥs man+ta/ kā ya wāka tsit+ta badzā dut+t+waṃ/ ta ki bu mo che ge mo hūṃ ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ④/ brjod pas sngags byung khro bo yis/ /lcags kyus ④sngon bzhin bkug byas nas/ /zhi ba srung ba'i cho ga yis/ /lha rnams la sogs 'gugs par byed/ /sngon bzhin thams cad rab byas la/ /rdo rje las byung mi g.yo ni/ /'og nas 'byung bzhin rab bsgoms la/ /lha chen chung mar bcas pa dgug /skyes pa'i thod pa ma gas pa/ /mdzis shing srub ⑤med ma gas pa/ /'thab tshe g.yul du shi ba yi/ /skyon med pa de btsal bar bya/ /rkang pa g.yas pa'i sor mo'i khrag /lan tshwa yungs kar ske tshe la/ /snag tsha byas la bya rgod rkang / /lha chen chung mar bcas pa kun/ /thod pa de la bri bar bya/ /de yi snying gar gong ma ltar/ /rig bcas sngags ni dgug par bya/ /bris nas snying gar glan par bya—/ /bkug ste bcug nas kha sbubs ⑥la/ /g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang pas mnan na/ /sngags 'di thun bzhir zhag bdun du/ /rig pa dang bcas bzlas dgug bya/ /na maḥs man+ta/ kā ya wāka tsit+ta badzā ⑦rde/ a tsa la ga na tse ta/ na ḍā na ḍā⑧/ mo ṭa mo ṭa/ spo ta sgo ⑨ta/ da ha da ha/ mo ha mo ha/ sa ha sa ha/ ha na ha na/ tiṣ+ṭha nyiṣ+ṭha/ a bi sha a bi sha /ma hā mat+ta pa la ka /dhu na dhu na/ nyi ni nyi ni/ kha da kha da/ bispyo ⑫ma ra ma ra duṣ+ṭa nān⑪/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ sabaṃ ku ru ku ru/ ki ri ki ri/ ma hā bi sha badz+ra/22—697

sbo ṭa ya sgo ṭa ya/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ tri ba li baṃ ga narta ya/ saṃ haṃ e haṃ/ a tsa la tse ta/ spo 1ta ya spo 3ta ya/ hūṃ hūṃ/ a sa marnyi ka /tra ta ma hā ba la/sa ma ya man+d+ra ①rgo/ tai ma ④shu ta bu lo ka du sh+ya du/ badz+ra na ma dhista pri ti ha ta ba la bya/ dza la ya tra ta a ha sa pyan na ma/ lha chen po bud med dang bcas pa ā kar+ṣa yadz+dza/ sngags las byung ba'i khro bo che/ /lcags kyu thogs pas 'gugs bsams nas/ /sngon bzhin rab mchod bsrung ba yis/ /g.yog dang chung ma'i bya ba byed/ /de bzhin lha min la sogs kyang / /sbyor ba de yis rab bsgrubs na/ /skrag cing 'jigs pa gong mas bsrung / /kha sbyar lus su bcas pa 'grub/ /thams cad snga ma bzhin byas la/ /'og nas 'byung ba'i cho ga yis//gnod mdzes rgyal po bsgoms byas te/ /bu mo rnams ni dgug par bya/ /mtshan rnams kun gyis rnam brgyan pa/ /rgyal mtshan gyur pa'i thod pa la/ /rkang pa g.yon pa'i ming med khrag /snag tsha byas nas de lha'i ⑦sgros/ /bsgrub bya'i bu mo'i gzugs bris la/ /de yi snying gar gong ma ltar/ /rig bcas sngags bri glan byas la/ /de yi bha gar gnod mdzes kyi/ /rkang pa g.yon pa'i mthe bos mnan/ /thun bzhir zhag bdun gsang sngags 'di/ /bskul dang bcas pas khros byas nas/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas pa'o/ /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha bu mo che ge mo hūṃ/ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa bu mo che ge mo hūṃ/ kṛsnra pa ya kṛsnra pa ya/ bu mo che ge mo hūṃ/ ā na ya hoḥbha ga bān me bir+ya rā dza bu mo che ge mo hūṃ phaṭa dz+dza/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /gnod mdzes gyur pa lcags kyu zhags/ /thogs pa 'phros pas rlung dkyil la/ /gnas pa'i bu mo snying ga phug /zhags pas ske nas bcings nas ni/ /'ongs pa'i tshe na bzlog pa'i phyir/ /zhing dang 22—698

bsrung bas brtan byas pas/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i las rnams byed/ /gang yang rung ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ /snga ma bzhin du thams cad bya/ /kha ti la sogs bsgrub byas la/ /skyes pa bud med dgug pa bsgrub/ /zla ba spyang kis zin pa'i tshe/ /btsag gam rdo rgyus la sogs pa/ /rang gi kha ru bcug nas kyang / /de nyid gsum bskyed lha ru bsam/ /de bar rang sngags bcug nas ni//sga ra ṇa yis spro byas pas/ /de las byung ba'i lha rnams ni/ /lcags kyus mtshan pas nam mkha' dgang / /bsnyu ba'i sbyor bas kun bsdus nas/ /rdzas kyis lha la bstem par bya/ /brtan pa'i ngo bos yang dang yang / /zla ba grol gyi bar du gzung / /de nas brtsams te thun bzhi ru/ /zhag bdun goms byas de bton la/ /tshangs pa drag po la sogs lha/ /gang gi ming rnams bris 'gyur na/ /rdo rje thugs kyi bka' bzhin du/ /skrag cing 'jigs nas 'ong 'gyur na/ /tha mal skyes pa bud med sogs/ /smos ci dgos par 'ong bar 'gyur—/ /sngon bzhin bzlas pa la sogs nas/ /dbang bskur yan chad zhugs byas te/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa las byung ba'i/ /thor tshugs gcig ma bsgom par bya/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbu ma sngo/ /dang pos rang gi thabs la 'khyud—/ /g.yas gnyis gri dang ral gri dang / /g.yon gnyis thod pa nor bu bsnams—/ /rgyan rnams kun kyis rnam brgyan pa/ /rnam par smin sogs mos pa yis/ /rnga sgra dang ni ldan byas nas/ /cung zad mche gatshigs dmigs par byaske/ /mtshams thung mi smrar gyur pa yi/ /thod pa klu shing me tog dang / /rkang pa g.yon pa'i ming med khrag /bsres te 'o mar sbyar byas la/ /de yi skra yi pir gyis ni①/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor la ⑤gnas pazhu/ /nor rgyas la 22—699

sogs bu mo bri/ /de yi snying gar rig sngags ni/ /bskul ba dang bcas bris te glan/ /bkug ste bcug nas g.yas brkyang ste/ /g.yon bskum pa yis gnas byas la/ /sngags 'di brgya dang rtsa brgyad bzlas/ /oṃ yis①badz+ra shu li ni klu'i bu mo che ge mo ā kar+ṣa yadz+dza/ brjod pas gsum las byung ba yi/ /mdud can ma ni lcags kyus mtshan/ /rlung dkyil la gnas bsgrub bya ni/ /bcug ste sngon bzhin 'tshe ba bzlog /de ltar zhag bdun thun bzhi ru/ /sngags rgyud de yis rab sbyar te1/ /klu yi bu mo mig bzang dag /bkug nas nye bar spyad par bya/ /thams cad snga ma bzhin byas la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa las byung ba'i/ /khro gnyer ma yi sbyor ba yis/ /nam mkha'i rig 'dzin bu mo dgug/dmar skya g.yas sngo g.yon dkar ba/ /dang po rang gi thabs la 'khyud/ /g.yas gnyis pad+ma ral gri 'dzin/ /g.yon gnyis rin chen 'khor lo 'dzin/ /gsum po mos pas dpag med mtshan/ /ser la thod pa'i phreng ba brgyan/ /rgyan kun brgyan pa'i na bza' bklubs①/ /mche ba cung zad gatshigs pa bsgom//rgyal po 'dra ba'i bu mo yi/ /thod par rig 'dzin bu mo'i gzugs/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ /gong gi rdzas kyis bri bar bya/ /snying gar sngon bzhin ming bris nas/ /bkug ste bcug nas g.yas brkyang dang / /g.yon bskum pa yis mnan byas la/ /'di ni brgya dang rtsa gcig bzla/ /oṃ a ④ pa ya na sha ni tra sa pra bhe ni tā sa ya tā ④sa ya/ be+e ti be+e ra ti/ bye pa ti bye be+e ta/dza ti ni rig pa 'dzin pa'i bu mo che ge mo ā kar+ṣa yadz+dza/ brjod pas sngags las byung ba yi/ /khro gnyer lcags kyus mtshan pa yis/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i bu mo mchog /gser gyi rna rgyan 'phyang tsab 22—700

rnams—/ /bkug ste 'ong ba hurgyas btab po/ /lhun gyis grub pa gnyis mi dgos—/ /thun bzhir zhag bdun sbyar na 'grub/ /gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor pas/ /sngon bzhin thams cad rab byas la/ /mar ngo bcu bzhi tshes brgyad la/ /ro bsregs sol ba blangs nas ni/ /sngags 'di brgya rtsa brgyad du ni—/ /bzlas nas srin po la sogs pa/ /ming bcas gro ga la sogs la/ /bris nas de yis dgug par byed/ /oṃ tweḥspriḥwī kṛ ④tā na na srin po la sogs pa che ge mo skyes pa'am bud med 'di bdag la byen zhig stam+bha ①ya hūṃ phaṭa dz+dza/brjod cing de mnan thun bzhi ru/ /bdun sbyar srin po la sogs pas/ /rang gis bka' pal gang yang rung / /khrid nas nges par 'bul bar byed/ /'das ma thag pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /thams cad snga ma bzhin byas la/ /ji skad bshad pa'i phyag rgya mchog /bsgrub phyir sbyin sreg cho ga bya/ /dur khrod thal ba sol ba la/ /hom khung gru gsum khru do pa/ /zabs su khru gang kha khyer ni/ /sor mo brgyad pa'i tshad du bya/ /rdo rje rtse gsum sor bcu gnyis/ /rtse dbus lcags kyu ltar byas nas/ /dbus dang kha khyer la bkod de/ /dmar nag kha khyer rams kyis byug /ji skad gsungs pa'i gshin rje gshed/ /hūṃ bskyed rdo rje lce ldan pa'i/ /zhal du nges par bsgyur byas la/ /po son cha sogs me sbar ro—/ /dug gi khrag dang rab tu sbyar/ /lan tshwa ske tshe de bzhin sbyar/ /dha ④du a yi 'bras bu yis/ /zhal du bsreg cing lus dang ngag /khro zhing bsgrub bya'i ming bcas pa'i/ /sngags 'di stong dang rtsa brgyad du/ /blo dang ldan pas g.yel med pas/ /bzla zhing sbyin sreg ⑤brtsam pa'o/ /oṃ trīḥspriḥli kṛ rjo tā na na bu mo che ge mo stam+bha ⑦ya na shā ⑤ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa dz+dza/ de las 'phros pa'i gshin rje 22—701

gshed—/ /lcags kyu thogs pa 'phros byas pas/ /rlung dkyil la gnas bu mo yi—/ /snying gar sbyar te dgug par bsam/ /nyi ma'i gung dang nam phyed na/ /'di ni shis pa'i dus yin pas/ /blo dang ldan pas sbyor ba des/ /nyi ma gsum dang drug tu bya/ /'ongs pas 'tshe ba bzlog pa'i phyir/ /sngon bzhin zhi dang bsrung skyeb bya/ /bskal pa grangs med gsum du'ang / /de yis rtag tu 'dul bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas sam ni chos 'dzin nam/ /rdo rje sems dpa' gang yang rung / /gal te rmongs pas 'das ⑤na ni/ /de yi tshe ni der zad 'gyur / /rngud ni klu skams pas char gcad ④par bya ba'i cho ga bshad par bya'o—/ /sngon bzhin byas pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po nyid//kha dog ser po bsgoms byas la/ /char mi bcad pa 'gog par ⑤ bya/ /yul yul kun nas phyogs gcig ste/ /hūṃ bskyed sna tshogs rdo rje ni/ /rab 'bar me stag 'phro ba ni/ /'dod pa'i phyogs ni g.yogs par bsam/ /de yi lte bar hūṃ bskyed pa'i/ /rdo rje rtse lnga 'greng bu ni/ /tā pya la'i tshad tsam me 'bar ba'i—/ /bum par rten gyi dkyil 'khor bsam/ /de ru gong gi spyor ba ni/ /'khor lo dang bcas de bzhin bsgom/ /bdag ci 'dra bar 'khor rnams kyang / /brjod par bsams te sngags 'di bzlas/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ ma hā ba ra sha ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ de rnams ba spu'i klu bu ga las/ /'phros pa'i 'od zer ser po yis/ /'dod pa'i phyogs ni khyab bsams pas/ /sna tshogs rdo rje me yis ni/ /sa gzhi thams cad bsregs nas ni/ /klu skams gyur du zhing 'bros bsams na/ /rang 'dod gnas las phyi rol du/ /'bab bam 'on te mi 'bab 'gyur/ /yang na sbyor ba nges gnas la/ /ske tshe lan tshwa 'bru mar dang / /dug dang dha ⑨22—702

du ra dag gis/ /dur khrod ras la 'khrul 'khor bri/ /dang po pad+ma 'dab brgyad la/ /klu brgyud rnams kyi stis bon nam/ /rang rang snying po bri ba'o/ /phu paṃ phe pho pha phi phe/ /snying po phaṭa gnyis bar du ni/ /chu yi snying po bā bris la//de rnams bkug ste sa bon la/ /bcug ste gsal bar bsgom par bya/ /yang ni ras ma gnyis pa la/ /las kyi rdo rje ser po ni/ /'od zer 'bar ba bri byas la/ /lte bar rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /hūṃ gis mtshan pa bri bar bya/ /gong gi sbyor bas byin brlabs la/ /dang po ras ma bkan te bzhag /ras ma gnyis pa kha sbubs ⑤nas/ /rdo la sogs pas phyamanan byas pas/ /gong ma'i sngags ni bzlas brjod bya/ /klu rgyal 'bum ni khros gyur yang / /char pa 'gog pa'i mchog yin no / /④da ni pha rol gyi ngag dang dpung gnon pa'i cho ga bshad par bya'o/ /snga ma bzhin du thams cad byas/ /ting 'dzin 'di yis zhag bdun du/ /thun bzhir gzugs brnyan gcig sbyar bya/ /'phral du mngon du phyis byed 'gyur/ /gang yang rung ba'i sbyor ldan pas/ /gcer bu la sogs phyir rgol rnams/ /ming gi yi ge dang pos bskyed/ /spobs pa mnan phyir de yi mgor/ /lo la dbang chen ser po la/ /grwa bzhir rdo rjes mtshan par bsamaske/ /de steng haṃ byung las rdo rje/ /de steng paṃ bskyed pad+ma la/ /gzhal yas khang pa ji bzhin bsam/ /de dbus khro bo'i 'khor lo che/ /kha dog ser po bsgoms ⑤byas nas/ /de ni gnon pa rnam par bsam/ /rkan gyi dbus su haṃ bskyed pa'i/ /sna tshogs rdo rje kha bzhi yis/ /gsum pos spyi bo burna ba gnyis/ /skog mar phug bsam sngags bzla'o/ /de nyid gsum par rang rang sngags/ /che ge pa sha pa ya hūṃ/ /brjod cing bltas pas bsgrub bya de/ /mig mi lta zhing 22—703

smra mi nus/ /gang yang rung ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ /'di yang sngon bzhin rab sbyar nas/ /gang tshe dpung tshogs mthong ba yi/ /de tshe las la yang dag sbyar/ /dpung rnams kun gyi spyi bo ru/ /sa sogs rten ni sngon bzhin bskyed/ /'khor lo thams cad khro bo che/ / pad+mo ser po'i ①mdog ltar bsgom/ /ri yi rgyal po tsam bsams te/ /de nyid gsum par rang rang sngags/ /ba hu pa ya hūṃ zhes brjod—/ /dpung rnams sa 'og 'bying bar 'gyur/ /khro bo rnams ni phar bltas bsam④/ /ba hu bi ra hūṃ zhes brjod/ /de dag phyir ni mi ldog par/ /'bros par rab tu gyur pa'o/ /gal te khro bo rang mdun bltas/ /ba hu kṛṇ+ḍi ①hūṃ zhes brjod/ /de ni 'bros par byed 'dod kyang / /mdung bzhin du ni rengs par 'gyur/ /tshu rol pham par byed 'dod pas/ /gnyi ga mdun gyi phyogs byas pas/ /ba hu e hi hūṃ brjod pas/ /pha rol rgyal bar 'gyur ba'o/ /de ltar sbyor ba'i rnam pa yis/ /g.yel ba med par sbyar 'gyur na/ /sangs rgyas dpung yang gnon byed na/ /mi dbang la ni dogs pa med/ /yang ni sngon bzhin rab byas la/ /gang tshe dpung tshogs mthong 'gyur nas/ /de rmongs bya phyir phur bu yi/ /bsam gtan 'di ni sbyar bar bya/ /hūṃ las bskyed pa'i phur bu ni/ /steng ni rtse lnga 'og rtse gcig /sor brgyad tshad tsam rab bsams la/ /ded dpon dang pos dpung rnams bskyed/ /thams cad snying ni phyogs bsams nas/ /de ni rdo rje tho ba yis/ /khros shing thams cad phog bsams la/ /sngags 'dis rab tu gdab pa'o/ /oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya / dpung thams cad phaṭa/ tī la ya kri la ya/ dpung thams cad phaṭa/hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra tī la ya/ badz+ra dha ro ādzñā ④pa ya ti/ dpung thams cad kā ya 22—704

wāka tsit+ta badz+ra shī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ khros pas bzla zhing btab 'gyur na/ /sangs rgyas dag gi dpung dag kyang / /ting 'dzin de yis 'jig 'gyur na/ /mi yi dbang po smos ci dgos / /①da ni char dbab pa'i cho ga rgyas par bshad par bya'o—/ /'og 'byung ②ba yi rim pa yis/ /stobs po che yi rnal 'byor pas/ /grangs med bzlas pas bka' lung thob/ /'bum phrag gcig ni bzlas pa bya/ /thams cad dmar por rab bsams la/ /rdza phor so ni ma btang la/ /ral gri rtse brgyad 'khor lo la/ /pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad po bri/ /de la rams kyi khu ba yis—/ /rdo rje thor tshugs gcig ma yi/ /sngags kyi snying po 'di bri'o/ /oṃ shu li ni nan ③swā hā bri/ /de dang 'dra ba'i kham phor gzhag④ /kha sbyar skud pa sngon dmar dkri/ /de dang de rjo'adul rab bkug ste/ /'khor lo 'di la gnas par bsam/ /de ni ji bzhin gzhan thal sbyar/ /mchod pa'i shi tshogs kyis mchod byas nas/ /klu gnas mtsho dang rdzing bu sogs/ /gzhan la gsang ⑦nas gzhug pa'o/ /bdag nyid gnas dgon dben pa ru/ /sa sogs cho ga sngon 'gro bas/ /me yi dkyil 'khor gru gsum steng / /rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam bri/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor rlum po ste/ /pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad po ni/ /phyogs dang mtshams ni ma 'khrul bar/ /sbrul brgyad phyi rol bsnol mar bri/ /dbus su chu bdag thu dkar po che/ /sbrul mgo bdun pa zhabs klu gcig /skyes bu'i gdong can sbrul zhags bsnams/ /lto 'phye mkha' 'gro zhon pa bri/ /shar kyi 'dab mar mtha' yas ljang / /at+pal thogs pa bri bar bya/ /lho yi 'dab mar nor rgyas dkar/ /rin chen bum thogs bri bar bya/ /nub kyi 'dab mar 'jog po dmar/ /dgra sta thogs pa bri bar bya/ /byang du karko ṭa 22—705

nag po/ /sbrul shog rmyethogs pa bri bar bya/ /nub phyogs 'dab mar pad+ma dkar / /pad+ma thogs pa bri bar bya/ /bden bral 'dab mar pad chen dkar//pad dkar thogs pa bri bar bya/ /rlung mtshams 'dab mar dung skyong ser/ /dung phor thogs pa bri bar bya/ /dbang ldan rigs ldan sna tshogs pa/ /rgyal bu 'dzin pa bri bar bya/ /de dag kun kyang sbrul mgo gdengs/ /zhabs kyang sbrul 'khyel sprin gyi bye ni/ /gdan la bzhugs pa bri bar bya/ /g.yo ba drag po la sogs pa/ /rang rang phyogs su brgyad po 1ni/ /zur dang sgo ru gnyis 'khyil ④nas/ /sgo zur gnyis su mgo mjug bsnol/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor bris nas ni/ /bum pa 'o ma khrugang ba dgu/ /phyogs mtshams rnams su bzhag nas ni/ /rgyan rnams kyis kyang mdzes par bya/ /de yi rtog pa las bshad pa'i//cho gas klu rnams rgo gis bskyed/ /srog dang bcas pa bzhin du ni/ /gong ma lta bu bsgom par bya/ /de rnams dza rgo dza zhes brjod/ /de nas bkug la bsang kye gtor sogs/ /byas nas de la zhugs par bsam/ /de nas gtor ma 'o mar bcas/ /bu ram la sogs lha bshos che/ /phul nas rang rang sngags 'di ni/ /brgya rtsa brgyad kyis dga' bar bya/ /oṃ baṃ ba ru ṇa ya gā ti pa ta ye na ga ā+oṃ ④par+sha ya dh+ri rgo hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ saṃ a nan+ta ya hūṃ rgo hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ baṃ ba su ke hūṃ rgo hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ tai tak+ṣa ka chohūṃ rgo hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ shaṃ karko ṭa hūṃ rgo hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ paṃ pad+ma hūṃ rgo hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ mo ma hā pad+ma hūṃ rgo hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ saṃ shaṃ rmyekha ba la hūṃ rgo hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ a na pa ta ha hūṃ rgo hūṃ swā hā/ de nas pog snod bzung byas te/ /gtor ma sogs kyis mnyes byas la/ /stobs chen sbyor ba de nyid kyis/ /bzhag ste tshig gis gsol ba gdab/ /klu chen po ni khyed rnams 22—706

kyis / /bdag la yang dag dga' ba dang / /bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' yis ni/ /char gyi 1rgyun ni dbab tu gsol/ /lan gsum brjod pas klu rnams kyis/ /dga' bas char pa 'bebs bsams nas/ /rang gi spyor ba ma nyams par/ /ji bzhin rang gi sngags bzla'o/ /na maḥs man+ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badzā tsāzhe / oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ u gra la shu la ba ni hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ dzo ti da ni rngu da hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ ma hā pa lā ya swā hā/ de yi dbang du rab byas nas/ /sa gzhi thams cad char gyi 4ni/ /rgyun gyis ngoms par byas nas ni/ /thams cad bde la gnas par byed/ /de yis phebs par ma gyur na/ /stobs po che yi rnal 'byor pas/ /thams cad dkar pos bsams byas te/ /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gis ni bsgrub/ /hom khung zlum po khru gang par/ /khru phyed zabs su kha khyer la/ /sor bzhi tshad tsam de tsam 'phags/ /pad+ma'i 'dab mas bskor bar bri/ /'khor lo 'khor lo phreng bskor la/ /rdo rgyus sogs kyis byugs byas te/ /ji bzhin pa yi cho ga yis/ /me lha la sogs mchod par bya/ /de yi dbus su stobs po che/ /'og nas 'byung ba bzhin du byabye/ /phyogs dang mtshams su klu brgyad kyang / /de yi zhal bltas thal sbyar bsam/ /gong gi sngags kyis spyan drangs nas/ /bsang gtor zhabs bsil la sogs pa/ /byas nas de la thim par bsam de rnams lce yi dbus su ni/ /yi ge rgo ni bsam byas te/ /drugs gzar dgang gzar cho ga bzhin/ /byas nas bsang gtor la sogs pa/ /yang ni byas nas sbyin sreg dbul/ /'o ma dang ni 'bras chan dang / /bur thuram sbrang rtsi li kha ra / /dbang po la sogs sman rnams ni/ /dang por gsum gsum dbul 22—707

bar bya/ /gong gi sngags la zhi ba yi/ /rig pa dang bcas bzlas na ni/ /klu rnams kun la ci 'dod pa'i/ /gong gi rdzas ni sbyin sreg khyebya/ /tshim par byas nas rang gi sngags/ /gong ma bzhin du rab brjod pas/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i phyogs rnams su/ /char kyi rgyun ni 'be+ebs par byed/ /de yis phebs par ma gyur na/ /stobs chen khro bo'i rnal 'byor pas/ /thams cad nag por bsams byas te/ /'khrul 'khor cho ga bsgrub par bya/ /chu bo'i ngos gnyis sa dang ni/ /grog mkhar sa dang bshang gci bsres/ /klu yi gzugs brnyan mtho gsum pa'i/ /snying gar 'khor lo 'di ni gzhug /dur khrod ci ni ras ma la/ /ske tshe lan tshwa yungs mar dang / /khrag dug rams kyi rngusnag tsha yis/ /ral gri rtse brgyad 'khor lo bri/ /de steng pad+ma 'dab brgyad la/ /phu sogs brgyad ni bri ba dang / /snying por yi ge bā bris la/ /sngon bzhin bsams te dgug gzhug bya/ /gzugs brnyan yan lag thams cad kun/ /tsha ba gsum dang ske tshe dang / /dha rkyedu ra dang yungs mar dang / /byugs nas me la gdung bya zhing //gong gi sngags ni brjod bya zhing / /klu rnams gzugs ni rab tsha bas/ /bye ma me yi pya'ajigs pa yis/ /'jigs nas char rgyun 'jam po yi 5/ /mngon par 'dod pa'i phyogs ni 'be+ebs/ /de yis char ni mi 'bebs na/ /sngon bzhin klu yi dkyil 'khor bri/ /stod g.yogs ser po smad g.yogs dmar/ /ze'u kha sngon po bcings nas ni/ /gos ni dmar po bgo ba'am/ /yang na gcer bur byung byas la/ /skra bshig so ni gcigs byas nas/ /rkang par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rdo rje 'bar bar byin brlabs la/ /klu ni gan rkyal gnas par bsam / /g.yon pas de yi dkyil 'khor mnan/ /skrag ste gdengs ka g.yo 22—708

bar bsam/ /gyen bltas kha las phus 1'debs shing / /de yi khrag gis mkha' khyab nas/ /rgya mtsho lta bur gyur bsams 2nas/ /sngags 'di g.yeng ba med par bzla/ /na maḥs man+ta/ kā ya wāka tsit+ta badzā rde/ oṃ dz+wa hūṃ rgo hūṃ rgo hūṃ/ phaṭa rgo phaṭa rna phaṭa / oṃ u gra la shu la pa ni rgo/ hūṃ rgo hūṃ rgo hūṃ cho/phaṭa rgo phaṭa rgo phaṭa/ oṃ dzo ti ni rna ta5/ t+t+waṃ rgo t+t+waṃ rgo hūṃ/ phaṭa rgo phaṭa rgo phaṭa / oṃ ma hā pa la rgo phaṭa/ de yis klu rnams stobs chen la/ /skrag nas sa gzhi rgyas pa ru/ /dam tshig dbang gis de dag gis/ /char gyi rgyun ni 'be+ebs par byed/ /des kyang char ni mi 'bab na/ /sngon bzhin mngon spyod hom khung du/ /po son cha yi tsher mas dgang / /sme sha can gyi me sbar bya/ /me lha sngon bzhin mchod byas nas/ /de dbus stobs po che bsams nas/ /zhal gdangs rdo rje rtse ldan pa/ /mche ba gcigs pa bsam par bya/ /sngon gzugs klu yi 7gzugs brnyan ni/ /dug dang lan tshwa dha du ra/ /ske tshe sogs pa rab byas la/ /phuḥs 9bskyed dgug cing gzhug par bya/ /de ni bshang ba gci bas byugs/ /gdug pa'i dgra yi g.yon pa yis/ /de yi mjug ma'i rtse mo nas/ /gtub cing gong ma'i sngags zlo zhing / /klu rnams mā sar ya phaṭa ces/ /brjod cing sbyin sreg brgya rtsa brgyad/ /byin pas klu rnams thams cad kyang / /tsha ste skrag nas char 'be+ebs byed/ /gal te de ltar byed pa la/ /char ni 'bebs par mi byed na/ /stobs po che yi 'gal ba'i phyir/ /de gnon pa yi cho ga bya/ /chu ngogs sa la sogs pa yi/ /sngon gsungs rdzas la khro bo che/ /gzugs brnyan zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /byas te gan rkyal gzhag 7par bya/ /bdag nyid dpal ldan gsum pa yi/ /rnal 'byor 'og nas 'byung 22—709

bzhin bskyed/ /de ni bkug nas gzugs brnyan bcug /g.yon pas mnan te sngags bzla'o/ /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bhasti/ ma hā ba la bar+ṣa shrī s+t+waṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa ma hā ba la bar+ṣa shrī rgyu hūṃ phaṭa/ gri1 pa ya kṛsnra pa ya ma hā ba la bar+ṣa shī rgyu hūṃ phaṭa/ ā na ya hoḥ3/bha ga bān bibyā rā da/dza ma hā ba la bar+ṣa shī sgo hūṃ phaṭa/de yang ④ji bzhin khri phrag gnyis/ /bzlas brjod byas nas gong ma yi/ /hom khung dbus su gnod mdzes che/ /zhal gdangs hūṃ gi lce can bsam/ /bskul ba'i tshig dang bcas pa yis/ /gzugs brnyan gtub cing khri phrag gcig /de yi zhal du sbyin sreg bya/ /stobs po che yis char phab nas/ /'dzam gling 'di dang thams cad kun/ /char gyis ngoms par byas pa yisakru/ /lo legs 'bru rnams 'phel bar 'gyur/ /'khrul 'khor rgyud du ni kun la grags/ /de nas zhi ba'i hom khung ni/ /sngon bzhin du ni rab byas nas/ /sbyan ma dkar mo bsams nas ni/ /de yi sngags dang de'i cho gas/ /mar dang 'o ma 'bras chan sogs/ /de yi zhal du dbab byas nas/ /sreg blugs khri phrag gcig dbul bas/ /klu dang khro bo stobs po che/ /tshar bcad de yis zhi bar byed ④/ /des na de yis dga' 'gyur te/ /gzhan du sbyar ba tsam gyis ni/ /mod la char gyi rgyun 'bebs byed/ /las kyi tshogs ni de dag gam/ /gzhan la sgrub /8 po bsrung ba'am/ /yang na bdag gis gzhan bsrung phyir/ /sbyor ba 'di ni brtsam pa'o/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa las byung ba'i/ /mā ma khri ni sngon bzhin bsam—/ /ye shes sems dpa'i shebhethugs ka ru/ /bsgrub bya bzhag nas sngags 'di bzla/ /oṃ s+dzashaṅka re shadhi ka re ghuṣ+ṭa sgoṣ+ṭa gh+rar+bhe ni gh+rar+bhe ni gha ta ya swā hā che ge mo rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ/ brjod pas sngon bzhin stobs dbab dang / /dbang 22—710

bskur byas nas bsgrub bya dezhu/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i 3sprul pa yang / /srung na gzhan sbyar smos ci dgos/ /gal te khyis gtses lkul sogs la/ /mtshon cha nor ni gzhan lta bsgrub/ /de tshe sa gsum sgras ge'agengs tshe/ /rnal 'byor 'di yis bsrung ba bya/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yi/ /spyi bor hūṃ las rdo rje bskyed//de yi lte bar zla ba la/ /mā ma tī ni sngon bzhin bsam/ /de yi ye shes lha mo ni/ /thugs kar mo la bzlas pa'i sngags/ /yang 'greng rig bcas bskor bar bsam//de nyid bzlas pas 'od zer 'phros/ /de yis spyi bo nas brtsams te/ /rkang mthil bar kyi rdo rje yi/ /go chas bar mtshams med gtams te/ /'byi lo ka ni chur blugs bzhin/ /sbyor ba 3yang dang yang bsams te/ /bdag dang gzhan ni srung bar byed/ /'jigs pa stong gsum gang ba yang / /srung byed stobs su 'gyur bar bshad/ /mngon rtogs 6nye ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ /las ni bzhi ste gcig la gsum/ /bsgrub phyir nye dang mi nye bas/ /bsam gtan ri mo bsrung ba'i phyir/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i chos rnams kyi tsu/ /don dang 'bras bur bcas pa rnams/ /dag pa'i khro bo rnams kyi ni/ /bsgom pa'i cho ga bshad par bya/ /sngon bzhin rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang / /dang po mgon po bskyed byas nas/ /sems can skye rim bzhi spangs nas/ /bar ma'i sems kyis rkyedang por 'gyur/ /bskul bas hūṃ lnga hūṃ kye du byung / /hūṃ lnga lcags kyu dbyug to trī snadang / /rtse gsum ral gri rdo rjer 'gyur/ /hūṃ 1ni 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad 'gyur/ /de yang de dag rnams kyis mtshan/ /'od kyi khams bzhugs sangs rgyas rnams/ /rang dang 'dra bas bskul byas te/ /bcug ste sa bon nang du thim/ /ṭāk+ki 1mirgyal po khro bo che/ /khru dang dbu zhal mthing ga la/ /22—711

g.yas dkar g.yon dmar phyag drug pa/ /g.yas gnyis lcags kyu ral gri 'dzin/ /g.yon gnyis rin chen pad+ma'o/ /dbyug sngon can ni khro bo che/ /sku mdog de 'dra phyag drug pa/ /g.yas gnyis dbyug to ①ral gri 'dzin/ /g.yon gnyis rin chen pad+ma'o/ /stobs po che ni khro bo che/ /zhal gsum de 'dra phyag drug pa//g.yas gnyis rtse gsum ral gri 'dzin/ /g.yon gnyis rin chen pad+ma'o/ /mi g.yo mgon po khro bo che/ /zhal gsum de 'dra zur gyis lta②/ /g.yas gnyis ral gri 'khor lo 'dzin/ /g.yon gnyis rin chen pad+ma'o/ /gnod mdzes rgyal po khro bo che/ /sku dang dbu zhal de 'dra ste/ /g.yas gnyis rdo rje ral gri dang / /g.yon gnyis rin chen pad+ma'o/ /gtsug tor 'khor los spyosgyur rgyal che/ /sku dang dbu zhal gser btso 'dra/ /g.yas gnag g.yon dkar phyag drug pa/ /g.yas gnyis 'khor lo rdo rje 'dzin/ /g.yon gnyis rin chen pad+ma 'dzin/ /de dag dang pos rig ma 'khyud/ /stag lpags sham thabs dang ldan pa/ /'gying bag tu ni rab khro ba/ /mche ba cung zad gcigs pa ste/ /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan/ /pad+ma nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ /sbom po g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'o/ /me yi 'od kyi ③3dkyil 'khor nang / /'khor lo 'bar bas gtsug tor bskor/ /mi bskyod cod pan mtshan ma bsgom/ /de dag dran pa gcig pa ste/ /las kyi khyad par sgrub byed pas/ /'di ni 'khor lor ldan pa yi/ /zhar la de yi sgrub /rngu pa gsungs/ /dgug dang dbang gi dang po dang / /chos tshe rgyas mdzad mang po zhi/ /ma yin las kyi khyad par rnams—/ /dang po gnyis pas yang bya ste/ /dus kyi bye brag nges med pas/ /'grub ste dang po thun mong lung / /khyad par gzhung 'dis zlos hūṃbyas te/ /22—712

dad pas de rnams nan tan bya/ /gti mug nyes pa'i 'dod chags dang / /sgrib pa las ni rnam dag pa'i/ /rang bzhin gzung dang dga' ba dang / /tshul dang mi g.yo rgyu nyid dang / /'bras bur dag ste de rnams kyi/ /spyi yi mtshan nyid rnam dag pa/ /khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba yi/ /bsgrub pa'i mtshan nyid bshad par bya/ /gang phyir ri mo'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /gzhung du nges par gsungs pas na/ /las kyi rim pa bskang khyeba'i phyir/ /gsang ba'i thig le rgyud las gsungs/ /de phyir sgrub thabs rim pa ni/ /rdzogs par bya phyir bla mas kyang / /sgrub po rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /'dus pa'i cho gar gsungs pa yi/ /sngon bzhin thams cad rab byas la/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad rnal 'byor gnas/ /dbus zhal sku ni mthing ka la/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar phyag drug pa/ /dang pos rang gi rig ma 'khyud/ /g.yas gnyis rdo rje lcags kyu bsnams/ /g.yon gnyis pad+ma zhags pa bsnams/ /mche ba cung zad gcigs pa ste/ /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan dang ldan/ /dbu skra ser po gyen du badze+es/ /gtum po'i 3hūṃ gi nga ro sgrogs/ /stag lpags smad g.yogs dang ldan pa/ /drag po g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis/ /lha chen chung mar bcas pa yi/ /gdan kyegayon sra ba'i nu mar mnan/ /cod pan mi bskyod mtshan pa bsgom/ /de ltar bsgoms nas de yi sngags/ /hūṃ bzhi 'am der gsungs bcu bdun po/ /rtse gcig las rnams kun la ni/ /sngar bcas cho ga bzhin du bzlas/ /oṃ s+dzakro dhe hūṃ ka ra na ha na ma tha bhañdza hūṃ phaṭa/ rtsa ba'i rig pa'o/ /oṃ hri da ya hūṃ/ snying ga'o/ /oṃ ka pā la hūṃ phaṭa/ mtshog chom la'o—/ /oṃ s+dzahūṃ ka ra ke ka be ra hūṃ phaṭa/ spyi gtsug tu'o/ /oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la 22—713

li ta bī tra rmye ha hūṃ phaṭa/ go cha la'o/ /oṃ be bas swa tan+ta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ mtshon cha la'o/ /sbyor ba de yis ba dan dang / /thal ba snag tsha btsag sor gtub/ /thod byed dag gi las rnams dag /ji bzhin du ni bsgrub ⑦par bya/ /dur khrod ras la ba dan ni/ /kha dog mthing ga sor ge bcu drug /smyug ma'i yu ba khru gang la/ /btags te dur khrod gnas su bsgrub/ /de ni lag tu gzung byas nas/ /zhag bdun sngags bzlas nam langs na/ /de thogs dgra dpung la g.yabs pas/ /the tshom med par gnon par 'gyur/ /mtshon thogs bdag la gnod byed gzhan/ /sgrub pa po ni mthong tsam gyis/ /de dag mdung bzhin rengs par 'gyur/ /de bzhin glang rgyal myos pa dang / /shing rta rta dang srog chags rngam/ /rkang thang 'khrugs pa mang bcas pa mthong ba tsam gyis rengs par 'gyur/ /mtshan mo mi ro bsregs pa yi/ /gnas song skra bshig byegacer bur phyung / /bzlas pa bskor zhing rab byas nas/ /nam langs thal ba spar gang blang / /lag pa g.yon pas blangs nas ni/ /rang gi khyem du 'gre bar bya/ /yang na lha khang stong par 'gro/ /phyir ni blta snyebar mi bya'o / /de nas der yang thal ba de/ /zhag bdun sngags bzlas bsrung bar bya—/ /snod sar nang du rab bzhag ste/ /sa la gzhag 'upar mi bya'o/ /de yis gang 3gi dpung gi tshogs/ /mthong na lan cig gtor tsam gyis/ /rengs par 'dod na rengs par 'gyur/ /rlung phyogs dag tu sbyar ba na/ /ldog par 'dod na ldog par 'gyur/ /mdun du skem ste dāgator byas nas ⑨/ /myos par 'gyur —7te mtshon cha rngam/ /de kho na bzhin 'dor bar 'gyur/ /tshil chen snum la mar me ni/ /thod 11pa bzang por sbar bar bya/ /steng gi 22—714

thod par du ba bsgo/ /snag tshar byas te de blangs la/ /zhag bdun sngags bzlas nam langs na/ /du ba'i snag tsha mig la bsku/ /de yis gang mthong thams cad kun/ /ci bgyi zhes ni bka' nyan 'gyur/ /yug snam btsag ni dge ba dag /bsreg pa'i gnas 'gro khar bcug la/ /de phyed tshig pa'i dus su ni/ /grogs med par ni mtshan mo blang / /lha yi khang stong du khyer nas/ /gong gi sngags ni zhag bdun bzla/ /de tshe bgegs kyang sna tshogs 'ang lha/ /mi 'jigs 'dug sbung de la bzla/ /de nas nam langs gyur pa na/ /ras ni dmar pos dkri byas la/ /mchod cing bsrungs nas gzhag par bya/ /de yis sems dang ldan pa'am/ /mi ldan gang gi ming bris pas/ /bskul nas dogs pa med pa yang / /rdo rje 'chang ba'i bka' bzhin du/ /'ongs nas las rnams thams cad byed/ /srog song dur khrod khyer ba na/ /gser gyi sor gdub de yi khar/ /bcug nas bdag nyid gcig pu ni/ /khro bo'i sngags ni zlos shing 'dug /ro de me yis tshig 'gyur na/ /kha yi sor gdub sgrub pa po'i//lag pa g.yon pas blang kyebyas la/ /zhag bdun bar du bzla bar bya/ /de nas sor gdub bzang po de/ /lag pa g.yon pa'i mdzub mo la/ /bcug ste lag pa de yis ni/ /gang dang gang du 5reg 'gyur ba/ /de dang de yis las kun byed / /phyi bzhin du'ang rtag tu 'brang / /rten 'brel bsam gyis mi khyab papya/ /'di la dpyad par yod mi bya/ /sing ta'i shing la gab tshe yang bzang po sor ni brgyad pa bya/ /de yi nang du smrod 5bhebyed kyang / /dngos grub sbyin par byed par blugs/bye sna/ /zla ba gzas ni zin pa'i tshe/ /ma grol bar du de la bzla/ /de nas sngon bzhin 'khor lo bri/ /'byung po gtor ma sbyin byas la/ /gab tshe 22—715

nang gi tsūd byed kyang / /sgra 'byung yang na gas kyi bar/ /de srid zhag bdun de la ni/ /khro bo'i sngags kyi ⑫bzlas par rjobya/ /de tshe sgod byed grub ma thag /blangs nas gang yang rung ba ru/ /cho ga bzhin du sbyar na ni/ /de yis mi nus gcig kyang med/ /sa yang 'gas byed chu yang skems/ /rin chen phye ma bzhin du zlog /ri rtser sbyar na bsnyil 1bar byed/ /khrag dang sol ba'i sel 'be+ebs byed/ /gnam lcags dag ni 'thor ba dang / /sa g.yos ④sprin ni gtor ba dgasnye /rnal 'byor pa yis rab sbyar na/ /glo bur du ni thogs med 'grub—/ /mtsho g.yo klu rnams skrag pa dang / /shing rnams 'bras bu glo bur 'byin / /gzhan yang sgrub po ci bsam rjopa'i/ /las rnams thams cad de yis byed/ /'di ni rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi/ /sngags rgyud ldan pa'i las rnams de/ /gzhan yang de las gsungs pa yi/ /las rnams mkhas pas shes par bya da ni thun mong gi dngos grub kyi mjug tu mngag gzhug bsgrub ⑦pa'i cho ga bshad par bya'o/ /rdo rje 37bzlas gnas rnal 'byor pas/ /rang gi dgos pa rdzogs pa'i /snaphyir/ /bdag gi rigs kyi khro bo mchog /mngag gzhug pa ru bsgrub par bya/ /'dod pa'i lha yi rnal 'byor pas/ /thams cad snga ma bzhin byas la//hri ni 'od zer lnga 'bar ba/ /nam mkha'i dbus su bsam par bya/ /mkha' dbyings bde gshegs byang chub sems/ /rig pa'i lha dang khro bo'i tshogs/ /gang bar bsams nas sngags 'di yis/ /sku gsung thugs la gnas la gdab/ /oṃ s+dzahri a mo gha sernyi nan bhak+ṣa ā kār+ṣa —ya hūṃ/ phab pas gnas de rigs kyi rimatsurnga / /mi bskyod pa yi a gyur te/ /tshe dpag med pa'i khaṃ du gyur/ /rnam par snang mdzad ding gyur to/ /cho ga de la skad cig gis/ /cho ga gnyis pa 22—716

bsgrub par bya/ /a de bdud rtsi 'khyil par gyur/ /thal sbyar gzhan la sngon bzhin bsam/ /khaṃ de pad+ma mthar byed gyur/ /de ni gshin rje gshed gyur te/ /de dag sngon bzhin nyi ma la/ /gnas te dang po thal sbyar bsam/ /lha mo spangs pa'i phyag mtshan yang / /g.yas kyi tha mar dpa' bo dang / /lcags kyus bkang ba'i snod bzung nas/ /sgrub pa po la stobs byed bsgom/ /de dag gnas gsum gong ma yinakye/ /a khaṃ de ni bkod byas nas/ /de nas bskul ba la sogs pas/ /don yod grub pas dbu brgyan te/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i thugs ka ru/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /mi bskyod pa ni bsgom par bya/ /pad+ma mthar byed thugs ka ru/ /de gnas 'etshe dpag med par bsgom—/ /gshin rje gshed kyi thugs ka ru/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i—/ /rnam par snang mdzad rab tu bsgom/ /de nas rigs gsum phyag gnas pa'i/ /mdung rtse gsum dang kyo ba dang / /rdo rje dang ni gtun shing gis—/ /gsang ba'i gnas la brdab cing bskul/ /oṃ mi bskyod pa ni rdo rje mchog / khyod kyi zhe rigs kyi khro bo che/ /nga yi re ba rdzogs bya'i phyir/ / khyod kyi pyamangag gzhug pa ru bskul/ /tshe dpag med dang snang mdzad kyang / /de bzhin du ni bskul byas te/ /nyams dga' ba yi ri dag dang / /chu gling rnam pa sna tshogs su/ /bsam gtan 'di ni zla phyed bsgom/ /ri rab sum cu rtsa drug gisnye / /rab tu phra ba'i rdul snyed dang / /'khor lo can gyi byang chub 'grub—/ /des khrid sangs rgyas zhing du 'go/ /zab cing rgya che'i chos thob 'gyur—/ /de ni gnyid sogs dang bral yang / /bde gshegs kun gyis byin brlabs nas/ /gnyid 'od de ru gong gsungs pa'i/ /mtshan ma rnams ni 22—717

yang dang yang / /'byung bar 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /lha yi hūṃbaka' yis brtan par byed/ /nam mkha' chos rnams spangs pa yang / /rta dang glang chen la sogs pa/ /sgrub pa po yis bskul ba yis me/ /mngag gzhug de yis byed par 'gyur/ /gong gsungs 'og nas 'byung ba la/ /sgrub pa'i thabs ni ji snyed pa/ /nus dang ldan pas de rnams las/ /lha sogs rnams kyis khyad shes gyurathu—/ /'don po'i dang po'i gnas bzhin du/ /thams cad brjod pas lung rngo thogs/ /de bas dang po sngon 5'gro bas/ /gzhung gi don la brtan par bya/ /da ni phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs kyi cho ga rgyas par bshad par bya'o/ /sngon gsungs yang dag rim gnas la/ /dgos 5dang don byed ma gtogs 7pa/ /bya ba thams cad mchil thal bzhin/ /spangs nas rdo rje 'chang ba yi/ /sbyor ba thob phyir dus rtag tu/ /sangs rgyas mchod dang 'go don la/ /dad pas brtson 'grus kyis sbyor byed/ /thabs shes sbyor bas skyon kun bsalathu/ /thob pa'i zas ni za bar byed/ /chags pa sdang ba rnams dang bral/ /'jig rten chos brgyad ma gtogs snyepa'i/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thob bzhin spyod/ /bka' yi gzhung lugs 'jigs spangs nas/ /lus gnas pa yi chog shes te/ /bya ba gsum gyi mtha' la spyod/ /dgos pa 'grub pa des bsgrub bya/ /ci gsung mtshan ma mthong 'gyur nas/ /rang gi rigs kyi phyag rgya mchog /gong du bstan pa'i cho ga yis/ /bkug ste bdag gir bya ba'o/ /de dang lhan cig yid 'ong dgonashesna/ /rang nyid ma gtogs gzhan gyis ni/ /mi phyed gnas su zla drug tu/ /gsang ba'i brtul zhugs spyod pa bya/ /brgyud pa'i man ngag las gsungs pa'i/ /lus ngag yid kyi spyod pa'i mchog /phyag 22—718

rgya dag phyir nyin mtshan du/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug brtson par bya/ /de yis zla ba gcig gis ni/ /skal ldan gyur par lhathe tshom med/ /de dang lnga yi bar du ni/ /rjes mthun shis pa'i zas longs spyod/ /rang gi khams na rang gnas pa'i / /bde gshegs rnams kyis thugs gdungs nas/ /de ru byon nas sgrub po la/ /'phral du bka' stsal ster bar gyurathu/ /de nas bka' stsal thob 1ma thag /rang gi mthu stobs rtogs bya'i phyir/ /gong dang lhan cig zla drug tu/ /phyi yi rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyad/ /yid 'ong dbe+en par cho ga bzhin/ /'dus pa'i 'khor lo bri byas la/ /mchod pa sogs kyis mnyes byas te/ /bsod nams tshogs ni rdzogs par bya/ /de nas bdag nyid de dang ni/ /bcos ma'i gdong la sogs pas mtshan/ /yang na phyogs gos 'ba' zhig gis/ /mtshan te kun du rgyu bar bya/ /ri yi gcong rong nags tshal gnas/ /glang chen seṅge sbrul dang stag /gdug pa'i sems can 'jigs pa'i sar/ /bdag rgyu de dag rtse bar byed/ /rdo leb rgya mtshor bdag nyid 'dug /ri dwags lte ba'i dri bro ste/ /in+d+ra nī la'i kha dog 'dra/ /snum dang mig stong gdan bzhin no / /tsher mang chu mig gog ral mang / /mi sdug gnas su bdag rgyu bas/ /me tog 'bras bu bzang po dang / /dri zhim chu ni mdongs 7dang ldan/ /gzhan gsungs phyag rgya rnams kyi kyematshan/ /gar byed gla blang brkam tshig smra/ /mi shes blun pa'i gzi can rnams/ /'dul zhing lus kyi rgyu mthun pas/ /gso bar byed cing stobs mthong bas/ /nags tshal dag tu bsod snyoms babe+eng / /bsgrub 7dbang de yi gzi brjid kyis/ /nags tshal lha rnams skrag nas ni/ /kha zas bzang po ster byeb dag /sgrub pa po la rab tu sbyor/ /phun sum tshogs 22—719

pa ma sbyar na/ /dam tshig stobs kyis de rnams 'chi/ /de ltar spyi dang dngos gzhi yi/ /mtshan thob pa yi rnal 'byor pas/ /rang gi khams ni dag bya'i phyir//'og nas bshad pa'i rim pa bzhin/ /dus mtshan bzhi ru zhag bdun du/ /bsgom pa'i dbang bskur rnam dag pas/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bdag nyid can/ /'khor lo'i bdag nyid dri med bya/ /rang gi rmyes bon 'od lcags kyu/ /rtag dang sbyor ba'i spyan ma'i tshogs/ /'og min nas ni bkug byas nas/ /nam mkha'i khams kun gang bzhugs bsgom/ /de nyid bde chen ro zhu bas/ /'o ma'i rgyun ltar de dag gis bye/ /spyi bo nas ni mdun rgyab dang / /lnga stong dag ni zhugs par bya/ /de bzhin bde ba can zhing nas/ /dpag med dang sbyor gos dkar dgug /sngon bzhin bsams nas de yi dus/ /de dag rnams ni lce la gzhug /mngon dga' las byung mi bskyod dang / /mā ma kri ni gnyis med du / /de dag rnams kyi thugs ka ru/ /lnga stong bdun brgya'i bar du zhugs / /'od des kha ti ka nas kyang / /don yod grub dang sgrol ma yang / /bde chen gzhan gyi dbang gyur nas/ /lte bar de dus zhugs byas nas/ /nam mkha' lta bur de bzhin nyid/ /yang dang yang du brtson par bya/ /gang phyir de nyid yang bsgoms pas/ /dngos po dag par byed pa'i phyir/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis de nyid bsngags/ /de dang de yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /rdo rje gsum gyis mtshan pa ni/ /khyu mchog de ni mnyes par 'gyur/ /de ltar sbyor ba gsum ldan pas/ /dngos gzhi'i las la 'jug don du/ /gong gsungs las kyi phyag rgya che/ /rigs gsum bye brag gis gzung bya/ /mi bskyod rdo rje rnal 'byor pas/ /sme sha can gyi mthu chen gyi/ /bu mo lo grangs bcu drug pa/ /22—720

at+pa la yi mdog 'dra bsgrub/ /de bzhin rtag pa'i sbyor ba yi/ /btso bzlag 1mkhan gyi bu mo dkar/ /lo grangs nyi shu lnga lon pa/ /spyan ma'i ngo bor bsgrub par bya/ /tshe dpag med kyi rnal 'byor pas/ /gar mkhan bu mo rab mdzes shing / /dmar po bzhin sdug mig dkyus ring / /nyi shu lon pa gos dkar bsgrub—/ /yang na bram ze rgyal rigs dang / /rje'u rigs dmangs rigs gzhan bud med/ /gang gi rnal 'byor gyis gnas sgrub/ /de yis gsang ba'i sku gsum thob/ /'dis ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das/ /gcig pu rab tu che ba'i lha/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /lhag pa'i bya ba bya zhes bsgrub/ /chags min chags dang bral ba'ang min/ /dbu mar yang ni mi dmigs so/ /'di ni gnyis med theg pa'i mchog /bud med sgyu ma'i rgyu 'di yis/ /sgyu ma dag ni thams cad pas/ /bud med sgyu ma khyad par che/ /ngo bo nyid kyi mthu dag gis/ /rang bzhin gyis ni de 'grub pa'o/ /'jig rten gsum 'dir bud med 'dis/ /gus pa byed pa dag tu 'gyur/ /rnyed dang bde ba dga' kun gyis/ /nang —spyod rnams kyang 'grub par 'gyur/ /rang gi ngo bo yongs bsgyur nas/ /bud med kun gyi sgyu ma 'grub/ /ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i phyag rgya 'di/ /mkha' 'go ma yi brdar bstan to/ /de bas de dang lhan cig tu/ /yid 'ong gnas su sngon bzhin du/ /ri mo'i dkyil 'khor bris nas kyang / /byin brlabs la sogs sngon bzhin bya/ /de ru stegs bu gru bzhi ni/ /bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pas byug /bde ba'i stan la de dang ni/ /lhan cig sgyu 'dra'i ting 'dzin rol/ /bsrung ba la sogs rten bsgrubs la/ /dang po'i mgon pos bdag nyid bsgrub/ /gong ma rig ma'i 'du byed pas/ /rab tu bsgrubs te 22—721

pad+mar bzhag /phrin las la gnas bde chen po/ /de yis ky-isku gsum goms bya'i phyir/ /yang dang yang du nyin mtshan du/ /zla ba drug tu bsgrub par bya/ /de yis sgrub po bdag nyid kyis/ /phyi nang dus su sangs rgyas kyi 37/ /mtshan gyis brgyan par ma gyur na/ /yang ni cho ga de kho nas/ /de yi 'dod pa longs spyod cing / /gsang ba'i mchod pa dang bcas pas/ /sa bcu de la gnas bcas te/ /zla ba drug tu yang bsgrub 7 bya/ /gal te de ru sgrub pa pos/ /gong gsungs mthong bar ma gyur na/ /ji skad bshad pa'i cho ga yis/ /yang ni zla drug rab tu brtsams/ /drug gsum bco brgyad cho ga bzhin/ /bsgrub pas rdo rje gsum gyis ni/ /dngos grub ster te phyis 'byung ba'i/ /phyag rgya chen po rab tu 'thob/ /de ltar byas pa'i sgrub pa pos/ /bsgoms pas dngos grub mchog ma mthong / /snyan tshig zhi ba'i bskul ba yis/ /dngos grub bslang bar bya ba'o/ /sngon gyi 'khor lo khang pa'am/ /gzhan yang gang yang rung ba ru//bgegs bskrad phur bus btab nas su/ /sngon bzhin gtsang gtor sa gsol btab4 / /sangs rgyas la sogs snga ma bzhin/ /gsol btab 5stegs bu 'dus byas te/ /byin brlabs ting 'dzin gsum gnas la/ /skye gcig thogs bsam gsol ba gdab/ /drug cu rtsa bzhis bgegs bskrad nas/ /sa bsrungs 6sa yi lha mo yang / /mchod pa sogs kyis mnyes byas la/ /dbang por zhal gyis bzhes par bya/ /de nas me tog sna tshogs dang / /dri zhim la sogs ldan pa yi/ /maṇ+ḍal sngon bzhin 'dus byas la/ /de na gnas pa dmigs par bya/ /rang gi sa bon 'od zer las/ /be+egs kyu rdo rje gsal shing sogs/ /mtshan pa'i khro bo spro byas la/ /de dag mchod sogs kyis mnyes 22—722

bya / /sgrub pos 'og nas 'byung ba yi/ /tshigs bcad sngags kyi khyed rnams kyis / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /bskul cig ces ni smra bar bya/ /de nas zhal gyis bzhes nas ni/ /song ste 'jig rten khams gnas pa'i / /sangs rgyas sogs la 1phra mo dang / /snyan tshig 'jebs pa'i dbyangs kyis bskul༄2sna/ /che ge zhes bya rdo rje che/ /'di yi gnas su dam sdom can / /rig ma'i brtul zhugs spyod pa yis/ /tshogs ni rdzogs par 'gyur ba'o / /bsgom pa bzlas brjod yongs rdzogs nas/ /phyag rgya chen po bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa yang gnas nas/ /khyed kyis bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bri/ /khyed cag de ru byon nas su/ /de yi 'khor lo byin brlabs la/ /mchod pa la sogs bzhes nas kyang / /phyag rgya chen po gnang bar mdzod/ /de ltar brjod pas de dag kyang / /rab tu dgyes nas khro bo la//de ltar bya zhes bsams nas kyang / /lhan cig byon bsams gnas su dgod/ /khro bos sgrub pa po la smras/ /bdag cag rnams kyis gsol ba btab / /de dag kyang ni 'di skad gsungs/ /rdo rje che ge zhes bya la/ /bdag cag phyag rgya chen po bzhin/ /gsungs nas 'di ru byon pa lags/ /khyed kyis mchod pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /mnyes par byas te dam tshig bskul/ /de nas sgrub pos sangs rgyas dang / /khro rgyal lha mo mnyes bya'i phyir/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bkug nas/ /rang gi ba spu'i bu gar bcug /de nyid lha mo sgeg pas brgyan / /spros nas sangs rgyas byang chub sems/ /khro bo dang bcas 'khor lo la/ /bde ba chen po'i ros mchod pa/ /byas nas bstod la 4bdud rtsi myang / /sna tshogs kyis ni mnyes byas nas/ /srog dang bcas pa bsams nas kyang / /22—723

bdag nyid kyis ni snyan gson tsho7gsol/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag dngos grub kyi/ /dkyil 'khor bdag gis bri bar 'tshal/ /sang ni de ru byon nas kyang / /bdag gi 7mchod pa la sogs bzhes/ /bzhes nas bdag la dngos grub stsol/ /gal te ma stsal khyed rnams kun/ /rang nyid kyi rnguni bstan pa la/ /brdzun chodu smra bar gyur pa'o/ /de ltar snyan gsan lan gsum du/ /gsol nas de dag zhal bzhes nas/ /mchod pa sogs kyis mnyes par bya/ /steng gi gnas su gshegs su gsol/ /yang ni mchod pa'i bum pa rnams/ /sngon bzhin sta gon gnas byas nas/ /me tog spos la sogs pa yis/ /mchod nas ji bzhin gnas su dgod/ /de nas phyi de nyin par yang / /skud pa tshon rtsi sngon bzhin bsgrub / /gos dang rin chen rgyan ldan pa'i/ /khye'u dang bu mo dbab byas nas / /de yis dngos grub dkyil 'khor mchog /yang dag sbyin byed bris nas kyang / /dbye ba byas nas de nyid kyang / /mchod nas rang gi gnas su btang / /de nas phyag rgya dang lhan cig /'khor lo bsgrub pa'i cho ga bzhin/ /gnyis 'dres byas nas steng nas dbab/ /sngon bzhin dkyil 'khor dbyer med bya / /bdag po lnga lnga 5bzhi pa'i dus/ /bdag po gnyis pas yang mtshan bya/ /yang na de dag klad rgyas dang / /lkog ma snying ga lte ba dang / /gsang bar rgyu yi skyes bu dgod/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum las skyes/ /sgrub pa po ni blo ldan la/ /'jigs shing skrag gnas byin gyis zlob6/ /de dag gsang ba'i mchog sogs pa/ /sngon gsungs mchod pa nyi shus kyang / /mchod nas 'od zer rtse mo las/ /yid dga'i rin chen sna bdun spro/ /gser mdog lta bu'i rgyan rnams kyis/ /brgyan pa'i bde ba'i longs spyod 'dzin/ /pad+ma'i steng na gnas pa yi/ /bud 22—724

med rin chen dbul bar bya/ /gnod sbyin lta bu'i gzugs 'dzin pa/ /gos sngon bsgos pa rin chen gter/ /gzung ba'i khyem bdag rin po che/ /sgyu ma lta bus sprul pa bya/ /mche ba drug ldan glang po dkar/ /gser gyis brgyan pa spro bar bya/ /at+pal mthing ga'i 'dab 'dra'i rta/ /rin chen chas brgyan spros te dbul/ /chang zungs hūṃrin chen sna bdun gyis/ /spras pa'i ral gri rin po che—/ /'od zer dang ldan pad+ma la/ /gnas pa spros te dbul bar bya/ /lha yi gos kyis rab brgyan pa/ /'od zer sna tshogs spro ba yi/ /gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ /sbyor ba shes pas spro bar bya/ //mkha' kun gsal bar byed pa yi/ /'od zer mtha' yas rab spro ba/ /blon po rin chen spros nas kyang / /de dag phyir rgol brgyan par bsgom/ /de ltar lha sogs bu mo dang / /rig sde 'dzin rnams kyis bsgyur ba yi/ /glu dang gar dang gling bu dang / /dung dang rdza rnga la sogs pas/ /nam mkha'i khams kun g.yos par bsgom/ /shin tu zhi ba'i sgra sgrogs pa'i/ /khu byug bung ba ngang pa sogs/ /mdangs dga' rnams kyis gang bar bsam/ /me tog shing gis mtha' brgyan pa'i/ /mdzes pa'i rdzing bu sna tshogs dang / /dpag bsam shing gi nags tshal ni/ /'khor lo'i phyogs bzhi nas 'byung ngo / /de bzhin bza' bca' kha zas dkar/ /tshal dang theg pa gdan rnams dang / /myos byed btung ba'i tshogs rnams kyang //'khor lo mnyes phyir spro bar bya/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i chos nyid la/ /chos kyi dbyings ni gnas med de/ /rdo rje las byung rtog pa ni/ /gsungs pa nyid kyang ma grub po/ /de ltar sna tshogs mchod pa yis4/ /mnyes byas sngon bzhin rang nyid zhugs/ /bdag po nga rgyal dang ldan par/ /'khor lo bdag la 22—725

zhugs byas te/ /dga' ba'i ye shes rab kyeganas nas/ /zhag bdun sogs par yang du brtag /de ltar de ru phyag rgya che/ /ji skad gsungs pa thob par 'gyur / /de ltar byas kyang phyag rgya che/ /sgrub pos kyang ni thob ma gyur/ /sngon bzhin nyams pa sna tshogs dang / /dbye ba'i sgo nas bsgrub par bya/ /rang gi 'dod bzhin gsol btab nas/ /bris pa'i 'khor lo gshegs su gsol//smon lam rnams ni byas nas su/ /byang chub chen por bsngo bar bya/ /rtog pa las byung ji snyed pa/ /rje btsun rnams kyi spyan sngar bshags/ /ci ldu/bzhin byin kyis brlabs byas nas/ /rang gi rjes su mthun pas bsgrub/ /'khor lo gang dang gang bstan pa/ /sna tshogs phyag rgya mchod pa yis kye/ /slob ma'i tshogs kun de dang des/ /mchod pa byas nas de bsgrub po/ /rang gi 'khor lo tshogs ldan pa'i/ /rang gi bla ma la sogs gzhan/ /yid dga' gnas su spyan drangs nas/ /dngos grub rnam par 'phrul 'di bya/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i lha rnams mchog /rin chen sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ /dril bu rgyal mtshan mchod sogs ldan/ /bla re dam pa byes pa ru/ /rdo rje sngags dang mchod la sogs / /glu dang sel snyan rnam par 'bul/ /me tog bdug sogs rab spyor bas/ /dag pa'i gdan chen bsham par bya/ /der ni de dag thams cad kun / /ji lta'i gnas su ji bzhin 'dug /bskal bzang rang gi phyag rgya dang / /dngos grub phyir ni rnam par rol/ /sha dang chang la sogs pa yi/ /bza' bca' btung ba'i tshogs rnams dang / /lus dang ngag gi spyod pa yis/ /de kun mnyes par bya dgos so/ /de bzhin phyogs skyong la sogs kun/ /gzhan bzhin 'khor lor bsgrub byas la/ /gong gsungs gtor ma'i tshogs 22—726

rnams kyis/ /de dag tshim par yang bya'o/ /sgyu 'dra'i ting 'dzin lha rnams dmigs—/ /'khor lo yang dang yang du mchod/ /bla mas tūmadun du bzhag nas ni/ /nyams par dogs pa thams cad bsal/ /de ltar goms 2/pa brtan bya zhing / /ma nyams skyon med spyod par ldan/ /mchog gi dngos grub lam la gnas/ /dam pa'i rig ma ma 'khrul pas/ /zhag bdun dang ni zla phyed dang / /zla gcig zla ba phyed dang gnyis/ /rdo rje dam tshig bskyed byas nas—/ /myur du dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /de ltar yang dang yang bsgoms pas/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi dngos grub mchog /mi 'grub 'khrul pa'i rgyu yis ni/ /sgrub pa po la bkag gyur na/ /de nyid du ni sgrub pa pos/ /go skabs gzhan ni med pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje che ba'i gsang ba kun/ /de la khros par rig pa yin/ /rtog pa'i dbang gis de dag rnams/ /rang rang tshogs dang rang khams dang / /sgrub pa po la mi gzigs te/ /btang snyoms chen por gnas pa'o/ /bka' yis 'jigs med 'khrul bsal dang / /thub pas spyan ras gzigs bya'i phyir/ /dam pa'i gzhung las gsungs pa ltar/ /de dag rnams kyi snying po bskul/ /bdag dang 'khor la dmigs byas nas/ /de dag rnams kyi spyi bo dang / /mgrin pa de 'og thugs ka ru/ /sngon bzhin phyag rgya bzhi'i 4rgyas gdab/ /de bzhin phra mo'i 'khor lo la/ /sa bon sogs pas yang mtshan te/ /de nyid brjod pas de dag las/ /de dag rnams ni spro bar bya/ /spros te mdun du rab g.yeng ba'i/ /shing rta de dag bka' nod pa/ / gnas shing 5khros pa bsam byas te/ /sgrub pos de la bka' yis bsgo/ /nga ni dpal ldan che ge mo/ /khyod kyi rtag tu bsgrub la gnas/ /dam sdom lam la 22—727

rtag brtson pas/ /bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ shrī ban tsakra saṃ gu sha ga te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad hri da ya tsun+de ā kār+ṣa 7ya phaṭa dza/oṃ shrī ban pad+ma e gu sha ga te/ gong gi bsgrub bya hri da ya tsun+de ā kār+ṣa pya ya phaṭa dza/ oṃ shrī ban kharga saṃ gu sha ga te/ bsgrub bya hri da ya tsun+de ā kār+ṣa ya spyophaṭa dza/ oṃ shrī ban badz+ra saṃ zigu sha ga te/ bsgrub bya tsun+de ā kār+ṣa ④ ya phaṭa dza/rin chen la sogs rang sngags kyis/ /rang rang mtshan mas mtshan pa yi/ /ye shes sems dpa' la sogs pa/ /de dag kun tu spro bar bya/ /spros te phyogs bcur song nas kyang / /rang gi zhing na gnas pa yi/ /bde gshegs rigs bcas btang snyoms gnas/ /lcags kyu thugs kar brdeg cing bskul/ /che ge zhes bya rdo rje la/ /khyed kyis dngos grub dam pa sprul/ /gal te ma stsal khyed rnams brdzunagye/ /smras pas rang nyid bslus pa'o/ /de bzhin lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang / /sku yi bu ga kun nas kyang / /de 'dra bsam kyis mi khyab pa/ /'phros pa'i mtshan ma rnams kyis bskul/ /mi gzigs mngon par gyur pa'i don//thabs de zhag bdun bar du bya/ /de yis rgyu kun rdzogs pas na/ /de dag rnal 'byor pa la 'jug /de yi 'og 'byung mchog bzhi'o⑦/ /rdo rje tshul mchog 'di brtsams pas/ /ye shes rdo rje can gyi 8snagasang / /mchog stsol zhing ni rnam par gzigs/ /yid ni 'jigs shing skrag gyur la nas/ /yid la mgu zhing dgar 'gyur ba'i/ /dngos grub dam pa de dus te/ /de la rol mo 'byung ba'o/ /gal te gnyis kyi bdag nyid rmongs/ /de yi srog ni der zad 'gyur / /de yis sngon du ma byas na/ /de dag chad pas gcad bye par bya/ /rang nyid 'khor lor bcas pa khros/ /nag po ske dpung dkyil na bzhugs/ /22—728

bsnyen pa la sogs dang ldan pas/ /phyag rgya lhan cig gnyis med bya/ /sngon gsungs 'phros pa rnams kyis kyang / /rang khams gnas pa'i rtag pa sogs/ /rang rang kha dog dang ldan pa/ /lcags kyus bkug par byas nas su/ /phyag rgya'i gsang bar nyi ma'i steng / /me yi dkyil 'khor gru gsum du/ /bzhag ste de dag dam tshig gis/ /bsnyengs pas 'dar bar bsam pa'o/ /de nas rang gi rigs can nyid/ /nyi ma bye ba phrag brgya'i 'od/ /ldan pa'i pad+ma kha bye ba'i//nang du bcug nas phan tshun dkri/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs 'byung gnas2//gshin rje mthar byed stod sngon bzhin/ /'od ldan smad ni rtse gcig gzugs/ /rdo rje las ni dbyung bar bya/ /de yis de dag rtag pa yidu / /spyi bo nas ni sngags 'di yis/ /btab pas rlung gis thal ba ltar/ /sngags kyi lus ni mi snang byas/ /oṃ spyon+ta khyurnyake // ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ dīp+ta byabadz+ra tsakra hūṃ phaṭa/ de bzhin pad+ma'i rigs 'byung ba'i/ /pad+ma mthar byed spros nas kyang / /sngon bzhin snang ba mtha' yas kyisnye/ /kha ru sngags 'dis gdab par bya / /oṃ tweḥ67phur pa hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje rigs las byung ba yi/ /shes rab mthar byed de bzhin spro/ /de yis mi bskyod thugs ka ru/ /sngags 'di yis ni gdab pa'o/ /oṃ snyapebadz+ra ra tsa hūṃ phaṭa/ yi ge gsum gyi bar bcug pa'i/ /sngags 'di bskul nas de yis btabapo/ /rtog pa las byung ji snyed pa/ /bsal bas shes bya'i sgrib sogs bcom/ /tata ku la na shwa shī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/btab pa tsam gyis rdo rje gsum/ /sku gsum dri med las byung ba'i/ /dam tshig mchog gis ldang bar 'gyur/ /yang na 'chi ba'i gnas su 'gyur/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /cho ga legs par byas nas ni/ /mkha' 22—729

dbyings rdo rje mtha' klas par/ /'debs par gyur pa gdon mi za/ /bsgrub bya de dag zhi ba'i phyir/ /bsdu dang spro ba'i sgo nas kyang / /phur bu sngags kyis phyung nas ni/ /ye shes tsam du gnas par bya/ /oṃ s+dzabadz+ra dha ro ādzñā ud 1/khri la ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dha ro ādzñā ud dukri la ya hūṃ/ oṃ āḥsarba kri la ya ka na budha du sa te na badz+ra di ta a badz+ra ya hūṃ/ oṃ āḥsarba tī la ya ka na dhas+thā sa te badz+ra di ta a badz+ra ya hūṃ/ oṃ āḥsarba tī la ya ka na saṃ gha sa te na badz+ra di ta a badz+ra ya hūṃ/ye shes mar me lta bu'i tshul/ /rang gi mi shes dbyer med byas/ /dbugs 'byen mchog dang lhan cig tu/ /cho ga 'di ni ma lus brtsam/ /dpung brkyang mgul pa nas 'khyud pas/ /mi g.yo skra bzung brla gnyis bar/ /bltas te sing sgra'i glu blangs nas/ /bung ba lta bur rtse bar bya/ /'gying bag stabs kyis 'khyud nas ni/ /g.yon gyi sgospyi bo nas bzung nas/ /g.yas kyi ko sko snyebasten nas ni/ /ma mchu sbrang rtsi gzhib 4par bya/ /gzhib 3cing sid ces rab brjod pas/ /'gram gnyis su ni 'o bya zhing / /dpung pa'i bar du rab byas la/ /kha yis de la rtse bar bya/ /rna ba de bzhin mchan khung dang / /mgrin pa'i glo dang sum mdo rnams/ /sen mos re mos gdab bya zhing / /yang dang yang du byug par bya/ /g.yon kyis pad+ma mnye ba dang / /lag gnyis spyor ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rdo rje g.yon kyis sor mo gsum/ /chos 'byung nang du brud cing rtse/ /bsnyen dang nyer bsgrub sgrub pa yis/ /'di ltar bskyod pa tsam gyis ni/ /snying 'dar dran pa nyams par 'gyur/ /spyi bo skra bkrol gos 'dor byed/ /dngul na chu thigs pas kun du khyab/ /brtan pa'i ngang tshul shor nas ni/ /ba sru rnams kyang g.yo bar byed/ /dmar ba'i mig ni phra 22—730

bas blta/ /bdag nyid bsgrub pa la gnas na/ /zla ba lta bu'i rigs can 'char—/ /rtse gcig yid kyis ma spros par/ /yang dang yang du brtag par bya//mkha' 'gro ma gtogs phyag rgya yis/ /lhan cig dus ni bdun du brtag /byin brlabs de'am de sngon du/ /mngon du byed par the tshom med/ /rdo rje nyi ma nub nas ni/ /bsgrub ①pa kun du brtsam par bya/ /nyi ma bdun gyis rngu 'grub 'gyur ba/ /skya rengs 'char ba'i dus na'o/ /de ru sangs rgyas kun kyi bdag /rdo rje 'chang chen kun kyi gnas/ /chos rnams kun gyi chos nyid de/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thabs byas thob/ /de ni sgu gsum mchog sbyin pa/ /sangs rgyas mtshan gyis mtshan par 'gyur/ /dpag tshad bye ba'i tshad tsam du/ /de yi 'od kyang snang bar byed/ /de nyid yang dag ye shes thob/ /gzugs brnyan bdag nyid spyi gzugs kyis/ /'khor lo gsum po mtha' yas khams/ /'gro ba'i phan don mdzad pa'o/ /'khor ba ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /sbyor ba bdun ldan rdo rje sems/ /ro myang mtshan nyid brgyan brnyes nas/ /bla na med par gyur pa'o/ /rnal 'byor pa rnam pa gnyis kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i cho ga rgyas par bshad zin to// //gang phyir rgyu dang bcas pa yis / /dngos po de dag ngo bo ni/ /byang chub sems yin de yi phyir/ /de yi rang bzhin brjod par rigs/ /thog dang tha ma med zhi ba/ /dngos po dngos med zad pa'i gtso/ /stong nyid snying rje mi phyed pa/ /byang chub sems su gsungs pa'o/ /byang chub sems de'i nang du ni/ /bdag po 'ga' yang mi dmigs so/ /de yi gnyen po rnam gsum la/ /tha dad dbye bar rnam par rtog /de yang rang 22—731

bzhin la mi dmigs/ /'od gsal sems ni dag pa la/ /gcig dang du ma bral ba'i phyir/ /don gzhan 'gyur ba yang mi dmigs/ /sgyu ma tsam gyi sems de ni/ /dag dang ma dag gnyis mi rung / /de bas rang bzhin rnam dag pa'i/ /byang chub sems su nges pa'o/ /de yi de bzhin nyid ngo bo/ /gang dang 'byel pa ma yin no/ /ma 'byel pa yang ma yin no/ /kun rtog yang ni snyam mi sems/ /nam mkha' rtag med bltar 7mi snang / /chos rnams kun kyang de bzhin no/ /chos rnams sku gsum mnyam pa ste/ /gang yin sems kyi ngo bo'o/ /sems de de bzhin nyid gnas la/ /de ni khams gsum gnas ma yin/ /mi gnas de ni kun brtags kyi/ /skye med ngo bo med pa'o/ /yin yang bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ /ye shes 'byung ba'i rgyu nyid de/ /rgyu gsum mi gnas chos de ni/ /skye med ye shes 'byung ba'i gnas / /sad dang rmi lam dbyer med pas/ /'das pa rmi lam lta bu ste//da ltar byung 2ba rmi lam 'dra/ /ma 'ongs rmi lam las byung ba'o/ /bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' dang / /sems can rnams ni ji snyed pa/ /rmi lam lta bur bdag med de/ /sgyu ma lta bur de bzhin no/ /dper na yid bzhin rin po che/ /rtog pa thams cad rab bral yang / /skal ba ldan pa'i sems dbang gis/ /'dod pa thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin byang chub sems de las/ /chos rnams thams cad 'byung bas na/ /nam mkha' rjes 'brang chos rnams la/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams rjes su 'brang / /de bas dngos grub thams cad dang / /sangs rgyas chos rnams thams cad kyi 1/ /lus dang ngag dang sems la gnas/ /de ni khams gsum mi gnas so/ /nam 22—732

mkha' bzhin du dag pa'i phyir/ /de bzhin gcig la gcig mi gnas/ /de dag de bzhin nyid gnas pas/ /de ni smra brjod yul las 'das/ /de 'dra'i de bzhin nyid la ni/ /rang gi ye shes rab sbyor zhing / /gzhan yang bdag po 'di snyam du/ /sku mi 'gyur ba 'di snyam du/ /gsung dang thugs kyi bdag nyid med/ /nam mkha' rdo rje rtog las byung / /log pa dag tu 'dzin snyam nas / /bdag gcig ston pa mi gsung bzhugs/ /de nas 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sogs/ /de yi gnyis pa dgag pa'i phyir/ /bde bar gshegs la yang zhus pa/ /gsung la log 'byung mi brtag 1gsol/ /ci phyir sngon gyi rgyal ba ltar/ /rdo rje 'chang bas mdzad par rigs/ /yod de tshangs pa la sogs pa//yang dag mngon shes ma thob pas/ /kun rdzob rgyun la 'khrul pas na/ /bdag po 'di yis shes nas sam/ /yang na mi sems 'chad do sems/ /de bas log 'byung bkag pa'o/ /skye med rdo rje mngon byang chub/ /ngo bo med pa mi 'gyur ba/ /bde gshegs rnams kyis kyang mi shes/ /des ni sems can kun la khyab/ /des na de dag thams cad kun/ /byang chub rdo rje'i gnas thob pas//sangs rgyas rdo rje rdzu 'phrul che/ /de blangs de ni thob pa'o/ /de bas chos 'di thams cad kun/ /ngo bo nyid bdag ༄ snaganas med la/ /chos dbyings shes rab gnas su rtog /rdo rje las byung ltar smras pa / /smra ste smra ba yang ma yin//sngon bzhin thams cad mkha' la gnas/ /nam mkha' gang du mi gnas pas/ /de ni rang bzhin 'od gsal dbyings/ /de ru yang dag kun rdzob rgyan/ /dbyer med pa yis rnam par bsgom/ /de ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /byang chub sems ni bsgom pa'o/ /de ltar byang chub sems bsgom pas/ /rnam dag 2 2—733

gsang ba'i yi ge gsum/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa'i sku/ /dad pa'i 'bras bu rdzogs par 'gyur/ /gang phyir bud med skyes pa dang / /ma ning gsal byed thams cad ni/ /yi ge gsum sdud k+ṇide yi phyir/ /de ni kun gyi gtso bo'o/ /dngos po gzugs can thams cad dang / /sgra grag 3pa ni ji snyed dang / /bsam rtog ma lus thams cad kun/ /rdo rje gsum gyi ༷ sdud pa'o/ /de 'dra'i de nyid gsum pos ni/ /kun khyab gzhan gyi spyod yul min/ /nyag gcig rtogs pa'i spyod yul pas/ /de ni gsang ba'i yi ge'o/ /de bas rdzogs ldan la sogs par/ /de ni snod ni ma gzigs pas/ /rdo rje 'chang ba de yi tshe/ /de 'gyur gsang ba'i don ma bshad/ /pha rol phyin pa la sogs pas/ /bskal par 'bad kyang mi brnyes pa/ /gsang ba'i don 'dis tshe 'di la/ /skad cig thang cig yud tsam gyis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub che/ /sku gsum dbyer med sangs rgyas mchog /rdo rje 'chang ba kun gyi gnas/ /bla na med pa des 'gyur ro/ /gong gsungs sems can de dag kun/ /'di yi snod sgom yin thos nas/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /snying rje de/gar kyis de dag dus/ /don de zab mor bstan pa'i phyir/ /gsang ba'i yi ge rnam dag pas/ /thun mong gi ni sdug bsngal te/ /de bas bde gshegs rnams kyis bkag /dus 'dir bdag cag snod du gyur/ /de yi chos nyid nyer sgo blangs pas/ /sku gsum rdo rje'i chos nyid de/ /'ga' 'gas rtogs par 'gyur ba'o/ /de ltar bstan pa'i dngos po rnams/ /rnam pa bzhi ru yang dag dbye / /skyes bu lam dang de sngon 'gro/ /lam gyis bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /skyes bu gsum de 3dang po dang / /cung zad tsam dang ye shes thob/ /bsnyen 22—734

pa thun mong cig shos kyi/ /bsgrub la 'jug pa'i skyes bu'o/ /rdo rje can gyis bstan pa yi/ /lam gyi rim pa rnam gnyis te/ /bskyed pa yi ni rim pa dang / /rdzogs pa'i rim pa kho na'o/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa bsnyen pa dang / /thun mong thun min sgrub snepa la/ /snod dag skye ba'i rim pa gsum/ /bsgom pa'i rim pa ji snyed pa'o/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa rnal 'byor dang / /phyag rgya las skyes chos thams cad/ /sgyu ma la sogs 'drar bsgrub pa/ /rang bzhin gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de yi sngon 'gro rnam gsum ste/ /dkyil 'khor dang ni dam tshig dang / /de yi bhe bsgrub pa'i ngo bo nyid1/ /rdo rje 'chang bas rab tu gsungs/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi ste ri mo dang / /lus dang byang sems bha ga ste/ /ye shes lnga la sogs pa yi/ /thob byed gnas su yang dag bshad/ /dam tshig la ni rnam gnyis te/ /thun mong sdom par bstan pa dang / /thun mong ma yin sdom pa'o/ /thun mong ma yin rnam gsum ste/ /spang ba'i dam tshig sdom pa dang / /bza' dang bsrung ba'i dam tshig dang / /rnal 'byor snying po sdom pa ste/ /snod sogs rkyen du yang dag bshad/ /dbang gi rnam pa gsum dag ste/ /bum pa'i dbang gi dang po dang / /gnyis pa la ni gsang ba'i dbang / /shes rab ye shes gsum pa'o/ /de ltar de bzhin bzhi pa yang / /bla ma dam pa'i zhal las ni / /thob pa yin te rnam pa gsum/ /kun la rab tu khyab pa'o/ /'bras bu la ni rnam gnyis te/ /thun mong gi ni grub pa dang / /phyag rgya chen po'i grub pa'o/ /thun mong grub pa rnam pa brgyad/ /rig 3'dzin mngon par shes pa lnga/ /mngag gzhug sngags kyi khyad par dang / /a dza las kyi dbye ba'o/ /cig shos rdo rje gsum yin te/ /de dang de ru rab bstan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas 22—735

nyid grub dngos grub ni/ /yang dag ye shes dbang thob pa'o/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud rnams kun/ /tshul 'di las ni ma 'das pas/ /shes rab ldan pa rnams kyis kyang / /'di rnams kho na bsgre bar bya / /rmyegasang dang rab gsang shin tu gsang / /zugasang ba 'dus pa zhes bya'i rgyud/ /phra zhing shes dka' bde gshegs rnams kyi yul 'di rtog bral dpyad las 'das/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi bla med thugs rje nyi zer gyis/ /bskal par 'dus byas pa yi mun pa kun bsal bde gshegs spyod yul bstan/ /bdag gis cung zad rtogs nas dang po krogs mchog bzang po gsang ba dang / /ko sa la yi gogs mchog dri med pa yi bzang po zhes bya dang / /shes rab lha zhes bya ba'i grogs mchog pañtsa —la yi dur khrod gnas/ /legs pa'i tshul mang shri na len+d+ra jeyi gtsug lag khang gnas te/ /dge ba'i spun gyis gsol btab rgyud kyi rgyal po de la blo dman pas/ /tshogs ni chung ngus rtogs par bya phyir nga rgyal ma yin dad pa yis/ /bsnyus pa'i don dang sgrub pa'i thabs 'di 'bad pas sems khral cher byas la/ /sangs rgyas la sogs dpa' bo mkhas pa rnams kyis bdag la bzod par mdzod / /chode ltar byas pa las byung dge ba dri med de yis 'gro ba rnams/ /'di gzhung rim pas tshogs ni rab rdzogs rig sna'adzin la sogs gsum kyis ni/ /tha mal pa yi skad cig sogs bsgres de 'gag de yis bzlog bya ste—/ /rang gi phyag rgyas rdo rje 'chang ba thob nas bdud las rgyal gyur cig /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa sgrub pa'i thabs dngos grub 'byung ba'i gter zhes bya ba/slob dpon chen po bi ta pā das mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la gu h+ya 3dang / bod kyi lo tsā — ba lha btsan po 22—736
