0778sngag /sbyor ba bdun pa zhes bya ba dbang bzhi'i rab tu byed pa/rmye༄gye/ /rgya gar skad du/ yo ga sap+ta nā ma tsa tu ra bhi ṣe ka ra ṇa/bod skad du/ spyor ba bdun pa zhes bya ba dbang bzhi'i rab tu byed pa/thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig dpe med tshul ldan pa/ /gnyis med bde chen rang bzhin med/ /thugs rjes rgyas shing bar chad med/ /'gog med sangs rgyas de la 'dud/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu kun khyab pa/ /gang gi snying gi pad dbus su/ /mi shigs thig le dbus gnas pa/ /gzhom med chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de 'dra rab tu ston byed pa/ /sems ni de nyid la bzhag pa//g.yang sa'i lam sgrol dge 'dun che/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /lam gyi rim pa sngon 'gro ba/ /dkyil 'khor dam tshig dbang sogs te/ /bum pa la sogs rim pa yis/ /dbang gi dbye ba cung zad brjod/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs rim pa snyeyis/ /thar chen yang dag slu ba ste/ /de nyid med pas mi 22—750

'grub pas/ /bzhi pa'i don ni yang dag bshad/ /thams cad mkhyen pas ji skad du/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud bstan la/ /dbang ni rnam pa gsum dag tu—/ /rgyud 'di las ni rab tu bshad/ /bum pa'i dbang ni dang po ste/ /gnyis pa la ni gsang ba'i dbang / /gsum pa shes rab ye shes dbang / /de ltar de bzhin bzhi pa yang / /bla ma'i bka' las shes par bya/ /dbang ni dang po dbye ba yang / /cung zad kyang ni bshad bya ste/ /rgyu yi slob dpon chen po yis/ /de ni yang dag bskur bar 'dod/ /yul mkhar khyim dang glang po sogs—/ /rjes mthun de la dbul bar bya/ /de yi thun mong gzhan pa yi/ /sdom pa snod du rung phyir sbyin/ /ri mo dang ni lus kyi ni/ /dkyil 'khor du ni de nyid thob/ /rig dang 'di rgyu slob dpon dbang / /cho ga'i rim pa bzhin lhadu bshad/ /de yi rang gi ngo bo ni/ /sgu yi rdo rje'i rang bzhin no/ /srog gcod la sogs snga phyi yi/ /dag dang nyes par mi 'gyur ro/ /thabs kyis khyad par 'phags pa'i phyir/ /sa brgyad pa ru yang dag bshad/ /spyor gsum yan lag bcas pa ru/ /de la yang dag bstan par bya/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i yul rnams kyi5/ /snang srid dbe+en par rtogs pa'o/ /snod du rung phyir bum pa ste/ /blugs gtor dag par byed pas dbang / /'di ni yang dag rgyu rim pa'i/ /lung gis nges par bshad pa'o/ /dang po'i dbye ba bstan nas ni/ /gnyis pa yang ni bshad bya ste/ /rgyu dang rkyen gyi slob dpon gyis/ /dbang bskur de ni yang dag thob/ /gser dang dngul la sogs pa yi/ /rjes mthun de la dbul bar bya/ /srog gcod la sogs thun mong ba'i/ /sdom pa snod du rung phyir sbyin/ /lhag pa byang sems zhes bya ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor du ni de 22—751

nyid thob/ /blo yi bye brag gis bskur ba'i/ /cho ga'i rim pa bzhin tudu bshad//de yi rang gi ngo bo ni/ /gsung gi rdo rje'i rang bzhin no/ /brdzun ldul sogs pa snga phyi yi/ /ngag dang nyen —7par mi 'gyur ro/ /thabs kyis rab tu phye ba'i phyir/ /dgu dang bcu la yang dag gnas/ /rdo rje bzlas pa'i ngo bo yis/ /sgyu 'dra'i ting 'dzin bstan par bya/ /mig sogs nang gi chos rnams kyi/ /snang srid dben par rtogs pa'o/ /bsgrags min phyir na gsang ba ste/ /blugs gtor dag par byed pas dbang / /'di yang brgyud pa'i rim pa yi/ /lung gis yang dag bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa'i dbye ba bstan nas su/ /gsum pa yang ni bstan par bya/ /rgyu dang rkyen dang lhan cig byed/ /slob dpon gsum gyis thob pa'o/ /pad+ma rā ga pur sha sogs/ /rjes mthun de la dbul bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba la sogs 'gog /sdom pa mchog ni sbyin pa'o/ /bha ga rnam dag ces bya yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni de nyid thob/ /shes rab dbang dang ye shes dbang / /cho ga'i rim pa gzhan du bshad/ /de yi rang gi ngo bo ni/ /thugs kyi rdo rje'i rang bzhin no/ /brnab sems la sogs snga phyi yi/ /ngag dang nye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /thabs kyi khyad par phye ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje lta bur yang dag gnas/ /mchog gi dngos grub sgrub ④pa'i phyir/ /brtul zhugs cho ga de la bstan/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i ngo bo yis/ /chos kun dbe+en par rtogs 5pa'o/ /shes rab las kyi hūṃye shes te/ /ma rtogs rtogs phyir dbang yin no/ /'di yang brgyud pa'i rim pa yi/ / lung gis kluyang dag bshad pa'o//da ni yang dag bshad bya ba/ /bzhi pa mngon par byang chub pa/ /bla ma'i zhal nas nges thob pa/ /sbyor ba bdun gyi de nyid bshad/ /rang bzhin gnas phyir 22—752

slob dpon med/ /rin thang med phyir yon med de/ /sdom pa pas ni sdom pa med / /de nyid dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor med/ /stobs kyis thob phyir dbang med de/ /spyi pas rang gi ngo bo med/ /chos kun gnyen po gnyen po med / /rdo rje 'dzin gnas sa med de/ /rang bzhin med phyir cho ga dang / /lta ba nges tshig med pa ru/ /bla ma yis ni yang dag bshad/ /shes rab las skyes ye shes ni/ /bzhi pa yin par shes par bya/ /mkha' gnyis rab tu sbyor ba yis/ /man ngag tu ni de nyid brtag /legs par goms pa'i phyag rgya las/ /'bad pa'i bya bas rtogs pa lkun/ /'dod chags chags bral bar ma ste/ /sbyor ba bdun gyi mtshan nyid do/ /nam mkha'i khams ni rdo rje sbyor/ /yang dag spyan can bde chen 'byung / /gang gang yang dag dga' byed chags/ /dga' gnyis rab tu dbe+en nyid mthong / /pad+ma'i dkyil du rdo rje nor/ /pad snying la ni 'byor pa ste/ /rdo rje'i skyil mo krung nang sems/ /nor bu rab tu kyemathong byas pas/ /gang de nyid ni ye shes te/ /'di nyid rdzogs pa'i rim pa ru / /bla ma'i zhal snga nas kyis bshad/ /de la sbyor ba bdun gyis ni/ /rim pa bzhin ④pa shes par bya/ /ci lta zhe na/ legs par bsgoms dang lhan cig tu/ /ji skad bshad pa'i cho ga yis/ /nang nas 'khor lo gsal bya ste/ /sor mo cung zad go byas te/ /snying 'dar dran pa nyams pa dang / /spyi bor skra grol gos kyang 'dor/ /rngul chu thigs pas lus kun khyab/ /brtan pa'i ngang tshul shor nas ni/ /rang gi ba sru kun kyang g.yo/ /mig dmar phra bas rab bltas pa'i/ /dga' ba'i ye shes yang dag 'byung / /rtag pa'i mdog gis yang dag brgyan/ /de ni dpe med bde rdzogs so/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i sku la 22—753

ni—/ /mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ /'ja' tshon lta bur rab gsal ba—/ /gsal ba nyid ni snye1ma skyes pa'i/ /sku chen dang du blangs gyur na/ /chos kyi sku dang sprul sku yang / /stobs kyis 'byung bar 'gyur ba'o/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po yi/ /sku che blta bas mi ngoms pa'i/ /zhal gsum phyag drug ltar snang ba/ /mchog kun ldan pas rig mas 'khyud/ /shes rab ye shes dbang dus su/ /mtshan nyid de yi tshul du gnas/ /ye shes dbang du gyur pa yis/ /brtul zhugs la sogs rim pa yis/ /gnas nas de yi don sgrub 2tshe/ /de yi dus su de 'thob pa'o/ /dpe med bde rdzogs kyi le'u ste dang po'o// //da ni rab tu bshad bya ba/ /dpe med bde rdzogs sku de yang / /pha rol phyin pa'i rdzogs sku las/ /khyad par mthong bar bya ba'i phyir/ /rang 'od rig ma dang ldan pas/ /spyor ba gnyis pa bshad par bya/ /gnyis med dang bral sku de ni/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa tsam yin la/ /de dang mnyam pa dag pa'i phyir / /rang gi rig mas 'khyud pa'o/ /de la gnyis kyi spros med pas/ /dngos po kun la ma zin pa'i/ /rgyu ni de la yod pa'o/ /de 'dra ma yin 'di la ni/ /gnyis su 1med pa dang ldan pa'o/ /'dod chags chen po'i bde ba yis—/ /'dod pa'i 'bras chan 7rab spyin pas/ /de bas rgyud chen 'di las ni / /spyor ba 'di ni bshad pa yin75/ /ye shes dang ni chos nyid dang / /don dam dang ni kun rdzob dang / /thabs chen dang ni shes rab dang gye/ /bde ba dang ni byang sems sogs/ /de ltar gnyis kyi rnam pa kun/ /dbyer 22—754

med mtshon phyir gnyis med de/ /sgyu ma'i skyes bu bud med las/ /shes rab ye shes dbang dus su/ /dga' ba'i ye shes dus su ni/ /khyad par gnyis med rang 'byung ba/ /gnyis su med par de la bshad/ /rnal 'byor gsum pas brtul zhugs kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshe ni de bzhin du/ /gnyis med 'gyur bar 'gyur ba ru/ /nges pa nyid du bshad pa yin/ /gnyis su med pa'i spyor ba ste gnyis pa'o// //da ni rab tu bshad bya ba/ /dga' ba bar ma'i ye shes mchog /chos skur yang dag nges pa yi/ /lus sems gnyis med byed bshad pa/ /bde ba de di ma lus kyis gye/ /sems can kun la gnas gyur kyang / /de las 'di ni khyad mthong phyir/ /chen po ru ni rab tu 'dod/ /rgyas pa dang ni sim pa dang / /nyon mongs med dang bar chad med/ /khyab cing 'gog pa yod med par/ /ji srid 'khor ba gnas kyi bar/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa'i tshul gyis su/ /de nyid du ni rab tu 'jug /de 'dra'i bde chen khyad par ni/ /shes rab ye shes la yang med/ /legs goms phyag rgya rtogs pa dang / /mi rtag zhing ni nyon mongs dang / /rdo rje pad+ma bskyod dus su/ /rdul ni tsha ba drag pa dang / /kun la ma khyab phyir dang ni/ /lus kun la ni ma rgyas dang / /nor bu tsam la gnas pas kyedang / /yud tsam gyis ni 'gog pa ste/ /de phyir chen po zhes mi bya / /'on kyang shes rab ye shes la/ /bde chen mtshan nyid gzugs su gnas—/ /de bas legs goms phyag rgya las/ /u durtswa d+ngha ra'i me tog ltar/ /rlung dang rang gi bya ba yis/ /skyes bu gang la thang cig tu/ /bde ba de nyid rdo 22—755

rje ru/ /'dug byas 'dar ba'i dus su ni/ /skyes bu de yis rab tu brtag /mi gnas kyang ni mi slu'i tshophyir/ /bde ba chen po zhes su bshad/ /'di ni dngos po thams cad kyis/ /mtha' yi de bzhin nyid yin par/ /bla ma mchog rnams kun gyis bshad/ /sbyor ba gzhan kun sbyor ba 'di'i/ /yan lag tu ni shes par bya/ /rnal 'byor ye shes dbang gyur pas/ /brtul zhugs la sogs rig ma yis/ /gnas nas de yi don sgrub tshe/ /de yi dus su de thob pa'o bde ba chen po'i sbyor ba ste gsum pa'o// //da ni rab tu bshad bya ba/ /dngos po kun la rnal 'byor gyis/ /phyin log rab tu bzlog pa'i phyir/ /sbyor ba bzhi pa bshad par bya/ /rang bzhin med phyir rang bzhin med/ /gcig dang du ma'i rang bzhin dang / /bral phyir stong pa nyid du gsungs/ /dngos po kun la mu stegs dang / /nyan thos gnyis dang rnam shes smra/ /dbu ma pa yi gzhung gis su/ /tha dad so sor rtog pa yang / /'di nyid la ni yongs 'khrul te/ /so sor kun du rtog pa'o/ /de dag kun kyang don dam pa/ /rtogs pa min pas bla dang bcas/ /de bas de yi rang bzhin kun/ /med pas 'di kun sgyu ma dang / /smig rgyu sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyibye / /'khor lo ru ni yang dag bshad/ /de bas de la bdag po dang / /gzung ba dang ni 'dzin pa'i chos/ /dngos po'i ngo bor 'dzin pa dang / /'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /gnyis su 'dzin pa yod pa med/ /'di kun mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /'khor lo 'di ni nges pa yin/ /de la rang bzhin med pa dang / /bsres pa'i don ni mchog tu gsung ḍa / /dngos po kun 22—756

byedagyi nang nas kyang / /rang bzhin med pa gtso bor bshad/ /ci phyir rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis/ /'di bsgoms pas ni sangs rgyas kyi/ /phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'grub/ /kha cig gis ni gzhung dag gi/ /chad pa'i stong pa stong pa min/ /rang bzhin med pa ma yin no/ /de yi rang bzhin de yin no/ /de ni lung skal can yin pas/ /de ltar gang bsgom 1rnal 'byor pas/ / bzung sgrub snam legs sbrul sogs bzhin/ /de bas rang bzhin med pa 'di/ /bde ba chen po'i skad cig la/ /dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ /gang min bsal ba bsal ba ni/ /rang bzhin med par bshad pa ste/ /rang bzhin med dang de bzhin nyid/ /chos nyid dang ni chos mnyam pa/ /don dam la sogs rnam grangs kyang / /rang bzhin med pa 'di nyid las/ /der ni gzhan dag ma gsungs so/ /dngos po kun ni gzhig pa dang / /gzhom pa yis ni stong pa min/ /de 'dra'i stong pa la sems kyis/ /dus gsum du ni gtang ba yi/ /stobs kyis rang bzhin med par 'gyur/ /med pa nyid ni rgyu sogs kyis/ /dkyil 'khor yang dag 'gog mi 'gyur/ /mi 'gog dus na rang bzhin med/ /rnal 'byor gsum pas brtul zhugs kyis/ /spyod pa de don sgrub pa ni—/ /de yi dus su de thob pa'o/ /rang bzhin med pa'i spyor ba ste bzhi pa'o// //da ni rab tu bshad bya ba/ /rang bzhin med pa'i spyor ba yis/ /bkra shis med pa dgag don du/ /sbyor ba lnga pa bshad par bya/ /thugs rjes rgyas pa 'di med par/ /rnam pa kun gyi sems can don/ /byed par nus pa ma 22—757

yin te/ /de bas thams cad mkhyen pa rnams/ /thugs rjes gang bas rgyas pa ste / /khams gsum gyi ni sems can rnams/ /sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa las—/ /grol bar 'dod par 3thugs rje'o/ /thugs rje de yang rnam gsum ste//sems can ma lus thams cad kun/ /sdug bsngal de rgyu las 'gog par kye/ /rtse gcig dmigs pa gtong ba ni/ /las dang po yis shes par bya/ /khams gsum 'di ni chos dbyings tsam/ /de la sems can ming yang med/ /don dam par yang ming yang med/ /don dam par yang mi dmigs la/zu/ /sa gnas byang chub sems dpa'o/ /dmigs pa thams cad dang bral ba ji ltar nam mkha'i 4/khams su yang / /sprin byung glulta bur snang ba ni/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi/ /thugs rje chen po yin par gsungs/ /de 'dra'i snying rjes 6rje btsun che/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa rgyas pas na/ /thugs rjes rgyas pa zhes bshad do/ /'khor ba ji srid yod kyi bar/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i 3rim pa dang / /shākya thub pa la sogs pa'i/ /gzugs kyis gdul bya'i rgyud la ni/ /ji ltar 'dul ba der snang ste/ /kun don byed par shes par bya//sprul sku 'di ni dang po ru/ /dga' bral shes pa'i dus su ni/ /thig le 'gog par 'gyur ba ste/ /nam mkha'i khams kun gang 'gyur ba'i/ /gzugs kyis rab tu gnas pa'o/ /ji ltar yid bzhin nor bu ni/ /mi rtog bzhin du skal ldan la/ /don rnams byed de de bzhin du/ /bde chen rang bzhin med pa las//dmigs pa med kyang don 'byung ba'o/ /ye shes dbang du gyur pa yis/ /brtul zhugs la sogs rim pa yis/ /gang tshe de don bsgrub pa na/ /de yi dus su de thob pa'o/ /thugs rjes rgyas pa'i spyor ba ste lnga pa'o// //22—758

da ni rab tu bshad bya ba/ /dpe med bde rdzogs chos sku dang / /thugs rje sku yi ngo bo ste/ /res 'ga' ba nyid dgag pa'i phyir/ /sbyor ba drug pa bshad par bya/ /dpe med bde rdzogs sku chen yang / /mi gnas mya ngan 'da' tshul gyis/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /rgyud dag rnams la rtag tu snang / /de bzhin bde chen chos sku /①yang / /khyab dang rgyas pa'i tshul gyis su—/ /nam mkha' phyaji srid gnas kyi bar/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa'i tshul gyis 'jug /thugs rje'i rang bzhin sku de yang / /gdul bya ji ltar mos pa ltar/ /srid pa srid du gnas nas ni/ /bar chad med par rgyun du 'jug /de 'dra'i rgyun mi 'chad pa'i sku/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa ste/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /shes rab ye shes dbang dus su/ /dga' ba gsum gyi gnas skabs su/ /skad cig gnyis sogs chu tshod dang / /nyin gcig zla ba lo la sogasaske/ /gnas pa rgyun mi 'chad ces bya/ /phyis kyi 'bras bu mi slu —phyir/ /de la yang ni de skad du/ /bla ma'i zhal nas bshad pa yin/ /ye shes dbang du gyur pa yis/ /brtul zhugs cho ga de bsgrub tshe/ /de yi dus su de thob nas/ /de nas 'khor ba'i mtha' yi bar/ /rgyun gyi rtag tu gnas pa'o/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa'i spyor ba ste drug pa'o// //da ni rab tu bshad bya ba/ /dpe med bde rdzogs sgu chen dang / /bral ba dgag par bya ba'i phyir/ /sbyor ba bdun pa bshad par bya/ /gong du yang dag gsungs pa ⑤yi/ /dga' ba'i ye shes dus byung ba'i/ /dpe med bde rdzogs ( rigs ldan sku/ /lan cig byung nas med pa ni/ /'gog pa zhes ni 22—759

rab tu bya/ /'gog pa de las byung ba na/ /phyis kyi 'bras bu mchog gyur pa/ /'gog pa med par shes par bya/ /snying rje che ba'i dbang gis ni/ /'khor ba ji srid bar du ni/ /dbang phyug brgyad kyi bcom ldan 'das/ /mi g.yo gzhug phyir 'gog med dang / /gnas la yang ni de bzhin du/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis shes par bya/ /skal ldan rnams kyi sngon du yang / /shes rab ye shes dbang dus su/ /bla ma'i zhal las nges thob pa/ /dga' dang dga' ba bar ma dang / /dga' bral dga' ba 'gog pa las/ /de 'dra'i sems rgyun myong ba ste/ /'gog pa med pa zhes bshad do/ /ye shes dbang du gyur pa yis/ /brtul zhugs la sogs spyod pa la/ /gnas nas de yi don bsgrub tshe/ /de yi dus su de thob pa'o/ /bya ba byas pa'i dbang phyug che/ /mtha' yi pha rol phyin pa'i mchog /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa ste/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'o/ /'gog pa med pa'i spyor ba ste bdun pa'o// //de ltar sbyor bdun ldan pa yi/ /bzhi pa mngon par byang chub pa/ /rnam pa kun kyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /thams cad mkhyen par 'gyur ba'o/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag /rdo rje 'chang ba kun gyi gnas/ /chos rnams kun gyi chos nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ①thabs bya'o/ /de ni 'khor ba ji srid kyisnye/ /bar du gnas pas rtag pa'o/ /sangs rgyas sems can thams cad kyi/ /ngo bor gyur pas gcig pa'o/ /de la sgrib pa bzhi yi ni/ /tsha ba med pas bsil ba'o/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa ni/ /gcig tu gyur pas bde ba'o/ /gzugs la sogs pa rtog pa yis/ /ma gos phyir ni mi gdung ba'o/ /phyin log 'khrul rtog dang bral bas/ /dag cing dri ma med pa'o/ /22—760

zab gsal byang chub las mi ldog /gzhan don mdzad pas dga' ba'o/ /chos nyid dang ni sems can la/ /sems mnyam gzhag hupas yid dang ba/ /'di ni bde ba chen po yi/ /ro myang ba yi mtshan nyid brgyad/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /bzhi pa'i don ni bla med pa'o/ /dngos po kun la cher gnas dang / /gang mi gsal ba'i dngos po ru/ /de nyid bla ma dam pa yi/ /zhal nas nges par thob pa la/ /som nyi yid gnyis mi bya'o/ /de yi ngo bo bshad nas ni/ /rnam grangs dag dang bshad par bya/ /'dod chags dang ni bar ma dang / /chags bral du ni shes par bya/ /dga' dang dga' ba bar ma dang / /dga' bral gyi ni dga' ba'o/ /bde rdzogs sku dang chos sku dang / /sprul sku ru ni shes par bya/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs dang ni/ /stong dang mtshan med smon pa med/ /gsang dang gsang chen shin tu gsang / /rnal 'byor lhag pa'i rnal 'byor dang / /rnal 'byor chen po zhes bya'o/ /bdag dang gzhan dang lhan cig byed/ /dpal gsum du ni shes par bya/ /dang po rnal 'byor las rgyal mchog /dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog shes par bya/ /thig le phra mo gsang sngags bzlas/ /rnam pa gsum du shes par bya/ /dam tshig gsum dang ting 'dzin dang / /ye shes sems dpa' shes par bya/ /lus dang bha ga byang sems kyi/ /dkyil 'khor gsum du shes par bya/ /bum pa dang ni gsang ba dang / /shes rab ye shes shes par bya/ /de la sogs pa'i dam tshig gi—/ /bzhi pa yi ni tshig gi ni/ /de 'dra'i rang bzhin mi shes la/ /de nyid sngags kyi sgu ru bshad/ /dpe med bde rdzogs ye shes sku/ /hūṃ sogs bskyed pa'i lha yi gzugs/ /bzhis bsgrub sku ru rab tu gnas/ /gang 3gi bzhi la 22—761

gnas byed phyir/ /bar chad med cing 'gog pa med/ /de ltar dpal ldan gsang 'dus su/ /rtog pa yi ni rnal 'byor pas/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa la brten te/ /bzhi pa'i don la spyod par 'gyur/ /de 'dra'i don rnams mi shes pas/ /phyi rol don la mngon zhen te/ /rin chen sems ni dri can byas/ /des na dge dang mi dge ba'i/ /las byas pas ni mtho ris dang / /dmyal la sogs par 'tshod dzo'agyur ba/ /chos 'di rang bzhin gyis dag pasarngu / /rnam rtog dra bas blun byas la/ /dge sdig phung po gnyis su brtags/ /de spangs nas ni skye med pa'i/ /rang bzhin don ni rtogs par bya/ /yang dag don du dge spangs na/ /dge ba smin pas smos ci dgos/ /dper na mi gang chu klung gi / /pha rol tu ni 'gro ba dag /rtswa bye shing la sogs bsdus byas pas chu las cergal ba'i gzings byas te/ /de la 'jug ste ⑤rab brgal nas/ /bor te bde bar 'gro ba ltar/ /de bzhin bzhi po'i ngo bo yi/ /don rtogs pas na 'bad rtsol gyisatre/ /bya ba de la ci zhig bya/ /de phyir bla ma dam pa nyid/ /mnyes byas dbang gi don mchog gi /bdud rtsi mchog 'di gang zag gang / /bdag gzhan don du 'thung byed pa/ /gang de rgyal ba'i sras zhes bya/ /de phyin chad ni gang cung zad/ /'dod chags la sogs dngos po rnams/ /bdud rtsir zin phyir de la dbul/ /skyon gyis gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /bsgom tsu par ldan pa smos ci dgos/ /de ni ma 'ongs rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de ni yang dag rkang gnyis mchog /de ni 'khor ba'i pha rol son/ /de ni phyin log khyar chen por/ /de ni bya ba thams cad byas/ /de ni kun gzigs rnams kyis bzhag /de ni gang du gnas gyur kyang / /sangs rgyas kyi gdung ma chad pas/ /22—762

bstan pa rin chen gnas pa yi/ /gtso bo ru ni de gnas so/ /de ni gang du 'dug kyang rung / /de dang de ru 'jig rten mgon/ /bzhugs dang bzhud par shes par bya/ /rnal 'byor de la thams cad kyis/ /dngos po kun gyis phyag byar 'os/ /srid gsum bdag po kun gyis kyang / /dkyil 'khor mchod pa 1'os pa yis④/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis kyang / /nyin re lan gsum byon nas ni/ /phyag byed cing ni bsngags ༄ brjod na/ /gzhan ma rnams ni smos sbu dgos/ /de bas kun nas 'bad pa yis/ /bla ma yang dag mnyes byas te/ /bzhi pa'i don mchog blang byas nas/ /dgon pa'am yang na grong gi mthar/ /gang rung ci rung de lta rung ④// /gnas nas bla ma'i zhal snga yi—/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa bsnyen bya ste/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtogs par bya/ /dngos po thams cad dngos med pas/ /rgyu sogs don ni rtogs pa dang / /rdo rje pad+ma spyad pa dang / /bdud rtsi lngas ni rang dgar byed/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la ni/ /rnal 'byor ci dgar spyod byed cing / /gsang bar bya ba'i chos gsang bas/ /gsang zhing sbas te spyad par bya/ /longs spyod chen po dka' thub dang / /bsam gtan smyon pa'i tshul gyis su/ /de 'dra'i ngo bo ma shes pas/ /lag pa dang ni rkang pa dang / /mig sogs sbyin pa btang bas kyang / /bskal pa chen po brgya ru yang / /bdud rtsi'i ro thob mi 'gyur ro/ /de bas dngos po 'di gcig gis/ /dam pa rtog pa thams cad spangs/ /zab cing legs par gsal ba'i sku/ /kun nas 'od zer 'phro ldan pa/ /kun du bzang por rang gi yid/ /rnal 'byor gang gis sgom mi byed/ /de bsgoms pas ni tshe 'di la/ /zla ba drug gis dngos grub mchog /ze tshom med par 22—763

'grub pa ste/ /su yis dngos bo de bzlog 'gyur/ /'khor lo gcig pa'i shing rta la/ /rta bdun sbrul gyi thag pas stel/ /kha khrid ①ro smad med pa yis/ /mkha' la khrid /enas mtha' ru phyin/ /rang dang gzhan don byed pa ltar/ /dngos po yi 1ni chos kun dang / /mdzes gyur min ltar snang gyur kyang / /rang dang gzhan gyi dngos grub pas/ /skyes bus 'di ni blang bar 'os/ /dal 'byor 'di ni g.yo bas na/ /drag po'i rlung gis mar me ltar/ /skad cig du ni mi snang 'gyur/ /de bas de nyid bsam par 'os/ /de 'dra'i rang bzhin ngo bo la/ /sgom pas rtag tu mnyam zhog la/ /khyab bdag rim bzhin rtogs gyur cing thu/ /bdag ni rtag tu gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /bla ma'i zhal sngas bsgrub skyepas na/ /sbyor ba bdun kyi bdud rtsi mchog /sman pa'i zhabs kyis thob pa'o/ /de 'dra'i bdud rtsi de la ni/ /'thung byed de ni log pa yina'u/ /rtog pa yis ni rab 'ching ⑦ba'i/ /nad ni kun nas med gyur cig /de med pas na sems can kun/ /yang dag phung po rgyas 'gyur te/ /sbyor ba bdun gyi rang bzhin mchog /'bras bu de nyid rtogs par shog /sbyor ba bdun po 37zhes bya ba dbang bzhi'i rab tu byed pa slob dpon chen po bi ta pā das mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la gu h+ya dang / bod kyi lo tsā spub mnga' bdag lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba'o// //22—764

bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (705)22wa 766

༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā ba bo bi dhi/ bod skad du/gtor ma chen po'i cho ga /thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig 2 shes bya'i sgrib sogs rab spangs nas/ /me long la sogs ye shes yang dag ldan//gsum gyi 'khor lo don byed rab mchog gtso/ /'jam dbyangs de la 'dud cing bla ma la'ang / /rnal 'byor rnams kyi bar chad zhi byas nas/ /mngon par don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /sangs rgyas ye shes zhal snga'i rim 'ongs pa /ma lus bstan pa'i gtor ma bshad par bya/ /mchod sbyin rnams ni thams cad kyi / /gtso bo gtor ma'i las yin te/ /rnal 'byor rnams ni de bsgrub 'dod / /cho ga 'di la 'bad par bya/ /gang phyir gzhan don gnyer ba'am/ /dngos grub bsgrub bya'i thulas byed na/ /bzlas dang sbyin sreg gnyis ka bas/ /gtor ma'i las 'di mchog tu gsungs/ /de yi las ni 'di lta ste/ /bdag 22—767

nyid bsgyur dang de mgron dang / /de yi yo byad bsngo ba dang / /gsol gdab gshegs su gsol ba'o/ /dang por bdag nyid yi dam lhar/ /sku dang mkhyen pa bya ba dbang / /rim pas thams cad rdzogs bsgoms nas/ /zhi phyir don grub gtor ma gtang lha//'khor lo la sogs khang pa yisarngu/ /phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhir stegs bu brgyad/ /brgya byin dbang ldan bar du gasbug /chu dang bden bral bar du gcig /dam pa'i dri yis bcu po byug /mdzes pa'i me tog rnams kyis brgyan/ /glu dang gar dang gdugs sogs pas/ /nus pa ji snyed kyis brgyan bya/ /de nas rang nyid rnal 'byor pas/ /dngos grub myur du mi 'thob phyir/ /'khor lor bcas pa'am yang na ni/ /khros pa'i byethams cad nag por bsgyur/ /de yi ye shes sems dpa' las/ /'od zer lcags kyu nag 'phros pas/ /phyogs skyong rang rang phyogs gnas pas④/ /chung ma 'khor bcas dgug par bya/ /brgya byin ser po spyan stong pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa sha tsir bcas/ /glang chen rab tu brtan pa la/ /chibs pa shar gyi sa stegs dbusabye/ /dgug bya de g.yon mkha' lding la/ /zhon pa'i khyab 'jug nag bo ste/ /g.yas pa rtse gsum 'khor lo 'dzin/ /g.yon du dung dang nor bu 'dzin/ /de steng dgug bya ྾ shar lho yi/ /stegs steng ra zhon me lha yipe/ /ral pa'i dbu rgyan dmar mdog can—/ /skyabs sbyin phreng 'dzin g.yon du ni/ /dbyug pa gudhe bya'adzin pa dgug /de bzhin lho yi stegs steng du/ /dgug bya ma te la zhon pa/ /gshin rje nag po brkyang bskum tshul/ /rgyan 'bar phyag na dbyug pa dang / /22—768

sdigs mdzub 1'dzin pa gnas par bya/ /lho nub stegs steng la dgug pa/ /mi ro la zhon brkyang bsgum tshul/ /gcer bu mche gcigs skra bzhin gnag /bden bral gri dang ka pā la 'dzin/ /nub kyi stegs bu'i steng dgug pa/ /mkha' 'gro lto 'phye zhon pa yi/ /chu lha 2dkar po klu zhags 'dzin/ /klu mgo bdun pa zhabs klu gcig /de bzhin nub byang steng dgug pa/ /dgo ba ser zhon rlung lha ljang / /phyag gnyis rlung gi gos 'dzin cing / /nam mkha'i khams su brkyang pa'o/ /byang gi stegs bu la dgug pa/ /mi zhon gnod sbyin ser po ste / /bi dza pū ra sa bon gang / /ne+e'u le bcir nas 'dzin pa'o/ /de steng bye ba la zhon pa/ /log 'dren dpon po glang chen mgo/ /dkar po la phug phreng ba dang / /mngar bsres dbyug 'dzin dgug pa'o/ /byang shar stegs bu la dgug pa/ /glang la zhon pa'i dbang phyug dkar/ /ral can rus pa'i phreng ba can/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ rnge'u chung 'dzin pa'o/ /brgya byen dbang ldan bar dgug pa/ /rta bdun shing rta la zhon pa/ /nyi ma dmar po zer bcas pa /phyag mtshan pad+ma dmar po 'dzin/ /de g.yon ut+pa la gnas pa/ /zla ba dkar po la gnas pa/ /phreng ba 'dzin pa 'khor dang bcas/ /bkug nas de ru gnas pa'o/ /de nyid dbus su de steng dgug /ngang pa zhon pa tshangs pa che /thung ngu zhal bzhi tshangs sgud can/ /tshon po phreng ba dbyug pa 'dzin/ /klu dang cig shos gnyis par steng / /shing rta la zhon thags zangs d+kuganag /dgug bya ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /lha min tshogs dang bcas pa'o/ /de yi g.yon du de steng du/ /pad+ma la bzhugs 5dgug bya ba/ /sa yi lha mo ser mo yi6 /bum pa 'dzin pa bsam par bya/ /'di rnams rin chen dbu rgyan can/ /22—769

rin chen rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /rab tu spras pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /phyogs skyong shin tu che ba rnams/ /rang 'dra ba yi tshogs bskor ba/ /rnam smin 'od dang sku mdog gis/ /mun pa thams cad sel byed pa/ /rang gi lha yis dgug byas dgod/ /de ltar rab tu bkug byas nas/ /cho ga'i rim pa 'di yis ni/ /shes bya'i sgrib 1mun bsal nas ni2/ /de rnams rab tu sbyar bar bya / /thugs kyi 'od zer las byung ba/ /gshin rje gshed sogs khro bo bcu/ /sku stod zhal gsum phyag drug blta / /smad ni gsal shing gzugs gnas pa/ /g.yas pas mgul ba 4brtan byas nas/ /ri rab las grub tho ba yis/ /g.yon pas brdab cing gong ma rnams/ /rim pa bzhin du gdab par bya oṃ āḥ bibyān+ta kreta 5sarba duṭ+wān6/ ku be+e ra ga ṇa 7pa ti sa pa ri wā ra ṇa shī la ya dh+ri phaṭa/ oṃ āḥṭak+ki rā dza 9sarba duṣ+ṭan/ asni sa pa ri wā ra ṇa tī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ āḥnī la daṇ+ḍa sarba dubyen/ nai ṛ 7ti sa pa ri wā ra ṇa shī la ya t+t+waṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ba la sarba duṣ+ṭhan/ bā yu na sa pa ri wā ra ṇa tī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥ.a tsa la sarba duṣ+ṭan/ yī sha na sa pa ri wā ra ṇa shī la ya t+t+waṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rgyu 1tsakra sarba dubyen/ arka tsan+d+ra pra ti ma hā sa pa ri wā ra ṇa shī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥsum+bha sarba dubyen/ tsa ma ri pa ti de ba bra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra ṇa gī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/sngags de dag ni brjod byas nas/ /gdab bya 'debs byed btab 12pa rnams/ /sgrib pa mnyam nyid shes pa yis/ /brtsal phyir rim —bzhin phur pas gdab/ /de dag lus 'di phur btab nas/ /thal ba nyid gyur 7brlag byas nas/ /rnam par shes pa mar me ltar/ /gnas pa sa bon gyis bkug ltar/ /zhal bzhugs ྾byang chub sems gyur nas/ /rdo rje'i lam byung mtsho skyes nang / /22—770

babs pa bsam pa'i gnod sems rnams/ /bsal phyir sngags 'dis byen gyis rlab7 / /oṃ āḥ.oṃ shrī te ru ka badz+ra sa ma ya mu dra 2sarba duṣ+ṭhan sa ma ya mu dra pra ban tsakra e ṣā ma a sha ya do ṣe a ba na ya hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje he ru ka yis ni/ /sngags kyis shes bya'i sgrib mun bsal/ /de nas bdud rtsi 'khyel pa yi/ /phreng ba bzlas pas nyon mongs bsal/ /na maḥs man+ta kā 4ya wāka tsit+ta badzā 5rde/na mo badz+ra rdasgota ka ṭa bye ra ba ya a si mu sa la pa ra shu pā sha hasta ya/ oṃ a mri 6ta kuṇ+ḍa li/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha bad+dhā/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ gardza gardza/ bi sgo ṭa ya bi sgo ṭa ya/ sarba bibyān 7bi nā ya kā māṃ/ma hā ga ṇa 4pa ti dz+re bi tān+ta ka rā ya/ sarba ṣ+ṭi a sha ya do ṣa 7a pa na ya t+t+waṃ phaṭa / de yis sgrib mun bsal nas su/ /mtsho skyes nang gnas khu ba las/ /cho ga gsum gyis rta legs bsgrubs pa'i/ /sgu rnams phyogs su dgod par bya/ /badz+re hūṃ dṛ shaṃ sum̐ baṃ yo r+ghaṃ saṃ'u saṃ 5a bhe ma oṃ lam̐/ bya ba'i sa bon rnams su gyur/ /de las/ rdo rje 'khor lo gubye 1 dang / /dbyug pa gri dang klu zhags dang / /rlung gos bi dza pū ngar dang / /pad+ma rtse gsum pad+ma dang / /ut+pal pad+ma ral gri dang / /pad+ma mtshan ma rnams kyi nang / /rang rang sa bon mtshan par bsam /sa bon phyag mtshan de nyid las/ /brgya byin rdo rje mtshan du gyur/ /ser po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /rdo rje ral gri phyag g.yas la/ /'khor lo pad+ma g.yon du 'dzin/ /thugs rigs zla ba'i steng du dgod/ /khyab 'jug sgyu ma rdo rje gyur/ /nag po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /'khor lo ral gri phyag g.yas la/ /dung dang pad+ma g.yon du 'dzin/ /'di yang thugs rigs nyi mar dgod/ /drang srong rdo rje me ru gyur/ /dmar ser zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /skyabs 22—771

sbyin dang ni phreng ba g.yas/ /gudhe 1dbyug pa g.yon du 'dzin/ /'di yang thugs rigs zur gsum dang / /nyi ma'i gdan la dgod pa'o/ /gshin rje rdo rje tshe zad gyur/ /nag po skra 'greng zhal gsum pa/ /phyag drug dbyug pa ral gri dang / /nor bu pad 'dzin brkyang bskum tshul/ /thugs rigs nyi ma'i gdan la dgod/ /bden bral rdo rje gtun du gyur/ /bung 'dra zhal gsum phyag drug pa / /gri gug ral gri phyag g.yas pa/ /ka pāl rin chen g.yon du 'dzin/ /thugs rigs nyi ma'i gdan la dgod/ /de rnams dbu rgyan mi bskyod pas/ /cod pan la ni mtshan pa'o/ /chu lha klu yi rdo rjer gyur/ /zhal gsum dkar po klu gdong dang / /klu yi zhabs can phyag drug pa/ /klu zhabs zhe ral gri phyag g.yas la/ /rin chen pad+ma g.yon du 'dzin/ /gsung rigs zla ba'i gdan la dgod / /tshe dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa'o/ /rlung lha rdo rje rlung du gyur/ /margad ltar ljang zhal gsum pa/ /phyag drug rlung gos ral gri g.yas/ /nor bu pad+ma g.yon du 'dzin/ /las kyi rigs te zla bar dgod/ /rnga sgra yis ni dbu brgyan pa'o/ /lus ngan rdo rje 4'jigs byed gyur/ /gser 'dra zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /bi dza pū 5ra ral gri g.yas/ /pad+ma dung ni g.yon du 'dzin/ /gsung rigs nyi ma la dgod bya/ /log 'dren rdo rje mchu rings gyur/ /dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /rdo rje mchu can la phug dang / /ral gri g.yas su 'dzin pa'o/ /rin chen pad+ma g.yon du 'dzin/ /'di yang gsung rigs nyi mar dgod/ /dbang ldan rdo rje khro bor gyur/ /dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa / /rtse gsum ral gri g.yas na 'dzin/ /g.yon du rin chen pad+ma 'dzin/ /gsung rigs zla ba la bkod de/ /tshe dpag med kyis gsum po brgyan/ /nyi 22———772

ma rdo rje 'khyil par gyur/ /dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /pad+ma ral gri phyag g.yas la/ /g.yon du 'khor lo rin po che/ /rin chen rigs te nyi mar dgod—/ /rin chen 'byung ldan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /zla ba rdo rje 'od du gyur/ /zhal gsum phyag drug dkar po'i mdog /ut+pal ral gri phyag g.yas la/ /rin chen pad+ma g.yon du 'dzin/ /sku yi rigs te zla bar dgod/ /tshangs pa thub pa'i rdo rjer gyur/ /ser po zhal gsum phyag drug pa1/ /pad+ma ral gri phyag g.yas la / /nor bu 'khor lo g.yon du 'dzin/ /sgu rigs 'di yang zla bar dgod / /lha min rdo rje thags bzangs gyur/ /nag po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /g.yas su ral gri 'khor lo 'dzin/ /g.yon du rin chen chu skyes 'dzin / /sku yi rigs ni zinyi mar dgod/ /sa gnas rdo rje sar gyur te/ /ser po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /pad+ma ral gri phyag g.yas la/ /g.yon du rin chen chu skyes te/ /sku rigs 'di yang zla bar dgod/ /bzhi po rtag pas brgyan pa'o/ /sgyu ma rdo rje byin za dang / /ma bdag sha rlon za ba dang / /lus ngan log par 'dren pa dang / /lha dmag zlog par byed pa rnams/ /nyi ma me yi 'od kyis 'khor/ /rten pa'i rgyab na gnas pa'o/ /lhag ma zla ba'i rgyab rten 5can/ /dang po rang 'od rig ma 'khyud/ /rdo rje skyil mo krung gnas pa / /zab mo yang dag gsal ba'i sku/ /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan ldan pa/ /mtshan dang dpe byad kyis 'od gsal/ /rang rang phyogs kyi nam mkha' gang / /rang rang dang 'dra 'khor tshogs rnams/ /zhal gsum phyag drug rig mar ldan/ /yang dag bskyed nas nyer sgrub 6sogs/ /yid 'ong gsang ba 'dus pa yi/ /gzhung gis byin brlabs sbyang bar bya/ /de bzhin nam mkha' mnyam pa yi/ /22 —773

'gro ba ma lus sa bon gyis/ /bkug nas zhal zhugs zhu bar gyur/ /rdo rje'i lam byung 1mtsho skyes nang / /ye shes rim pa lnga las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa'i mos pa yis/ /zhu gyur pad+ma'i nang gnas pa/ /sbyan sogs lha mo glu dbyangs kyis/ / bsgul bas k+ṣi 2la sogs pa yis — / /sa bon nyi shu gcig tu gyur/ /de las mtshan ma sa bon mtshan/ /sa bon phyag mtshan las byung ba'i4/ /sa snying la sogs gzugs bskyed nas/ /sku mdog zhal dang phyag mtshan rnams/ /sgrub pa'i thabs gsungs grags pa rnams/ /nam mkha'i khams kun spros pas gang / /de ltar mgron rnams kun sbyang 5nas/ /yo byad rnams ni sta gon gnas/ /gser dang dngul dang zangs ma'i snod/ /lcags dang nya phyis la sogs pa'i/ /snod mchog nang du khur ba dang / /zan dang sdig med sha khrag dang / /mdzes pa'i lha bshos nya sha dang / /mon sran gre'u 'o ma dang / /chu dang mar me dri me tog /bldag 6rgyu btung rgyu bza' rgyu sogs/ /rgyas pa mdun du mthong bya ste/ /glu dang gar dang rol mo dang / /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang / /bla re la sogs mchod pa'i tshogs/ /de bzhin phyi rol kun bskor bkod/ /med na kham phor la sogs la/ /mon sran gre'u chu zan dang / /gzhan ma dag kyang rnyed pa bzhin/ /cho ga bzhin du dbul bar bya/ /'khor lo snga ma bzhin du bsgrubs / /pad+ma sa bon bcu po las/ /ba spu'i bu ga las byung ba'i/ /gzugs sogs lha mo spyos pa yis/ /nam mkha'i khams kun rab bkang nas/ /mgron rnams so sor 'khyud byas te/ /de bzhin me tog la sogs pa/ /sa tsho2—77/

bon gyis bskul so sor thengs/ /mchod pa mnyam nyid bya ba'i phyir/ /sngags kyis byin gyis brlab par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū 1dza badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3/ri byehaṃ—/ de nas rdo rje dril bu ni/ /gsor gsil bskor ba'i bde bas kyang / /lha rnams thams cad dges bya'i phyir/ /chos thams cad kyis bstod par bya/ /rdo rje mi bskyod /gruye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' 4chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje sgrogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag chen po/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab//rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med/ /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dpag med 'dod chags che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa thob/ /'od gsal rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo / /dngos grub rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /rang bzhin dag pas 5rdo rje sems/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas yi byung gzhu 'dra dang / /re byung gru gsum me dkyil du/ /a byung pad+ma 'dab brgyad la/ /rdzas rnams mi 'chi 6lnga ru dmigs/ /de steng zla ba nyi ma la/ /bye sogs bsams nas de'i 'od kyis/ /rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas bkug byas te/ /sa bon las ni thim gyur stobs/ /rlung gis me bus pad nang gi/ /bdud rtsi khol bas gcig gyur te/ /rlangs pa hūṃ byung rdo rje dkar / /lte bar hūm̐ bsams zhu gyur pas/ /pad nang bdud rtsi la babs te//zla ba shel ltar dag bsams nas/ /steng du oṃ bsams zhu gyur pas/ /nang du thim byas gsal byas te/ /'od zer lnga ni rab 'bar bsam/ /de nyid 22—775

gsum gyi gsang sngags nyid/ /rab tu bzlas pas byen brlabs te/ /de ltar sbyang byas gtor ma rnams/ /sa bon gyis bskul pad+ma yis/ /nam mkha'i khams kun bkang byas te/ /lha rnams ji snyed phyag g.yon bteg /jengs par byas nas so so yi/ /lce ni hūṃ las rdo rje yi/ /bum par dh+ri bsam de 'od kyis / /lce'us chu ni 'thungs bzhin du/ /bdud rtsi 'thungs pas zad med de//de yi stobs kyis gnyis med kyi/ /ye shes yongs su myong bar bsam/ de nas tshigs bcad 'di rnams kyis/ /rab tu brjod de dbul bar bya oṃ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams gnas pa/ /dus gsum las ni byung ba kun/ /mkha' dang rgya mtsho sprin gyi tshogs/ /shin tu rgya che phra rab kyi/ /rdul gyi dkyil 'khor so so yi/ /nang du gnas pa'i tshogs chen po/ /nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam pa yi/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin can/ /phyogs bcu skyong ba thams cad dang / /sems can khams rnams ma lus pa'i/ /so so spyor ba'i tshul gnas pa/ /de dag kyang ni 'di lta ste/ /rdo rje mtshon cha sgyu ma rdo rje dang //rdo rje me dang rdo rje zad dus dang / /rdo rje gtun dang klu yi rdo rje dang / /rdo rje rlung dang rdo rje 'jigs byed dang / /rdo rje mchu rings rdo rje khro bo dang / /rdo rje 'khyel pa rdo rje 'od chen dang / /thub pa'i rdo rje rdo rje thags bzangs 1dang / /sa yi rdo rje 'khor dang so sor bcas/ /sa snying phyag na rdo rje nam snying dang / /'jig rten dbang dang sgrib sel kun du bzang / /gzugs dang sgra dang dri yi rdo rje ma/ /ro dang reg bya chos dbyings rdo rje dang / /spyan ma dang ni mā ma gī dang ni/ /na bza' dkar mo dam tshig sgrol ma dang / /rnam snang mdzad dang rin chen dbang phyug dang / /snang mtha' yas dang don yod 22—776

grub pa rnams/ /mi bskyod pa yi tshogs chen thams cad la/ /bdag gis me tog dang ni spos dang ni/ /mar me dri zhim zhal zas dam pa dbul/ /rol mo la sogs dag dang ldan pa yi/ /gtor ma'i yo byad 'di ni thugs rje yis/ /bzhes shing dgongs shig bdag la rab tu dgongs/ /bdag la gser dang dngul dang 'gron bu dang / /nor phyug tshe ring ba dang bzhon pa dang / /na tsha med dang dam tshig bde ba kun/ /'phrog par byed pa bgegs kyi sde dpon dang //gdug (dang shin tu gdug 2pa can dag dang / /mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad dag /rmugs par gyis shig rab tu rmugs par gyis/ /chings shig chings shig khyed kyis yang dag chom/ /de bas nga yi 'gron bu gser dngul dang //nor gyi dbyig dang tshe ni ring ba dang / /bzhon 4pa dang ni na tsha med la sogs/ /bde ba chen po rab tu 'phel bar mdzod/ /bdag ni byang chub snying po ma thob bar / /khyed rnams bdag gi grogs la rtag tu spyon/ /bdag gi nad rnams dag ni zhi ba dang / /bdag la bgegs kyi gnod pa zhi bar gyis/ /kye bcom ldan 'das ni rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog /skyon can kun gyi phyag rgya bshig 5pa po/ / bdag gis gtor phul bdag la zhi ba dang / /dus 'di nas ni bsrung bar 6mdzad du gsol/ /de ltar 'dod bzhin gsol btab nas/ /de dag rnams kyang mthun pa ru/ /bdag la dngos grub gnang bsams nas/ /mgrin gcig tu ni legs so zhes/ /gsungs pa'i ku cos khams bkang ba'i/ /sgra kun grag 7par dmigs nas su/ /tshigs bcad 'di yis bshags par bya/ /'jig rten 'di na 'khod pa'i mgron rnams kun/ /phyogs skyong sems can kun dang lha yi lha/ /rang bzhin gyis grub spyor bas sbyangs pa rnams/ /bdag ni 22—777

brtson dang mi ldan bkren chen te/ /mchog gzhan ci yang bdag la ma mchis na//gzhan don dgongs pa'i mgon po spyod rnams kyis/ /thugs dang mi 'gal rang gi mthus bzhes shig /bdag ni rnam g.yeng rmugs dang le lo yis sems ma 'dus dang mi gsal ma bsgrubs pas kye/ /mgon po khyed rnams thugs dang 'gal ba gang / /rang bzhin bdag gis ༄2chos gzigs bzod par mdzod/ /de ltar brjod pas dga' 'gyur te/ /'gal ba dag ni sos par dmigs/ /yang na a yis dang por rdzogs/ /brjod pa byin brlabs gtor ma dbul/ /de nas rdo rje dril bu dang ldan pa'i/ /bde ba'i dbyings rab brjod bya ste/ /bskor nas pad+ma'i lag bskor lnga/ /byas nas sngags 'dis gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ sems can don kun byas nas su/ /rang gi yul du gshegs su gsol/ /yang ni byon par mdzod cig muḥ/ /gshegs gsol yi ge brgya pa yis/ /las kyi skyon kun bsal bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa/ tidz+re dṛ ḍho me bha ba/ a nu rak+to me bha ba/ su toṣ+yo me bha ba/ su poṣ+yo me bha ba/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+t+waṃ gre yaḥ4ku ru hūṃ 5ha ha ha ha ho6/ bha ga bān 7sarba ta thā ga ta/ badz+ra mā me muñtsa/ badz+rī bha ba ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ/ de ltar brjod nas gtor ma rnams/ /mngon sum dus su phyogs bcur gtor/ /gzhan ma sa phyogs gtsang sar srung / /chu gnas sems can rnams dang ni/ /mi ni dbul ba rnams la sbyin/ /khye dang bya rog la sogs la/ /nan tan gyis ni sbyin mi bya/ /de bzhin de yis snarim pa yis/ /zhi ba la sogs ji bzhin du/ /rang 'dod phyogs su kha bltas te/ /de yis kha dog 'khor lor ldan/ /sngon bzhin phyogs bcur 7skyong ba rnams/ /22—778

bkug nas bsam pa'i nyon mongs bsal/ /shes bya'i sgrib pa yang bsal nas/ /de dag stong byas sa bon las/ /bsregs nas rje dpon du gyur pa/ /yi dam lha yi phyag mtshan sogs/ /spro dang bsdu ba byas nas su/ /snga ma'i rten ni gyur byas nas/ /thams cad kun mkhyen sku thob bya/ /'phro ba'i zer byung thugs dbang gis/ /phyogs bcu'i 1/khams kun khyab par byas/ /sku dang mkhyen pa byed pa dbang / /rgyas btab mtshan nyid shes byas nas/ /myur ba sa bon sogs tshul kyis/ /mchod byas dges rkebyas tshim par byas/ /gtor ma sngon bzhin byin brlabs nas/ /phul te tshim byas gnyis med kyi/ /ye shes yongs su myong bar bsam/ /yid kyis rdo rje dril bzung nas/ /mi bskyod la sogs tshigs bcad kyis/ /bstod pas dgyes te lan cig gsungs/ /de nas phrin las bsgrub pa rnams/ /bsgrub bya'i don du gsol ba btab //'di yis gtor ma byin brlabs 4sngags/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra dh+rika sarba duṭ+wā na sa ma ya mu dro pra t+t+waṃ dza ka ma ma sharnyi ku ru swā hā t+t+waṃ/ de bzhin rgyas pa'i mtha' ru oṃ/ /puṣ+ṭi ku ru zhes bya'o/ / dbang gi mtha' ru che ge mo/ /5ba shaṃ ku ru zhes bya'o/ /mngon spyod la ni hūṃ dang phaṭa/ /mā ra ya ni zhes bya'o/ /dgug pa'i mtha' ru dzaḥ6zhes bya'o/ /bskrad pa la ni phaṭa mthar bzhag /uts+tsha ta ya zhes pa'o/ /de bzhin las kyi bye brag gis/ /ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du sbyar/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i sngags rnams brjod/ /de dag rab tu dgyes bsams nas/ /rang gi gnas su gshegs su gsol//22—779

de ltar ma lus bstan pa yi/ /gtor ma'i cho ga mchog 'di ni/ /bla ma mchog gis legs sbyangs pa'i/ /sems dul dang ldan brtson 'grus can/ /gsang shes de nyid rig dzo/pa po/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs rtog pa'i tshogs/ /shes shing sgrub par lhur len pa/ /de la 'di ni sbyin par bya/ /gang zhig bla ma la mi gus/ /dad med 'jungs pa rnam g.yengs 3pa/ /le los sems sbyong rnam spangs pa/ /blun chen de la sbyin mi bya / / bdag gis gtor ma'i cho ga 'di byas dge ba yis/ /rnal 'byor 'di sgrub bar chad zhi zhing 'dod don grub/ /gtsug lag tshad mas rnal 'byor chen po'i lam bgrod de/ /bcu gsum dge ba rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar 'gro shog /4slob dpon chen po bi ta pā das mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la gu h+ya 5dang / bod kyi lo tsā tsab chen po mnga' bdag lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa7// //22—780
