༄khya/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī gu h+ya sa mā dza mya mañdzu shrī sā dha dze+e/bod skad du/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i 2'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/dpal 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa'i sku/ /skya gsung thugs ni rdo rje can/ /ye shes rnam pa lnga dang ldan/ /rtog pa ma lus kun las grol/ /thams cad ngo bo thams cad du/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo mchog dang ldan/ /'jam dpal de la phyag 'tshal nas/ /'gro ba'i byang chub thob pa'i rgyu/ /de yi sgrub pa'i cho ga mchog /ci nus bdag gis bshad par bya//dang po sngags pa bdag nyid ni/ /'jam pa'i stan la 'dug byas nas/ /rang gi snying gar zla ba la/ /tshe rabs sngon nas goms byas pa'i/ /tshad med bzhi po snying rje dang / /byams dang dga' dang btang snyoms te/ /tshangs spyod mtshan nyid bzhi rnams kyi/ /rgyu yi dngos po'i sa bon oṃ / /dam pa'i gur 22—835

gum lta bu yi/ /'od zer 'phro bar rnam par bsam/ /'gro rnams sdug bsngal mthong byas nas/ / grol 'don 1mtshan nyid snying rje'o/ /bde bar 'dod rnams mthong byas nas/ /phan pa'i bde ba ma lus pa/ /grub par 'dod pa byams pa'o/ /'gro rnams spyod pa mi mnyam zhing / /gdul dka' sbug bsngal lam la dga'/ /bde ba mi 'dod pa rnams kyi/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa dang / /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /bde ba mtha' yas dang ldan pa'i/ /ji ltar bdag gis bya bsams te/ /rang gi snying gar gnas pa'i saṃ 2 / /sangs rgyas kun gyi byin rlabs kyis / /'jam dbyangs 'grub pa'i rgyu bsams la/ /de nyid bcom ldan thams cad mkhyen/ /'gro ba 'dul ba'i thabs mkhyen pas/ /ji lta ji ltar 'dul 'gyur bas/ /de lta de ltar 'gro ba la/ /thabs kun rab tu ston mdzad pas/ /thabs nyid gang gis sems can rnams/ /sbug bsngal kun las grol ba dang / /bla med byang chub thob kyi bar/ /bde ba ma lus ldan 'grub pa/ /'di ltar bdag nyid 'jam dpal skur/ /'grub cing 'gro ba'i don byed pa'i/ /stobs dang ldan par bsam pa la/ /dga' ba'i mtshan nyid dga' ba'o/ /bsgoms 4pas byang chub nges byed phyir/ /'jig rten bya ba mi byed pa'i/ /mtshan nyid btang snyoms chen po ste/ /de rnams nges par bsam par bya'o/ /'jam dpal nyid du bsgrub pa yang / /bsod nams med par mi 'grub pas/ /sbyin pa la sogs 'grub pa'i rgyu/ /dbul phyir bdag gis mi nus pas/ /snyeng gar yid bzhin nor bu ltar/ /'gro ba'i don kun 'grub byed pa'i/ /saṃ nyid rab tu dran byas te/ /de 'od las byung nam mkha' la/ /bla ma dam pa sangs rgyas rnams/ /22—836

sras dang bcas par gsal byas nas/ /de yi 'od zer las byung ba/ /spyan la stsogs pa'i lha mo bcus/ /dngos su gsang ba'i mchod pa dang / /gzhan yang phyi yi mchod pa'i sprin/ /rin chen bdun dang mchod pa lnga/ /dri yi phye ma sna tshogs gos/ /sna tshogs rgyan dang phreng ba dang / /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang / /rnga yab sbrang yab bsil yab dang / /rta dang glang po bud med tshogs—/ /seng ge gdan dang bla re sogs/ /ji snyed brtan pa'i sems kyis su / /mchod pa byas nas phyag kyang bya/ /thog ma med pa'i srid rgyun man chad blo gros rnam rtog las byung ma lus tshang sdig gang / /thugs rje cher ldan ma lus mdun du cho ga de bzhin de rnams bdag gis bshags par bya/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang de bzhin 'phags dang gzhan rnams kyis ni dge ba gang mdzad pa/ /de rnams lhag med rjes su yi rang bla med byang chub chen por yang dag bdag gis bsngo/ /spro byed dri med thugs ni zla ba lta bus 1mtha' yas thugs rje dam pa'i thabs rnams la/ /bde bar gshegs pa kun la bdag nyid nang 'khor spyod bzhin rtag tu rab tu skyabs su mchi/ /rtog pa ji snyed ma lus grol ba lhag rnged dam pa'i sems can phun sum tshogs pa'i rten2 / /ji snyed thams cad ro gcig dngos po chos la bdag nyid kyis ni rab tu skyabs su mchi / /yang dag bcings pa ma lus grol ba'i thugs mchog dang ldan kun gyi dpal nyid yang dag bstod/ /rab dga' la stsogs sa bcur bzhugs rnams rab tu byung bdag tshogs la yang dag skyabs su mchi/ /bsam pa'i ngo bo rnam smin dag phyir sgrib pa'i bag chags thams cad yang dag shin tu bcom/ /yongs su grol ba'i sems ni rnam brgyan bla med byang chub la ni yang dag bskyed 22—837

—par bya/ /sras ldan bde bar gshegs dang lam gcig tu ni spyin sogs yon tan dkar po dngos po ste/ /ma lus yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rang bzhin blo yis da ltar bdag gis brten par bgyi4/ /'jig rten ma lus 'di rnams lta ba'i dra bas bcings pa la ni snying rje chen po bskyed/ /bla med byang chub sems ni dri med rin chen bdag gis yang dag gos pas 2yongs su bsam par bya/ /rang bzhin dang bral stong pa nyid/ /rgyu med pas ni mtshan ma med/ /so sor rtog gi kun bral bas/ /ji snyed smon pa ma lus bral/ /de skad lan gsum brjod par bya/ /bsod nams tshogs ni rdzogs byas nas/ /ye shes tshogs kyi don du ni/ /stong pa nyid ni bsam par bya/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ sngags 'di bzlas pa byas nas su/ /'gro ba kun gyi lus ngag yid/ /de rnams bdag gis ngo bo gcig /rang bzhin med phyir lus ngag yid/ /de rnams rang bzhin btags pa tsam/ /gang phyir brtags par rang 'dod de/ /de phyir rang bzhin lus ngag yid/ /oṃ s+dzahūṃ yig gsum byas la/ /hoḥ gnyis bar na rab gnas pa/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng du ni/ /mdun gyi mkha' la bsam par bya/ /byang chub sgrub pa'i dus su ni / /bar du gcod pa'i bgegs bsal phyir/ /mdun du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ /nag bo hūṃ las byung ba yi/ /rdo rje 'od zer 'bar ba can/ /de yi 'od zer rab 'phros pas/ /mtshams kyi phyi rol dag na 4ni/ /bgegs rnams phur bus gdab par bya/ /phyogs dang mtshams su 'phros pa yis rdo rje'i ra ba rab brtsigs te/ /steng du 'phros pas rdo rje gzeb/ /'og tu 'akro ba rnams las 5su/ /rdo rje'i sa gzhir bsam par bya/ /bdud dang bral ba'i 22—838

sems kyis su/ /de yi dbus su rdo rje sems/ /'og nas 'byung ba lta bur bsam / /de las chos 'byung phyag rgyar 41dkar/ /grub nyid phra mo mar bltas nas / /gyen du 'greng ba rab gnas pas/ /nang nyid nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /dbus su ser po paṃ las byung / /sna tshogs pad+ma rnam 2bsams te/ /de steng khaṃ ni ljang gu las/ /sna tshogs rdo rje bsam par bya/ /de steng zla ba'i dbus su ni / /dkar po bye las byung ba yi/ /rtsibs brgyad 'khor lo'i lte ba la/ /bye gyis mtshan pa rnam par bsam/ /de las snang mdzad rig mar bcas /de las byung ba'i gzhal med khang / /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /twa ra ṇa bzhis brgyan pa ste/ /ha ra ha ra phyed pas brgyan/ /sna tshogs pad+ma bcu dgu'i steng //nyi ma'i gdan ni bdun rnams dang / /zla ba bcu gnyis dang ldan pa/ /de lta bu ni rnam par bsam/ /de yi dbus kyi zla ba la/ /yi ge gsum la gnas pa'i sems / /rab tu goms par bsam byas te/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams gnas pa'i/ /bde gshegs 'gro ba ma lus rnams/ /byang chub rgyu la nges byed pas/ /de yi dus su gzigs par bya/ /de rnams mngon dga' sgrub rten du/ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin gyis4/ /sgra yig bcu drug nyis 5'gyur dang / /gnas kyi yi ge sum cu bzhi/ /ya ra la wa ḍa bhār lhag /bzhi bcu nyis 'gyur du byas pa'i/ /yi ge brgyad cu gzugs su 'gyur/ /de nas gzhal med khang pa yi/ /steng gi mkha' la 'byor gyur nas/ /de rnams ye shes kyis bskul te/ /sems nyid drangs nas gcig tu 'gyur/ /de nas nang gi zla ba la/ /yi ge phreng 6ba rim pa gnyis/ /'og dang steng du gnas pa las//thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin dang / /smon dang 'jug pa'i sems dang ni/ /22—839

mtshan dang dpe byad rang bzhin gyi/ /zla ba gnyis su 'grub par bya/ /de gnyis dri med 'od gsal phyir/ /me long ye shes mngon gyur pa'o/ /de gnyis gcig tu gyur pa ni/ /mnyam nyid gcig tu mthong ba'o/ /de las dkar po t+t+waṃ du gyur/ /de las rdo rje dmar po nyid/ /hūṃ gis mtshan pa bsam bya ste/ /oṃ badz+ra āt+ma kophohaṃ zhes/ bdag la de yi nga rgyal bya/ /de nyid kun rtog ye shes so/ /de nas dh+ri las byung ba yi/ /bde gshegs rnams kyis ji snyed pa'i/ /'gro ba bde gshegs nyid byas nas/ /hūṃ gi nang du thim byas te/ /oṃ ya tha 1sarba ta thā ga ta ā haṃ zhes/ bdag la de yi nga rgyal bya/ /nan tan ye shes mthong ba'o/ /dh+ri gi 'od zer gyis bskul nas/ /nam mkhar gnas pa'i bde gshegs rnams/ /t+t+waṃ nyid la ni thim par bya/ /de gnyis zhu bar gyur pa las / /dbus zhal sku ni chu shel mdog /g.yas dang g.yas min gnag dang dmar / /dbu brgyan 4mi bskyod pas gnon pasade/ /rdo rje skyil mo krung bcas shing / /zla ba'i gdan dang rgyab rten ldan/ /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan / /phyag gnyis bdag 'od rig ma 'khyud/ /g.yas gnyis rdo rje ral gri ste//g.yon gnyis rin chen pad+ma 'dzin/ /de 'dra'i rnam pa dang ldan pa'i/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab tu bsgom/ /de nyid shin tu rnam dag pa'i/ /chos dbyings ye shes rab rdzogs pa'o/ /de nas 'dod chags chen po yis/ /'dul ba'i 'jig rten mthong gyur 6nas/ /bde ba'i sgra yis rgyal ba'i tshogs/ /bskul nas byon par gyur pa rnams/ /ba spu'i bu gar )thim gyur nas/ /mi snang bar ni rgyas gyur te/ /rang gi rig ma dga' bar byas/ /de nas thim pa'i rgyal ba'i tshogs/ /rang rang rigs dang yongs 'byel pa'i/ /spyan 22—810

la sogs pa'i lha mo gzugs/ /reg gi rdo rje ma yi bar/ /rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /spros te yum gyi ba spu yi/ /bu gar thim pas thabs nyid mnyes/ /de nas ye shes sems dpa' yi/ /sa bon 'od kyis bde gshegs rnams/ /bkug nas zhal du lam zhugs nas/ /sku la thim nas zhu byas te/ /rdo rjer lam byung pad+mar gnas/ /de las rdo rje sems dpa' nyid/ /gtsor byas lha ni bcu dgu yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rab tu bsam/ /de nang blo yis sems can rnams/ /sgo bzhi'i lam nas zhugs par bsam/ /de nas ye shes sems dpa' ni/ /'od kyis bde gshegs rnams bkug nas/ /zhal gyi lam zhugs zhu byas te/ /rdo rjer lam byung dbang yang bskur/ /de yi mthu yis sems can rnams/ /bde dang yid bde thob par 'gyur/ /ji ltar rim par dbye ba yi / /mig dang rna ba sna dang ni/ /lce dang lus dang yid dag dang / /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes dang / /'du byed rnam shes rnam dag pas/ /de las k+ṣiṃ rjo 1khaṃ shaṃ sko gusaṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ khaṃ re lo māṃ paṃ t+t+waṃri / bye māṃ dz+rī 4khaṃ hūm̐ zhes bya ba'i sa bon rnams su gyur/ de las 'khor lo rdo rje dang / /rin po che dang pad+ma dang / /ral gri dang ni rdo rje dang / /me long pi wang dri yi cang ro yi snod dang sna tshogs gos/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas phyag rgya dang / /'khor lo ut+pal dmar po dang / /pad+ma dmar dang ut+pal ser/ /'khor lo rin chen pad+ma dang / /ral gri rdo rje phyag mtshan rnams/ /rang rang sa bon mtshan par gnas—/ /sa bon phyag mtshan de nyid las/ /sa snying phyag na rdo rje dang / /nam snying 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / /sgrib pa rnam sel kun du bzang / /22—81/

gzugs sgra dri ro reg dang ni/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rdo rje dang / /sbyan yangs ma dang mā ma shī/ /gos dmar 1mo dang sgrol ma dang / /rnam snang mdzad dang rin chen 'byung / /snang mtha' yas dang don yod grub/ /mi bskyod pa rnams rab tu grub/ /de nas pad+ma'i gzhal yas nas/ /blo yis — phyi rol dbyung byas te / /de rnams phan par shes nas su/ /bcom ldan phyag 'tshal bstod byas nas / /bcom ldan sems can don du ni/ /mkha' la phyogs bcur spros par bsam/ /'gro ba'i dbang bskur rdzogs byas nas/ /rang gi zhal gyi lam du ni/ /yi ge gsum nyid zhugs byas te/ /zhugs nas rdo rje'i lam nas su/ /pad+mo dbus su babs par bya/ /de yi 'od zer dmar 'phros pas/ /reg pas yab yum gnyi ga yang / /'dod chags chen po'i me yis ni/ /yongs su zhu bar gyur par bsam/ /de nas khu ba de nyid las/ /mā ma ṭā ni dbyung byas nas / /lho nub mtshams kyi grwar bzhag ste/ /dbyangs kyis bskul bar bsgom byas te/ /rdo rje thugs khrod sems can dbyings kyi khams kyi dbang phyug ste/ /dga' ba'i rnam pa 4yid 'ong mkhyen pa bdag la thar par 5mdzad du gsol/ /sems can skyed 6byed gnyen mchog 'dod pa'i don chen rnams kyis ni/ /mgon po bdag ni gson par mchis bzhes dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ / ci 'chad 7'di yis bsgul ma thag /khu ba nyid la thim par bya/ /rim bzhin lha mo gsum po yang / /khu ba nyid las phyung nas ni/ /me dang rlung dang dbang ldan grwar/ /gnas nas bskul bar byed par bsam/ /rdo rje sku khyod sems can kun gyis 9dga' bar mkhyen pa po/ /sangs rgyas 'khor lo don du don dam byang chub bstan pa can/ /mgon po chen po bdag nyid legs —par 22—8 2

gson par mchis bzhed na/ /'dod chags kyis ni 'dod chags dam tshig bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /rdo rje gsung khrod thams cad kyis 1ni thugs rje dang ldan pa/ /'jig rten don gyi dgos pa'i don kun dam pa'i spyod pa can/ /mgon po chen po bdag nyid gal te gson par mchis bzhed na/ /kun du bzang po bde bar spyod pa bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /rdo rje 'dod pa khyed 2 ni dam tshig mchog gi phan don che/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gsung dngos mnyam pa'i thugs rje can/ /mgon po chen po bdag nyid gal te gson par mchis bzhed na/ /yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter bzhin bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /rim bzhin dbyangs kyis bskul ma thag /rim pa bzhin du thim par byas/ /lha mos bsgul pa'i dbang gis su/ /byang chub sems byung sa bon saṃ/ /gur gum mdog 'drar rnam bsams te/ /de las ral gri'i yu ba la/ /zla ba'i steng du saṃ gyis mtshan/ /de yi 'od kyi mkha' dbyings na/ /gnas pa'i bde bar gshegs pa rnams/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i 4sgur byas te/ /bkug nas baṃ la zhugs par bya/ /de gnyis zhu bar gyur pa las/ /dbus zhal sgu ni gur gum mdog /g.yas dang g.yas min gnag dang dkar/ /phyag gnyis rang 'od rig ma 'khyud/ /g.yas gnyis ral gri mda' 'dzin pa/ /g.yon gnyis gzhu dang ut+pal sngo/ /rin chen dbu rgyan dang ldan pa/ /rdo rje skyil krung shin tu brten5/ /rgyan rnams so sor brgyan byas pa'i/ /'jam dbyangs dpal dang ldan pa bsam/ /oṃ dhadz+re 6dhā tu swa bhā wa āt+ma kophohaṃ/chos kyi dbyings su byin gyis brlab/ /gnyen po'i bsnyen pa'i yan lag dang / /'dra bar 'byung ba'i 'bras bu'o/ /de nas rang gi mig gnyis kyi/ /dbus su 22—8 3

zla ba re re la/ /k+ṣi nyedakar po las byung ba yi/ /'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i/ /lte bar k+ṣi yis spumatshan pa bsam/ /de las sa yi snying po nyid/ /g.yas gnag g.yon ni dmar ba'i zhal/ /g.yas gnyis 'khor lo ral gri 'dzin//g.yon gnyis nor bu pad+ma 'dzin/ /rna ba'i bu ga gnyis po la/ /zla ba'i dbus su nag po rjo3/ /de las rdo rje dz+re gis mtshan/ /de las phyag na rdo rje nyid / /g.yas dang g.yon dkar dmar ba'i skye zhal/ /g.yas gnyis rdo rje ral gri 'dzin/ /g.yon gnyis nor bu pad+mar ldan/ /sna yi bu ga gnyis po la/ /zla ba'i dbus su khaṃ ser po/ /de las rin chen ljang gu ni/ /khaṃ gis mtshan pa las byung ba'i/ /nam mkha'i snying po bsam par bya/ /g.yas sngo g.yon ni dkar ba'i zhal/ /g.yas gnyis nor bu ral gri 'dzin/ /g.yon gnyis 'khor lo pad+ma 'dzin/ /lce dbus zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /dmar po shaṃ las byung ba yi/ /pad+ma shaṃ gis mtshan pa bsam/ /de las 'jig rten dbang phyug nyid / /g.yas gnag g.yon ni dkar ba'i zhal/ /g.yas gnyis pad+ma ral gri 'dzin / /g.yon gnyis nor bu 'khor lo 'dzin/ /dpral ba'i dbus su zla ba la/ /sko tre/nyid ljang gu las byung ba'i/ /ral gri'i 3yu ba sko byegis mtshan//de las sgrib pa rnam 9sel nyid/ /g.yas sngo g.yon ni dkar ba'i zhal/ /g.yas gnyis 'khor lo ral gri 'dzin/ /g.yon gnyis nor bu pad+ma 'dzin/ /lte ba'i dbus su zla ba la/ /dkar po saṃ las byung ba yi/ /rdo rje bum pa saṃ gis mtshan/ /de las kun du bzang po nyid/ /g.yas gnag g.yon ni dmar ba'i zhal/ /g.yas gnyis rdo rje ral gri 'dzin/ /g.yon gnyis nor bu pad+ma 'dzin / /rang rang sa bon ji lta bar/ /dbus kyi zhal dang mtshan ma dang / /22—811

sku rnams kun yang de bzhin du2/ /rdo rje skyil krung rab brtan zhing / /phyag gnyis rang 'od rig ma 'khyud/ /rin chen dbu rgyan ldan pa'o/ /bsnyen pa'i grub pa'i yan lag dang / /rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /de nas snying ga'i zla ba la/ /nag po hūṃ las byung ba yi/ /rdo rje bum pa'i nyahūṃ gis mtshan/ /de nas rdo rje bum pa las1/ /hūṃ gis mtshan pa bsgom byas te/ /nang gi t+t+waṃ dang rdo rje las/ /phyag na rdo rje lta bu yi/ /thugs kyi rdo rje bsam byas te/ /de yi thugs kar zla ba la/ /hūṃ gis mtshan pa bsam par bya/ /lce rtsa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /dmar po āḥ④las byung ba yi/ /pad+ma'i dbus na āḥsayis mtshan / /de las pad+ma āḥthus mtshan pa/ /nang gi āḥ7dang pad+ma las/ /'jig rten— dbang phyug lta bu yi/ /ngag gi rdo rje bsam byas te/ /de yi thugs kar zla ba la/ /āḥ3las pad+ma dbus su yang / / āḥyis 9mtshan pa bsam par bya/ /mgo dbus zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /oṃ las 'khor lo'i 7lte ba la/ /oṃ gyis mtshan pa bsam par bya/ /de las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan/ /nang gi oṃ dang 'khor lo las/ /sa yi snying po lta bu yi/ /sku yi rdo rje bsam par bya/ /de yi thugs kar zla ba la/ /oṃ las 'khor lo lte ba la/ /oṃ gyis mtshan pa bsam par bya/ /de nas thugs sogs rdo rje yi/ /thugs las 'od zer rab spros nas/ /spyan sogs lha mo bcu rnams kyis/ /mkha' la gnas pa'i bde gshegs rnams/ /so so thugs ka la sogs la/ /gnas pa'i thugs sogs rdo rje la/ /mchod nas zhu ba gsol bar bya/ /dpal ldan thugs ni rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /de ring bdag dbang byen gyis rlobs/ /rdo rje thugs can mdzad du gsol/ /de ni rang gis bsgom 1 pa 22—845

la'o / /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms kun/ /de ring bdag dbang byin gyis rlobs7/ /rdo rje thugs can mdzad du gsol/ /de ni lhun gyis grub pa yi/ /thugs ka na ni gnas pa la'o//de nas lhun gyis grub pa yi/ /thugs kyi rdo rje ma lus rnams/ /rang gi nyid la zhugs byas la/ /oṃ sadze+e ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma kophohaṃ/ zhes gnyis su med par byin kyis brlab/ /chos kyi ngag lam dpal dang ldan/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /de ring bdag dbang byin gyis rlobs2/ /rdo rje gsung can mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams / /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms kun/ /de ring bdag dbang byen gyis rlobs/ /rdo rje gsung can mdzad du gsol/ /de yis de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /gsung gi rdo rje ji snyed rnams/ /rang gi nyid la zhugs byas la oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bāka badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma kophohaṃ/ zhes gnyis su med par byin gyis brlab/ /dpal ldan sku ni rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas / /de ring bdag dbang byin gyis zlobs/ /rdo rje sgu can mdzad du gsol / /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms kun/ /de ring bdag dbang byin gyis rlobs/ /rdo rje sku can mdzad du gsol/ /de yis de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /sku yi rdo rje ji snyed rnams / /rang gi nyid la zhugs byas la/ /oṃ sadze+e ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma kophohaṃ/ zhes gnyis su med par byin gyis brlab/ /bsnyen pa'i sgrub pa'i yan lag dang / /skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /de nas nu ma'i bar du ni / /zla ba'i dbus su rma las byung / /ral gri'i yu ba oṃ gyis mtshan/ /de 22—8 6

nas ral gri'i yu ba la'ang / /saṃ gis mtshan par rab bsams te/ /nang gi de gnyis las byung ba'i/ /dam tshig sems dpa' 'dra ba yi/ /ye shes sems dpa' gnas dang bcas/ /de yi thugs kar zla ba la/ /rma las ral gri'i yu ba la'ang / /zla ba'i steng du rma bsams te/ /de yi 'od zer gyis bsgul nas/ /nam mkhar gnas pa'i bde gshegs rnams/ /so sor 'od zer las byung ba'i/ /spyan sogs lha mo bcu rnams kyis/ /bum pa'i ye shes chu rgyun gyis/ /dri ma med byas dbang bskur zhesahūṃ/ /chu dang lha mo skur thim ste/ /mi bskyod dbu rgyan rab tu grub/ /bsnyen pa'i sgrub pa chen po yi2/ /dri ma med pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /de nas mdun du zla ba bsam/ /yi ge gsum la gnas byed pa'i/ /rnal 'byor pa yi sems nyid ni/ /bag chags dngos po gang yin de/ /zla ba'i dbus su gnas byas la/ /sngon bzhin 'gro ba'i byang chub rgyur/ /'thad pa'i bde gshegs ma lus kyis/ /zla ba'i gnyis pa grub la sogs/ /mngon par byang chub rnam pa lngas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab tu bsgom / /gnyi ga'i dga' ba dag dang ni/ /'gro ba 4dbang bskur ma byas par / /snga ma bzhin du yi ge gsum/ /zhal gyi lam du zhugs byas nas/ /zhu nas rdo rje'i 5lam nas su/ /phyung nas pad+mo'i 6nang du gnas/ /de yi 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /'od rigs bcas par zhu bar gyur/ /lha mos dbyangs kyis bskul ba las/ /khu ba las byung saṃ gyi 7mdog /gur gum lta bu las byung ba'i / /ral gri'i yu bar zla ba'ang / /oṃ gyis mtshan pa bsam byas te/ /de yi 'od kyis mkha' dbyings na/ /gnas pa'i bde gshegs ji snyed rnams/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje mar byas te/ /bkug nas de la zhugs par bya/ /mo 9dang 22—847

ral gri de gyur pas/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje lta bu yi/ /'jam dbyangs ma ni bdag nyid kyis1/ /'od kyi thabs la 'khyud pa bsgom/ /oṃ dhan+d+ra rtedhā tu swa bhā wa āt+ma kophohaṃ/ zhes bdag nyid nga rgyal bskyed par bya/ /bar gyi bsnyen pa'i yan lag dang / /'dra bar 'byung ba'i 'bras bu'o/ /de nas sngon du bstan pa bzhin/ /mig la sogs pa byin gyis brlab/ /bar gyi nye ba'i bsgrub pa dang / /rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /sngon bzhin thugs sogs rdo rje rnams / /grub par 'gyur bar jirab bsgoms te/ /sngar gyis byin gyis brlabs pa tsam/ /bar gyi grub pa'i yan lag dang / /skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /de nas 'jam pa'i rdo rje yi/ /ye shes sems dpa'i sa bon gyi/ /'od kyis bde gshegs ma lus rnams/ /bskul ba'i 'od zer las byung ba'i/ /spyan la sogs pas dbang bsgur nas/ /mi bskyod dbu rgyan ldan par bya/ /bar gyi sgrub pa chen po dang / /dri ma med pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /de nas skra yi lam nang gi/ /zla ba'i dbus su oṃ dkar po/ /sku yi rigs kyi rang bzhin te//de yi oṃ ni phra mo yis/ /nu ma yan lag 5khyab par bsam/ /snying gar nyi ma steng du ni/ /nag po hūṃ ni bsam bya ba/ /thugs kyi rigs kyi rang bzhin te/ /de yi t+t+waṃ ni phra mo yis/ /lte ba yan chad khyab par bsam/ /lte ba'i 'og tu nyi ma la/ /swā nyid ser po rin chen rigs/ /de yi swā ni phra mo yis/ /rked pa yan chad khyab par bsam/ /gsang ba'i dbus su nyi ma la/ /āḥ5nyid dmar po 'dod chags rigs/ /de las 'phros pa'i āḥ7rnams kyis/ /rked pa ma lus khyab par bsam/ /brla gnyis dbus nas dānyi ma la/ /hā nyid ljang gu las kyi rigs/ /de yi hā 9ni phra mo rnams/ /rkang mthil yan chad khyab par 22—848

bsam—/ /rigs lnga'i tshogs dang ldan byas te/ /dh+ri gis rang gi rdo rje nyid/ /bum par byas pa bsam byas nas/ /oṃ gyis bu ga grub par bya/ /de yi nang du phaṭa ser po/ /rang gi rig ma'i pad+ma la/ /nag po hūṃ nyid phra mo yis/ /khyab par rab tu bsam byas nas/ /āḥyis 1snying po 'grub bya zhing / /bu gar phaṭa kyang bsam par bya/ /gnas skabs lnga dang gyur pa yi2/ /shes rab ma nyid grub byas la/ /rang gi gye'od zer gyis bsgul nas/ /rang gi rig ma nyid la thim/ /oṃ sat+tha ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma kolhahaṃ/ zhes sngags nyid rab tu bzlas par bya/ dang po'i rnal 'byor gyi ting nge 'dze+en rdzogs so// //de nas rang gi sa bon gyi/ /'od kyis bde gshegs rnams bkug ste/ /zhal du zhugs te zhu gyur nas/ /pad+ma'i nang du 'bab par bya/ /de las gyur pa'i sa bon oṃ/ /de las gtso bo mi bskyod pa/ /'khor lor bcas pa bskor zibyas te/ /'phro ba'i sngags kyis rim bzhin spro/ /badz+ra dh+rika 5zhes pas su/ /phyag na rdo rje lta bu yi/ /mi bskyod pa ni 'phro byas te/ /sangs rgyas bya ba kun mdzad nas/ /'dus nas bdag la zhugs par bya/ /dzi na dzika ka zhes pas su//sa yi snying po lta bu yi/ /gong ma lta bu rnam snang mdzad/ /'phros te 'dus nas rang mdun du/ /shar gyi zla bar gnas par bsam/ /rat+na dh+rika 6zhes pas su//nam mkha'i snying po 'dra ba yi/ /rin chen 'byung ldan 'phros byas nas/ /lho yi nyi mar gnas par bsam/ /ā ro loka zhes pas su/ /'jig rten dbang phyug 'dra ba yi/ /'od dpag med pa 'phros byas nas/ /nub kyi nyi mar 22—87 9

gnas par bya/ /pradzñā dh+rika 1ces pas su/ /sgrib pa rnam sel 'dra ba yi/ /don yod grub pa 'phro byas nas/ /byang gi nyi mar gnas par bsam/ /kun kyang ral pa'i dbu rgyan can/ /gsum po nyi ma'i 'od dang ni/ /snang mdzad zla ba'i 'od 'dra ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor rgyab brten 2ldan pa'o/ /mo ha ra tī zhes pas su/ /sa yi snying po lta bu yi/ /spyan ma shar lho mtshams su bsam/ /dwo ṣa ra t+t+waṃ 4zhes pas su/ /phyag na rdo rje lta bu yi/ /mā ma tī ni lho nub mtshams / /rā ga ra ṭī 5zhes pas su/ /'jig rten dbang phyug 'dra ba yi/ /gos dkar mo ni nub byang mtshams/ /badz+ra ra tī cezhes bya bas/ /nam mkha'i snying po 'dra ba yi/ /sgrol ma byang shar mtshams su bsam/ /de rnams rtsa ba'i phyag mtshan ni/ /'khor lo ut+pal pad+ma dmar/ /ut+pal ser por shes par bya/ /'khor lo phyi rol grwa bzhi dang / /shar gyi g.yas g.yon phyogs gnyis la/ /de nyid gsum gyi gong ma ltar/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya dang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi rdo rje ma/ /sa snying la sogs 'dra ba 7 rnams/ /me long pi wang dri yi dung / /ro yi snod dang sna tshogs gos/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas phyag rgya rnams / /rim bzhin rtsa ba'i phyag mtshan ldan/ /ya man+ta kṛta ces pas su/ /mi bskyod lta bu'i gshin rje gshed/ /gong ma lta bu 9shar sgor bsam/ /pradzñān+ta kṛta ces pas su/ /rnam par snang mdzad lta bu yi/ /shes rab mthar byed nyi ma'i gdan/ /nyi ma'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis 1/ /bye brag byas pa lho sgor bsam / /pad+mān+ta sakṛta ces pas su/ /'od dpag med pa lta bu yi1 / /pad+ma mthar byed nub sgor bsam/ /bibyān+ta ཿkṛta ces pas su/ /gshin rje mthar 'byin lta bu yi/ /bgegs mthar 'byin pa byang gi sgor/ /de rnams rtsa 22—850

ba'i phyag mtshan ni/ /rdo rje tho ba rdo rje dbyig /pad+ma rdo rje kha dbye 1ba'o/ /kun kyang g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang zhabs/ /zhal ni dgod ༄dang gdangs pa dang / /khro dang mche ba gcigs par ldan/ /lcags 'dril spyan zlum 'dril ba dang / /nyi ma gsar shar lta bu dang / /zhal ni khyo gnyer dang ldan pa/ /gsus pa che zhing yangs pa dang / /sra zhing phye ba 'phyang bar ldan/ /brla dang brang yang de bzhin te/ /lus dang yan lag thams cad / kun/ /thung zhing rab tu sbom pa dang / /sma ra dmar ser 'od dang ldan/ /skra yang dmar ser 'od dang ldan/ /gyen du 'khyel zhing 'bar ba ste/ /'od zer 'bar bar ldan pa rnams/ /rang 'od rig ma sma ra med/ /dang po phyag gis 4'khyud pa dang / /stag lpags smad g.yogs dang ldan pa/ / bung ba nag po lta bu yi/ /mtha' yas dbu yi thod du bcings/ /mdog dmar drag po lta bu yi/ /'jog po yi ni snyan cha dang / /pad+ma chen po dkar po yis/ /do sha'/ rgyan ni byas pa ste/ /stobs rgyu ljang gu se ral kha/ /dung skyong ser pos phyag gdub byas/ /kha dog sna tshogs lta bu yi/ /rigs lda na gyi ni dpung rgyan dang / /nor rgyas mdog dkar ska rags byas/ /pad+ma'i rtsa ba lta bu yi/ /pad+mas rkang gdub byas pa yi8/ /de rnams rab tu bsam par bya / /de nas rang gi sa bon gyi/༷/ /'od zer lcags kyu 'dra rnams kyis/ /khro bo bzhi yi thusas bsgul nas/ /gshin rje gshed kyis dzaḥ kaizhes brjod/ /de yi thugs las 'phros pa yi/ /khro bo rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bgegs rnams med par bsrung byas te/ /lcags kyus dgug par byas nas su/ /rdo rje ra ba bshig byas te/ /zhugs te rang gi mdun du rgo/ /sna tshogs pad+mar gnas/ par bsam/ /de nas snying 3sde3 8kye/

nas 'phros pa yi1/ /khro bo rnams kyi ra ba nyid/ /bshig pa brtsigs par byas nas su/ /phyir yang snying la zhugs par bya/ /de nas rang gi mdun du ni/ /man ji thu7gsum la dung phor gsum/ /me tog dkar po dang ldan pa/ /tsan+dan chu yis gang bar byas/ /de mdun man ji gruganyis steng du/ /gser dang rin chen las byas pa'i/ /gsol ba'i snod gnyis gzhag par bya/ /g.yas phyogs dung gi gsum pa la/ /'og nas 'byung ba'i cho gas su/ /byin brlabs bdud rtsi lnga blugs 5bya/ /yi ge gsum gyi bar byas te/ /yi dam lha yi sngags bzlas la / /ku sha'i bam po dang po yi/ /dung gi chu yis gsol ba'i snod/ /dang po lan gsum btung gtor bya/ /gnyis pa'i chu dang me tog bcas/ /bzung ste de yi snod nyid la/ /lan gsum nye reg sbyin par bya/ /gsum pa bdud rtsi dang ldan pas/ /gnyis pa mchod yon chu yang sbyin/ /de nas me tog bzung byas te/ /zhabs bsil phyag rgya dang ldan par/ /de yi snod la zhabs bsil sbyin / /de nas rang snying 'od zer gyis/ /shes rab mthar byed bskul byas nas / /de yis 6dh+ri brjod snying las su/ /byung ba'i 'od zer dkar po yis/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor bteg byas nas/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor zhugs par bya/ /de nas rang snying 'od zer gyes/ /pad+ma mthar byed bskul byas nas/ /de yis baṃ brjod thugs las su/ /'od zer ser po 'phros pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor khyab par byas nas bcing / /de nas rang snying 'od zer gyis/ /bgegs mthar phyin pa bskul byas nas/ /de yis hoḥ7brjod de snying las/ /'od zer dmar po 'phros pa yis/ /khyab par rab tu dga' bar bsam/ /yang dag bsnyen pa'i yan lag dang / /'dra bar 'byung ba'i 'bras bu'o/ /kun gyi mig 22—802

la sogs pa rnams/ /sa yi snying po la sogs par/ /rdzogs pa'i tshul gyis byin gyis brlabs/ /yang dag sgrub pa'i yan lag dang / /rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /de rnams kun la gnas gsum du/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje nyid—/ /sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs byas te/ /rdzogs pa'i tshul du bsgom par bya/ /yang dag bsgrub rmye pa yan lag dang / /skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu'o//rang gi sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /bskul nas nam mkhar gnas pa yi3 bde gshegs rnams kyi 'od zer las/ /spyan sogs lha mo bcu rnams kyi / /dbang bskur byas nas dbu rgyan la/ /rang rang bdag po grub bya ba/ /bde gshegs lnga dang mā ma tī/ /sgra dang chos dbyings rdo rje dang / /shes rab mthar phyin bgegs mthar phyin/ /de rnams bdag po mi bskyod pa/ /spyan ma gzugs kyi rdo rje dang / /gshin rje mthar phyin rnam snang mdzad/ /dri yi rdo rje rin chen 'byung / /ro yi rdo rje gos dkar mo/ /pad+ma mthar phyin 'od dpag med / /sgrol ma reg gi rdo rje ma'i/ /dbu rgyan bdag po don yod grub/ /mi bskyod dbu rgyan rdo rje sems/ /sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag dang / /dri ma med pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /de nas rang gi sa bon/ gyi/ /'od kyis 4bde gshegs rnams bkug ste/ /zhal du zhugs nas zhu byas la/ /pad+mo'i sadabus su 'bab par bya/ /khu ba de las gyur pa yi/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ6khaṃ ram̐ zhes/ /dang po'i phreng ba dang ldan pa/ /de steng oṃ lo paṃ tai zhes/ /gzhan gyi steng du gnas par bya / /rang gi sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /gzugs sogs rdo rje dgug byas la/ /rang rang sa bon la ni thim/ /de yi sa bon rgyas par 'gyur/ /rig ma'i ba sru'i bu ga nas/ /sa bon rnams las 'od 'phros te/ /dkyil 'khor las ni 7 22—853

mthong bar bya/ /de las byung ba'i spyan la sogs/ /dkyil 'khor la ni 'phro byas la/ /rang rang rigs dang 'brel rnams kyirte/ /rang gi 'khor lo rab tu mchod / /oṃ sat+tha ta thā ga ta pū 2dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes sngags kyang rab tu brjod par bya/ /de nas rab tu bstod par bya/ /mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /dbyangs kyi rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ / rdo rje bdud rtsi rgyal po che/ / rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po shin tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med/ /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha'i rdo rje 'chang //'dod chags pha rol phyin pa thob/ /'od gsal rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje don grub rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs su grub/ /rang bzhin dag pa nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nas sa bon yo gi mdog /du ba lta bu las byung ba'i/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu lta bu/ /g.yas g.yon ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ /yo gis mtshan pa bsam par bya/ /de steng ram̐ ni dmar po las/ /byung ba'i me yi dkyil 'khor ni/ /gru gsum 'bar ba ram̐ gyis mtshan/ /de steng a dkar byung ba yi/ /pad+ma'i sgod ni a yis mtshan/ /de nang dbus kyi phyogs dang ni/ /shar sgo nub byang phyogs bzhi ru/ /rim bzhin dri chu dri chen dang / /rak+ta dang ni byang chub sems / /ma hā saṃ sa gzhag par bya/ /de steng shar du zla ba dang / /lhag ma bzhi ni nyi ma'i 4gdan/ /de steng hūṃ bye s+t+waṃ dz+rī 5khaṃ/ /sa bon rnam lnga mthong 22—851

byas nas/ /ye shes sems dpa'i sa bon gyi/ /'od kyis bde gshegs rnams bkug ste/ /rang rang sa bon nyid du thim/ /de nas rlung gis me bskyod nas/ /me yi thod pa btsos pa yi/ /rlangs pa las byung hūṃ gi tshogs/ /dkar po las byung rdo rje'i snatshogs/ /bum pa hūṃ gis mtshan par 2bsam/ /de rnams phreng ba lta bu'i rgyun/ /zhu nas snod la zhugs par bya/ /de bzhin lan gnyis gsum bzhi'i bar/ /bsams te rlung me la sogs pa/ /de rnams ma lus gyur par bsamasnye / /me tog pad+ma dkar po nang / /bdud rtsis gang bar gyur par bsam/ /bsil bar bya phyir de steng du/ /dkar po e ni bsam byas te/ /zhu nas nang du zhugs par bya/ /de nas 'od zer 'bar 'gyur te/ /phyir yang de nyid zhugs par bya/ /rang gi lce yi dkyil du yang / /dh+ri las rdo rje rtse gsum pa/ /bum par hūṃ gis byen brlabs 5bsam/ /de nyid gsum gyi gsang sngags nyid/ /ji ltar 'dod pa bzlas byas te/ /bdud rtsis bkang ba'i pad+ma la/ /ye shes sems dpa'i 7sa bon las/ /'od zer byung bas bsgul byas nas/ /pad+ma bcu dgur 'phros gyur te/ /lha rnams so so'i phyag gnas nas/ /yab yum dus gcig mthun pa ru/ /bdud rtsi'i ro mchog myong bar bsam/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin rdzogs so// //de nas ye shes sems dpa' yi/ /sa bon las ni 'od zer tshogs/ /gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol du/ /kha dog sna tshogs 'phros pa yi/ /rtse gsum 9bde gshegs byung rnams kyis/ /'gro ba sangs rgyas par byas nas/ /sa bon 22—855

nyid la thim gyur te/ /de yis yang dag rgyas par gyur1/ /'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab phyir/ /rma de nyid ni thig ler gyur/ /de yi 'od zer rim pa yis /dang po ral gri snang bar byas/ /de nas ye shes sems dpa' yi/ /nang dang phyi dang lus dang ni/ /ye shes sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor rnams/ /gnas pa'i ral gri dag dang ni/ /dam tshig sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs/ /rdo rje tshun chad snang byas nas/ /de nas rang sems yi ge rma/ /thig le lta bur zhugs par bya/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa de ma thag /ting 'dzin gsum gyis yongs su grub/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje bsam byas nas/ /dam tshig sems dang 'brel pa yi/ /rdo rje thugs sogs yan chad gsal/ /gzhag snyepa'i 'od zer rnams kyis ni/ /dam tshig sems dpa'i phyi yi sgu/ /de yi dkyil 'khor gsal byas nas/ /gzhal med khang nas phyi rol du/ /byung nas 'gro rnams gsal byas nas/ /yang ni de bzhin bzhugs par bya/ /de lta'i rim pa rab 'phro zhing / /ji tsam 'dod par 'phro 'du bya/ /'di ltar thig le rnal 'byor bsgom//las kyi rgyal ba mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin rdzogs so// //thig le rnal 'byor bsdu byas nas/ /phra mo rnal 'byor bsgom par bya/ /ye shes sems dpa'i sa bon gyi/ /'od kyis 5bde gshegs rnams bkug nas/ /zhal gyi lam du zhugs byas nas/ /rdo rje'i lam nas pad+mar gnas/ /de nas las kyi tshad tsam gyi/ /ral gri yu bar gzhal med khang / /rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor ldan/ /pad+mo 6dbus na mthong bar bya/ /gnyi ga'i dga' ba la sogs pa/ /thig le rnal 'byor yan chad par/ /ting 'dzin gsum nyid 22—8pya6

rdzogs pa yi/ /rang gi rdo rje rtse lnga yi/ /rtse dbus lcags kyu lta bu ru/ /bsam ste de yi lcags kyu yis/ /dam tshig sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor dang / /ldan pa'i ral gri phra mo nyid/ /phyi rol du ni phyung byas te/ /pad+ma'i sna rtser gnas par bya/ /'di yi thig le rnal 'byor la/ /dam tshig sems dang 'byel pa yi/ /sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje la/ /snang bar byas pa yan chad kyi/ /'od kyis dam tshig sems dpa' yi/ /phyi yi lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi/ /lha rnams rab tu gsal byas nas/ /gzhal med khang nas phyir byung ba'i/ /'od kyis nam mkha' khyab byas te/ /phyir yang de nyid zhugs par bya/ /de bzhin yang dang yang ni bsam/ /mtshan ma ma byung bar du ni/ /'od zer tsam gyi 'phro 'du nyid/ /ji tsam 'dod pa rab tu bya/ /mtshan ma rnam pa lnga mthong nas—/ /lha dang phyag mtshan la sogs pa/ /yang nas yang du 'phro 'du bya/ /phra mo'i ting nge 'dzin rdzogs so// //phra mo'i rnal 'byor bsdus ma thag /sku yi rdo rje la sogs pa'i/ /thugs kyi zla ba la gnas pa'i/ /phyag mtshan dkyil na gnas pa yi/ /oṃ sogs bzlas pa'i dus su ni/ /sku yi rdo rje la sogs dang / /lha mo bde gshegs bcas pa rnams/ /pad+ma'i dkyil na gnas pa yi/ /lha mo'i sa bon dze+e tshol sogasaske/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje la sogs pa'i/ /mchod pa'i lha mor ldan pa rnams / /rim par bye brag so so nas/ /bzlas ma thag tu 'phro byas te/ /bzlas pa zin pa'i skad cig la/ /rang rang sa bon zhugs par bya/ /'di ltar rim pa'i bzlas brjod rdzogs/ /rdzogs pa'i bzlas brjod phyogs su ni/ /22—857

re re brjod pa'i skad cig la/ /rang rang sa bon rnams las ni/ /sku yi rdo rje la sogs dang / /lha mo de bzhin gshegs pa dang —rte / /oṃ la sogs pa'i yi ge rnams / /bzlas pa zin pa'i skad cig la/ /rang rang sa bon rnams la ni/ /sku yi rdo rje la sogs dang / /lha mo dang bcas bde gshegs kun/ /mchod pa dang ldan zhugs par bya/ /de ltar rdzogs pa'i bzlas brjod bsgom/ /bzlas pas ngal bar gyur na yang / /spyan sogs lha mo bzhi rnams kyirdu/ /dbyangs kyis blang zhing bskul nas ni/ /sngon bzhin dkyil 'khor mchod par bya/ /spyi bor mtho gang tsam du ni/ /mtho gang tsam gyi zla ba bsam/ /de steng zla ba nyi ma la/ / bye s+t+waṃ dz+rī —khaṃ hūṃ rnam lnga/ /dri chen rdzas sogs steng du bsam/ /de rnams dbus su oṃ dkar po/ /de nas rang rang sa bon gyi/ /'od kyis bde gshegs bkug byas nas/ /zhugs te gcig tu gyur byas la/ /de nas ye shes sems dpa' yi/ /sa bon 'od kyis bskul byas nas/ /zhu ste oṃ gyis reg byas la/ /de rgyun mgo la 'bab bya steje/ /gzi byin ldan par shes par bya/ /de nas skad cig ngal bsos te/ /gong ma lta bu'i cho ga yis/ /gsang sngags bzlas brjod yang bya'o/ /gal te gshegs su gsol 'dod na/ /sngon bzhin mchod dang bstod pa dang / /bdud rtsi bya ba'i bar byas te/ /de nyid gsum gyi gsang sngags kyis/ /ye shes sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor zhugs par bya/ /de nas sdug bsngal ldan pa yi/ /sems can mthong bar byas nas su/ /sngon du smon lam byas pa nyid/ /mngon sum nyid du bsam byas te/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje spyor ldan pas/ /rang sems dag byas langs par bya/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya rnams/ /rang gi sems tsam min 522—858

pa'i phyir/ /rim bzhin rnam par snang mdzad dang / /mi bskyod pa dang rin chen 'byung / /snang ba mtha' yas don yod grub/ /yang na 'jam pa'i rdo rje nyid / /yang na rdo rje sems dpa' shābasam/ /bya ba ma lus byed do cog /lha yi de nyid dag ldan bya/ /de yi thugs kyi zla ba la/ /ye shes sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ /sems kyis sabasam par byas nas su/ /bza' btung bdud rtsir rab byas te/ /gong ma lta bu'i cho ga yis/ /yi ge gsum gyi sngags brjod la/ /lce la rdo rje hūṃ dkar po/ /de las rdo rje rtse gsum pa/ /bum par hūṃ gis mtshan byas te/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams ma lus par/ /tshim pa'i bsam pas myang bar bya/ /khyim nas 'byung dang 'jug la sogs/ /lus ngag yid kyi las rnams kun/ /sems can don la spyor ba dang / /sangs rgyas mchod par rnam dag bsam/ /dam tshig nyams pa gso ba'i phyir/ /sna tshogs pad+mar zla ba la/ /don yod grub pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /'gro rnams rang bzhin dag bsams te/ /rang gi snying gar zla ba la/ /khaṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje ste/ /de dkyil zla bar khaṃ yang bsam/ /de las 'od zer rnams spros pas / /bde gshegs ma lus bskul byas te/ /de rnams las byung 'od zer las / /spyan sogs lha mo bcu rnams kyis/ /rang la dbang bskur byas par bsam / /bla ma brnyas sogs skyon byung na/ /yon dang ldan pa'i mchod bstod dag /bla ma la ni dbul byas te/ /dbang bsgur cho gas khrus kyang bya/ /de nas tho rangs dus dang ni/ /nyi ma phyed dang nub pa dang / /nam phyed dus dang rtse gcig par/ /de bzhin thams cad bsgom par bya/ /bya bas bskal pa'i 4rnal 'byor pa/ /tho rangs dus na ting 'dzin gsum/ /ma lus par ni 22—859

bsgom par bya/ /de las gzhan pa'i dus na ni/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug byas te/ /yi dam lha yi snying ga ru/ /mtshan ma la sogs bsam byas la/ /de nyid gsum gyi 1gsang sngags kyis/ /ye shes sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor las/ /dam tshig sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor spro/ /de bzhin dbang bskur mchod pa dang //bstod dang bdud rtsi myang la sogs/ /byas nas sngags kyi bzlas brjod bya/ /ldang bar 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /sngon bzhin mchod dang bstod pa dang / /bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar byas te/ /yi ge gsum gyis phyi rol gyi/ /dkyil 'khor ye shes sems dpa' yi/ /'khor lo nyid la zhugs par bya/ /gong ma lta bur bya ba rnams/ /ma lus rab tu spyod byed cing / /nam phyed dus su rnal 'byor pas/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ muḥzhes sngags kyis/ /mchod pa la sogs rab byas te//ye shes dkyil 'khor gshegs par bya/ /de nyid gsum gyi dam tshig gi/ /dkyil 'khor ye shes sems dpa' yi/ /'khor lo la ni zhugs par bya/ /nyal ba'i dus na thabs nyid kyi1/ /shes rab ma dang bcas par nyal/ /tho rangs langs pa'i dus na ni/ /lha mos dbyangs kyis bskul nas langs/ /kha dog sna tshogs bsgyur byas la/ /rang gi —snying gar zla ba la/ /sa bon saṃ tsam bsam byas la/ /tha mal pa yi lus nyid ni/ /gong ma lta bus tho rangs kyi/ /dus la sogs par bsgom par byas / /sgrub thabs 'di ni byas pa yis/ /bsod nams tshogs ni gang thob des/ /'gro ba thams cad bcom ldan 'das/ /'jam pa'i rdo rjer grub gyur cig /slob dpon chen po mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa'i gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rnam par bshad pa/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgrub thabs slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal kun du bzang 22—860

byas te/ gye〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stasprin/859 ①〈〈pe 〉stanapar/ 〈〈snar 〉〉par/ rgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ri )〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byus/ rgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgo/75 ba:re/86༷ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ zhu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/ ge〈〈snar 〉〉gos/ bya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bya/861 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉girtis/bsdur 'bras re'u mig/rgyurngad/ (111༷) 22wa 863

༄/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba'i grub pa'i thabs/rte ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī sa mā dza a rnyi sa ma ya nā ma sā dha ṭaṃ/bod skad du/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nang par dang por bsam gtan gyi khang pa yid dang rjes su mthun pa shin tu dbe+en par stan 'jam po la 'dug ste/ 'gro ba drug gi sems can thams cad la blos bltas la byams pa'i sems bskyed de bdag gir byas nas/ de rnams phol mig la sogs pa'i sbug bsngal dang ldan pa dang / de'i rgyu mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam yin par 2byas te/ de nas snying rje'i sems bskyed pas gdungs pa'i blos gnod pa de bsal ba'i phyir/ bdag nyid 'jam pa'i rdo rjer gyur nas sems can rnams kyang de dang 'dra bar bskyed par bya'o zhes smon lam bya'o/ /de nas bsgom pa'i spyor ba brtsam par bya ste/ rang gi snying gar yi ge a yongs su gyur 22—8mi4

pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la yi ge oṃ mdog ser po bsams nas/ de las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas lnga rnams dang / rang gi 'dod pa'i lha rnams dang / slob dpon mdun du nam mkha' la bsams te/ snying po thu/'od zer gyi sgo las byung ba'i gzugs rdo rje la sogs pa rnams kyis yang dag par mchod la phyag byas te/ sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa lan gsum brjod par bya'o/ /de la tshigs su bcad pa ni 'di yin te/ gang zhig thog med srid pa'i chu klung du/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'o/ /de nas rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum gyi ngo bo stong pa nyid rnam par bsgoms la/ oṃ shu n+ya 2tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma kolhahaṃ/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas sems gcig pu nyid ni bsod nams dang ye shes kyi stobs kyis rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur te/ oṃ s+dzahūṃ zhes bya ba ni 'jug pa'o/ /so sor snang 1ba'i bdag nyid can ni smon pa'o/ /de la yang bgegs 'byung bar 'gyur 4/na mdun du yi ge lta phyelas byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsams la/ de'i steng du yi ge hūṃ dang bcas pa'i rdo rje drag po nag po bsams te/ de'i 'od zer rnams kyis bgegs bsal bar bsams la/ de nyid kyis rdo rje dra bar byas pa'i khyechos 'byung ⑦dkar po gru gsum nang stong pa gyen kar 'dug pa'o/ /de'i 'og logs su yi ge a ༄ 7yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ yi ge baṃ yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du zla ba la khaṃ ljang gu yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs rdo rje/ der zla ba la byu kyeyongs su gyur pa las 'khor lo yi ge bye 0 dang bcas pa'o/ /de gnyis yongs su gyur pa las rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal g.yas gnag pa/ g.yon dmar ba/ phyag gnyis kyis 22—865

shes rab dam pa la 'khyud pa/ g.yas na 'khor lo 1ral gri dang / g.yon na rin po che dang pad+ma bsnams pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zla ba'i gdan dang zla ba'i 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i cod pan can bsams la/de'i ye shes sems dpa'i snying po'i 'od zer rnams kyis sangs rgyas rnams yang dag par bskul nas bcug la/ de yongs su gyur pa las khang pa brtsegs pa zur bzhi pa la sogs pa dang yang dag par ldan pa bsams la/ de'i dbus ma'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la stong pa nyid bcu drug gi ngo bo a la sogs pa yongs su gyur pa'i zla ba de rnams kyis mtshan pa ni mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa'o/ /de'i steng du skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis 'dzin pa'i ngo bo ka la sogs pa yongs su gyur pa las 2de rnams kyis mtshan pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis pa ni rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rnam pa'o/ /de'i steng du yi ge hūṃ dmar po ste/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis dang yi ge hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dmar por gyur pa las 1yi ge hūṃ gis mtshan pa ni snang ba mtha' yas kyi rnam pa'o/ /de'i 'od zer rnams kyis sangs rgyas thams cad yang dag par bskul nas bcug ste/ de'i nga rgyal du byas pa dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa ni don yod grub pa'i rnam pa ste/de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa'i skur bdag nyid bsam pa ni/ sku mdog dkar po/ zhal g.yas gnag /g.yon dmar ba/ phyag gnyis kyis shes rab dam pa la 'khyud pa/ g.yas na rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon rin po che pyadang pad+ma bsnams pa/ rin po che'i cod pan dang / zla ba'i gdan dang zla ba'i 'od mnga' ba/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i skur bdag nyid bsams la/ sems can rnams 'dod chags chen pos 'dul bar shes nas 22—866

dga' ba'i sgyu ma'i sgras sangs rgyas rnams bdag nyid la bcug la/ de la spyan ma ①la sogs pa dgu'i gzugs kyis rngurang gi lha mo'i nang du chud par byas nas/de nas yi ge hūṃ gi 'od zer rnams kyis sangs rgyas rnams yang dag par bskul nas khar bcug ste/ rdo rje'i lam nas nges par phyung la/ pad+ma'i nang du byang chub kyi sems ②rnam par blta ste/ de yongs su gyur pa las dkyil 'khor du bsams la/ sems can ma lus pa yid kyis rab tu bcug ste/ de byang chub kyi sems su yongs su gyur nas/ rdo rje'i lam nas nges par 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de nas de rgyu dze+e dz+rī snyekhaṃ hūṃ/ lo māṃ paṃ ⑤t+t+waṃ/ dzaḥ⑥hūṃ baṃ hoḥdze+ekhaṃ re/ k+ṣiṃ dzi khaṃ ge sko saṃ/ dzaḥ3hūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ zhes bya ba'i yi ge las byung ba'i rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ⑨pad+ma'i nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha mo'i ba spu'i bu ga nas blos dbyung ngo / /de ltar sems can kyi khams rnam par dag nas/ hūṃ las 'od zer byung bas yi ge ho ⑩gnyis dang oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes bya ba'i 'jug pa'i sems spel ba bkug la khar bcug ste/ rdo rje'i lam nas nges par phyung nas byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam par lha mo'i pad+ma'i nang du babs pa dang / de'i 'od zer rnams kyis reg pa tsam gyis rig pa rdo rje 'dzin ⑪ pa dang bcas par zhu bar gyur par bsam mo/ /de nas 'byung ba chen po bzhi spyan ma 8la sogs pa'i lha mor gyur pas / sems can khams na zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i glus bskul bar bsam mo / /'di rnams kyis yang dag par bskul bar gyur pa dang / sems kyis ⑫'od zer de 'byung ba bzhi dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bskul nas sangs rgyas ke/ zhugs par gyur pa las rang gi sngags kyi gzugs su bdag nyid bsams 22—867

nas / de yongs su gyur pa las ral gri yi ge rma gyis mtshan pa'o/ /de gnyis yongs su gyur pa las 'jam pa'i rdo rje sku mdog ser po/ zhal g.yas nag po g.yon dkar po phyag gnyis kyis shes rab dam pa la 'khyud pa/ g.yas na ral gri dam pa dang / nyugayon na a la dang gzhu bsnams pa/ zla ba'i 'od dang rin po che'i cod pan mnga' ba/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng na zla ba la rdo rje'i duskyil krung du bzhugs par bsams la/ de'i snying gar zla ba la ral gri/ de'i dbus su de dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' de'i thugs kar zla ba ral gri/ de'i dbus su yi ge saṃ gnas par bsams la/ oṃ dhabyu 1dh+wa tu swa bhā wa a kophohaṃ/zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags kyis byen gyis brlab ④pa'o/ /'di dag ni mchog gi bsnyen pa'i yan lag ste/ rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu chung ba'o/ /de'i mig tu zla ba la k+ṣiṃ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las 'khor lo k+ṣiṃ gis mtshan pa'o/ /de gnyis yongs su gyur pa las sa'i snying po sku mdog dkar po/ zhal g.yas gnag g.yon dmar/ phyag gnyis shes rab dam pa la 'khyud pa/ g.yas na 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon na nor bu dang pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /de bzhin du rna ba la yi ge dzi snyedang bcas pa'i rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las phyag na rdo rje sku mdog nag po/ zhal g.yas dkar po zhwagayon dmar/ phyag gnyis kyis shes rab dam pa la 'khyud pa'o/ /g.yas na rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon na rin po che dang pad+ma'o/ /de bzhin du sna la yi ge khaṃ dang bcas pa'i rin po che yongs su gyur pa las nam mkha'i snying po sku mdog ser po/ zhal g.yas gnag g.yon dkar ba/ phyag gnyis kyis shes rab dam pa la 'khyud pa/ g.yas na rin po che dang ral gri/ g.yon na 'khor lo pad+ma pa'o 3/ /de bzhin du lce la yi ge 22—868

gi dang bcas pa'i pad+ma yongs su gyur pa las 'jig rten dbang phyug sku mdog dmar po/ zhal g.yas gnag g.yon dkar ba/ phyag gnyis kyis shes rab dam pa la 'khyud pa/ g.yas na pad+ma dang ral gri/ g.yon na rin po che dang 'khor lo bsnams pa'o/ /de bzhin du mgo la yi ge sko dang bcas pa'i ral gri yongs su gyur pa las sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba sku mdog ljang gu/ zhal g.yas gnag g.yon dkar ba/ phyag gnyis kyis shes rab dam pa la 'khyud pa/g.yas na ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon na rin po che dang pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /de bzhin du lte ba la yi ge saṃ dang bcas pa'i rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las kun du bzang po sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas gnag g.yon dmar ba/ phyag gnyis kyis shes rab dam pa la 'khyud pa/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon na rin po che dang pad+ma bsnams pa ste/ sa'i snying po la sogs pa 'di rnams kyang zla ba'i gdan dang zla ba'i 'od dang / rin po che'i cod pan mnga' ba/rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /de dag ni mchog gi nye bar sgrub pa'i 1yan lag ste/ rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu chung ngu'o/ /kun du bzang po'i steng du zla ba la yi ge hūṃ nag po yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje'i snyelte ba la hūṃ dang bcas pa'i rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las thugs rdo rje phyag na rdo rje lta bu thugs ka'i zla ba la yi ge hūṃ nag po'o/ /lce rtser ①yi ge āḥchoyongs su gyur pa las pad+ma'i lte ba la yi ge āḥ 3dang bcas pa'i pad+ma yongs su gyur pa las gsung rdo rje 'jig rten dbang phyug lta bu'o/ /de'i thugs ka'i zla ba la yi ge s+dza6dmar po'o//dpral bar yi ge oṃ yongs su gyur pa las 'khor lo'i sngalte bar oṃ dang bcas pa'i 'khor lo yongs su gyur pa las sku rdo rje sa'i snying po lta bu'o/ /de'i thugs 22—869

kar zla ba la yi ge oṃ dkar po snying po de rnams kyi 'od zer gyis thugs rdo rje la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams yang dag par mchod nas dpal ldan rdo rje thugs 'chang ba/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa brjod de/ yang dag par bskul la sngags kyis byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de dag ni mchog gi bsgrub 1pa'i yan lag ste/skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu chung ngu'o/ /snying po'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas thams cad bskul ba dang de rnams kyis 'od zer btang ba'i sgo nas byung ba'i spyan ma la sogs pa'i rigs rnams kyi rin po che'i bum pa nas bdud rtsis dbang bskur ba dang ldan pa dang / rang gi rigs kyi bdag po cod pan du thogs pa'o/ /de dag ni mchog gi sgrub 4pa chen po'i yan lag ste/ dbang gi 'bras bu chung ngu'o/ /yan lag bzhi pa'i dang po'o/ /rnal 'byor pa mchog gi bsnyen pa la sogs pa'i yan lag 'di dag gis rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu 'bring po la sogs pa ni rang dang 'dra bar babyed par bya'o/ /gzhan yang oṃ hūṃ swā 5uhā zhes bya ba'i yi ge las bskyed par byas te/ de'i mgo dang / snying ga dang /lte ba dang / gsang ba dang / brla dang / rkang pa'i mthar thug pa'i bar ro/ /yi ge hūṃ las pad+ma āḥ6las lte ba/ phaṭa las dbab pa dgag pa'o/ /bdag nyid kyis yang yi ge hūṃ las rdo rje/ oṃ las nor bu phaṭa kyis dgag pa'o/ /de nas snying po'i 'od zer rnams kyis bskul la drangs te/ de dang lhan cig sngags pas dga' ba brtsam par bya'o/ /oṃ sat+tha ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa 7badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma kolhahaṃ/ yan lag bzhi pa'i gnyis pas te/ 'di dag ni dang po'i sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /22—870

snying po'i gsang sngags kyi 'od zer rnams kyis sangs rgyas rnams bskul la bkug nas khar bcug ste/ lha mo'i 'dod chags kyis zla ba zhu bar gyur pa dang /pad+ma'i nang du phab pa las byung ba'i rang gi sa bon yongs su gyur pa las bdag po dbus na gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor ba bsams la cho ga 'dis dbyung ①bar bya'o//badz+ra j-ika ces bya ba ②las mi bskyod pa bskul te/ sku mdog nag po zhal g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ phyag gnyis kyis shes rab dam pa la 'khyud pa/g.yas na rdo rje dang ①ral gri/ g.yon na rin po che dang pad+ma bsnams pa/ nyi ma'i gdan dang zla ba'i 'od mnga' ba/ ral pa dang cod pan can/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa dngos po thams cad kyis bdag la bzhugs gyepar bya'o/ /dzi na dzika ces bya bas rnam par snang mdzad dgod de/ sku mdog dkar po zhal g.yas gnag /g.yon dmar ba/ phyag gnyis kyis shes rab dam pa la 'khyud pa/ g.yas na 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon na rin po che dang pad+ma bsnams pa/ zla ba'i gdan dang zla ba'i 'od mnga' ba/ shar kyi pad+ma la bzhugs par bya'o/ /rat+na rjaka ces bya bas rin chen 'byung ldan dgod de/ sgu mdog ser po zhal g.yas gnag g.yon dkar ba/ phyag gnyis kyis shes rab dam pa la 'khyud pa/ g.yas na rin po che dang ral gri/ g.yon na 'khor lo dang pad+ma bsnams pa/ lhor bzhugs par bya'o/ /ā ro t+paka ces bya bas sa'od dpag tu med pa dgod de/ sku mdog dmar po/ zhal g.yas gnag 'u /g.yon dkar ba/ phyag gnyis kyis shes rab dam pa la 'khyud pa/ g.yas na pad+ma dang ral gri/ g.yon na rin po che dang 'khor lo bsnams pa/ nub tu bzhugs par bya'o/ /pradzñā dh+rika ces bya bas don yod grub pa dgod de/ sku mdog ljang gu/ zhal g.yas gnag /g.yon dkar ba/ phyag 22—871

gnyis kyis shes rab dam pa la 'khyud pa/ g.yas na ral gri dang 'khor lo/g.yon na rin po che dang pad+ma bsnams pa/ byang du bzhugs par bya'o/ /'di rnams ni nyi ma'i gdan dang nyi ma'i 'od dang na bza' dang rgyan bzang po dang /ral pa ⑨dang cod pan mnga' ba/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /mo ha ra tī spuzhes bya bas shar lhor spyan ma ①dgod de/ sku mdog dkar po④/ zhal g.yas gnag g.yon dmar ba/ phyag gnyis kyis thabs la 'khyud pa/ g.yas na 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon na rin po che dang pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /dre ṣa ra tī lduzhes bya ba las kwa lho nub tu mā ma kri dgod de/ sku mdog nag po zhal g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ phyag gnyis kyis thabs la 'khyud pa/g.yas na a la dmar po dang ral gri/ g.yon na rin po che dang pad+ma bsnams pa'o / /rā ga ra tī ⑦zhes bya ba las nub byang du gos dkar mo dgod de/ sku mdog dmar mo zhal g.yas gnag /g.yon dkar ba/ phyag gnyis kyis thabs la 'khyud pa/ g.yas na pad+ma dang ral gri/ g.yon na nor bu dang 'khor lo bsnams pa'o/ /badz+ra ra tī ⑧zhes bya ba las byang shar du sgrol ma dgod de/ sku mdog ser po/ zhal g.yas gnag /g.yon dkar ba/phyag gnyis kyis thabs la 'khyud pa/ g.yas na a la ser po dang ral gri/g.yon na rin po che dang pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /phyi rim kyi shar lhor de kho na nyid gsum las gzugs rdo rje sa'i snying po lta bu me long la sogs pa dang ldan pa'o/ /de bzhin du lho nub tu sgra rdo rje phyag na rdo rje lta bu la pi wang la sogs pa dang ldan pa'oske/ /de bzhin du nub byang du dri rdo rje nam mkha'i snying po lta bu la dri'i dung chos la sogs pa dang ldan pa'o/ /de bzhin du byang shar du ro rdo rje 'jig rten 22—872

dbang phyug lta bu la thod pa la sogs pa dang ldan pa'o/ /shar gyi sgo'i g.yon du reg rdo rje sgrib pa rnam par sel ba lta bu la lha'i gos sna tshogs pa dang ldan pa'o/ /shar gyi sgo'i g.yas su chos kyi dbyings rdo rje kun du bzang po lta bu la chos 'byung ba la sogs pa dang ldan te①/ lha mo bcu po de rnams ni zla ba'i sti'od mnga' ba/rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i cod pan dang na bza' bzang po dang ldan pa'o/ /ya mān+ta kṛta ces bya ba las shar phyogs kyi sgor gshin rje gshed dgod de sku mdog nag po/ zhal g.yas dkar ༷ /g.yon dmar ba/phyag gnyis kyis shes rab dam pa la 'khyud pa/ g.yas na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i tho ba dang ral gri/ g.yon na rin po che dang pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /pradzñān+ta kṛta ces bya ba las lho phyogs kyi sgor shes rab mthar byed dgod de/ sku mdog dkar po/ zhal g.yas gnag /g.yon dmar ba/ phyag gnyis kyis shes rab dam pa la 'khyud pa/ g.yas na rin po che sa mtshan pa'i dbyig pa dang ral gri—/ g.yon na rin po che dang pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /pad+mān+ta kṛta ces bya ba las nub phyogs kyi sgor pad+ma mthar byed dgod de/ sku mdog dmar po/zhal g.yas gnag g.yon dkar ba/ phyag gnyis kyis shes rab dam pa la 'khyud pa/ g.yas na pad+ma dang ral gri/ g.yon na rin po che dang 'khor lo bsnams pa'o/ /bibyāsto kṛta ces bya ba las byang phyogs kyi sgor bgegs mthar byed dgod de/ sku mdog nag po/ zhal g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar po/phyag gnyis kyis shes rab dam pa la 'khyud pa/ g.yas na rdo rje dang ral gri/g.yon na rin po che dang pad+ma bsnams pa ste/ khro bo 'di rnams nyi ma'i gdan dang nyi ma'i 'od mnga' ba/ khro bo'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ stag gi 22—873

pags ①pa mnabs pa/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ smin ma dang / ag tshom 1dang spyan ser ba/ dbu skra gyen du brjes pa/ mche ba gcigs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ de ltar dngos po thams cad kyis rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan nas—/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi ④'od zer gyis ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sangs rgyas rnams spyan drangs nas/ mdun du bltas la/ de rnams dang lhan cig 'ongs pa'i bgegs gshin rje gshed la sogs pas bskrad pa dang / mngon par bsrung ba dang / bcing ba dang mnyes par byas nas/ bdud rtsis gang ba'i snod kyis mchod yon phul la/ snying po'i 'od zer las byung ba'i gzugs rdo rje ma ④la sogs pa rnams kyis yang dag par mchod cing / gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i rang bzhin ⑤ gsang sngags kyis dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang /bcing ba dang / dbang du bya'o/ /de dag ni thun mong gi bsnyen pa'i yan lag ste/ rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu chen po'o/ /rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi mig la sogs pa byin gyis brlabs pa ni/spyi'i nye bar bsgrub pa'i yan lag ste/ rnam par byun pa'i 'bras bu chen po'o/ /de bzhin du sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ spyi'i sgrub pa'i yan lag ste/skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu chen po'o/ /de nyid gzhan pyadu dbang bskur bar gyur pa ni/ sangs rgyas rnams dang rdo rje 'chang ba dang / mā ma shī dang /sgra rdo rje dang / chos 3dbyings rdo rje dang / shes rab mthar byed dang po /bgegs mthar byed kyi cod pan la ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /spyan dang gzugs rdo rje dang / gshin rje gshed kyi cod pan la ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /gos dkar mo dang / ro rdo rje ma dang / pad+ma mthar byed kyi cod pan la ni 'od 22—874

dpag tu med pa'o/ /sgrol ma dang reg rdo rje'i cod pan la ni don yod grub pa'o//dri'i ①rdo rje'i cod pan la ni rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /'di dag ni spyi'i sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag ste/ dbang gi 'bras bu chen po'i yan lag bzhi pa'i gsum pa'o/ /snying po'i 'od zer rnams kyis sangs rgyas rnams bskul la khar bcug ste/ rdo rje'i lam nas nges par phyung nas/ lha mo'i chags pas pad+ma'i nang du zla ba zhu ba'i gzugs can du bsams la/ de'i 'od zer las byung ba'i gzugs rdo rje la sogs pa phyung bas yang dag par mchod nas/ oṃ sat+tha ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa a kolhahaṃ/ zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags kyis byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas rang gi yid lhag pa'i lhar gyur pa las chos rnams kyi/mi bskyod pa ni rdo rje che/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i stong pa'i sgra brag ca lta bur ⑤bstod pa byed par bsam mo/ /de nas bdud rtsi myang ba'i cho ga 'di yin te/yi ge yi yongs su gyur pa las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu la ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ du ba'i mdog can yi ge yi dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du yi ge re yongs su gyur pa las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum zur gsum la rdo rjes mtshan pa'i yi ge re dang bcas pa'o/ /de'i steng du zla ba la yi ge a yongs su gyur pa las thod pa'o/ /der sngags pas bi mu shu ma ra ste bdud rtsi lnga dang / go ku da ha na ④ste dpa' bo lnga bkod la/ rlung gis bskyod pa'i mes thod pa de la gnas pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsams la/ der yi ge hūṃ las rdo rjer gyur pa yang nang du bsam mo/ /yang yi ge oṃ gyis de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i sa bon drangs la 'dres par gyur par byas nas/ der yi ge gsum mngon par bzlas la rnal 'byor pas hūṃ bkod pa'i rdo rje'i lce bzang po dang / de lha 22—875

rnams tshim par bya'o/ /'di ni dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /snying po las nges par byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis yang dag pa ma yin pa'i rtog pa spangs pas de'i bdag nyid du 'gro ba rnams byas nas rang gi sa bon gyi nang du bcug ste/ thig le'i gzugs su rang gi yid yongs su bsgoms la/sems de'i 'od zer gyi ①phreng ba'i snang bas sku dang gsung dang thugs dang lus kyi mchog gi bar sad par byas la/ yang de nyid du zhugs pas ye shes kyi phyabadud rtsi 'bab par bsam mo/ /des nang gi lus dang de bzhin du thams cad snang bar byas te/ ba spu'i bu ga re re nas byung ba'i mtha' yas pa'i 'od kyi zhutshogs rnams kyis sna tshogs pa kun du bkang nas be+er 'dus te gnas pa dang /brtan par gyur pa ni thig le'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas rang gi sngags kyi 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas bcug la/ rdo rje'i lam nas nges par phyung nas zla ba zhu bar gyur pa las thu/ de yongs su gyur pa'i mtshan ma phra mo'i lte bar ting nge 'dzin gnyis bskyed la/ sna tshogs pa sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid du rang gi sngags kyis ⑤nang du bcug la/ thig le de'i gzugs can 'od gsal bar bdag nyid bsams te/ de'i 'od zer rnams kyis dkyil 'khor la bltas la sems brtan par gyur nas rjes su dran pa bcu drug bsgom par bya'o/ /bsgoms ⑥ pas dub na cig car ram rim gyis sems ma yengs par bzlas brjod bya'o—/ /rang gi rgyud tshim par bya ba bsam pa ni mtho gang gis spags ⑦pa la spyi bo'i steng du gdugs dkar po bzhin bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du yi ge 22—876

oṃ—/ de'i 'od zer rnams kyis bdud rtsi phab la/ de nas srog gi rlung dang rang gi sngags kyi 'od zer gyis drangs nas/ rkan gyi phyogs su phab nas ba spu'i khung bu dang rtsa brgyad lha/las sku gsung thugs tshim par byasakhye/ de nas bzlas pa dpag tu med par byas nas/ oṃ la sogs pa de kho na nyid gsum gyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsdus la yang dag pa'i smon lam mngon du bya'o/ /de nas rang gi lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas langs nas thams cad kyang de dang 'dra bar bsams nas gnas par bya'o/ /bdud rtsi myang ba'i rim gyis zas la sogs pa spyad par bya'o/ /dbang bskur ba'i rim pas khrus bya'o/ /rgyu mthun pa 'bring po la sogs pas grong gi chos bya'o/ /thun mtshams su yang de kho na nyid gsum gyi ldudakyil 'khor rnam par spros la/ mchod pa la sogs pa sngon du 'gro bas bzlas pa byas nas thu/ yang de kho na nyid gsum gyi dkyil 'khor bsnyus la nyal bar bya'o/ /yang nang par gyi dus su bskyed pa'i rim gyis ting nge 'dzin gsum sdogs par byas la mnyam par gzhag pyenas bzlas brjod la sogs pa bya'o/ /bsgom pa'i cho ga 'di ni shes rab dman pa'i sems can mthong nas/ slob dpon gyis 'di nyid gsar du brtsams pa yin no/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ slob dpon bsod snyoms pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrad+dhā phyaka ra warma dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā meb dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te slad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa'o// //22—877
