kyi rab zab pa'i/ /tshul la lhag par mos pa'i yid/ /sbyin dang khrims sogs phun sum tshogs/ /srid dang longs spyod la phyir phyogs/ /sems kyi sdug bsngal yang skyo med/ /lha rnams bsten pa byed gyur pa/ /chu dang cod pan rdo rje dang / /bdag po ming dang slob dpon gsang / /shes rab ye shes brtul zhugs sogs/ /bsod nams ye shes cher 'char ba'i/ /dpal ldan gsang 'dus dkyil 'khor du/ /ji ltar rigs par dbang bskur ba/ /bla ma yongs su mnyes pa yis/ /dbang bskur rdo rje sems brtan 1pa/ /rnal 'byor spyod nus rnal 'byor pas/ /ri bo la sogs yid 'ong bar/ /gnas byas mgon po bsgrub par bya/ /bsam gtan sogs pa la brtson pa/ /mtshan mo phyed kyi lhag ma la/ /cho ga bzhin du langs byas la/ /snying zlar de nyid oṃ 'od ldan/ /gdong la sogs pa dag par bya/ /de nas chu bzangs sman dang ni/ /me tog ga pur tsan+dan gyis/ /bsam gtan gnas ni yang dag gnas4/ /bsams pas kyang ni yid 'ong bya/ /bde ba'i stan la gnas nas ni/ /legs brtan rdo rje'i skyil mo krung / /de ru yang na bder gnas pas/ /bsam gtan rab tu bsam par bya/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /kun du bla mar bcas pa yi/ /dus gsum gshegs pas yongs gang ba/ /nam mkhar mngon sum bzhin bltas la/ /sa bon rma byung gzugs sogs pas/ /de bzhin rin chen phung po yis/ /mchod sogs rtog 5pa spang 6byas nas/ /rab tu 'bad pas 7de rnams mchod/ /de rnams spyan sngar gnas byas la/ /pus mo btsugs te thal sbyar nas/ /dmigs pa med par byas nas ni/ /sdig pa bshags pa la sogs bya/ /gang zhig thog med srid pa'i chu klung du/ /ma lus 22—9/5

kun rtog gis bsags rnyog 1pa rnams/ /thugs rje cher ldan spyan sngar de dag ni / /cho ga bzhin du thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / /'phags pa gzhan gyis dge ba gang mdzad pa / /de dag kun la yang dag yi rang zhing / /byang chub tu ni yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /yid kyi rol pa dri med zla 'dras bsgrubs/ /snying rje dam pa mtha' yas pa yi thabs/ /rang gi yid la gnas par gyur pa yi/ /bde gshegs rnams la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /rtog pa ma lus pa las nges grol zhing / /sems dpa' dam pa kun gyi phun tshogs gzhi/ /dngos po thams cad ro gcig ngo bo nyid/ /dam pa'i chos la rtag par skyabs su mchi/ /'ching ba rnams las yang dag grol 'gyur zhing / /snying rje mchog gis bskrun pa'i dpal dang ldan / /rab tu dga' sogs sa la rab bzhugs pa/ /brtul zhugs dbang po'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ /bsam dang rnam par smin pa dag gyur cing / /sgrib pa kun gyi bag chags yang dag 'byin/ /lhag par mos pas rnam par brgyan pa yi/ /sems ni byang chub dam par bskyed par bgyi/ /bde gshegs sras bcas rnams kyi lam gcig pu/ /sbyin sogs rnam bcu dkar po'i yon tan tshul/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas bdag ma lus ngo bo'i blos/ /yang dag nyid du da ni gnas par bgye/ /'jig rten mthar 'byin bsam pa dang / /log par lta ba'i bsgom pa dang / /tshul khrims brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin pa'i/ /nyes pas 'gro ba 'di bskyed pas/ /snying rje thams cad dmigs byas te/ /don dam pa ni ji lta bar/ /byang chub sems mchog bsgom par bya/ /tshigs bcad don 'di bsam bya ste/ /ngo bo nyid dang bral phyir stong pa ste/ /de phyir rgyu dang —)tsho— 9/6

bral bas mtshan ma med/ /rtog pa rnams dang bral phyir dngos po ni/ /ma lus smon pa las ni nges par grol/ /de ltar stong pa dang ldan par/ /'gro ba 'di kun blta byas nas/ /ji srid sems ni brtan 'dod pas/ /sngags 'di nye bar brjod par bya/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba 17ā kopho haṃ/ stong nyid ro gcig gang sems dpa'o / /byang chub mchog tu mi 'gyur ro/ /gnas dang gzhal yas bdag nyid de/ /rang gi sems kyis 'di ltar bya/ /sangs rgyas zhing du nam yang ni/ /ma dag pa yis 'tshang mi rgya/ /de yis dang por zhing dag phyir/ /rang sems nyi mar bsgom par bya/ /de ru hūṃ skyes rdo rje ni / /kha gyes sngon po 'od 'bar ba/ /de yi dbus gnas hūṃ yig las/ /rdo rje phra mo rnam spro bya/ /'og dang steng dang phyogs bzhi ru/ /rdo rje ra ba gur dang ni/ /rdo rje rang bzhin sa gzhi bya/ /bsrung ba'i don du bsam par bya/ /snyug bsngal kun 'byung shes pa dang / /'gog pa dang ni lam dang ni/ /zad dang mi skye chos dang ni/ /de bzhin rjes dang kun rdzob dang / /sngon gyi gnas 'gro shes pa dang / /ji ltar thos pa rnam par 4shes/ /chos dbyengs tha dad med pa rnams/ /shes pa 'di rnams su 'gyur ro/ /'di ltar shes pa bcu gcig ni/ /legs par rdzogs pa'i rgyu yin te/ /rtsibs bcu la ni khro bo bcu/ /lte bar mchog ni bcu gcig pa/ /shar sogs phyogs ni de rnams su/ /go rims 5bzhin du de rnams la/ /gshin rje shes rab mthar byed bsgom/ /pad+ma bgegs ni mthar byed kyang / /me la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams su/ /'dod sngon stobs dang mi g.yo rnams/ /steng du gtsug tor rgyal por 'gyur/ /'og tu gnod mdzes 'dren pa'o/ /lte bar rdo rje t+t+waṃ mdzad dpal/ /rtag rdzordzo 9/7

pa la sogs par yang 'gyur/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha yang 'dir/ /rnal 'byor pa ni kha cig 'dod/ /tho ba lcags kyu dbyeg 1pa dang / /dbyug pa pad+ma rtse gsum dang / /rdo rje ral gri 'khor lo dang / /rdo rje rdo rje g.yas na 'dzin/ /phyag g.yas thams cad ral gri ste/ /g.yon na rin chen pad+ma'o/ /spyan g.yon rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur/ /mi g.yo byis pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /rtsa ba'i phyag mtshan rdo rje ste/ /g.yas nyid na ni yang dag gnas/ /gang gi g.yas na pad+ma yod / /de yi g.yon du 'khor lo'o/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi g.yon du/ /zhags pa lcags kyu'i phyag 'bar ba/ /u ma dang bcas bde byed ni/ /zhabs kyis mnan nas yang dag gnas/ /gzhan gyis mi thub dkar por 'gyur/ /pad+ma mthar byed dmar po ste/ /gtsug tor kha dog ser por 'gyur/ /lhag ma rdo rje 'dzin nag po/ /dmar dang ser dang lus dkar rnams/ /g.yas pa'i gdong ni nag po mdzes/ /dkar dang dkar min dmar ba ni/ /de rnams kyi ni g.yon du bsgrags/ /khro bo nag po rnams kyi ni/ /dbye bas kha dog shes par bya/ /nas kyi myu gu dang 'dra ba/ /g.yon pa dmar po'i rnam pa ste/ /g.yas pa dkar por 'dod pa yin/ /bden bral dang ni rlung gi mtshams/ /gang zhig phyogs su gnas pa rnams/ /thams cad mi sdug thung ba ste/ /gdong 'jigs gsus pa chen po ste/ /sma ra smin ma skra ser ba/ /gad rgyangs bzhad par byed pa'o/ /stag gi pags pas gos mdzad khro/ /sbrul kyi rgyan 4ni 'dzin pa'o/ /mgul dang lag pa rna ba la/ /rigs ldan dung dang 'jog po rnams/ /dmar ser mdangs ldan nor rgyas ni/ /ska rags 5su ni rnam par gnas/ /rkang pa dpung par dkar ba yi/ /pad+ma pad+ma chen po gnas/ /22—918

karko ṭa dang mtha' yas dag /ljang sngo se ral mgo la'o/ /mche bas cung zad mchu mnan te/ /zhal ni rnam par brgyan pa'o/ /zhi ba'i rgyan dang gos bzang ste—/ /gzugs mdzes gzhan ni mtshams thung ba/ /snga ma sku ni gyen 'greng tshogs—/ /gzhan ni rin chen dbu brgyan 7no/ /thams cad smin ma khro gnyer 'khyog /zhal ni gnyer mas mtshan ma 2ste/ /sna tshogs chu skyes nyi ma la/ /g.yon brkyang zhabs kyis yang dag gnas/ /phyogs su khro bo'i gurigs spro ba/ /sdang tshogs thams cad 'jigs byed pa/ /'og sngum bar dang mthar bral ba/ /skye dang 'jig pa rnam par spangs/ /thams cad ye shes tsam la brten/ /chos kyi de nyid go 'phang gnas/ /'di ni shes pa ji ltar thob5/ /grub nas yongs su gnas pa'o/ /'khor lor chos 'byung phyag rgya ni/ /gru gsum dkar po steng gnas pa/ /dbus gnas sna tshogs pad rdo rje/ /nang gi nam mkha'i rang bzhin du/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od 'phror ldan/ /phyogs ni mtha' yas gsal blta dang / /sna tshogs rdo rje la gnas bsgom/ /zla bar rgyu 6ni yang dag 'bar/ /'khor lo rtsibs ni bcu gnyis pa/ /ma rig la sogs yan lag dag /sa bon bcas pa de gyur nas/ /rtag pa rig mar bcas la byung / /byang chub phyogs kyi chos rnams kyi/ /rnam dag 'khor lo bsgom par bya/ /de la sangs rgyas sangs rgyas min/ /mnyam phyir gru bzhir gnas pa'o/ /de yi rnam dag rnam bstan phyir/ /byang chub phyogs kyi chos rnams las/ /dran pa dag pa shar phyogs sgor7/ /gang phyir dran pa sngon 'gro bas/ /dge la rjes su 'jug par 'gyur/ /dge dang mi dge'i chos rnams ni/ /bskyed dang mi bskyed pa yi phyir/ /rtsom dang yongs su sbyong yin te/ /so sor rtog dang bya 22—9/9

lhur len/ /'di ni brtson 'grus rnam dag pas/ /des na lho yi sgo ru 'gyur/ /'dun pa brtson 'grus de bzhin sems/ /dpyod pa zhes bya 'di dag pas/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi yin te/ /de bas nub phyogs sgo ru 'gyur/ /dad pa brtson 'grus dran pa nyid/ /ting 'dzin shes rab dang bcas pa/ /dbang po lnga po de dag pas/ /byang phyogs sgor ni 'di 'gyur ro/ /rtog dang dpyod dang dga' ba dang / /bde dang ting nge 'dzin rnams ni/ /bsam gtan dang po yan lag lnga/ /gnyis pa yan lag bzhi yin te/ /rtog pa dang ni dpyod pa dang / /nang ni rab tu dang ba dang / /bsam gtan dang po'i yan lag mthas—/ /de yis gang ni ldan gyur pa'o/ /btang snyoms dran pa dang 'byel pa / /shes bzhin dang ni bde ba'i rten1/ /de ni sems rtse gcig par ldan/ /yan lag lnga ldan gsum pa yin/ /btang snyoms dran pa yongs su dag /bde sdug min pa'i tshor ba dang / /sems rtse gcig dang ldan pas na/ /yan lag bzhi ldan bzhi pa yin/ /go rims ji bzhin bsam gtan ni/ /bzhi po yongs su dag pa yis/ /'di dag sgo sgor gyur pa yi/ /rta babs gzugs kyis mdzes par byas/ /dpa' 'gro nam mkha' mdzod du grags/ /dri med seng ge rnam rol pa'i/ /ting 'dzin 'di rnams rnam dag pa/ /khyams ni bskor bar gyur pa'o/ /a kā ro mu khaṃ zhes sogs/ /bzod dang chos dang don sngags kyi/ /gzugs rnams dag cing dag pa yis/ /mchod bzangs kyis 2ni lag sbrel ba'i/ /de dag khyams rten lha mo yis/ /kun nas yongs su bskor ba'o/ /sems can 'dod pa rdzogs byed pas/ /sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /mdo dang dbyangs dang lung bstan dang / /tshigs 22—920

bcad ched brjod gleng gzhi dang / /de lta bur byung shin tu rgyas/ /skyes pa'i rabs rnams sgra sgrogs pa/ /ston pa'i bstan pa yan lag dgu/ /phyogs bcu tshorab tu skor 2bar byed/ /'di ni rlung gis skyod 7pa'o/ /ba dan dril bu'i sgra sgogs ldan/ /dran pa shes rab ting nge 'dzin/ /shin tu sbyangs dang dga' btang snyoms/ /brtson 'grus zhes pa 'di bdun pa/ /byang chub yan lag rnam dag pas/ /dra ba dra phyed nyi zla dang / /phreng bzangs 4me long rnga yab 5mdzes/ /ji ltar gnas su bkod pa yi/ /'di rnams kyis ni mdzes byas pa'o/ /stong nyid la sogs rnam pa dang / /gzugs can gzugs rnams lta byed pa/ /zil gyis mnan nas rab tu shes/ /de ni rnam thar dang po yin//nang ni gzugs med 'du shes pas/ /phyi rol gzugs la sngar bzhin du/ /mthong ba zhes pa gnyis pa ste/ /rnam par thar pa 6yang dag brjod/ /sdug pa'i rnam thar lus kyis ni/ /gzugs dang ldan pa nyid brjod pas/ /mngon sum byas nas rdzogs byas te/ /nam mkha' dang ni rnam shes dang / /ci yang med pa gzhan yin te/ /'du shes med min 'du shes med/ /skye mched bdun kyi dbye ba yis/ /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa ni/ /brgyad pa 7nye bar brjod pa ste/ /yid ni rnam par grol ba yis/ /rnam par thar par des 'dod do/ /'di ltar rnam thar brgyad rnams ni / /go rims ji bzhin rnam dag pas/ /'khor lo rin chen mtsho skyes dang / /ral gri ka ba brgyad kyis brgyan / /kun du bar chad med pa yis/ /rdo rje theg pa rab bskor bas/ /ka ba'i steng du gnas gyur pa/ /rdo rje phreng ba zlum pos bskor/ /gzugs la sogs pa phyin ci log /rab tu zhi bas bla med pa'i/ /tshad med pa dang yang 22—921

dag spangs/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga po 'di/ /shin tu rnam dag las grub pa//chos kyi dbyings kyis rnam par brgyan/ /mchod pa rnam pa lnga yis dgyes/ /cho ga ji bzhin rnam par gsol/ /'gro ba kun dang tha mi dad/ /nyes pas gang la ma gos pa/ /gnas 'di dag ni bcu dgu ru/ /sna tshogs pad+mas brgyan byas pa'o/ /rmongs dang rab rib gzhir gyur pa/ /'dam ni rnam par skems pas na/ /byang chub sems kyi myu gu dag /smin pa'i don du yang 'di yin—/ /snying rje'i rang bzhin nyi 1bzang po/ /bdun kyis yongs su brgyan pa'o—/ /dbus kyi stan dang mdun spangs te/ /phyogs dang sgo na rnam par gnas—/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba 'phel ba dang / /nyon mongs gdung ba zhi ba'i phyir/ /shes rab bdag nyid mngon khyab pa/ /lhag ma nub mo byed pa yin/ /tshogs gnyis yang dag rdzogs 'gyur bas/ /grub par bstan pa'i don gyi phyir/ /snying rjes brlan pas yang dag gang / /bum pa gang bas 'di brgyan byas/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin gyis/ /de bzhin rin chen lnga yi gzugs/ /gzhal yas khang gi rnam pa ni/ /rang gi sems ni rnam dag pa'o/ /de dbus gdan gyi zla ba la/ /nyis 'gyur dbyangs yig bcu drug ste/ /mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis tshogs/ /bskyed par nus pas bsgom par bya/ /lugs dang mthun dang mi mthun pa'i/ /phreng gnyis dag ni dgod par bya/ /dag pa'i zla ba shel 'dra bas/ /'od zer phreng ba spro bar byed/ /'di ltar gzhan yang bsgom bya ste/ /dbyangs yig bcu drug las byung ba/ /stong pa nyid kyis 'phangs pas na/ /gang phyir sems ni 'di ltar 'gyur/ /des na shes rab rang bzhin 'di / /ri bong can du yang dag mtshon/ /shes rab yang ni gnyis med 22—922

shes / /bcu drug stong pa nyid gsungs pa/ /dkyil 'khor tshogs ni dag chen po/ /nam mkha' bzhin du dri ma med/ /gnas ngan len ni kun nas grol//rtog pa spangs pa'i mchog yin no/ /nyon mongs dri ma thams cad dag /zla ba mthong ba sngon 'gro ba/ /'dir ni sangs rgyas yon tan kun/ /a la sogs pa'i gzugs kyis gnas/ /a ā/ i yī/ u spru/ ṛ dzā/ dza lbo/ e i / o lngo saṃ āḥ dzobhe/ 'di dag bcu drug tshogs pas ni/ /byung ba nges par bstan pa yin/ /kun du bzang po'i 3gsal ba ru/ /ye shes zhabs ni nyid kyis su/ /der gnas cho ga bzhin du sgra/ /dbyangs yig bcu drug smra ba yis/ /ji ltar brjod pa'i dbyangs yig gis/ /bsil ba'i 'od zer rab bsgrub pa/ /'di rnams 'di ltar grub pa ni/ /skyes bu chen po'i mtshan yin no//sku ni byin gyis brlabs 'gyur ba/ /gang phyir 'di las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dha da ya la wa bsnan bya/ /ka sogs nyis 'gyur byas pa las/ /de steng ri bong can blta ste/ /dpe byad sgrub par byed pa'o/ — /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin pas / /snying rje rtsa ba'i rang bzhin grags/ /bsod nams tshogs ni yang dag rdzogs/ /yid las byung yang rnyog pa bral/ /'jig rten rab grags grangs kyis ni/ /gzugs brnyan rab tu sbyor ba las/ /sangs rgyas yon tan kun gyi lus/ /'dir ni ka la sogs pas gsal/ /yang gsungs pa/ snying rje chags las yang dag byung / /sems can rjes su 'dzin byed pa/ /dge ba'i chos ni yang dag rdzogs/ /nyon mongs kun la nges gnod pa/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /byang chub zla ba gnyis pa'o/ /'dir yang sangs rgyas yon tan rnams/ /ka sogs gzugs kyis yang dag 'jug /gzugs 22—923

brnyan rab tu sbyor bas so/ /zhes so/ /kun gzhi rnam shes gyur pa las /'di ni zla ba gnyis su grags/ /me long ye shes su brjod pa/ /rnam pa dang po nyid yin no/ /nyon mongs can yid gyur pa las/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid—/ /der yang hūṃ byung rdo rje ste/ /dmar gsal ba yi 'od can no/ /phung po lnga ni rnam dag pas/ /ye shes lnga ru bstan pa yin/ /steng du gnas pa de yi ni/ /lte bar hūṃ yig zla gnyis gnas/ /brjod bya rjod byed las 'das te / /chos nyid rab tu rtogs pas na/ /de ni rtogs par gyur pa las/ /so sor kun du rtog par bsgom/ /de las de bzhin gshegs spros pas/ /'gro ba kun la phan byas nas/ /sangs rgyas gang de 'dir bsdus pa/ /de ni bya ba nan tan no/ /byang chub spyod gang dag pa ni/ /bla med sangs rgyas ye shes so//de rnams dag ni rang bzhin 1gzugs/ /brtan pas rdo rje nyid du 'gyur/ /'di ltar yid kyis bsgom byas nas / /rang gzugs tha dad med pa'i dngos/ /rdo rje ji ltar bstan mthong nas/ /de la bdag tu nga rgyal bya/ /de yang /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku 'di ni/ /snang ba med cing gnas med pa/ /ma skyes ma byas dag pa ste/ /rang bzhin la sogs rnam par spangs/ /mi chod mi phyed sreg tu med/ /lhag ma med pa chos kyi sku/ /rdo rje bdag nyid yang dag 'byung / /rdo rje sku ni bla na med/ /ces gsungs so/ /rang gi sems kyi 'phen pa yis/ /byang sems shar ba mchog yin no/ /spro dang basbu ba dag la ni/ /brtan par byed 'dod byin gyis brlab / /rdzogs sangs rgyas su mnyam 'gro ba/ /rgyud gzhan las kyang gsungs pa yin/ /sngags ni 'di rnams 'dir brjod pa/ /gang zhig sngags ni rig pas so/ /de la/ oṃ/ tsit+ta pra ti be t+t+waṃ ka ro mi/ oṃ 22—92/

bo bye tsit+t+waṃ ut+pā da yā mi/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ oṃ pa ra badz+ra/ oṃ saṃ ha ra badz+ra āt+ma ko3haṃ / oṃ ya thā sat+tha ta thā ga ta ta ja 1a haṃ/ zhes pa'o/ /de la zla sogs yongs gyur pas/ /skad cig ye shes spyor ba yis/ /kun du bzang por bdag nyid ni/ /rgyal ba rnams bskyed rgyal ba yin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin mgon/ /rnam thar sgo gsum gyi ni zhal/ /sngon po dkar po dmar por ldan/ /g.yas dang dbus dang g.yon rnams so/ /shes rab thabs ni bdag nyid sku/ /rdo rje ral gri nor bu pad/ /gnyis kyis shes rab la 'khyud pa / /rdo rje skyil mo krung gis gnas/ /mi bskyod pa yis spyi bor brgyan/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan pa'o/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa ste/ /zhi dang sgeg pa'i gzugs 'dzin pa/ /phun tshos/sa kun byed mgon po ste/ /mtshan mo byed pa'i 'od byed pa/ /chos dbyings shin tu rnam dag pa'i/ /rang bzhin du ni bsgom par bya/ /'dod chags chen po 'dul ba yi/ /sems can khams la kun du ni/ /snod ldan la ni bltas nas ni/ /gsang ba 'dus pa'i don bstan phyir/ /dag pa'i sgyu ma'i sgra rnams kyis/ /lus la sangs rgyas rnams bcug ste/ /bde ba rdzogs pa yang dag grub/ /thams cad sangs rgyas gcig gzugs gyur/ /spyan dang gzugs kyi rdo rje sogs/ /gzugs su sprul nas phyung ba rnams/ /de rnams rang gi rig ma la/ /ji lta ba bzhin yang dag gzhug /de bzhin 'khor lo'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /bcug ste zhu bar gyur pa rnams/ /lha mo'i pad+mar spro byas la/ /rdo rje can gyis gnas par blta/ /de dag yongs su gyur pa sems/ /rten dang brten bcas dkyil 'khor te/ /mi bskyod gtso bo bsgom byas la/ /skye bo'i tshogs ni yang dag gzhug /rnam 22—925

snang la sogs sangs rgyas rnams/ /de bzhin rdo rje can gyis gzhug /byang chub sems su zhu ldan pas/ /de yis skye ba 1dbang bskur bya/ /de nas byang chub sems kyis ni/ /'gro la 'od zer reg gyur pas/ /ston pa'i byin gyis brlabs dbang gis/ /yang dag byang chub bde thob pa/ /thams cad zhal gsum phyag drug ste/ /sa snying la sogs ngo bo nyid/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo can gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan ldan/ /de phyir de rnams mnyam par ldan/ /der gnas sangs rgyas mkhas pa yis/ /sems kyis mang po gdon par bya/ /gnyug 2snama'i sa bon ji lta bas/ /dam pa'i mig dang rna ba sna/ /lce dang lus dang yid rnams kyis/ /yongs su dag pa'i rang bzhin ni/ /de ni ye shes bzang shar ba/ /sa snyeng la sogs drug po yi/ /sa bon la sogs rim bzhin yin/ / k+ṣiṃ dz+rī khaṃ shaṃ de bzhin du/ /sko 4saṃ zhes pa yi ge'i rim/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥde bzhin du/ /khaṃ re sa bon rim 'di rnams/ /gzugs sogs rdo rje drug rnams kyis5/ /gzugs sogs skye mched bdag nyid do/ / lo māṃ paṃ 6t+t+waṃ 'di zhes bya/ /sa bon sa bon rig pas brjod/ /spyan ma la sogs bzhi po ni / /sa la sogs pa'i rang bzhin yin/ /gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes dang / /'du byed dang ni rnam shes kyang / /rtag tu rnam par dag grub pa'i/ /rtag pa la sogs par gsal lo/ / bye slo dz+rī 7khaṃ hūṃ sa bon/ /'di rnams go rims ji bzhin 'gyur/ /'di ltar thams cad phyung nas ni/ /lhag pa'i lha rnams bsgrub par bya/ /de la lhag pa'i lha rnams ni/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor 'khor lo can/ /sngon bzhin rnal 'byor pas bsgul bas/ /rang gi kha ru gzhug par bya/ /de ni byang chub sems byas la/ /rdo rje nas ni son 22—926

par blta/ /rig ma'i pad+ma'i nang song ba/ /kha dog gzugs su gyur pa'o/ /shes rab thabs kyi chags chen gyi/ /rang bzhin phyir na 'od gsal ba'o/ /de ru oṃ s+dzahūṃ bsam mo/ /hoḥdamar gnyis kyi dbus bcug lalku/ /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin gyi/ /me 'bar bas ni zhu bar byas/ /'od kyi tshogs su gyur pa yi/ /'od ni 'bar bas yab yum yang / /zla ba dang 'dra zhu ba'i gzugs/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i lam bzhin gnas/ /dogs med rang nyid 3kyis bltas la/ /byams pa snying rje'i rgyu mthun dang / /dga' dang btang snyoms rang bzhin gyi/ /mā ma tī dang spyan mar grags/ /gos dkar sgrol ma mnyam pa ru/ /mi dmigs pa yi sbyor ba yis/ /de yi 'od zer las byung ba/ /'di rnams rang gi gnas bzhugs pas / /bskul bas rtsol ba bsgom par bya/ /sems can khams na gnas kyi dbang phyug byed ni rdo rje'i thugs/ /dga' ba'i yid 'ong don chen 'dod pas bdag la skyabs su gsol/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /sems can yab chen gnyen mchog bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje sku khyod bka' yi 'khor lo sems can kun la phan/ /sangs rgyas don du byang chub don dam rab tu phan par gzigs/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /'dod chags dam tshig chags pas bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /khyod ni rdo rje'i gsung ste kun la phan zhing thugs brtse ba/ /'jig rten dag ni 4don dang dgongs 5pa mdzad la rab tu brtson/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /dga' ba'i spyod pa kun du bzang po bdag la dgyes par 22—927

mdzad du gsol/ /khyod ni rdo rje 'dod pa dam tshig mchog gi phan don che/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdung mchog mnyam nyid thugs brtse ba /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /yon tan rin chen mang bo'i gter gyur 1bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /'di rnams kyis ni bskul ba'i sems/ /zhu ba'i gzugs su bsgom par bya/ /sems can don nyams mthong bas na/ /bdag nyid phun tshogs nyams pa 'dra/ /sgyu ma lta bur mos pa yis/ /chos rnams thams cad brtag par bya/ /yongs su gyur nas sangs rgyas spros/ /zhu ba 2yi ge saṃ du bsgom/ /de yongs gyur pas ral gri ste//sa bon mo 'bar yu bar ni/ /bdag gi rang bzhin de ltar bsgom/ /sems brtan de nyid rig pas so/ /de las byung ba'i sangs rgyas tshogs/ /'gro la phan par blta bar bya/ /be+er yang de ru zhugs gyur nas/ /'jam pa'i rdo rjer bsgom par bya/ /spro bya rgyan dang cod pan can/ /gur gum rlon pa'i 'od ldan pa/ /ral gri mda' dang chu skyes sngo/ /gzhu yis mtshan pa bzhi po dang / /rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyis 'khyud pa/ /shes rab 'di zhal myang bas 'gyid / /zla bar rdo rje skyil mos gnas/ /na bza' dam pas rgyan gyis mdzes / /g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal dag ni/ /sngo dkar sgeg pa'i gzugs 'dzin pa/ /sangs rgyas tshogs ni ma lus spro/ /srid gsum ma ni rab tu bsgrubs / /srid pa sdug bsngal dbang song ba/ /nyon mongs kun skyes bsal bar mdzad/ /bdag nyid bde ba dang mnyam pas/ /sdug bsngal thams cad rnam par spangs/ /rab tu rtogs pa'i snod rung ba/ /sems can kun gyi don byas te/ /snying rje chags med ngo bo yis/ /kun rdzob tu ni thabs 22—928

bstan to/ /mya ngan 'das kyang tshul bzhin du/ /yang dag ma yin sgro 'dogs srid/ /so so'i skye bor bden 'gyur ba'i/ /sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar byed/ /gang zhig 'dir ni mos byed pa/ /chos kyi dbyings kyis khyab pa'o/ /rnam par byang la zhugs pa yi/ /spang bar bya phyir 'di brjod do—/ /oṃ dhan+d+ra dhā 1tu swa bhā ba āt+ma kophohaṃ/ chung ngu'i gnyen po'i yan lag nyid—/ /chung ngu'i rgyu mthun 'bras bzang po/ /de nas mig sogs byin brlab 3pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa thob phyir bya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa/ /k+ṣiṃ yig dkar dang 'khor lo las/ /phyag dang zhal dang mtshon cha nyid/ /rnam par snang mdzad rang bzhin can/ /mig tu sa yi snying por grags/ /phyag na rdo rje rna bar son/ /zla bar dz+rī ka yig rdo rje las/ /byung ba mi bskyod pa 'dra'i gzugs/ /zla bar khaṃ dang rin chen skyes/ /sna yi nang du mkha' snying po/ /rin chen 'byung ldan dang 'dra bar/ /kha dog mtshan ma zhal rnams so/ /sgrol ma'ibadag por yang dag gnas/ /shaṃ dang mtsho skyes las byung ba/ /'jig rten mgon po lce la'o/ /kha dog la sogs dpag med 'dra—/ /mtshan mo byed bzang gzugs steng ④ gnas/ /yi ge sko lngamachog ral gri las/ /zhal sogs don yod dang 'dra bar/ /mgo bor sgrib pa rnam sel gtso—/ /'od dkar gdan la saṃ skyes tepya / /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gzugs 'dra ba—/ /snying gar kun tu bzang por grags/ /byang chub sems dpa' ྅bsgom par bya/ /thams cad rdo rje skyil mo krung / /rab 'phro rin chen cod pan can//shes rab dam pas 'khyud zhi ba/ /zla bzang la brten 'od gsal ba/ /rang gi kha dog sa bon bsgrubs/ /spro zhing bsdu ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /rang rang skye 22—929

mched bdag nyid gzugs/ /rang rang rnam par yang dag gnas/ /de bzhin mtshan rang sa bon las/ /rang gi gdan la gnas pa'i gzugs/ /gzugs sogs gzugs kyi rdo rje sogs/ /sa sogs spyan la sogs pa rnams/ /rnam snang la sogs sangs rgyas rnams/ /gzugs sogs phung po lnga po rnams/ /bsgom bya nges par mos pa yis/ /sems ni brtan pa nyid kyis ni/ /'di dag nye ba'i sgrub pa dang / /rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bur byed/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa yi/ /sku yi don du 'di bsgom bya/ /snying zlar gnas pa'i hūṃ yig las/ /yang dag byung ba'i rdor dbus su/ /de bzhin t+t+waṃ skyes rdo rje ni//phra mo bsgom bya hūṃ dang bcas/ /de yi sangs rgyas 'od zer gyis/ /sems can don byas yongs gyur nas/ /thugs kyi rdo rje dbang phyug bsgom/ /phyag na rdo rje dang 'dra mchog /thugs rdor rang snying sa bon gyi/ /'od zer las sprul gzugs rnams kyis/ /thugs kyi rdo rjes gang khyab pa/ /phyogs gnas yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /snying ga'i sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /kun du yang dag sprul pa'o/ /gzugs sogs rdo rjer gyur pa yis/ /de rigs nang zhugs bdag nyid kyis/ /mchod byas de rnams thugs rdo rje/ /byin gyis brlab phyir gsol ba gdab/ /tshigs bcad 'di gnyis rtogs byas la/ /thams cad bde byed brjod par bya/ /dpal ldan rdo rje thugs 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rnams kyis1/ /22—930

— —yon tan gyis ni mnyam gyur pa/ /de yis tshibyin gyis brlabs 2pa'i thugs/ /sems su brtan par rnam par blta/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi thugs rdo rje'i/ /bdag po dang mnyam blta bar bya/ /thugs kyi sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs/ /rdo rje'i tshig gis brjod par bya bye/ / oṃ sat+tha ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma kolhahaṃ / zhes pa ni sngags so/ /de steng nu ma'i dkyil du ni/ /mtshan ma'i dkyil du gsol gdab med/ /dam tshig sems dpa' dang 'dra ba/ /ye shes sems dpa' bsgom par bya/ /lkog mar āḥzhiskyes chu skyes lagye/ /āḥ7las byung ba'i pad+ma ni/ /phra mo sa bon bcas pa bsgom/ /gsung gi rdo rje bsam par bya/ /spyan ras gzigs dang de bye'adra bsgom/ /mkha' gnas gsung gi rdo rje bsnams/ /yang dag mchod bya gsol ba gdab/ /de yi tshigs bcad gnyis brjod do/ /chos kyi gsung lam dpal dang ldan/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms rtepas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje gsung gis 7 sna mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlab ri —1nas su/ /rdo rje gsung gis mdzad du gsol/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag kun phun tshogs/ /rang gi ngag ni mos par bya/ /sangs rgyas gsung dang mnyam gyur pa/ /sngags 'dis byin gyis brlab par bya/ /oṃ sathru ta thā ga ta wāka badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma kophohaṃ / spyi bor zla gnas oṃ las ni/ /byung saba'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ /oṃ dang 'khor lo pra las byung / /sa snying dang 'dra de 1 bltas nas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas phyogs gnas la/ /tshigs bcad gnyis kyis sgu rdor tshogs/ /byin gyis brlab phyir gsol ba gdab/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sku 'chang ba/ /rdo 22—931

rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje skus ni mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje skus ni mdzad du gsol/ /byin gyis brlab par sku bltas la/ /mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis 'bar/ /dpe byad bzang po phun tshogs pa/ /mnyam par bya phyir brjod par bya/ /oṃ sat+tha ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma kolhahaṃ/sa snying la sogs sku mthar thug /mig la sogs pa rnam dag pa/ /'di ltar mdor bsdus shes par bya/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis rgyas btab pa'o/ /chung ngu'i sgrub pa'i yan lag dang / /chung ngu'i skyes bu'i byed 'bras so/ /ji ltar chos rgyal dbang bskur ba/ /de bzhin 'dir ni dran par bya/ /ye shes sems dpa'i thugs 'od kyis/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bskul nas ni/ /'od zer las byung rig ma rnams/ /bar med khyab pa gang rnams kyis/ /pad+ma'i phyag ni nus pa yis/ /rin chen bum pa yid 'ong ba/ /rang lus rnam dag kha dog bzang / /byang chub sems kyis rab gang bas/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i rdo rjes kyang / /mchod pa sngon du 'gro ba yis/ /bdag nyid 'khor los sgyur rkyabazhin du/ /de nyid rig pas dbang bskur bya/ /spyi bor mi bskyod rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'chad par 'gyur ba'i phyag sogs ldan/ /byang chub sems ni dam pa'i chu/ /yongs su gyur bas bsgom par bya/ /ye shes chen po'i mthur shes bya/ /chung ngu'i sgrub pa chen po dang / /'bras bu yang ni dri med ni/ /chung ngu'i ngo bor rab tu bsgrags/ /rgyu mthun rgyu dang 'dra ba ste/ /rnam par smin pa lhag 'bras bu/ /gang gis 2stobs las gang skyes pa/ /'bras bu de ni 22—932

skyes bur 'dod/ /dri med bral ba'i 'bras bu ste/ /gang phyir chos kun bdag po'o—/ /ma lus sems can phun tshogs don/ /sna tshogs dri ma 'khru bas so/ /de bzhin shes rab mdun bltas la/ /rang snying bdag nyid mnyam byas pa/ /de ni sngar bzhin bsgoms nas ni/ /mig la sogs pa sbyang ba'o/ /be+er yang 'di yi bye brag ni/ /rnam pa gzhan dag brjod par bya/ /sku sogs byin gyis brlab pa la/ /tshigs bcad brjod pa spangs pa'o/ /de ni 'bring gi bsnyen sogs dang / /ldan par nye bar brtag par bya/ /thabs ni ye shes lnga yin kyang / /shes rab chags pa dag gyur te/ / dpal ldan gsang 'dus rdzogs byang chub/ /sgrub par 'dod pa'i sems la ni/ /byang chub mngon du byed 'dod pas/ /btang snyoms lam la zhugs gyur pa/ /dkar dang dkar min ljang ser dang / /dmar po ljang sngon 'od 'dra ba/ /oṃ hūṃ swā dang āḥhā ra bcas / /go rims 'dis 1ni byin gyis brlab/ /snying min sku yi rdo rjer grags—/ /lte min khyerdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /gsang min rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /gsang bar 'dod chags rdo rje'o/ /brla nas rkang pa la gtugs ladu / /don yod bltas te yi ge des/ /lha mo'i kha dog dbyibs rnams ni/ /de la de rnams brtag zipar bya/ /hūṃ skyes pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa/ /de ni dmar po 'od phreng ba/ /gsang yin rang gi gsang ba snyeyang / /rdo rjer gyur par phyornam par bsam/ /yi ge āḥdang oṃ las byung / /de dag ze 'bru nor bu dang / /sangs rgyas gzugs be+e du ma ru/ /bdag kyang bsgom par bya ba'o/ /'dod chags chags pa'i spyan gyis blta//de nas de dang bde 'dod pas/ /rgyal ba'i rjes chags bya ba yi/ /lugs yin zhes ni byas pa'i sems/ /mnyam pa'i ye shes sbyor ba yis/ /'od zer zhags pas 22—933

bkug nas ni/ /sngags pas dga' ba brtsam par bya/ /rang 'dra'i nang du lhung gyur pas/ /'dod chags nyes pa spangs nas ni/ /skal bzang ma dang rjes chags bya/ /sangs rgyas mchod phyir nga rgyal bya/ /sngags 'di nye bar brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ sadze+e ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa yi kolhahaṃ/ ting 'dzin rang don bsgom pa'o/ /'di ni dang po'i spyor ba'o/ /de'i phyir dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog /gzhan gyi don du bsgom par bya/ /ye shes sems dpa'i snying zla yi/ /yi ge saṃ gyi 'od zer gyis/ /sangs rgyas tshogs la lkugasol btab nas/ /rang gi sa bon nang gzhug bya/ /rang rig pad+ma'i khongs su ni/ /rdo rje nas ni gdon par bya/ /byang chub sems ni zhu gyur nas2/ /rang gi 'od ni 'bar ba las/ /de dag gyur pa sa bon te/ /rang gi 'od zer 'bar ba las / /de gyur rang gi sa bon dgod/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /rten dang brten pa rnam par gsal/ /gcig nyung nyi shu'i lha rnams so/ /de ru brtan par byas nas ni/ /rjes gnang thob bya rigs bdag las/ /cho ga bzhin du 'khor lo gdon/ /sgrub pa po yis sngags brjod pas/ /bden min sgro 'dogs las byung ba/ /zhe sdang rgyun ni dag pa yis/ /ma 'dres in+d+ra nī la'i 'od/ /phyag mtshan rdo rje sems dang mtshungs/ /rnam dag ye shes las grub pa/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin las/ /cung zad 'gro ba'i nyams tshul ldan/ /sangs rgyas stong ni spro byed pa/ /dmar dang gnag dang dkar po'i gzugs/ /g.yon dang dbus dang g.yas rnams so/ /badz+ra byeka gis yang dag bsgul/ /mi bskyod gtso bo gdon par bya/ /phyogs kyi sems can zhe sdang rigs/ /zhe sdang rdo 22—934

rje'i rang bzhin byas/ /yid kyis de ltar rig byas nas/ /bsdus nas bdag la bstim par bya/ /gzugs phung kun gzhi rnam par shes/ /gti mug lus ni rnam dag pa/ /me long ye shes yang dag pa/ /'khor lo ral gri nor bu pad/ /rdo rje 'dzin chen rnam pa yi/ /zhal dang kha dog rjes su byed/ /slar yang yid kyis gdon par bya/ /dzi na dzika gis rtag pa'o/ /'gro ba'i gti mug bcom nas ni/ /ma lus de yi ngo bor byas/ /de bsdus nas ni blo ldan gyis/ /mdun du ri bong dkyil 'khor dgod/ /nga rgyal nyon mongs can yod tshor/ /phung po rnam par dag gyur pa/ /mnyam nyid ye shes yang dag ldan/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje lta bu'i zhal/ /rat+na dh+rika gis rin chen dbang / /'dzam bu'i chu bo'i dang mtshungs 'od/ /bdag nyid chen pos gdon par bya/ /rin chen ral gri 'khor lo pad/ /de yis ma lus 'jig rten 'di/ /gzigs nas bdag dang mnyam par mdzod1/ /yang dag bsdus nas lho phyogs char/ /de rgo nyi mar dgod par bya/ /'du shes phung po dag 'dod chags/ /rnam rtog shes pa dag gyur pa/ /so sor yang dag rtog par bya/ / 2pad+ma ral gri nor 'khor lo/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal dag ni/ /'jam —pa'i cha byad dang 'dra'o / /snang ba mtha' yas shin tu dmar/ /ā ro t+paka gis gdon par bya//brjod bya rjod jebyed las 'das pa'i/ /chos nyid rab tu ston byed pas/ /'dod chags sems can dag byas nas/ /bzlog pa las ni yang dag byung / /'dod chags chen po la gnas pa/ /brtul zhugs can gyis 5yang dag bzung / /rgyab tu pad+ma nyi 6dkyil du/ /der 7byon gnas par yang dag blta/ /phrag dog la zhugs rnam par shes/ /'du byed phung po dag pa yis8/ /gcig tu 22—935

ljang gu mtha' yas 'od/ /ral gri 'khor lo nor bu pad/ /pradzñā dh+rika ཿgis don yod grags/ /bya ba nan tan bden pa'i lam/ /sems can kun don mdzad pa'o/ /nam mkha' khyab par spro bar bya/ /phrag dog gtso bo'i phrag dog la / /zlos rtepas rim gyis btul ke nas ni/ /bya nan ye shes dang ldan par/ /'gro ba'i rang bzhin byas nas ni/ /bsdus nas byang gi phyogs su ni/ /mtsho skyes nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /slar yang bzhugs par bsgom par bya/ /rtse gcig yid kyis gsal bar bsgom/ /kun kyang dam pa'i shes rab 'khyud/ /legs brgyan rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyis/ /rdo rje skyil mo krung bsgom bya/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan pa'o/ /sa dang snying po thabs dang ni/ /stong pa nyid sgo'i rang bzhin can/ /rtag pa'i gzugs kyis pyaspyan ma ni/ /mo ha ra tī 5 zhes pas gdon/ /sems can don la brtson pa dang / /snying rje stong pa nyid kyi sgo/ /rang gi nyes spong bsam gtan dang / /yang dag pa yi las dang ni/ /myur bar bde ba'i byang chub dang / /ma lus thabs ni gsum dag dang / /'gro ba ring du song ba las/ /ji lta'i stobs kyis gzhag byas nas/ /nyes dang 'jigs pas snyekun nyen la/ /phan phyir de ni yang dag gnas/ /bsnyus nas yid kyis blta byas te/ /me ru zhi bsgrub byed pyama'o/ /byams dang smon lam yang dag ldan/ /chu khams mtshan ma med pa yis/ /rnam dag lha mo mā ma khri / /mi bskyod rang 'od dang mtshungs pa/ /dre ṣa ra tī 5zhes bskul nas/ /kun nas 'od zer mi mnyam dang / /tshogs ni sogs ⑨par rtsom pa dang / /sems can don la rjes 'byel dang / /sangs rgyas zhing ni rnam dag dang / /'dir ni smon lam gsum dag dang / /mi g.yo ba la nges bzhugs nas/ /22—936

byams sogs dam pa la bzhugs nas1/ /'gro ba kun gyi don byas te/ /'gro ba de de 'od 'bar byas/ /bsdus nas bden bral du bkod pa/ /yang dag 'jigs pa 'joms byed ma'o/ /stobs kyi ka pha rol phyin dang me/ /dga' ba dang ni smon pa med/ /dag pa'i gos dkar mo gdon bya/ /'od dpag med pa'i btsun mor mtshungs/ /rā ga ra tre+e 3zhes bskul nas/ /sgeg pa'i nyams dang dam pa'i dga'/ /dga' ba la sogs yon tan dang / /rang las nyon mongs bdud sogs las/ /rnam par bzlog la dgod pa ste/ /de yis 'gro la phan par byas/ /'dir ni stobs ni rnam gsum dang / /legs pa'i blo gos la gzhag pa/ /ji ltar byas nas yang dag 'ongs/ /'od mdzes 'khrigs pa'i phreng ba can/ /rlung du rgyas pa 'phel mdzad ma/ /rnal 'byor pa yis bzhugs par bsgom/ /btang snyoms ye shes pha rol phyin/ /rlung dang rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /rnam dag sgrol ma gdon par bya/ /btso ma'i gser gyi 'od dang ldan / /badz+ra ra tī 4zhes sngags kyis/ /rin chen dbang gi 3zhal mdzes ma /'gro ba'i bya kun rang gi ni/ /btang snyoms yon tan sogs kyis mdzad/ /mi rtog pa dang rnam rtog dag /mnyam par rab tu rtogs pa dang / /sems can don thabs phun sum tshogs/ /lkog tu gyur pa'i rjes 'jug la/ /'gro ba thams cad nges par sbyar/ /ye shes pha rol phyin yum byudang / /chos kyi sprin gyi rang bzhin gyi/ /sa la yang dag bzhugs ༄7par bya/ /de nas sna tshogs yon tan rten/ /bsgoms nas sbyor bas bsdu byas te/ /dbang ldan du ni lha mo de/ /dbang gi las ni sgrub byed bzhugs/ /thams cad rin chen cod pan mtshan/ /lang tsho sar pas 'gying bag can/ /rdo rje skyil krung rnal 'byor ldan/ /zla 22—937

mjes gdan dang de yi 'od/ /bdag 'dra'i thabs la yang dag 'khyud/ /mdzes ma dga' bar bsgom par bya/ /phyogs kyi 'gro ba'i don byas nas/ /ji lta ji ltar da ltar byung / /'khor lo ut+pal dmar po pad/ /ut+pal ser po dang 'dra ba/ /phyag mtshan 'di rnams gtso bor 'gyur/ /lhag ma rang gi bdag por mtshungs/ /ser sna'i gnyen por gyur pa yis/ /spyan ma gnyis pa nyid yin te/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin dag pa/ /'di ltar gzugs kyi rdo rje gdon / /chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs grags/ /ji ltar nus pas sbyin pa la / /ser sna'i dri ma las krol phyir/ /'gro ba ma lus dgod par bya/ /rab ni sngon song dga' ba'i sar/ /'a1 ba'i dam pa bzhag nas ni/ — /phyi yi dkyil 'khor gyi mtshams kyi/ /me yi mtshams su gzhag par bya/ /rnam dag tshul khrims las grub pa/ /mā ma shī dang mtshungs pa de/ /sgra rdo rje grags gdon par bya/ /ngan song gis 'jigs skrag byed pa/ /sdom dang shin tu sems can don/ /dam chos yongs su 'dzin pa dang / /'dir ni tshul khrims rnam gsum la/ /tshul khrims 'chal la zhugs pa dag /snod ni ji ltar gzhag par bya/ /de bzhin dri med sa la bzhag /slar ni ji ltar gshegs bltas la/ /bden bral du ni yid 'ong ma'o/ /de bzhin bzod pa rnam dag mchog /rin chen dbang phyug shes rab mtshungs/ /sems can kun la phan ldan pa/ /dri yi rdo rje yang dag gdon/ /chos la dmigs pa phun tshogs dang / /sems can sdug bsngal lhag gnas dang / /gzhan gyis gnod pa la bzod la/ /'gro ba ma lus bkod byas te/ /des ni 'od byed sa la ni/ /rtag tu brten 1—par byed pa'o/ /rlung du mdzes pa'i gzugs can te/ /byon nas gnas par blta 22—938

bar bya/ /brtson 'grus phun tshogs rnam dag pa/ /gos dkar mo dang 'dra ba gzhan—/ /slar yang 'od dpag med 'dzin ma/ /ro yi rdo rje yang dag 'byung / /go cha bzhi ①dang rab sbyor dang / /yongs su brtan par gyur pa yi/ /'dir yang brtson 'grus rnam gsum dang / /sems can 'od 'phro la 'god de/ /ye shes bdud rtsi tshim byed pas/ /'gro ba thams cad tshim par byed/ /de byon nas ni dbang ldan du/ /yang dag gnas par mkhas pas bsgom/ /bsam gtan rnam dag yang dag grub/ /don yod rang 'od rjes byed ma/ /'jig rten rnam g.yeng zhi ba'i phyir/ /reg bya rdo rje yang dag gdon/ /mthong ba'i chos la gnas pa dang / /nyes pa sel bar byed pa dang / /khyab bdag dam pa'i bsam gtan la/ /skye bo ma lus nges sbyar te/ /kun kyang sbyang dka'i sa la ni/ /brtan par yang dag sbyar byas te/ /shar gyi sgo yi byang du ni/ /byon nas yang dag gnas par bsgom/ /shes rab pha rol phyin rnam dag /rang bzhin zhi ba'i gzugs can ma/ /kun du bzang po'i rig ma 'dra/ /de nas chos dbyings rdo rje gdon/ /sbyar bya thos dang bsam pa dang / /bsgom pa la yang bye brag tu/ /gti mug mun pa'i skye bo kun/ /mngon du gyur la brtan par byas/ /shar sgo'i lho yi cha la ni/ /dam pa'i lam mchog gsal byed ma/ /mtha' yas yon tan rgya mtsho ni/ /blo dang ldan pas gnas par bsgom/ /thams cad 'di la shes byas te/ /thabs dang rgyan dang cod pan dag /'di rnams thams cad kyi yang ni/ /rtsa ba'i mtshan ma'i khyad par ni/ /mdzes pa'i mre long pi wang can/ /dri yis rab gang dung dang ni/ /ye shes bdud rtsis gang ba yi/ /ro yi snod ni shin tu mdzes/ /sna tshogs kha dog gos dang ni/ /22—939

chos 'byung gi ni phyag rgya yang / /phyag ni g.yas pa nyid kyis ni/ /phyag rgya mchog ni yin phyir 'dzin/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yis/ /rigs kyi rim pas dgod par bya/ /gang phyir 'di skad le'u ni/ /bco brgyad pa las yang gsungs pa/ /kun kyang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su/ /dkyil 'khor du ni dgod pa'i phyir/ /de rnams gzhan du thos gyur pas/ /de rnams 'byin pa yig gsum 'dod/ /ma dang phung po 'jig tshogs lta/ /shes bya'i sgrib pa zad ces bya/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin yang dag gru lku/ /khro bo'i tshogs ni yang dag spros—/ /gdul dka' 'dul la rab brtson pa/ /thams cad du ni 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /ya mān+ta kṛta ces pas khro/ /gshin rje 'joms byed spro bar bya/ /rang gi yon tan la bkod nas/ /rnam mnan rim pa bsgoms pa las de ni shar phyogs sgor gnas bsam/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su'o/ /le lo nyon mongs bdud dang ni/ /mthar 'jigs kyelta ba mi mthun phyogs/ /rnam dag brtson 'grus yang dag 'byung / /sems can kun la phan don du/ /ma lus sdang ba'i tshogs dag ni/ /gdul ba'i don du yang dag brtson/ /bskal pa 'bar ba'i me dang mtshungs/ /de yi 'od zer nam mkha' khyab/ /lha dang lha min spyi bo yisabye/ /rin po che yis zhabs gnyis brgyan/ /pradzñān+ta kṛta ces pas khro/ /shes rab mthar byed ces pas gdon/ /rang gi brtson 'grus sogs ldan par/ /'akro ba 'dir byas byon gyur pa/ /lho yi sgo ru bsgom par bya / /mtsho skyes nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /'chi bdag brjed thungs log par lta / /skye ba'i sgrib pa mi mthun phyogs/ /rnam dag dran pa las skyes pa/ /pad+mān+ta kṛta kyis khyab bdag /gdon bya phyogs su sems can don/ /byas 22—940

pas dran sogs mchog gyur pas/ /byon nas nub phyogs sgo ru ni/ /nyi dkyil yang dag gnas pa bsgom/ /rnam g.yeng lta ba mchog tu 'dzin/ /lha yi bdud dang las sgrib dag /rnam par g.yeng la rab gtum gzugs/ /ting 'dzin dam pa'i rang bzhin gyi/ /bispyon+ta ① kṛta ces pas grol⑤/ /bgegs 'joms pa ni gdon par bya/ /de nas 'gro ba'i bya ba byas/ /mi mthun phyogs zad las de grub/ /de ni byon nas yang dag gnas/ /byang gi sgo yi nyi ma la'o/ /bgegs kyi tshogs ni ma lus pa/ /kun du 'joms par byed pa'o/ /'di dag zhal mdog mtshon cha rnams/ /srung ke ba'i 'khor lor brjod pa yin/ /de yi phyir na 'phral du ni/ /bsgom bya de rnams 'dir ma brjod/ /dgug pa dang ni gzhug pa dang / /bcing ba dang ni mnyes pa yang / /nyams pa med pa'i bya ba dag /'di rnams bye brag shes par bya/ /thams cad gdan la skyil krung ni/ /bcas pas yang dag gnas pa rnams/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po la mngon phyogs//byang chub sems dpa' 'dir mi 'dod/ /gzhan dag sems dpa'i skyil krung ngo //khro bo rnams ni g.yon brkyang gis/ /bye brag tu ni 'dir gnas so/ /'di ltar thams cad du grub ④ pa/ /dam tshig dkyil 'khor bltas nas ni/ /ye shes sems dpa'i snying 'od kyis/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor dgug par bya/ /bgegs ni mthar byed la sogs pas/ /bgegs bskrad yang dag bsrungs nas ni / /mchod yon dbul bya rang sngags kyis/ /dam pa'i tsan+dan la sogs pa'i//dgug pa la sogs las rnams ni/ /man ngag gis ni rig par bya/ /gshin rje mthar byed sogs khro bos/ /ji ltar slar yang rim bzhin du'o/ /'di ni chen po'i rgyu mthun gyisas / /yang dag 'bras skyes dam pa dang / /chen po'i 22—941

bsnyen par shes par bya/ /bsgom pa gsum gyi rang bzhin gyis/ /so sor dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyis1/ /mig sogs byin gyis brlabs pas na/ /chen po'i rnam smin 'bras don dang / /chen po'i nye bar bsgrub pa'o/ /thugs sogs byin gyis brlabs pa las/ /chen po yi ni sgrub pa dang / /chen po de las grub gyur nga / /'bras bu'ang skyes bu byed pa'o/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang thob pa/ /chen por son par gyur pa ste/ /'dir yang sgrub — pa chen po ste / /de yang dri med 'bras bur grags/ /sangs rgyas rnams la rdo rje sems//mā ma tī dang sgra rdor dag /phyag na rdo rje khro rnams las/ /pad+ma gshin rje chom gtogs pa'i/ /spyi bor mi bskyod don gyis so/ /de la'ang rdo rje 'dzin chen gnas / /thugs gsung sku rdo rje rnams kyi/ /mi bskyod dpag med rtag pa rnams / /kha cig rdo rje 'dzin par smra/ /rnam par ma spros rang bzhin la/ /ye shes lnga gcig rang bzhin pas/ /sangs rgyas lnga ru bsgrags pa yin/ /sa yi snying po gshin rje gshed/ /spyan dang gzugs kyi rdo rje yis/ /spyi bor rtag pa rin chen dbang / /dri yi rdo rje mkha' snying la'o/ /'jig rten dbang phyug pad mthar byed/ /gos dkar ro yi rdo rje yis5/ /spyi bor 'od dpag med par 'gyur/ /gtsug tu nor bu bzhin du gsal/ /sgrol ma sgrib pa rnam sel dang / /reg bya'i rdo rje cod pan yang / /dbang bskur go 'phang thob gyur nas / /'dren pa don yod grub pa bzhugs/ /kun du bzang po chos dbyings kyi/ /spyi bor yang ni gsal gyur pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'o/ /gang gis gang la dbang bskur 'dir/ /de yi de ni bdag por 'dod/ /dbang gi go 'phang gnas gyur pa/ /spyi bor rang gi bdag pos mtshan6/ /de 22—942

rnams dkyil 'khor 'dir mi bsgom/ /lhag ma nang bdag dkyil 'khor min/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis mtshan pa dang / /rigs kyi bdag po dbang bskur min/ /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin min/ /gang rnams zhal gsum phyag drug min/ /gang gis 1gang la phyogs bcu ru/ /'gro ba'i don ni byed pa min/ /dbang bskur gyi ni rjes thogs la/ /blo dang ldan pas mchod par bya thu/ /tshogs gnyis po ni 'phel phyir dang / / ye shes snying po ༄ bskyed pa'i phyir/ /ye shes snying ga'i sa bon gyi/ /'od kyis thams cad kun nas bkug ④ /de la gzugs la sogs pa'i yul/ /rang gi snying gar gzhug par bya/ /de nas zhu bar gyur bsams la/ /rdo rje'i ltalam nas rnam par 'byung / /lha mo'i pad+mar blta bar bya/ /de ni ba sru'i bu ga las/ /'od zer gzugs kyis 6de rnams dbyung / /de rnams 'od zer sgo dbyung ba/ /rgyan ni thams cad 'dzin pa rnams—/ /rtog pa las ni grol 'gyur bas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi bde rgyu yis / /sgyu ma la sogs yang dag bltape/ /'jig rten lta la mkhas pa rnams/ /nam mkhar ma lus sprul byas la/ /mchod pa 'dzin pas brel ba'i phyir/2 /gzugs rdo rje sogs lha mo'i tshogs/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam gyur pas/ /kun nas de las byung gyur pa/ /lha rdzas spos ni yid 'ong ba spyo/ /sna tshogs phyi yi me tog sogs/ /rang gi bde bar gshegs kyang mchod/ /mchod pa'i bdag nyid mnyam son par/ /mchod pa nyid du sems kyis bsam/ /mi brtan pa ni rab zhi nyid/ /sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ sadze+e ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma kophohaṃ/ thams cad sgra brnyan dang mnyam par/ /sgra yi tshogs ni nges bsams te/ /chos rnams rang las dbyer med pas/ /22—943

'dod pa'i lha yis bstod par bya/ /mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje dbyangs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri med mkha'/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal bstod//rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /rang bzhin dag pa nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nam mkha'i phyogs gnas zla ba la/ /gnas pa'i hūṃ skyes bsgom bya ste/ /de ni rdo rje hūṃ bcas so/ /de yi 'og tu 'di bsam bya/ /dung mdog gzhu dbyibs rgyal mtshan ldan/ /yo skyes rlung gi dkyil 'khor ro/ /de dbus re skyes dmar po ni//zur gsum me yi dkyil 'khor ro/ /de steng a las byung ba yi/ /pad+ma'i snod kyi dbus su ni/ /bi mu ma ra shu dang bcasalha/ /go ku da ha na rngudang lnga'o/ /sangs rgyas sa bon bum sogs kyisakye/ /go rims choji bzhin byin gyis brlab/ /de ru rdo rje dbab par bya'o/ /zhu gyur 'od zer rnams kyis ni/ /de nas thams cad zhu byas te/ /me ni rab tu gsal byas 5so/ /yi ge oṃ ni de ru dgod / /ston zla'i 'od zer phung po 'dra/ /de 'od kyis bkug sangs rgyas kyi / /bdud rtsi ma lus nang du gzhug /blo dang ldan pas bdud rtsi bzhin/ /de ni 'od zer gyis gang lta/ /oṃ s+dzaju zhes bya ba yi/ /yi ge gsum gyis byin 22—944

gyis brlab/ /rang gi snying zlar 1'khor lo ni/ /dpa' bo'i blo yis bsgom par bya/ /bdag nyid dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyis5/ /lce la rdo rje 'bar ba ste//yang dag hūṃ hūṃ nas 'bras skyes/ /rtse lnga dkar po bsgom par bya rang bzhin spyi bor bsams nas ni/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams tshim par bya/ /rtog pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /blo dang ldan pas 'di bsam mo/ /lce yi rdo rje sbu gu yis/ /blo dang ldan pas bkug par bya/ /bdag dang dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyang / /ye shes bdud rtsi chu des tshim/ /dkyil 'khor 'byin pa sngon 'gro ba'i/ /bdud rtsi myang ba'i cho ga ni/ /'di ni dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi/ /ting nge 'dzin du yongs su gnas/ /rang sems dbang du bya ba'i phyir/ /thig le'i rnal 'byor la sogs bsgom/ /ji ltar rigs par bsgom bya ste/ /las kyi rgyal mchog sgrub pa la'o/ /gcig dang du ma'i ngo bo yis/ /phyi rol dngos po yod 4ma yin/ /de phyir de yis 5'dzin pa gred / /rnam par shes kyang yod ma yin/ /de phyir 'di dag rang yid dngos/ /bag chags kyis dkrugs 6rmi lam bzhin/ /'gro ba ji lta 7ji ltar min/ /'di dag rab tu rtogs par bya/ /'di ltar spyad byas rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /ye shes snying ga'i sa bon rnams/ /spros pas 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /des ni rdzogs sangs rgyas su byas / /slar yang yid kyis bkug nas ni/ /rang gi snying gar gzhug par bya/ /tsa na ka gnas dbang gyur lta/ /rang sngags thig le'i gzugs can no/ /de yi nang song blta bar bya/ /bdag nyid lha yi dkyil 'khor 8ni/ /ye shes sems dpa'i de 'od kyis/ /thugs la sogs pa sad par bya/ /slar yang de yis thams cad ni/ /22—9 5

bar med rab tu gsal bar ro/ /ba spu'i khung bu las song ba/ /'od kyis sna tshogs kyang gsal lo/ /slar yang de nyid du bsams te/ /rab zhugs gsal ba'i gzugs su lta/ /rnal 'byor de ltar sems rtse gcig /de ni ye shes bdud rtsi 'bab / /'di ni thig le'i rnal 'byor ro/ /sngar bzhin 'od zer gyis bskul bas/ /sangs rgyas tshogs ni yang dag gzhug /rang gi sa bon rtag 3las grub/ /zhu bar gyur ces bsam par bya/ /rang rig gsang ba'i sna rtse la/ /nas tsam kyi ni tshad dag ni/ /ral gri rang sa bon skyes lta/ /de dbus yungs kar 2dang mnyam pa'i/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin phyir/ /kha dog lnga ldan bsgom par bya/ /ji skad brjod pa de'i dbus su/ /dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bsgom par bya/ /dang po —smig rgyu 'dra ba ste/ /du ba lta bu gnyis pa yin/ /mkha' snang lta bu gsum pa yin/ /mar me ltar 'bar bzhi pa yin/ /sprin med nam mkha' lta bur ni/ /rtag tu snang ba lnga pa yin / /'di ltar mtshan ma lnga rnams ni/ /sems kyis rab tu brtan gyur par 4/ /rnal 'byor pa yis 5shes par bya/ /'a1 ba'i don ni rab sgrub 6phyir/ /sprul pa yi ni dbang gyur par7/ /phan sems snying rje'i bsam pa yis/ /gzung ba la sogs ma myong bas/ /bdag nyid rig la bstan 8nas ni/ /sangs rgyas spro bar bya ba ste/ /mtshan ma'am 'od zer las sprul pas/ /'di ni phra mo'i rnal 'byor ro/ /sku gsung ye shes thugs rnams ni / /bdag nyid bsgom la rab brtson pa/ /rang mtshan lte bar gnas gyur pa/ /ji lta ji ltar rang bstan la/ /oṃ s+dzasaṃ hūṃ zhes gsal bar//blta bya der gnas blo yis ni/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa'i cho ga bya/ /'dir ni kha cig yang dag gnas/ /rlung dang chu dang dbang chen dang / /me yi dkyil 'khor dbus dag tu/ /sgu sogs sa bon gzhan dag ni/ /gzhung lugs smra bas brjod pa'o/ /22—9/6

de rjes rang gi ting 'dzin gnas/ /mkhas pas rang sngags dbye ba med/ /ring min thung ba ma yin no/ /sngags ni 'di ltar gdon par bya/ /srog gi rlung gis khyab par bya/ /oṃ la sogs pa'i sa bon gyi/ /sku la sogs pa ljo bar bya / /thams cad thugs sogs byen rlabs bzhin/ /de rnams gzugs rdo rje sogs kyis/ /der gnas mchod pa byas nas ni/ /blta bya bde mchog thob pa yis / /rtsol ba'i rlung gis bkug nas ni/ /rang rang sa bon du gzhug bya/ /rim pa 'di ltar bya ba ni/ /so sor rim ni gsum spro ba/ /brjod pas ma lus spro bar bya/ /sngags kyi blo ni bsdus byas te/ /ye shes sa bon ye shes la/ /kun nam snartag tu spro bar bya/ /'dir ni rnal 'byor kha cig gis/ /thig le phra mor yang dag ldan/ /chung ngu sogs dbye spyor ba yis/ /dang por ma skyes rang bzhin du/ /sku la sogs pa rnam par brtag /rang gi sa bon byang chub brtag /bsam gtan bzlas pa'i cho gas gnas/ /'di ni bzlas pa'i cho ga'o//zhum pa'i sems dang le lo dang / /rgod pa la ni lhag mthong bya/ /'di ltar zhum pas gzung gyur nas / /lha mo'i glu yis bskul ba ste/ /rgod pa thig le'i sbyor sogs kyis/ /de nyid bsgom pas zhi bar bya/ /dngos po rnam par dbe+ed pa yis/ /stong pa nyid ni yid la bya/ /bsgom pas bskyod pas ngal gyur na/ /de rnams zhi bar bya nyid la/ /'di ltar tshim pa'i cho ga bya/ /nyams stobs 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir/ /spyi bor mtho gang gis spags par/ /bdud rtsi dkyil 'khor bdud rtsir bcas/ /oṃ yig dkar po dang ldan lta/ /bdud rtsi 'dzag pa'i 'od dang bcas/ /de nas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin rgyun/ /rtag tu 'dzag par byed pa ni/ /srog rtsol 'od kyis 4bkug bya ste/ /blo ldan 22—9 7

gyis sku sogs la dbab1/ /'di ni tshim byed cho ga'o/ /'di ltar thang cig ngal bso 2ste/ /bde zhen gyis ni ma dkrugs par/ /thig le la sogs sngon 'gro ba'i/ /ma zhan pa yis sngags bzlas bya/ /gang tshe 'gro bar 'dod pa dang / /bsgom pa gtong bar 'dod pa yis/ /de tshe mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang / /cho ga bzhin du byas nas ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnams/ /mtshan ma'i sa bon la bsdus 4bya/ /sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad ni/ /cho ga bzhin du rim gyis so/ /gdod nas ma skyes bsgom bya ste/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid do/ /nam mkha' bzhin du ma gos pa/ /gnyis med ye shes rang bzhin no/ /'di ni las kyi rgyal mchog gi/ /ting nge 'dzin du yongs su bsgrags/ /slar yang smon lam gdab bya ste/ /sems can don ni nyer 'phel phyir/ /bdag gis 5bsod nams gang bsags dang / /'jam pa'i rdo rje bsten pa yis / /'jam pa'i rdo rjer bdag gyur nas/ /sems can sbug bsngal sgrol gyur cig /sems can don thabs phun sum tshogs/ /rnam par rgyal bas legs grub shog /sems can 'khor ba ji srid du/ /de srid 'gro la phan byed shog /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa yis7/ /sku gsum rnam par gnas pa dang / /bdag la 'gro ba re ba dang / /'dod pa bdag la sgrub par shog /'jig rten khams ni thams cad na/ /skad cig gis ni thams cad du/ /gdul ba'i thabs ni rig pa yis/ /snod dang snod min bskang bar bya/ /gdul bya ma yin kha cig ni/ /khams gsum dag tu byung gyur na/ /thams cad byang chub lam la ni/ /de rnams 22—948

bdag gis gzung 1bar bgyi/ /'di ni smon lam mo 2 lhag pa'i lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /ting nge 'dzin las langs nas ni/ /rnal 'byor yid ni chags med pas/ /snang ba'i go 'phang la gnas te/ /thams cad rang gi lha gzugs sam/ /rang gi rigs kyi rjes rim mam/ /gzugs sogs rdo rje'i ngo bo'am/ /rang rang dag par rnam par gnas/ /gnyis med ye shes rang bzhin gyis/ /rdo rje 'chang chen bdag nyid rnams/ /ji ltar thob pa'i yul rnams ni/ /dog pa med pa nye bar spyad/ /'di ni mtha' yas mchod mchog tu/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis yang dag gsungs/ /rtag tu bar med sbyor bas na/ /byang chub 'bras bu ster bar byed/ /zas la sbyor na sngar bzhin du/ /bdud rtsi myang ba'i cho gas brten/ /'di ni phyi yi sbyin sreg gam/ /gzhan nyid kyis kyang bsgre bar bya/ /yid kyis bsam 4pa tsam gyis kyang / /legs par brten pas de bzhin spyod/ /phung po'i bud shing bsregs snyepa yis/ /ye shes me ru bla na med/ /bdag nyid mchod pa nyid ni bya/ /gzhan nam rang gi lhag pa'i lha/ /rtag tu 'dod pa'i yon tan gyis/ /dam tshig 'di ni bde 6gshegs bzhed/ /sdom la gnas pas ji ltar rnyed/ /bdag nyid dam tshig ma nyams pas/ /rnyed pas nyin mo'am mtshan mo ru/ /legs par spros pas yang dag spyad/ /gang gis sems can mnyam med don/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa mchog yin te/ /gang yang lus la sogs pa'i las/ /snying rje'i bsam pas rgyal 7ba ste/ /sngags dang phyag rgya'i bdag nyid kyis/ /de kun de yir 'gyur ba ste/ /lhag pa'i lha yi spyor bdag nyid/ /gang nyid thams cad du bya ste/ /'di'am gzhan du sman pa'am/ /pha yis bu la 22—949

bslab ched du/ /'bras bu med la phan bsams pas/ /las kyi gnod pa rtsom par byed/ /shes rab thabs kyi cho ga dang / /dngos kun bdag nyid rig pa yis/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam pa'i sems/ /gnyis med rnal 'byor min zhes 'gyur/ /don yod grub pa'i spyor ldan pas/ /de yi 'khor lo'i dbus gnas te/ /ji ltar tshul bzhin dbang bskur ba/ /dam tshig nyams pa blang bar bya/ /rang gi ye shes thugs zla ru/ /khams —4skyes sna tshogs rdo rjer gnas/ /zla bar 2khaṃ yig bcas bsams nas/ /'od zer gyis ni rgyal ba bsgul/ /slar yang 'di ni khyad par te/ /dbang bsgur sngon du song ba yis/ /bla ma brnyas la sogs nyes pa/ /bshags dang sbyin dang mchod ston no/ /sngar kyi dbang bskur bzhin du khrus/ /rang gi 'khor lo'i bdag spyor ldan/ /thun mtshams gsum du bsgom bya ste/ /las dang po yis mnyam mar bya/ /rang gis sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /sngar bzhin du ni nyer bsdus te/ /ye shes 'khor lor mnyam son pas/ /shes rab snying rjer ldan pas nyal/ /nang par nyal bas 4ldang ba na/ /lha mo'i glu yis bskul ba ste/ /sngar bzhin bsgom pa sngon 'gro bas/ /rtag tu sngags kyi 5bzlas pa brtsam/ /nye ba'i sgrub pa nas brtsams te/ /ye shes cung zad thob bdag po/ /sngags kyi tshul khrims brtul zhugs ldan/ /dang po'i las dang 'dra bar bsgom/ /spro ba dang ni bsdu bar ldan/ /slar yang yang dag ye shes so/ /skad cig gis ni ye shes rdzogs/ /mtshan min rnal 'byor yang dag bsten/ /so sor dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ /rtag tu snang bas phan pa bsgom/ /'khor lo bdag nyid gzugs kyis ni/ /mtshan ma gnyis ni thob gyur pa/ /dang bo'i las can 22—950

'dir shes bya/ /de nas re re 'phel ba ni/ /lhag ma'i rnal 'byor par shes bya / /ting 'dzin gsum ni yongs rdzogs pa/ /snga ma bzhin du las dang po'i//'byin pa'i dkyil 'khor sngon song ba/ /lhag ma'i mtshams la bsgom pa yi/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor 'byin pa dang / /slar yang sprul pa'i 'khor sdud ༄1pa/ /gang tshe nyal bar 'dod gyur zhes/ /rnal 'byor pa ni gzhan dag smra/ /rdul tshon dkyil 'khor bri ba'am/ /yid kyis sprul par bya ba yang / /sku gsung thugs ni legs mchod pa/ /cho ga bzhin du der mchod nas/ /rang 'dod lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /'khor lo'i dbus su yang dag gnas/ /'dod pa'i dngos po bsgrub par bya/ /de yi rgyu la sems brtan pas/ /sngar gsungs bdud rtsi 'khyel pa spro ba'i khro bo'i 'od zer nam mkhar 'bar/ /'khor lo'i bdag po shes bya cho ga yis ni rang nyid de yi rnal 'byor ldan/ /nges par chos kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog nyid ces pa nyid du rig par bya/ /log 'dren bgegs ni sun phyung bcom ldan 'das kyis 3bdag nyid dbang ni bsgur bar bya//mi bskyod pas dbe+en slar yang gal te sangs rgyas de yi bdag por 'gyur/ /'khor lo'i bdag po de yi gnas zhugs dbus kyi lte ba'i 4cha la ldan/ /de ni 5bcom ldan mi bskyod ces su gsal bar gzhan gyis 6gzhung dag smra byed kyang / /gsang bar yang ni 'khor lo'i bdag po gsang ba de yang 'gyur zhes 'dir smra mi rigs min/ /'dir ni dag pa'i blo can rnams kyis me long la sogs gzugs la sogs pa dag par brjod/ /rnam par shes pa de yi bdag por gyur pas dbus kyi gdan la rig 7par 'dod/ /spyir btang las gzhan 'dir ni gzhan 8dag 9ni/ /nyams myong gcig pa nyid de de kho nas/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas 22—93/

ma yin nyid du mnyam/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas min par ji ltar rten/ /zhi dang 'khrul pa'i dri ma'i 1rnyog pas gos 3pa'i yid ni dag pas dkar ba'i gzugs / /sems can bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i yid kyis rgyas pa ser ba'i 'od/ /dmar po 'dod chags rnam dag kun gyi dbang gis 3cho ga la ni spyor gyur pa/ /bya ba nan tan zhes bya'i ngo bor gyur pas bai ḍūr+ya yi kha dog 'bar/ /zhe sdang nyon mongs rnam dag kyang ni shin tu sdang ba rnams la gnag pa'i 'od/ /me long la sogs mi 'dod pas na ji ltar yang 'dir zhe sdang dag /rdo rje can gyis me long sogs su gyur pa sngon po'i gzugs su gang gis yin / /ci'i phyir dbus su zhe sdang rnam dag grub sku dkar po la sogs mdzes par 'gyur/ /ji ltar spyir btang la yang 'di ni nang 'dus rang gi bdag dang mi bskyod gnyis/ /de'i phyir bde bar gshegs par gcig gyur gzhan min de yi gzugs mi bsten/ /'di ltar gzhan du 'gal ba spang ba'i blo rnams ji ltar yang dag gsungs/ /tha dad ye shes kyis byas gyur pas ji ltar sgrol ma la sogs gnyis su rtogs/ /ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid rnams ni 'di rnams nges par ye shes so so ste5/ /lhag par grags pa gang gis gang du myur ba ye shes de'i dag pa / /ye shes kyis 'gyur kha dog gnas pa rtog pas gal te kha dog yin gyur na//dkyil 'khor bdag po 'jam dpal gsal ba nyid du nges par bdag 6po nyid du 'gyur / /rdo rje can gyi 7lugs ni gal te 'ga' zhig yod na bde gshegs gnas la brten/ /rang rigs dbang phyug dang ni rgyal ba'i sras po 'khor lo'i bdag por gnas par bya/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas ma yin bdag nyid ngor mtshon gang zhig gsang ba'i 'khor dbang phyug /mi bskyod nges par bdag por 22—932

gyur na rnam par snang mdzad la sogs gnyis su 'gyur/ /dpal ldan ye shes zhabs kyi lam zhugs bla ma rjes bsten pas/ /bdag gis man ngag khyad par gang zhig cung zad thob gyur pa/ /'di ༄lngani de yi dran pa nyams par ma gyur zhes phyir dang / /de phyir 'di ni yang dag spel ba bdag mnyam blo la phan phyir ro / /legs par bsdu byas bde ba'i sgrub thabs byang chub lam thob pa/ /'dir ni bdag gis 2gang zhig mnyam pa med pa'i bsod nams grangs/ /dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa'i cho ga nyid kyis skyon spangs pa/ /de yis byang chub mchog gi go 'phang skye bos thob par shog /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyis 4gdul bya ma yin spangs gyur pa/ /bsam gyis mi khyab rnams la phyogs bcur gnas pa'i sems can rnams/ /de yis byang chub sgrub pa'i ched du rgyal bas byen zhes pas/ /dga' ba'i sgrub thabs zhes grags 'di ni bdag gis bkod / /dga' ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon chen po rgyal bas byin pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta pad+ma ka ra warma dang / lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur6// //22—953
